We also reinvest a significant percentage of our revenue back into research and development, ensuring our employees have the resources to innovate and make a lasting impact. Recognized by Forbes as a top private cloud company and honored as one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, we offer flexibility, growth opportunities, and meaningful work. 
 
At PointClickCare, we empower our people to be the architects of a smarter healthcare future; one that is human-first and accelerated by AI to create meaningful and lasting change. Employees harness AI as a catalyst for creativity, productivity, and thoughtful decision-making. By integrating AI tools into our daily workflows, collaboration is enhanced, outcomes are improved, and every team member has the proficiency to maximize their impact. It all starts with our hiring practices where we uncover AI expertise that complements our mission, and we continue to invest in training and development to nurture innovation throughout the employee journey.
 
Join us in redefining healthcare — so it doesn’t just survive, it thrives. To learn more about PointClickCare, check out Life at PointClickCare and connect with us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn.
 
About the Team
The People Strategy & Transformation (PST) is PointClickCare's HR strategy, organizational design, and portfolio management pillar. The team includes HR Business Partners, Organizational Design & Effectiveness, People Experience, and the HR Strategy & Enablement function, with a dotted-line partnership to Internal Communications. PST is responsible for ensuring HR's work across every Center of Excellence is planned, resourced, sequenced, and tracked against business outcomes — spanning a portfolio of Pillar Initiatives, Cross-Pillar Projects, and Program Roll-Ups delivered across all four HR solution groups.
 
Position Summary:
The Director, People Strategy and HR Portfolio (Project) Management s is the VP, People Strategy & Transformation's strategic thought partner in building and running PointClickCare's HR Portfolio Management Office (HR PMO) — co-designing the strategy, governance model, capacity methodology, and dashboard reporting that let HR plan, resource, and track its work against business outcomes. This is a net-new function: no HR PMO currently exists at PointClickCare, and this role will design these mechanics in partnership with the VP rather than operate a system someone else has already built.

Operating with significant design authority but without direct reports or final decision rights on cross-functional trade-offs, this role earns influence through the credibility of the mechanics it builds and runs. It operates across all four HR solution groups without formal authority over any of them, serves as the VP's thought partner on HR strategy and the HR SLT prioritization process, and convenes HR initiative stakeholders and Internal Communications to coordinate how HR's work reaches the business.
 
Key Responsibilities:
Design and run the HR Portfolio Management Office’s core operating mechanics
Design and maintain the capacity management methodology, including the heat map model and the oversubscription thresholds used to flag resourcing conflicts across HR COEs
Own and run the Portfolio Council governance cadence end to end — intake, capacity check, tier assignment, publish, mid-quarter check, and close-out
Build and maintain the integrated HR initiative dashboard, ensuring data currency and accuracy across every active Pillar Initiative, Cross-Pillar Project, and Program Roll-Up
Example deliverable: a quarterly Portfolio Council capacity heat map showing every HR COE’s current initiative load, used to approve or defer new initiative intake
Serve as strategic thought partner to the VP, People Strategy & Transformation
Co-design the HR SLT prioritization process and criteria used to evaluate and sequence HR initiatives each planning cycle
Co-design the OKR and scorecard measurement architecture — what gets measured, how it rolls up, and the cadence it runs on
Co-author and stress-test the HR Strategy on a Page, contributing independent analysis before it is finalized by the VP
Example deliverable: a documented HR SLT prioritization framework — criteria, weighting, and process — adopted for the FY28 planning cycle
Own capacity management and project plan oversight across the full HR initiative portfolio
Track progress against committed business outcomes, not activity completion alone, across every active HR initiative
Maintain consistent project plan structure, milestone tracking, and dependency mapping in partnership with each initiative’s named Delivery Lead
Proactively surface cross-COE capacity collisions and resourcing conflicts before they reach Portfolio Council
Example deliverable: a consolidated project plan view across all active Program Roll-Ups, flagging dependency risk before it affects a committed milestone
Convene HR initiative stakeholders and Internal Communications on a recurring cadence
Establish and run a recurring go-to-market coordination cadence bringing together initiative Delivery Leads and Internal Communications
Sequence the timing and stakeholder readiness of HR initiative rollouts to the business, avoiding duplicate or conflicting messages landing in the same window
Maintain a shared go-to-market calendar visible to HR SLT, showing what is launching, when, and to whom
Example deliverable: a quarterly HR go-to-market calendar sequencing every planned initiative rollout to the business, reviewed and approved by HR SLT before the quarter begins
Represent HR in enterprise planning and governance forums
Serve as the primary operational liaison to the Strategic Delivery Office, aligning HR’s initiative classification and intake practices to enterprise taxonomy
Represent HR’s initiative portfolio and capacity picture in the Corporate Strategy Group’s quarterly planning cadence
Flag enterprise-level dependencies or conflicts affecting HR’s ability to deliver against committed priorities
Example deliverable: HR’s consolidated initiative and capacity submission into the Corporate Strategy Group’s quarterly planning sprint, reflecting current Portfolio Council status
 
Required Skills & Qualifications:
10–15 years of experience in program/portfolio management, management consulting, or a PMO leadership capacity, including demonstrated experience designing — not only operating — portfolio governance, capacity management, or OKR measurement systems
A track record serving as a strategic thought partner to a senior leader, with evidence of shaping that leader's thinking rather than only executing direction
Demonstrated experience operating in matrixed, cross-functional environments without formal authority over the teams being coordinated
Strong data and dashboard fluency — comfortable architecting reporting tools and the metrics model behind them, not just maintaining an existing build
Executive-level communication skills — this role prepares materials for and interacts directly with VP-level stakeholders across every HR pillar
Experience convening cross-functional stakeholder groups to coordinate sequencing and alignment on complex, multi-team initiatives
 
Preferred Experience:
Experience building a PMO or governance function from scratch, in a design capacity, rather than operating within an already-mature one
HR domain experience, including familiarity with COE structures and business-outcome-linked workforce initiatives
Experience partnering with internal communications or marketing functions on coordinated, multi-stakeholder rollouts

jobs.description:
Our Purpose 

 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

 Title and Summary 

Regional Director, Digital Assets Sales & Commercialization, North America 

Overview

Mastercard is seeking a highly strategic, commercially focused, and externally oriented Director, Regional Commercialization, Digital Assets to lead the growth, market expansion, and commercialization of Mastercard's BVNK solution across NAM Region. This sales executive will play a critical role in establishing Mastercard's leadership position in next-generation payments by driving adoption of Mastercard's stablecoin capabilities and BVNK-powered solutions.

He/she will define and execute the regional go-to-market strategy, shape ecosystem partnerships, and drive revenue growth across financial institutions, fintechs, payment service providers, marketplaces, digital merchants, and emerging payment innovators.

The successful candidate will serve as Mastercard's expert sales leader for accelerating the adoption and usage of MA’s BVNK solution opportunities, working closely with BVNK Senior Sales leadership, MA Regional Sales and Product leadership and account management teams, market development and MA Move teams to originate, structure, and accelerate strategic opportunities. The role requires balancing commercialization execution with long-term ecosystem development and strategic market expansion.

This is a highly visible expert sales role requiring deep expertise in payments, digital assets, cross-border flows, stablecoins, fintech ecosystems, and platform commercialization.

Role

The Director, Regional Commercialization, Digital Assets will be accountable for driving market adoption, revenue growth, and ecosystem expansion for BVNK and MA’s digital asset solutions across NAM Region.

The role serves as the BVNK expert sales leader connecting BVNK’s solutions, Mastercard's capabilities, and regional customer opportunities.

Key Responsibilities 

Strategic Leadership & Commercialization 

• Define and execute the regional commercialization strategy for Mastercard's BVNK- powered solutions and stablecoin offerings 

• Collaborate with MA account teams to advance pipeline generation, strategic partnerships, client acquisition, and revenue realization. 

• Establish regional priorities, target segments, and market expansion strategies 

Revenue Growth & Market Expansion 

• Lead targeted regional sales efforts focused on MA customer segments including financial institutions, fintechs, PSPs, remittance providers, marketplaces, merchants, and digital economy participants. 

• Develop and govern a robust pipeline of high-value opportunities while supporting deal progression from origination through contract execution, retention and growth. 

• Sponsor strategic pursuits and executive-level client engagements for priority opportunities. 

• Drive achievement of revenue, transaction volume, and market adoption goals across the region. 

• Identify new market opportunities, geographic expansion priorities, and emerging use cases that create sustainable growth. 

Executive Client Engagement 

• Evangelize BVNK and MA’s digital assets and stablecoin-based payment solutions. 

• Build and maintain executive relationships with key Account Managers, clients, and ecosystem partners. 

• Provide stablecoin expert sales for strategic client discussions, executive briefings, workshops, and solution design engagements. 

• Support regional sales teams in navigating complex opportunities and executive-level negotiations. 

Strategic Partnerships & Ecosystem Development 

• Identify emerging partnership opportunities that accelerate adoption of Mastercard and BVNK’s digital asset capabilities. 

• Monitor competitive, regulatory, and market developments and translate insights into commercialization strategies. 

Product & Market Development 

• Partner with BVNKs product teams to inform client insights, competitive analysis, product strategy, roadmap prioritization, market readiness decisions, and future product investments. 

• Develop regional growth strategies around key digital asset use cases, including: 

 • Stablecoin-enabled cross-border payments 

 • Remittances 

 • Merchant payouts and settlement 

 • Treasury and liquidity management 

 • B2B payments 

 • Disbursements 

 • Marketplace payouts 

 • Wallet funding and cash-out solutions 

• Assess market readiness and prioritize opportunities by country, client segment, use case, and revenue potential. 

All About You 

Required Qualifications 

• Significant experience leading commercialization, business development, product, or growth initiatives within payments, digital assets, fintech, cross-border payments, or financial technology. 

• Demonstrated ability to originate, negotiate, and close complex strategic partnerships and enterprise opportunities. 

• Deep understanding of the payments and financial services landscape across NAM Region. 

• Experience engaging and influencing C-level executives and senior decision-makers. 

• Ability to lead through influence across highly matrixed global organizations. 

• Strong executive presence with exceptional communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. 

• Demonstrated success operating within rapidly evolving and ambiguous market environments. 

• Ability to translate emerging technologies and market trends into commercial business opportunities. 

• Willingness to travel across the region. 

Preferred Qualifications 

• Experience in digital assets, stablecoins, blockchain-based payment infrastructure, or crypto-financial services. 

• Experience commercializing emerging or nascent payment technologies at scale. 

• Strong network across the banking, fintech, digital commerce, and payments ecosystem within the region. 

• Experience developing market-entry strategies and scaling new business lines globally or regionally. 

• Background in consultative sales, strategic partnerships, product leadership, or general management. 

Success Measures 

Success in this role will be measured by: 

• Achievement of regional digital asset revenue and business growth objectives. 

• Strategic pipeline creation, conversion, and closed revenue. 

• Expansion of Mastercard's stablecoin and BVNK-powered solution adoption. 

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly. 

 Corporate Security Responsibility 

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
 Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

 Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

 Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

 Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in Canada, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive pay based on location, experience and other qualifications for the role and may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. This posting reflects one or more current openings on our team.

 Job Description: 
 VP, Business Group Information Security Officer, Sun Life Canada 

 Job Purpose  

 The Vice-President, Business Group Information Security Officer, Canada (BG CISO) serves as a senior security leader and partner to the Business Group leadership team and Business Group President.  Acting as the senior security executive for the Business Group and the primary bridge between the business and enterprise Security function, the BG CISO provides independent oversight and challenge of cyber risk, resilience and security outcomes across the business group. 

 The BG CISO, Sun Life Canada is accountable for cyber risk, resilience, and security outcomes for Sun Life Canada, one of the company’s core markets and a leader in health, wealth and protection, serving Clients across Canada through group benefits, individual insurance, wealth, advice and distribution channels.  

The Canadian business is made up of complex ecosystems, requiring strong alignment with Canadian regulatory expectations, enterprise risk practices and digital/client-service priorities.  Reporting directly to the global Chief Security Officer this position will have direct and indirect reports including a team of ~ 10 security leads and advisors aligned to the Canada business and subsidiary priorities including oversight of Dialogue security, product/platform risk, incident readiness, and stakeholder engagement. 

 The BG CISO partners closely with executives, technology leaders, risk partners, and the enterprise security team to protect critical assets, enable innovation, strengthen resilience, and ensure risks are understood and managed within the organization's risk appetite. The BG CISO is accountable for providing independent business-aligned security oversight while enabling growth, innovation and transformation across the Business Group. The role translates complex cyber and security risks into business impacts and shapes strategy, investments, priorities, and operating decisions across the Business Group.  

 Scope, Decision Authority and Key Interfaces  

 The Vice-President, Business Group Information Security Officer serves as the senior security executive and trusted advisor to the Business Group President and leadership team. The role is accountable for cyber risk oversight, executive advisory services, security governance, resilience alignment, regulatory engagement, and independent challenge across the assigned business group. The Vice-President translates enterprise security strategy into business-relevant actions while ensuring cyber risk, resilience, regulatory obligations, and security priorities are appropriately considered within business decisions and transformation initiatives.  

 The Vice-President has delegated authority to establish business-group security governance routines, direct security assessments, challenge risk decisions, require remediation planning, recommend security investment priorities, and escalate material cyber and resilience concerns through appropriate governance channels. Within approved authorities, the role provides independent advice and challenge regarding cyber risk, resilience, technology transformation, regulatory obligations, third-party risk, and risk acceptance decisions. Where management disagreement exists regarding material cyber risk acceptance, the matter will be escalated to the Global Chief Information Security Officer for review and discussion with the applicable Business Group President before a final decision is made. 

 The role is accountable for business-group security oversight, executive advisory services, risk escalation, independent challenge, alignment of enterprise security services to business priorities, and operational ownership of Business Group Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) platforms and associated security outcomes. The role does not own enterprise cyber defence operations, enterprise security platform engineering, vulnerability remediation, incident response operations, or second-line risk oversight except where responsibilities are expressly assigned. The Vice-President works closely with Enterprise Security leaders to ensure Business Group CIAM capabilities remain aligned with enterprise architecture, security standards, resilience requirements, and regulatory obligations. 

 Matters escalated to the Chief Information Security Officer would typically include significant cyber or operational resilience concerns, material breaches of risk appetite, major regulatory matters, unresolved management actions, significant third-party security issues, material client commitments, or disagreements regarding risk acceptance, prioritization, or investment decisions. 

 Major Accountabilities   

 Strategic Security Leadership and Vision  
 Serve as the primary Security advisor to the Business Group executive team and Business Group President. 
 Accountable for defining and driving the Business Group security strategy, aligned to enterprise security priorities and business objectives. 
 Ensure security considerations are integrated into business strategy, transformation initiatives, digital strategies, and operational decision-making. 
 Report significant changes in risk to appropriate levels of leadership on a periodic and event-driven basis.  
 Exercise independent challenge and escalate material cyber, technology, resilience and security risks through appropriate governance forums when risk exposure exceeds established risk appetite or remediation commitments are not achieved.  
 Deliver timely insights and data to enable informed executive decision-making, prioritization, and risk-based trade-offs.  
 Influence and shape multi-year security, resilience, and technology risk investment strategies, ensuring resource allocation aligns with business priorities, regulatory expectations and evolving threat landscapes.  
 Identify emerging threats, trends, and regulatory developments that may impact the Business Group and proactively develop mitigation strategies. 

 Business Partnership & Influence  
 Build trusted relationships with business and technology executives. 
 Act as the voice of the Business Group within the CISO organization and as the voice of the CISO organization within the Business Group. 
 Facilitate effective collaboration between business stakeholders and enterprise security teams. 
 Influence business group investment priorities and strategic trade-offs related to cyber risk, resilience, regulatory obligations, and secure technology adoption 

 Cyber Risk Management  
 Accountable for the Business Group’s cyber risk posture, control effectiveness and security outcomes, ensuring material risks are identified, assessed, escalated, remediated, or formally accepted through appropriate governance and in alignment with enterprise risk appetite. 
 Facilitate cyber risk assessments across application/platform/system levels to identify vulnerabilities and potential threats, analyze impacts, and recommend protection required based on threat modeling. 
 Support business leaders in making informed risk decisions consistent with enterprise policies and risk appetite. 
 Work with the Global Cyber threat intelligence team and monitor evolving threat landscapes and advise leaders on risk implications and required actions. 
 Provide oversight of BG specific third-party cyber risk related to critical vendors, strategic partners, outsourced services, and technology providers, ensuring security risks are appropriately identified, assessed, governed, monitored and escalated as appropriate.  
 Provide independent security advice on material risk acceptance decisions and ensure risks exceeding approved appetite or delegated authority are escalated to the appropriate enterprise and business governance forums.  

 Governance, Regulatory & Compliance  
 Lead security governance activities within the Business Group. 
 Oversee regular reporting and ensure alignment to global functional teams 
 Represent Security on business governance forums, executive committees, and risk councils. 
 Ensure effective management of applicable cybersecurity, technology risk, operational resilience, regulatory, legal, and policy requirements within the Business Group. 
 Represent the Business Group during regulatory examinations, supervisory reviews, external assessments and cybersecurity-related audits.  
 Hold leaders accountable to effective remediation of audit findings, regulatory issues, and control deficiencies. 

 Security Integration & Transformation  
 Partner with the enterprise security team to ensure security services and controls meet the needs of the Business Group. 
 Provide security leadership for major initiatives, acquisitions, client commitments, strategic partnerships, and technology transformations, including cyber due diligence, risk assessment, integration planning, and oversight of material remediation commitments. 
 Enable secure adoption of emerging technologies, including cloud, AI, automation, and digital solutions, ensuring appropriate cybersecurity, data protection, privacy, and governance controls are embedded throughout the lifecycle. 
 Provide oversight of information protection, data security, AI security and emerging technology risks ensuring critical information assets are protected and used responsibly and in compliance with regulatory and enterprise requirements.  
 Champion a secure-by-design approach across technology and business initiatives. 

 Incident Preparedness & Resilience  
 Serve as the senior security executive for the Business Group during significant cyber incidents, operational disruptions, and crisis events, coordinating with enterprise incident response, business continuity, legal, privacy, risk, communications, and business leadership to support timely decisions, escalation, recovery and reporting. 
 Oversee the Business Group’s cyber and operational resilience preparedness, including alignment with business continuity and crisis management, scenario testing, crisis simulations, recovery planning and oversight of resulting remediation actions.  
 Oversee the Business Group’s cyber risk assessment program across critical applications, platforms, systems, business processes, and transformation initiatives, ensuring material vulnerabilities, and threats are evaluated, prioritized, and addressed based on business impact and threat-informed analysis. 

 Security Culture & Awareness  
 Foster a strong security culture across the Business Group. 
 Promote accountability for risk management among leaders and employees. 
 Drive awareness and adoption of security best practices. 

 Leadership & Talent Development  
 Lead a network of business-aligned security leaders and professionals from across the Business Group and affiliate entities, providing strategic direction, oversight, and coordination of security priorities within a complex global matrix environment.  
 Present cyber risk, resilience, security posture, and emerging threats to executive committees, governance forums, and board-level audiences as required.  
 Lead through influence across complex matrixed environments. 
 Represent both the enterprise security function and business group with senior executives, regulators, auditors, and within industry forums.  
 Demonstrate executive presence and credibility with senior leaders. 
 Balance risk management with commercial and strategic objectives. 
 Drive informed decision-making under ambiguity and changing conditions. 
 Act as a trusted advisor capable of challenging constructively when risks warrant escalation. 

 Qualifications  

 Education  
 University degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Technology, Risk Management, Business, or a related discipline. 
 Relevant security certifications preferred (CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CGEIT, or equivalent). 

 Experience  
 15+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, information security, technology risk, risk management, or related disciplines. 
 Experience advising senior global executives on technology and cyber risk matters. 
 Experience operating in highly regulated environments. 
 Proven ability to influence strategic and investment decisions at an executive level. 
 Experience leading large-scale transformation, risk, or security initiatives. 

 Key Knowledge & Skills  
 Deep understanding of information security, cyber risk, regulatory requirements, and resilience frameworks. 
 Strong business acumen and ability to translate technical risks into business impacts. 
 Exceptional stakeholder management and executive communication skills. 
 Strong understanding of enterprise technology, cloud, data, AI, and digital platforms. 
 Strategic leader with the ability to anticipate and address emerging risks and opportunities. 
 Strong judgment, influence, and decision-making capability. 
 Ability to lead through influence in a matrixed global organization. 

 Success Profile  
 The ideal candidate combines the credibility of a security leader with the mindset of a business executive. They are a trusted advisor to senior leaders, capable of enabling growth and innovation while ensuring risks are effectively understood, governed, and managed. 

 The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues.  We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling. 

 We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

 Influence and shape multi-year security, resilience, and technology risk investment strategies, ensuring resource allocation aligns with business priorities, regulatory expectations and evolving threat landscapes.  
 Identify emerging threats, trends, and regulatory developments that may impact the Business Group and proactively develop mitigation strategies. 

 Business Partnership & Influence  
 Build trusted relationships with business and technology executives. 
 Act as the voice of the Business Group within the CISO organization and as the voice of the CISO organization within the Business Group. 
 Facilitate effective collaboration between business stakeholders and enterprise security teams. 
 Influence business group investment priorities and strategic trade-offs related to cyber risk, resilience, regulatory obligations, and secure technology adoption 

 Cyber Risk Management  
 Accountable for the Business Group’s cyber risk posture, control effectiveness and security outcomes, ensuring material risks are identified, assessed, escalated, remediated, or formally accepted through appropriate governance and in alignment with enterprise risk appetite. 
 Facilitate cyber risk assessments across application/platform/system levels to identify vulnerabilities and potential threats, analyze impacts, and recommend protection required based on threat modeling. 
 Support business leaders in making informed risk decisions consistent with enterprise policies and risk appetite. 
 Work with the Global Cyber threat intelligence team and monitor evolving threat landscapes and advise leaders on risk implications and required actions. 
 Provide oversight of BG specific third-party cyber risk related to critical vendors, strategic partners, outsourced services, and technology providers, ensuring security risks are appropriately identified, assessed, governed, monitored and escalated as appropriate.  
 Provide independent security advice on material risk acceptance decisions and ensure risks exceeding approved appetite or delegated authority are escalated to the appropriate enterprise and business governance forums.  

 Governance, Regulatory & Compliance  
 Lead security governance activities within the Business Group. 
 Oversee regular reporting and ensure alignment to global functional teams 
 Represent Security on business governance forums, executive committees, and risk councils. 
 Ensure effective management of applicable cybersecurity, technology risk, operational resilience, regulatory, legal, and policy requirements within the Business Group. 
 Represent the Business Group during regulatory examinations, supervisory reviews, external assessments and cybersecurity-related audits.  
 Hold leaders accountable to effective remediation of audit findings, regulatory issues, and control deficiencies. 

   Security Integration & Transformation  
 Partner with the enterprise security team to ensure security services and controls meet the needs of the Business Group. 
 Provide security leadership for major initiatives, acquisitions, client commitments, strategic partnerships, and technology transformations, including cyber due diligence, risk assessment, integration planning, and oversight of material remediation commitments. 
 Enable secure adoption of emerging technologies, including cloud, AI, automation, and digital solutions, ensuring appropriate cybersecurity, data protection, privacy, and governance controls are embedded throughout the lifecycle. 
 Provide oversight of information protection, data security, AI security and emerging technology risks ensuring critical information assets are protected and used responsibly and in compliance with regulatory and enterprise requirements.  
 Champion a secure-by-design approach across technology and business initiatives. 
 Incident Preparedness & Resilience  
 Serve as the senior security executive for the Business Group during significant cyber incidents, operational disruptions, and crisis events, coordinating with enterprise incident response, business continuity, legal, privacy, risk, communications, and business leadership to support timely decisions, escalation, recovery and reporting. 
 Oversee the Business Group’s cyber and operational resilience preparedness, including alignment with business continuity and crisis management, scenario testing, crisis simulations, recovery planning and oversight of resulting remediation actions.  
 Oversee the Business Group’s cyber risk assessment program across critical applications, platforms, systems, business processes, and transformation initiatives, ensuring material vulnerabilities, and threats are evaluated, prioritized, and addressed based on business impact and threat-informed analysis. 

 Security Culture & Awareness  
 Foster a strong security culture across the Business Group. 
 Promote accountability for risk management among leaders and employees. 
 Drive awareness and adoption of security best practices. 

 Leadership & Talent Development  
 Lead a network of business-aligned security leaders and professionals from across the Business Group and affiliate entities, providing strategic direction, oversight, and coordination of security priorities within a complex global matrix environment.  
 Present cyber risk, resilience, security posture, and emerging threats to executive committees, governance forums, and board-level audiences as required.  
 Lead through influence across complex matrixed environments. 
 Represent both the enterprise security function and business group with senior executives, regulators, auditors, and within industry forums.  
 Demonstrate executive presence and credibility with senior leaders. 
 Balance risk management with commercial and strategic objectives. 
 Drive informed decision-making under ambiguity and changing conditions. 
 Act as a trusted advisor capable of challenging constructively when risks warrant escalation. 

 Qualifications  

 Education  
 University degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Technology, Risk Management, Business, or a related discipline. 
 Relevant security certifications preferred (CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CGEIT, or equivalent). 

 Experience  
 15+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, information security, technology risk, risk management, or related disciplines. 
 Experience advising senior global executives on technology and cyber risk matters. 
 Experience operating in highly regulated environments. 
 Proven ability to influence strategic and investment decisions at an executive level. 
 Experience leading large-scale transformation, risk, or security initiatives. 

 Key Knowledge & Skills  
 Deep understanding of information security, cyber risk, regulatory requirements, and resilience frameworks. 
 Strong business acumen and ability to translate technical risks into business impacts. 
 Exceptional stakeholder management and executive communication skills. 
 Strong understanding of enterprise technology, cloud, data, AI, and digital platforms. 
 Strategic leader with the ability to anticipate and address emerging risks and opportunities. 
 Strong judgment, influence, and decision-making capability. 
 Ability to lead through influence in a matrixed global organization. 

 Success Profile  
 The ideal candidate combines the credibility of a security leader with the mindset of a business executive. They are a trusted advisor to senior leaders, capable of enabling growth and innovation while ensuring risks are effectively understood, governed, and managed.

Make an impact at all\-North American precious metals producer. New Gold is now part of Coeur Mining. Visit www.coeur.com to learn more.

  



Coeur Mining attracts and hires highly skilled individuals. By joining our team, you can look forward to:


* A stimulating values\-based work environment
* A culture of collaboration and inclusion
* Inspiring colleagues and approachable leaders
* Career development opportunities
* A deeply rooted commitment to responsible mining, health and safety and community engagement
* A competitive total compensation program
* A comprehensive benefits package including a retirement savings plan

  


**About Coeur Mining:**



Coeur Mining is a growing, all\-North American precious metals producer with seven operations: the Las Chispas silver\-gold mine and Palmarejo gold\-silver complex in Mexico, the Rochester silver gold mine in Nevada, the Kensington gold mine in Alaska, the Wharf gold mine in South Dakota, the Rainy River gold mine in Ontario, Canada, and the New Afton copper\-gold mine in British Columbia, Canada. In addition, Coeur owns the Silvertip silver\-zinc\-lead exploration project in British Columbia.


Coeur offers a flexible, hybrid work model and a culture built on safety, collaboration, and real opportunities to develop your career for those who want to grow alongside a company that is doing the same.

  

**Location**: Remote US with travel required

  


**Position Overview**


Reporting to the Senior Director, Site Finance \& Consolidations, the Director, Accounting Operations – US Site Finance is responsible for overseeing Coeur’s site\-level finance and accounting functions across its US mining operations. This role ensures the timely and accurate completion of operational financial close processes, provides strong leadership to site controllers, supports SEC reporting and internal controls, and performance reporting to support operational decision\-making and strategic initiatives.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


* Oversee the operations of the site accounting departments, including consolidated accounting, financial reporting, and tax functions at the site level
* Lead the monthly financial close process for Coeur’s mining operations, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and conformity with GAAP
* Direct, oversee, and provide leadership to site controllers across all US operations, including performance management, development, and standardization of processes
* Oversee the execution of site\-level financial planning processes, including life\-of\-mine modeling, annual budgets, forecasts, and strategic plans
* Develop, improve, and standardize site\-level financial reporting, financial planning, supply chain, and accounting systems/processes
* Analyze key performance indicators for operations and project groups and communicate results across management levels to support decision\-making
* Prepare and review financial analysis, variance explanations, and materials for site General Managers, Executive Leadership Team, and Board of Directors
* Support the integration of key processes, systems, and data across sites and corporate to enable high\-quality information flow and informed strategic planning
* Ensure transactions are accurately and timely recorded in accordance with GAAP; review journal entries, reconciliations, cash disbursements, and other accounting entries for propriety
* Prepare and/or review audit schedules and work directly with external auditors (GT) to resolve questions and issues.
* Assist with the preparation of 10\-Ks, 10\-Qs, and other regulatory reports, including coordination of site\-level inputs.
* Support AP and supply chain functions to maintain optimal working capital levels
* Coordinates production and compilation of various reports and statements for management review and for accounting purposes.
* Provide ongoing assistance to internal stakeholders on accounting and Oracle related matters
* Lead and participate in special projects, including process improvements, system implementations, and value\-added financial analysis.
* Champion data management, model governance, controls, and documentation as a single source of truth
* Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities across site and corporate accounting practices

  


**Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance required; CPA designation strongly preferred
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive finance and accounting experience, with significant time in operations finance or controller roles within the mining industry
* Minimum of 5 years of experience managing and leading accounting/finance teams
* Strong understanding of GAAP, SEC reporting, internal controls (SOX), and mining\-specific accounting (e.g., inventory, reclamation, revenue recognition)
* Proven ability to advise senior stakeholders, build relationships with site/operational teams, communicate complex financial information, and influence decision\-making
* Experience with ERP systems (Oracle preferred), Blackline, and other financial reporting tools

  


**Other Requirements**


* Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills
* Strong oral and written communication skills with the ability to interact effectively at all levels of the organization
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, conflicting stakeholder interests, and tight deadlines in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong operational mining knowledge is highly desirable
* Demonstrated commitment to confidentiality and ethical standards

Any resume or other information received from a supplier not approved by Coeur Mining will be considered unsolicited and will not be considered.

jobs.description:
Overview:

At KPMG in Canada, our people bring their unique perspectives to Canada’s most important challenges. Here, you can build momentum that reaches beyond our business, develop skills for the future, and take ownership of your career with support at every stage. Join a firm where your career can make a difference.

  

Are you a talented leader with a proven track record for motivating teams and delivering exceptional client service?  

Our Banking \& Capital Markets team in Toronto is looking for a professional like you with the skills and drive to make a real difference.
What you will do:  

* Lead end\-to\-end AI solution development or transformation programs using cloud AI services, enhancing customer experience, operational efficiency, and decision\-making across various industries
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior and C\-level client stakeholders, shaping AI strategies and roadmaps while positioning KPMG’s AI solutions as strategic enablers of business objectives
* Oversee the design, architecture, and delivery of multi\-agent GenAI systems, advanced Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and multimodal solutions, ensuring seamless integration, quality, scalability, and security within enterprise workflows
* Advise clients on AI Risk Management, Governance, and Security, ensuring GenAI deployments comply with emerging regulatory frameworks and enterprise security standards (e.g., implementing guardrails and defending against LLM vulnerabilities)
* Drive business development to expand KPMG’s AI portfolio by identifying market opportunities, developing proposals, and securing new client engagements, while fostering strategic alliances
* Manage and mentor cross\-functional teams, promoting a high\-performance culture, technical excellence, and career development, ensuring the team stays at the forefront of AI and cloud engineering technology advancements
* Work closely with our Microsoft, Google, Salesforce, and other related platform teams to develop our AI capabilities and offerings within the relevant ecosystems
* Set a clear strategic vision for AI strategy and engineering offerings, staying updated on the latest AI advancements (including frontier vs. open\-weight models) and innovations, fostering a culture of innovation, and ensuring alignment with KPMG’s digital strategy
* Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG’s respectful and courteous work environment


What you bring to this role:
* Minimum eight years of recent experience in AI/ML, data analytics, and cloud technology, including leadership roles in Banking and Capital Markets consulting
* AI certifications (for example: Professional AI Architect, Machine Learning Engineer) or equivalent are a plus
* Advanced degree from an accredited college or university in computer science, data science, engineering, or related field preferred; minimum of a Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university is required
* Deep knowledge and hands\-on experience with Microsoft, AWS, and/or Google Cloud’s AI ecosystem (including agent build functionality) to design and orchestrate intelligent multi\-agent systems, integrating complex RAG pipelines, and connecting GenAI to proprietary enterprise data (Knowledge Graphs, Vector Databases) that handle complex, dynamic tasks and conversations
* Proficient in architecting and implementing AI\-powered workflow solutions using Microsoft, AWS, or Google Cloud services (For example: Foundry, Bedrock, Vertex AI), and demonstrating a strong grasp of model\-agnostic architectures leveraging both proprietary and open\-weight foundational models for scalable, automated systems with expertise in agentic AI and automation
* Skilled in designing multi\-agent conversational and autonomous AI systems integrated with enterprise applications (CRM, ERP), enhancing customer engagement through smart chatbots and virtual agents to improve user experience and operational efficiency; experienced in conversational AI integration
* Deep understanding of scaling AI\-driven solutions, GenAIOps/LLMOps (including LLM evaluation frameworks, prompt versioning, routing, and cost optimization), AI governance, and MLOps practices for maintaining models; ability to bring industry consulting insights with a balance of technical and business acumen to deliver strategic, value\-driven AI solutions; In\-depth knowledge of AI orchestration and best practices

 **Providing you with the support you need to be at your best**  


Our Values, The KPMG Way:
**Integrity**, we do what is right \| **Excellence**, we never stop learning and improving \| **Courage**, we think and act boldly \| **Together**, we respect each other and draw strength from our differences \| **For Better**, we do what matters  

KPMG in Canada is a proud equal opportunities employer and we are committed to creating a respectful, inclusive and barrier\-free workplace that allows all of our people to reach their full potential. A diverse workforce is key to our success and we believe in bringing your whole self to work. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply and hope you will choose KPMG in Canada as your employer of choice. **Adjustments and accommodations throughout the recruitment process**  

At KPMG, we are committed to fostering an inclusive recruitment process where all candidates can be themselves and excel.  Opportunities for career growth and advancement based on contribution, initiative, and impact.

 Opportunities to connect with colleagues through learning sessions and informal social activities.

Crozier has been awarded esteemed top employer, leadership and business growth recognitions, including one of Canada's Top Small \& Medium Employers, Southwestern Ontario's Top Employers, and ranked among Canada's Top Growing Companies by Report on Business.


**Your Impact:**


Crozier is currently seeking a **Director of Finance** to join our growing company.


Reporting to the President, the Director of Finance will serve as Crozier’s lead finance executive and be responsible for oversight of all finance, accounting, treasury, and reporting activities. As a strong communicator, you will make it your mission to streamline our budgeting, payroll, and financial reporting processes. You will produce thorough financial\-status reports for senior management, to help improve our operational efficiency and aid in our continued growth.


**How you will contribute to the team:**


* In conjunction with the Manager of Finance, oversee all accounts, ledgers, and reporting systems ensuring compliance with IFRS and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain internal control and safeguards for receipt of revenue, costs, program budgets, and actual expenditures.
* In conjunction with the President and senior leadership team, establish financial and operating benchmarks, budgets, program monitoring, and reporting standards on a bi\-weekly, monthly, and annual basis.
* Achieve budget goals with proper analysis, and corrective action.
* Help develop and support short and long\-term operational strategies.
* Act as a key member of the executive team, providing strategic financial counsel to the President and the Board on investments, growth initiatives, and risk management.
* Consistently analyze financial data and present financial reports in an accurate and timely manner; clearly communicate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements; monitor progress and changes.
* Develop and enforce internal controls to maximize protection of company assets, policies, procedures, and workflow.
* Oversee and support accounting team with dynamic leadership that creates an environment of trust and productivity.


**What you bring:**


* Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in business, accounting, or related field; CPA designation required.
* 15\+ years of proven accounting experience, with 10\+ years of experience in a senior finance leadership position.
* Strong knowledge of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS); knowledge of US GAAP is an asset.
* Extremely knowledgeable in financial forecasting, accounting principles, and financial data analysis.
* Strong understanding of economic and banking processes.
* Keen analytic, organization and problem\-solving skills which allows for strategic data interpretation versus simple reporting.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills; experience in effectively communicating key data, including presentations to senior management, board, or other outside partners.
* Ability and desire to translate complex financial concepts to individuals at all levels including finance and non\-finance managers.???????


**We offer:**


**Comprehensive Benefits That Support You:** We offer flexible and customizable health benefits designed to meet your needs, including dental, vision, prescription coverage, a health spending account, and much more. Crozier offers RRSP matching, an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), parental leave top\-up, annual wellness allowance, our unique First\-Time Home Buyers' Assistance Program, and more.


**Investing in Your Growth**: Your development matters to us. It is our goal to provide programs that support our employee’s experience through personal and professional development. We offer paid professional development support and training, including a Lifelong Learning Assistance Program to support career pathways.


**Making a Difference Together**: Giving back is part of who we are. We actively support not\-for\-profit organizations in the communities where we live and work, and encourage employees to get involved through community initiatives and local events.


**Crozier Social**: At Crozier, we believe strong relationships make great teams. From sports leagues and game nights to creative workshops and social events, there are plenty of opportunities to connect with colleagues. Throughout the year, we bring our teams together through activities such as golf tournaments, hikes, boat cruises, and other fun company\-wide events.


**Salary range:** $130,000 \- $170,000


**About the salary range:** The range shown reflects what we typically offer for this type of role. When we make an offer, we consider the responsibilities of the position, market data, and internal equity to ensure consistency across our teams. Your actual offer will depend on your experience, skills, and alignment with the role.


**Vacancy status:** This posting is for an open position.


**AI Disclosure:** Crozier does not use artificial intelligence (AI) in the hiring process. All applications are reviewed by the People \& Culture team and hiring managers.

jobs.title: Director, Global AI Thought Leadership
jobs.description:
Our Purpose 

 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

 Title and Summary 

Director, Global AI Thought Leadership 

Who is Mastercard?

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.

Overview
The AI & Data Office is responsible for the strategy, acquisition, evaluation, and responsible use of AI and data capabilities that power innovation and operations across Mastercard. It defines the enterprise AI and data vision, develops shared capabilities, and helps the business realize value from AI and data responsibly and at scale. 

The Director, AI Thought Leadership, will report to the Vice President, AI Thought Leadership and partner with AI product, engineering, and SMEs, to cultivate a unified narrative for Mastercard’s AI solutions and position. Within the AI & Data Office, the AI Thought Leadership team shapes Mastercard's internal and external perspective on artificial intelligence and its impact on our business, our customers, and on commerce, business, and society. The team develops original insights, executive narratives, and thought leadership programs that strengthen Mastercard's reputation as a trusted leader in applied AI and execute on Mastercard's AI positioning to strengthen engagement with customers, stakeholders, and employees, and reinforce Mastercard's unique role in the evolving AI landscape

Role
• Monitor AI and data technologies landscape, their application, and industry trends to identify emerging opportunities, risks, and implications for Mastercard and its customers.
• Develop original thought leadership, research, and points of view on topics such as AI adoption, trust, economy, workforce transformation, and the future of commerce.
• Create flagship content including research reports, whitepapers, executive briefs, articles, presentations, keynote materials, and webinar content, building towards an AI-driven AI content studio. 
• Lead the end-to-end thought leadership lifecycle, including research, content development, stakeholder coordination, reviews, approvals, publication, and ongoing content refresh.
• Measure the impact of thought leadership programs and continuously improve content effectiveness, audience engagement, and business outcomes.
• Partner with executives and cross-functional teams across AI & Data, Products, Marketing, and Communications to deliver through leadership programd and activation through speeches, bylines, presentations, customer briefings, executive workshops, facilitation sessions, strategic discussions, and thought leadership programs.
• Represent Mastercard at industry events, customer forums, analyst engagements, and external thought leadership opportunities.

All About You
The ideal candidate for this position should demonstrate:
• Experience in thought leadership, market research, management consulting, technology research, journalism, publishing, editorial strategy, or a related field.
• Strong understanding of artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative AI, agentic systems, data strategy, responsible AI, and enterprise AI adoption trends including evaluating emerging technologies and their business and socio-economic implications
• Track record producing high-quality research, reports, articles, or executive content and translating complex technology topics for business audiences.
• Effective project and production management skills, with experience coordinating complex publications from planning through review, approval, and delivery.
• Strong market research and analytical capabilities, able to synthesize large volumes of information into clear viewpoints.
• Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling abilities, and leading the use of AI tools to accelerate and amplify thought leadership work.
• Experience working with senior executives, technical subject matter experts, communications and marketing. 
• Knowledge of payments, technology, financial services, or digital commerce preferred.
• Ability to operate independently in ambiguous and rapidly evolving environments.
Corporate Security Responsibility
Every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security. All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and therefore, it is expected that the successful candidate for this position must:

• Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
• Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
• Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and 
• Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines. 

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly. 

 Corporate Security Responsibility 

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
 Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

 Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

 Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

 Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in Canada, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive pay based on location, experience and other qualifications for the role and may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. This posting reflects one or more current openings on our team.

Toronto, Canada: $138,000 - $221,000 CAD

jobs.description:

 Nous sommes une agence Web dynamique qui conçoit des solutions numériques innovantes afin de contribuer au succès de ses clients. Notre équipe mise sur la créativité, la collaboration et l’excellence. Nous sommes à la recherche d’un·e directeur·trice de la stratégie expérimenté·e pour diriger notre équipe de stratégie et accompagner nos clients dans des initiatives de transformation numérique, Web et marketing.
 Le ou la directeur·trice de la stratégie sera responsable du développement et de la mise en œuvre de stratégies globales de marketing et de contenu. Ce rôle requiert un leadership mobilisateur, capable d’inspirer une équipe tout en participant activement à la planification stratégique et à son exécution. La personne idéale possède une solide expérience en marketing, en stratégie de contenu et dans l’élaboration de plans marketing stratégiques.

 Dans ce rôle, vous serez appelé·e à: 
 Diriger, encadrer et faire évoluer l’équipe de stratégie, tout en favorisant une culture d’innovation et d’excellence
 Agir comme conseiller·ère stratégique auprès des clients, comprendre leurs objectifs d’affaires et leur fournir des recommandations pour orienter leurs initiatives numériques et marketing
 Accompagner les clients dans leur transformation numérique et veiller à l’adoption de bonnes pratiques en matière de technologies Web, d’accessibilité et d’expérience utilisateur
 Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des stratégies numériques qui alignent les objectifs des clients sur les besoins des utilisateurs, en s’appuyant sur la recherche UX, les données analytiques et la stratégie de contenu
 Veiller à ce que les solutions proposées soient évolutives, rentables et réalisables dans les limites du budget du projet
 Réaliser des études de marché approfondies afin d’identifier les tendances, les occasions et le contexte concurrentiel, et utiliser ces informations pour orienter les recommandations stratégiques
 Collaborer avec les équipes multidisciplinaires de design, de développement et de gestion de projet afin d’assurer l’alignement stratégique tout au long du cycle de vie des projets
 Définir les principaux indicateurs de succès

 Quelles compétences sont nécessaires pour réussir au sein de la communauté Evolving Web? 
 De 7 à 10 ans d’expérience en stratégie numérique, UX ou stratégie produit, idéalement au sein d’une agence de développement Web ou d’une agence numérique
 Expérience démontrée en leadership, notamment dans l’encadrement et le développement d’équipes performantes
 Expérience démontrée dans l’élaboration et la mise en œuvre de stratégies de marketing et de contenu sur différents canaux et plateformes
 Excellente capacité à comprendre les objectifs et contraintes des clients, à analyser des données, à interpréter les résultats et à les traduire en stratégies concrètes
 De solides compétences en communication en français et en anglais. L’anglais est requis puisque ce poste implique une collaboration régulière avec des clients et des membres de l’équipe situés à l’extérieur du Québec qui communiquent principalement en anglais. Si vous estimez que ce poste vous correspond, mais que vous n’êtes pas parfaitement à l’aise dans les deux langues, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler

 Atouts supplémentaires: 
 Connaissance de Drupal et WordPress
 Expérience de travail avec des clients institutionnels
 Expérience dans le développement et la mise en œuvre de stratégies de marketing et de contenu sur différents canaux et plateformes

 Ce que nous offrons: 
 Impact – Travaillez sur des projets pour des organisations prestigieuses qui ont un impact sur la vie de dizaines de milliers d’utilisateurs chaque jour
 Défis – Profitez de l’occasion de prendre en charge des projets présentant un niveau élevé de complexité créative et technique
 Apprentissage et développement – Évoluez dans un environnement collaboratif qui encourage l’apprentissage continu et le mentorat
 Culture – Faites partie d’une équipe internationale, accueillante et soudée
 Mode de travail hybride flexible – Pour les candidat·e·s résidant à Montréal ou dans les environs, ce poste suit un horaire hybride comprenant trois jours par semaine au bureau et deux jours en télétravail

 Prêt·e à faire une différence? Joignez-vous à nous et contribuez à façonner l’avenir des expériences numériques!
 Veuillez noter que toutes les communications liées au processus de recrutement seront effectuées exclusivement par courriel.

 Nous aimerions tout de même avoir de vos nouvelles! 
 Vous ne répondez pas à tous les critères, ou vous avez découvert cette offre après la fin de la période de candidature? Ne laissez pas cela vous empêcher de nous contacter. Plusieurs de nos nouvelles recrues nous rejoignent grâce à des recommandations ou par d’autres moyens. Soumettez une candidature spontanée et parlez-nous de vous.

 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 We are a dynamic web agency committed to delivering innovative digital solutions that drive client success. Our team thrives on creativity, collaboration, and a passion for excellence. We are seeking an experienced Director of Strategy to lead our strategy team, guiding clients through transformative web and marketing initiatives.

 The Director of Strategy will spearhead the development and execution of comprehensive marketing and content strategies. This role demands a visionary leader who can inspire a team while actively engaging in strategic planning and implementation. The ideal candidate will possess a robust background in marketing, content strategy, and the creation of strategic marketing plans.

 In this role, you will be expected to: 
 Lead, mentor, and develop the strategy team, fostering a culture of innovation and excellence
 Serve as a strategic advisor to clients, understanding their business goals and providing insights to inform their digital and marketing initiatives
 Guide clients through digital transformation, ensuring they adopt best practices in web technology, accessibility, and user experience
 Craft and implement digital strategies that align client objectives with user needs, leveraging UX research, analytics, and content strategy
 Ensure solutions are scalable, cost-effective, and achievable within the project budget
 Conduct thorough market research to identify trends, opportunities, and competitive landscapes to inform strategic recommendations
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams (design, development, and project management) to ensure strategic alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
 Define key success metrics

 What kind of skill set do you need to be successful in your role within the Evolving community? 
 Minimum of 7-10 years in digital strategy, UX, or product strategy, preferably in a web development or digital agency.
 Proven leadership experience, with a track record of mentoring and growing high-performing teams.
 Demonstrated proficiency in developing and executing marketing and content strategies across various channels and platforms
 Strong ability to understand client goals and constraints, analyze data, interpret insights, and translate them into actionable strategies
 Strong communication skills in both French and English. English is required because this role involves regular collaboration with clients and team members located outside Quebec who primarily communicate in English. If you feel this position is a good fit for you but you are not fully comfortable in both languages, we still encourage you to apply

 Bonus for: 
 Knowledge of Drupal and WordPress
 Experience working with institutional clients
 Experience in developing and executing marketing and content strategies across various channels and platforms

 What we Offer: 
 Impact - Work on projects for prestigious organizations that impact the lives of tens of thousands of users every day
 Challenge - Opportunity to take ownership of projects with a high level of creative and technical complexity
 Learning & Growth - A collaborative environment that encourages continuous learning and mentorship
 Culture - A company with a team from around the world that feels like a family
 Flexible hybrid - For candidates based in Montreal and its suburbs, this role follows a hybrid work schedule, with three days in the office and two days working remotely each week

jobs.title: Lead AI/ML Data Scientist - VP
jobs.description:
About Citi:

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management.

As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Enterprise Operations & Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services.

Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together.

About the Team:

Citi is looking for a Lead AI/ML Data Scientist
to join the Olympus Data Reconciliation and Engineering team, where you will shape the next generation of AI and machine learning capabilities powering enterprise-scale reconciliation across global processing hubs.

In this role, you will drive the full lifecycle of ML model development — from ideation and architecture through to deployment and adoption — delivering measurable impact across Capital Markets operations, risk, and finance. Your work will sit at the intersection of advanced data science and real-world financial systems, influencing outcomes at a global scale.

Responsibilities:

Design, build, and deploy AI and machine learning models — including Agentic AI and Generative AI solutions — to solve complex reconciliation and data engineering challenges at enterprise scale.
Lead the end-to-end ML model development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and data preprocessing through to ensemble modeling, validation, and production integration.
Analyze large volumes of structured and unstructured financial data to uncover trends, patterns, and opportunities for optimization across banking platforms.
Define and deliver ML model roadmaps in collaboration with technical and business teams, ensuring alignment with project timelines, budgets, and Citi's architecture standards.
Translate complex data findings into clear visualizations and strategic recommendations that inform decisions made by senior business and technology leaders.
Partner with engineering, operations, and cross-functional teams to ensure seamless model integration, long-term scalability, and reliable performance in production environments.
Identify and communicate technology risks and their business implications, developing mitigation strategies and maintaining transparency with stakeholders at all levels.
Maintain comprehensive model documentation and support knowledge transfer to ensure continuity and adoption across teams.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

Technical Expertise:

6+ years hands-on experience in AI/ML development and big data engineering within Financial Services, Insurance, or Telecom environments
Expert-level proficiency in Python (scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Pandas, NumPy), R (caret, tidyverse, mlr3), and SQL (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL)
Deep technical knowledge implementing supervised and unsupervised ML algorithms: linear/logistic regression, neural networks (CNN, RNN, LSTM, Transformers), k-means clustering, DBSCAN, decision trees (CART, C4.5), and ensemble methods (Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost)
Proven experience building and deploying Agentic AI and LLM-based solutions using:
LangGraph for complex agent orchestration and state management
LangChain for chain-of-thought reasoning and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
Agent Development Kit (ADK) for enterprise-grade autonomous agent development

Beneficial Skills & Qualifications:

Hands-on experience with advanced statistical modeling: Generalized Linear Models (GLM), Random Forest, Gradient Boosting (AdaBoost, XGBoost), and Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques including text mining, topic modeling (LDA), and sentiment analysis
Experience with model versioning and experiment tracking tools (Mlflow, Weights & Biases, DVC)
Proficiency with Git/GitHub/Bitbucket for version control and collaborative development
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for ML model deployment (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions)
Familiarity with data visualization libraries (Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly) and BI tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience with real-time streaming data frameworks (Kafka, Kinesis)
Passion for staying current with emerging AI/ML frameworks, research papers, and open-source contributions

Education:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science
, Data Science
, Software Engineering
, Information Systems
, Mathematics
, Statistics
or related fields of study.
