This Director will lead, manage and mentor a small team of Junior and Media scientists. This role requires a hands-on approach to solving problems, planning and managing change related to all aspects of marketing sciences delivery.

 At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You'll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you'll spend 1-3 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote. 

 How you'll succeed 

 Champion media analytics as a strategic growth driver — Serve as the trusted analytics partner to marketing, retail, wealth, and distribution leaders by translating business priorities into clear media measurement, experimentation, and optimization strategies. Ensure solutions are practical, scalable, and aligned to business outcomes.
 Lead measurement, experimentation, and optimization across the media ecosystem — Oversee the design, implementation, and ongoing evaluation of analytics frameworks, models, and test-and-learn programs that improve media effectiveness. Guide the team in applying advanced analytics, AI/ML, and emerging GenAI capabilities to both structured and unstructured data, with a strong focus on campaign performance, attribution, audience insights, and investment optimization.
 Deliver end-to-end analytical solutions — Lead work from problem definition and methodology through execution, validation, monitoring, and refinement. Continuously evolve approaches as business needs shift, new channels emerge, or performance insights suggest optimization opportunities.
 Build a high-performing analytics function — Lead, coach, and develop a strong team of media analytics professionals. Hire and nurture talent with the right blend of analytical rigor, business acumen, and media expertise. Set clear expectations, remove barriers, and ensure the team is aligned to business priorities and enterprise goals.
 Embed responsible, effective analytics practices — Foster high standards in measurement design, data quality, experimentation discipline, and responsible AI use. Ensure the team’s work adheres to relevant policies, governance standards, and best practices while maintaining credibility with partners across the organization.

 Who you are 

 You are a media analytics leader first. You bring strong command of the media landscape and understand how to connect channels, audiences, and investments to measurable business outcomes. You are fluent in media effectiveness, incrementality, attribution, testing, and optimization.
 You combine craft expertise with strategic thinking. You know how to move from business question to analytical approach to actionable recommendation. You are comfortable shaping measurement strategies that inform planning, improve performance, and support better investment decisions.
 You are highly analytical and experimentally minded. You have deep experience applying advanced analytics to marketing and media use cases, including forecasting, audience analysis, causal measurement, optimization, and performance diagnostics. You understand how to structure rigorous experiments and use evidence to guide decisions.
 You are digitally and technically fluent. You are comfortable working with modern analytics and data science tools such as Python, SQL, Pandas, scikit-learn, and cloud-based data environments. You can partner effectively with technical teams while staying focused on business relevance and usability.
 You are an effective translator between technical and business teams. You can turn complex analytical concepts into clear, compelling narratives for senior stakeholders. You know how to influence decisions, build trust, and bring partners along in environments with complexity and ambiguity.
 You are a strong people leader. You lead with clarity, accountability, and empathy. You develop talent, elevate team capability, and create an inclusive environment where high performance and collaboration go hand in hand.
 You understand applied AI in a marketing context. — You have experience using traditional AI/ML techniques and an appreciation for where GenAI can enhance workflows, insight generation, and decision support. You are thoughtful about where these tools add value and where rigor in measurement must remain paramount.
 You bring strong business and industry judgment. Experience in marketing, media, or sales analytics is essential, and financial services experience is a strong asset. You understand how to operate in a regulated, complex environment while still driving innovation and impact.
 You are well-credentialed and credible. You bring advanced academic training in analytics, statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, along with a track record of delivering large, high-impact analytical initiatives.
 Values matter to you. You bring your real self to work, and you live our values - trust, teamwork, and accountability.

jobs.title: Director, Public & Alternative Investments, Data Platforms
jobs.description:
Purpose. Performance. People. 

 Joining CPP Investments means joining one of the world’s most admired and respected institutional investors to drive a single mandate: to deliver strong, sustainable returns for generations of Canadians.   

 With a long-term horizon and global reach, we deploy capital at scale across public and private markets. Our size, stability, and disciplined investment philosophy allow us to pursue complex opportunities and build enduring partnerships worldwide.  

 For our people, this means meaningful work with tangible impact, real opportunity, and collaboration with exceptional colleagues who value partnership and performance. Here, you’ll contribute to outcomes that matter alongside team members committed to excellence and shared success.   

 The Role 

As Director, Data Engineering for the Public Markets and Alternate Assets (PMAA) team, you will build and publish the enterprise market data products that power investment strategies across our public markets and alternate assets businesses. Partnering closely with your business-aligned product owner, you will lead a talented team of data engineers and analysts and own the end-to-end lifecycle of PMAA data, from vendor and internal feeds through to trusted, well-documented data products used by investment teams, analytics platforms and AI agents. You will set the technical direction for a modern AWS data platform, establish the semantic and knowledge graph foundations that connect data across asset classes, and ensure every data product meets the standards of timeliness, quality, licensing compliance and control that investment decisions demand. 

 The Team 

 CPP Investments invests across public and private markets, supported by technology and data capabilities that enable informed investment decisions and long-term value creation.

 Within PMAA, this role leads market data engineering and the development of enterprise data products that support investment professionals, quantitative and research teams. The team works with investment, product, architecture, technology and governance partners to deliver reliable, accessible and AI-ready market data.

 Accountabilities 
 Define and execute the multi-year data engineering strategy and roadmap for PMAA market data products, partnering with the product owner to align priorities with investment needs and enterprise architecture standards.
 Own the target-state AWS data platform architecture across ingestion, storage, processing, orchestration, governance and consumption, making design and build-versus-buy decisions that balance scalability, resilience, security and cost.
 Lead the development and adoption of enterprise data products across public and private markets, including pricing, reference data, corporate actions and benchmarks, with clear ownership, data contracts, service levels and documentation.
 Establish semantic data capabilities, including RDF knowledge graphs on Amazon Neptune, and enable governed access to AI-ready data through Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, agent skills and Amazon Quick.
 Ensure reliable, timely and secure data delivery through observability, automated quality controls, incident management, AWS Lake Formation, data lineage and market data licensing and entitlement controls.
 Lead agile roadmap delivery and engineering excellence, embedding CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing and reusable frameworks while engaging senior stakeholders, investment teams and strategic technology and data partners.
 Build, coach and develop an inclusive, high-performing engineering team, fostering accountability, collaboration, continuous learning and career growth.

 What You Bring 
 Undergraduate degree or college diploma in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field; a graduate degree is an asset.
 10+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, data platforms or software engineering, including 5+ years leading engineering teams, with demonstrated success delivering enterprise-scale, cloud-native data platforms and leading complex agile programs.
 Strong understanding of capital markets, investment management and market and reference data, including experience with major data vendors, licensing, entitlements and usage controls; private markets experience is an asset.
 Advanced AWS architecture expertise equivalent to Solutions Architect – Professional, including security, IAM, networking, resilience and cost optimization, together with hands-on technical depth in Apache Spark (PySpark or Scala), AWS Glue or EMR, Airflow/MWAA, AWS DMS and Amazon RDS/Aurora.
 Expertise in enterprise data product design, AWS Lake Formation governance, data contracts, service levels and consumption patterns, along with RDF, SPARQL, ontology design, Amazon Neptune, MCP servers, agent skills and AI-assisted analytics using Amazon Quick.
 Ability to guide engineering teams across cloud-native development, data quality, observability and delivery practices. Experience with lakehouse technologies, Python, SQL, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, data cataloguing, financial ontologies, Amazon Bedrock or GraphRAG is an asset; relevant AWS certifications are also assets.
 Inclusive people leadership, sound judgment and strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to investment professionals and executives, influence stakeholders and manage strategic vendor partnerships.

 You are motivated to contribute to something larger than yourself, approach complex challenges with rigor, and hold yourself to  high standards in a collaborative, performance-driven environment.   

 We provide colleagues with cutting-edge AI tools, dedicated learning time, and practical support to help them deliver with greater impact.

 Inclusion & Accessibility 
 CPP Investments is committed to  equitable access to employment and building a workforce that reflects diverse talent and perspectives. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.   

 Attention: Protect Yourself from Fraud 
 CPP Investments is committed to a secure and transparent recruitment process. We will never ask candidates for payment or financial information at any stage of hiring. All legitimate opportunities are posted on our careers page, and communications will come from our applicant tracking system, Workday.  

 CPP Investments may use AI tools to help screen and assess applicants by analyzing resumes and applications for relevant skills and experience. These tools support, but do not replace, human decision-making.

At Varicent, we're not just transforming the Sales Performance Management (SPM) market—we're redefining how organizations achieve revenue success. Our cutting\-edge SaaS solutions empower revenue leaders globally to design smarter go\-to\-market strategies, maximize seller performance, and unlock untapped potential. * **Shape the Future: Lead in redefining revenue optimization.**
* **Grow Together: Unlock your potential in a supportive environment.**

Join us at Varicent—where your talent and ambition meet limitless opportunities for success!  


**The Opportunity**



This is an 18\-month fixed\-term position covering a maternity leave. The Director, Financial Reporting, reporting to the Vice President of Finance, is a key member of the Finance department and owns the global financial close, consolidation, external financial reporting, and audit execution; and partners with internal stakeholders and external advisors on global tax compliance and planning. They are an experienced Controller/Director with extensive knowledge of accounting principles, systems and processes, and a passion for partnering with key stakeholders to drive awareness and optimization of the business. They are enthusiastic, high\-energy, an experienced people leader, and passionate about coaching and investing in their team to elevate career development and experience.  

This is a hands\-on role in a high\-growth software business backed by U.S. Private Equity. This role will partner with other senior leaders to continue to build and scale the department with best practices to support our global business with operations in Canada, US, UK, Romania and Australia.


**What You'll Do**


* Financial Accounting and Reporting: Oversee the ongoing accounting function and financial reporting calendar to meet critical reporting timelines. Be the in\-house technical accounting expert that ensures compliance with US GAAP (ASC 606 revenue recognition, ASC 718 stock based compensation, ASC 842 leases, etc), federal, state and local laws and accounting principles in the US, Canada, UK, LATAM, Romania, and Australia.
* Audit Management: Manage the relationships with external auditors and government authorities. Effectively negotiate and defend the Company's accounting positions and manage audits to be on time and on budget. Prepare complex technical accounting and tax memos, working papers, and consolidated financial statements with note disclosures in compliance with US GAAP.
* Tax: Participate in global tax planning and strategy (transfer pricing, SR\&ED) and coordinate tax return compliance and preparation with our global tax advisors. Oversee sales tax compliance and follow\-ups.
* Collaborate with FP\&A to support internal and external management reporting: Produce high\-quality monthly, quarterly and annual consolidated financial statements, MD\&A and management reports; provide thorough analysis of the financial data and effectively communicate key findings, opportunities and risk.
* Lead AI\-enabled finance automation across close, reconciliations, variance analysis, reporting, and audit support by integrating our tech stack (NetSuite, Concur, Salesforce, Adaptive Planning, UKG, Snowflake, and Claude) in partnership with AI/Systems, ensuring strong controls, data security, and documentation.
* Support the sales process through delivering financial health reviews on customer calls.
* People Leader, Coach \& Active Listener: Lead a team responsible for accounting, audit management, financial reporting and tax. Lead their training and development, performance evaluation and maintaining a healthy and collaborative work environment.
  


**What You'll Bring**


* CPA \+ experience at a top tier accounting firm \+ industry experience.
* 8 years' experience leading global accounting operations as a Controller/Director.
* 4 years of people management experience.
* Advanced knowledge of US GAAP/IFRS.
* Proficiency with NetSuite or similar ERP systems.
* Experience preparing consolidated financial statements and note disclosures and managing auditors and government agencies.
* Experience partnering with cross\-functional stakeholders to drive results.
* Egoless, Innovative and Entrepreneurial: Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment. Relentless focus on improvement and raising the bar. Balances scrappiness and execution with business maturity, prioritization, and thoughtfulness. Is curious, agile, a self\-starter and welcomes challenge as a conduit to improvement. Can be creative with resources and has a history of getting things done in complex environments and flat hierarchies. Welcomes candor from above and below.
* Collaborative: Will have the confidence and willingness to work up and down the organization.
* Effective Communication Skills: High integrity, no\-nonsense approach. Quick and to the point. An active listener.

  



For this role, the estimated annual base salary range is between **CAD $138,200\.00 \- $181,400\.00**. In addition to base salary, our compensation package may include bonuses, commissions for eligible sales roles, and a comprehensive benefits package. The actual base salary will vary based on factors including individual qualifications and market data, as objectively assessed during the interview process.

jobs.title: Strategic Finance Director
jobs.description:
**About Beacon Software**
-------------------------


Beacon is building the essential technology infrastructure for the everyday economy: the businesses, organizations, and services that make real life work, and that mainstream tech has largely left behind. We acquire, operate, and grow vertical market software companies. They are niche, founder\-built businesses serving industries that are often overlooked and too profitable to ignore.  

  

Our model is simple: we seek out founders who have built their business by spending years understanding their market and prioritizing their customers' specific needs. We buy great businesses, invest in their continued growth, and hold them permanently, accelerating that growth with an AI\-native platform built specifically for vertical market software. No mandate to cut, flip, or roll up into something unrecognizable.  

  

We are not a financial firm. We are technology entrepreneurs and operators who believe the most important businesses in the world are already running quietly in industries most people never think about. Our job is to find them, support the people who built them, and make them better.  

  

Beacon is backed by a diverse base of investors, with $550M\+ raised to date, including General Catalyst, Lightspeed, D1 Capital, CPMG, the family offices of the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp, and evergreen funds built for the long game.

**Role and Mission**
--------------------


This is an exciting and entrepreneurial opportunity to join a fast\-paced technology company with a very significant growth trajectory. Beacon Software is making its first hire on the Strategic Finance team. This is a role where investing turns into building. The individual will report to Beacon’s VP, Strategic Finance and work closely with Beacon’s CEO, CTO, M\&A Directors, industry pod leaders, and the General Managers of Beacon’s portfolio companies.


The Strategic Finance team’s mandate spans the financial decisions that shape Beacon: partnering with portfolio companies on growth and value creation, building AI\-native systems that let functions scale non\-linearly with the portfolio, owning Beacon’s capital allocation across organic and inorganic strategies, leading new strategy extensions beyond core software M\&A, and building Beacon’s capital markets capability. Team members work across a mix of these areas based on their interests and skillset.


This is an asymmetric opportunity to build a company, with decision authority and velocity over process driving compounding equity. You’ll sit next to the CEO on capital allocation and capital markets, or fill a CFO role across dozens of companies on their most consequential decisions. The playbook will be shaped by you with the goal of building Beacon into a $100B company.


To succeed in this role, this individual should be an enthusiastic and energetic self\-starter, with the ability to translate operator intuition into financial decisions and build the analytical rigor behind Beacon’s platform\-level bets. The ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously across portfolio companies and platform initiatives will be essential. We are seeking a collaborative professional who wants to contribute ideas on how to improve the status quo and create best\-practices that will accelerate our execution. Teamwork and positivity are key foundations of this growing team’s culture and ethos.

**Location:** for discussion. Beacon has offices in Toronto, San Francisco, New York, and Chicago.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Finance partner to acquired companies**

* Partner with industry sector leaders and portfolio company General Managers as the financial decision\-making engine across Beacon’s portfolio companies.
* Translate product, AI, and operator intuition into investment decisions: pricing changes, sales hires, direct marketing investments, engineering allocation, and tuck\-in M\&A.
* Build value creation plans, set budgets and targets, and make the day\-to\-day capital decisions that drive growth across companies.

**Beacon capital allocation**

* Help own platform\-level capital allocation: organic platform investment vs. inorganic M\&A, platform\-level acquisitions vs. tuck\-ins, debt vs. equity at the corporate level.
* Build the analytical rigor behind Beacon’s platform\-level bets, ensuring capital is deployed where returns are most asymmetric.

**Strategy extension beyond core software M\&A**

* Own thesis through acquisition through ownership for new strategy extensions, starting with software\-plus\-services vertical integration in end markets where Beacon already owns software.
* Partner with the M\&A team for execution while driving the strategy, the diligence, and the post\-close build.

**Capital markets**

* Lead Beacon’s debt strategy, support future equity raises, and prepare Beacon for an eventual IPO.
* Build best\-in\-class debt and equity investor relations and position Beacon as an institutional\-grade capital allocator.

**Build AI\-native finance systems**

* Partner with Beacon’s CTO and engineering leadership on the company\-wide tools that scale across the portfolio, including BeaconOS and AI\-native financial systems.
* Build the systems, dashboards, and decision frameworks that let sector leaders and GMs self\-serve the financial answers they need, allowing the finance function to scale non\-linearly with the portfolio.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3\-8 years of post\-undergrad experience in strategy consulting, private equity, or other finance roles (e.g., investment banking, growth equity, corporate development, or strategic finance).
* Strong academic record from a competitive institution with a degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
* Investor mindset, analytical toolkit, and operator instinct: equally comfortable building a model and being in the room with a product leader or GM helping them make the call.

jobs.title: Director of Data and Analytics
jobs.description:
**About Modular Solutions**



Founded in 2015, Modular Solutions delivers enterprise\-grade technology to the insurance industry. Our configurable platform helps insurers, mutuals, MGAs, and brokers manage core operations through a single system designed for flexibility, long\-term growth, and complex regulated environments.

  


**Position Summary**



Modular Solutions is seeking a Director of Data \& Analytics to own the architecture and governance of our data and analytics platform and how our data is turned into decisions, so that the data we collect becomes reporting and answers that clients and teams can trust as we continue to grow our platform, client base, and internal capabilities.

  



Reporting to the CTO, this role leads the Data function, including data engineering, data science, business intelligence, analytics, and migration, and owns the architecture of the data and analytics platform that connects them. While the data and analytics platform is the primary focus, the role also contributes to and collaborates on the data architecture and design of our core application alongside our Product and Development teams.

  



The ideal candidate is a hands\-on leader who sets direction and stays close to the work: designing the analytics data architecture, data models, and semantic layer alongside engineers rather than managing from a distance. You should bring deep experience in data architecture, data modelling, BI and analytics, and data governance, with a working knowledge of data migration and AI\-enabled workflows, along with the ability to lead people, prioritize work, and translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes.

  



This role is well suited for someone who can build structure, develop teams, improve processes, and help Modular responsibly adopt data and AI practices that create real value for clients, employees, and the platform.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


* Set the data strategy and long\-term roadmap for the Data function, including platforms, vendors, budget, and cost, and build a high\-performing team across data engineering, BI and analytics, and data migration.
* Own the data and analytics platform architecture: the target\-state design for how data flows out of our application into ingestion and pipelines, the data warehouse and data marts, the semantic layer, and the BI and AI tools that consume them, supported by reference architectures and documented architecture decisions.
* Define and maintain the analytics data model for insurance data, including policy, billing, claims, bordereaux, brokers, and coverage, aligned with the application's data model, so that migration, reporting, and analytics map to it consistently.
* Collaborate with Product and Development on the data architecture and design of our core application: bring a data perspective to schema and data model design, assess the downstream impact of changes, favour incremental improvements over large\-scale redesign, and establish data contracts so that application changes do not break reporting, integrations, or client deliverables.
* Own metric governance: a single set of business definitions and KPIs with clear owners, implemented once in the semantic layer and consumed consistently by BI, client reporting, and AI.
* Design how clients access their reporting and analytics data, including governed data sharing and extracts, partnering with product engineering where access runs through application APIs, with appropriate tenant isolation, security, and performance.
* Set standards for data quality, governance, privacy, security, and data residency, including PII classification, retention, lineage, and access control, in support of our security and compliance programs.
* Establish a data quality and validation framework, including automated reconciliation, testing, and certification of trusted datasets and AI\-generated outputs, so that our teams and clients can trust results at scale.
* Define the reporting operating model for standard and client\-specific reporting, including intake and prioritization, move clients toward governed self\-service analytics, and deliver executive\-level insights and advanced analytics, such as forecasting, where they create clear business value.
* Build data migration and onboarding into a repeatable capability, with a reusable conversion framework, reconciliation, and post\-migration validation, led by a dedicated migration lead.
* Build AI\-ready data foundations so that AI features call governed data and semantic models rather than calculating on their own, lead AI adoption within the Data team, and help define the product direction for self\-service and AI\-assisted analytics.
* Partner with Product, Development, Implementation, Operations, and leadership to align priorities, and communicate progress, risks, and trade\-offs clearly to executives.
* Perform other duties as required to support the Data function.

  


**Required Qualifications**


* 8\+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, business intelligence, analytics, or a related data field, including designing data platforms or data models at an organizational level.
* 3\+ years of experience leading, mentoring, or managing technical teams, while remaining hands\-on in the work.
* Proven experience designing enterprise data architecture, including data models, data warehouses and marts, ETL/ELT pipelines, semantic models, and the integration between operational systems and analytics platforms, with a track record of collaborating with application engineering teams on data design and improving existing systems incrementally.
* Hands\-on experience building and governing business definitions, metrics, or semantic models, and working directly with engineers to implement them.
* Strong grounding in data governance, data quality, privacy, and security, including access control, PII handling, lineage, and validation of data and reporting outputs.

jobs.title: Director, Data Engineering
jobs.description:
Our Purpose 

 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

 Title and Summary 

Director, Data Engineering 

Overview: 

Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. We provide value-added services and leverage expertise, data-driven insights, and execution. The Director, Data Engineering for Cyber Analytics will be a key contributor in helping Mastercard develop and deliver actionable insights and products to mitigate cyber vulnerabilities across the Mastercard ecosystem.

Role:

• Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and improve data storage, pipelines, and ETL processes.
• Lead the design and build of graph database solutions and data models that support cyber analytics use cases.
• Partner with data scientists to understand existing ML and AI applications, identify optimization opportunities, and craft processes and solutions that streamline data engineering integration.
• Oversee the integration and management of data from various sources and storage systems to produce cohesive datasets for analysis and modeling.
• Partner with software engineering, IT, Info Sec, and infrastructure teams to deploy and validate production artifacts.
• Lead, develop, and grow a team of highly skilled data engineers.

All About You:

• Strong data engineering skills, including building data pipelines and infrastructure for ML and AI applications, with a solid understanding of ML and AI concepts to build solutions together with data scientists.
• Proficiency in graph databases and graph modeling techniques.
• Proficiency in Databricks, Spark, and AWS, with working knowledge of on-prem distributions (Apache, Hadoop, Oracle).
• Skilled in databases and big data tools such as Hive, Impala, OOZIE, Airflow, and NIFI, with working knowledge of Shell scripting and Linux/Unix systems.
• Strong computer science fundamentals in object-oriented design, data structures, algorithm design, and complexity analysis.
• Proven ability to lead and develop a team of data engineers.
• Skilled at delegating, organizing, and motivating a team, and at prioritizing competing requests across multi-person projects.
• Strong stakeholder management, with the ability to build trusted relationships across technical and business partners.
• Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down ambiguous problems, propose solutions, and implement them with cross-functional teams.
• Clear, persuasive communication with both technical and non-technical audiences, in writing and verbally.
• Curiosity and adaptability, with the ability to learn new domains quickly and stay open to alternative ideas.

Preferred Skills:

• A degree in a technical field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or Computer Science, or equivalent skills gained through hands-on work.
• Knowledge of the payments, cyber, and/or fraud domains.
• Knowledge of web crawling and scraping.
• Exposure to agentic AI. 

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly. 

 Corporate Security Responsibility 

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
 Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

 Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

 Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

 Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in Canada, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive pay based on location, experience and other qualifications for the role and may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. This posting reflects one or more current openings on our team. 
 Pay Ranges 
Toronto, Canada: $154,000 - $247,000 CAD

jobs.title: Director, Delivery CX AI
jobs.description:
Director, CX AI Delivery 
 Who We Are 
 Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture
 With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across eight core service areas: Digital Product Consulting, Digital Marketing Services, Data & AI, Strategy Consulting, Business Operations Modernization, Enterprise Applications, Cloud Engineering, and QA & Test Engineering.

 From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

 Location & Flexibility 
 This role will operate remotely in the United States or Canada OR be based out of one of our major North American office locations - Charlottesville, VA, Durham, NC, Columbus, OH, Boston, MA, Toronto, ON, or Vancouver, BC.
 This role may involve travel of up to 25% to contact center and client locations.

 The Opportunity 
 We are seeking a Director, CX AI Delivery: a consultant and delivery expert who can turn complex contact center and AI programs into predictable, measurable outcomes. You will lead delivery across our CX AI portfolio, spanning Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) platforms, conversational and agentic AI, agent assist, and CX intelligence, and serve as a trusted advisor to client executives. You will manage a portfolio of client engagements (generally ~$15–20M in revenue), directly lead delivery, product, and engineering leaders, and step in to stabilize and recover programs when needed.

 This is a delivery-first leadership role with an AI lens. You will bring the rigor of a seasoned delivery executive together with a working command of how AI is changing CX: from AI-driven routing and virtual agents to copilots, knowledge, and agentic automation. You will help clients adopt these capabilities responsibly, at scale, and in iterative releases that get value into production quickly. You will also help evaluate vendor and partner solutions and decide how and when new tools enter the ecosystem.

 This position reports to the Managing Director, CX AI Delivery and typically manages 8–12 direct reports, including senior managers, managers, and principal-level delivery and technical leaders. It is primarily evaluated on delivery success, client and team feedback, forecast accuracy, portfolio profitability, and growth of key accounts. This is an opportunistically billable position.
 Responsibilities 
 Strategic Account Governance & Growth 
 Be the executive partner. Act as the primary escalation point and strategic advisor for client executives, ensuring TELUS Digital is viewed as a “Doctor” (consultative partner), not a “Waiter” (order taker).

 Run portfolio health. Drive the commercial success of a ~$15–20M portfolio, leading Quarterly Business Reviews that connect delivery progress to the client’s long-term CX and business goals.

 Grow organically. Identify expansion opportunities in existing accounts by understanding client pain points and bringing a relevant point of view on CX and AI. Support renewals, upsell, and expansion in partnership with strategic sales and customer success teams.

 Extend into managed services and advisory as the practice matures: shape Day 2 support models, operational readiness, and advisory engagements that keep clients engaged after go-live.

 Delivery Excellence & Risk Mitigation 
 Lead a global, multidisciplinary team across multiple concurrent workstreams, ensuring product, engineering, and delivery leaders operate as a cohesive unit to deliver measurable outcomes.

 Manage risk proactively. Identify “red” and “yellow” programs early; step into recovery situations to provide clarity, reset expectations, and stabilize teams and client relationships.

 Push for iterative delivery. Favor smaller releases and faster cycles over big-bang launches, especially for AI capabilities where learning in production is essential.

 Optimize delivery models, balancing onshore/offshore teams, automation, and repeatable assets to improve margins and scalability.

 Manage vendor and partner ecosystems. Work with CCaaS and AI platform partners (e.g., Genesys, Google, AWS, Zendesk, Five9, ElevenLabs, Cresta, Parloa) to deliver joint solutions as well as surrounding services in the client ecosystem.

 Partner on pre-sales. Support the commercial team to shape innovative solutions and lead scoping, estimation, and handoffs into delivery so engagements start with clear requirements and goals.

 Leadership & Talent Development 
 Coach and mentor delivery, product, and engineering leaders on leading their own teams and navigating complex client dynamics.

 Build a high-performance culture with regular 1:1s and performance reviews grounded in radical candor and growth, delivering feedback upward, across, and down with grace and clarity.

 Raise the bar on talent. Participate in senior-level hiring, contribute to the Delivery Playbook, and build career paths and skill development (including AI and platform certification pipelines).

 Operational & Financial Stewardship 
 Own portfolio financials: gross margin, utilization, and effective billable rates.

 Forecast accurately. Maintain precise revenue and resource forecasts so the business can plan hiring and growth with confidence.

 Influence with data. Use reporting language, data visualization, and storytelling to influence internal and external decisions and inspire confidence in stakeholders.

 Collaborate across the business with peers and practice leaders to improve internal processes and operational efficiency, and bring energy to moments that matter: new relationships, key presentations, and recovery situations.

 Qualifications 
 10+ years in the technology industry, including 4+ years in a senior leadership role in a professional services, consulting, or agency environment.

 Proven record managing a diverse portfolio of client accounts (ideally $10M+ in annual revenue) with a focus on retention and organic growth.

 Experience delivering large-scale CX or contact center transformations that influenced VP- and C-level decision making.

 Working knowledge of how AI is applied in CX: conversational and voice AI, agent assist and copilots, AI-driven routing, knowledge and content for AI, and CX intelligence; ability to discuss architecture, risk, and ROI credibly with both technical and executive audiences.

 Hands-on delivery experience with one or more leading CCaaS or CX AI platforms (e.g., Genesys, Amazon Connect, Zendesk, Google); platform certifications and experience across multiple verticals are a plus.

 Deep understanding of the SDLC and Agile delivery, with a track record of leading complex, custom-built software solutions from discovery to launch, and comfort with iterative, experiment-driven delivery.

 Experience managing and coaching leaders across Product, Engineering, and Delivery, and leading large, globally distributed teams.

 Strong command of professional services metrics, including gross margin, utilization, forecast accuracy, and effective billable rates.

 Exceptional ability to navigate “recovery situations” and high-stakes client conversations with poise, clarity, and a solution-oriented mindset.

 Ability to translate complex delivery data into compelling narratives for QBRs and executive stakeholders.

 Understanding of regulatory requirements in contact center operations (e.g., PCI, HIPAA, TCPA, PIPEDA) is a plus.

 Equal Opportunity Employer 
 At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity. 
 We will only use the information you provide to process your application and to produce tracking statistics. Since we do not request personal data deemed sensitive, we ask you to abstain from sharing that information with us.
 For more information on how we use your information, see our Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: VP, Financial Planning & Analysis
jobs.description:
About ClearGov 

 ClearGov is building the modern financial operating layer for the public sector. 

 We help US local governments and school districts plan, budget, report, and communicate their finances with clarity and confidence. From long-term planning to financial reporting, compliance, and transparency, our platform connects the work finance teams are already doing and makes it easier to deliver for their communities. 

Today, more than 2,000 public sector organizations use ClearGov, and we continue to expand our platform and reach as we grow.

 Our Core Values 

 Be Clear & Credible  

 We are authentic in our interactions, communicating with clarity, speaking with honesty, and following through with consistency. We turn transparency into our greatest competitive advantage. 

 Be Human   

 We are human partners to our colleagues and customers and lead with consideration and kindness - making space for others to do the same. We turn empathy into a shared strength.

 Be Better Together   

 We are committed to building an inclusive community where everyone thrives. We share successes, support each other through challenges, and show up for our teammates the way we show up for our customers. We turn togetherness into our greatest advantage and collaboration into our greatest multiplier.

 Be Honourable/Honorable   

 We are responsible to our colleagues and customers. We bring our full selves to every conversation, every project, every decision, and every relationship. We act with intention, deliver on our commitments, and lead with integrity - even when no one is watching. We turn honour into the foundation that powers everything we do.

 Be Connected 

 We are culture builders where people are seen, welcomed, and celebrated. We show up in every interaction - the laughs, the wins, the hard days. We turn connection into opportunities for people to feel they belong.

 What Makes You a Great Fit 

 You take ownership and follow through

 You communicate clearly and effectively

 You're comfortable solving problems and figuring things out

 You learn quickly and adapt as things change

 You care about the team, not just your own work

 You bring a sense of humor and perspective to what you do

 About the Opportunity 

 We are seeking a hands-on Vice President, Financial Planning & Analysis to own enterprise-wide planning, forecasting, and performance analytics for a growth-stage SaaS business. This is not a purely oversight role, the VP, FP&A will be in the models directly, building and stress-testing scenarios, and translating the numbers into decisions. Reporting to the CFO, this person will be a key partner to executive leadership and business unit owners, and will play a central role in the company's next chapter of growth.

 We're looking for someone who wants to build, not just review, someone as comfortable inside the mechanics of a model as they are presenting its output to the CFO and board. 

 Key Responsibilities: 

 10+ years of progressive finance experience, including FP&A leadership, with a track record of being genuinely hands-on in the model — not several layers removed from it.

 Direct experience in a SaaS or recurring-revenue business, fluent in ARR, NRR, churn, cohort, and unit economics analysis.

 Strong financial modeling and scenario-planning skills — able to build complex models from scratch and pressure-test assumptions in real time.

 Exposure to an exit, sale process, recapitalization, refinancing, or similar transaction, with a working understanding of what "diligence-ready" actually looks like.

 Executive presence — able to move fluidly between deep model work and clear, confident presentation to the CFO and board.

 Strong judgment about what's urgent, what's important, and what can wait — able to prioritize across competing asks from the CFO, business leaders, and the sponsor.

 Nice-to-haves: 

 M&A diligence or post-acquisition integration experience.

 CPA, CFA, or MBA.

 Prior experience building or scaling an FP&A function from a less mature state.

 Compensation: 

 In the spirit of transparency, we are excited to share the base salary for this position is $200,000 - $240,000 USD and $185,000 - $225,000 CAD and exclusive of fringe benefits or potential bonuses. If you are hired at ClearGov, your final base salary compensation will be determined by factors such as skills, interview performance, education and/or experience. In addition to those factors, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please keep in mind that the range mentioned above is the full base salary for the role. Hiring beyond the base range would not be typical in order to allow for future & continued salary growth. We also offer a generous compensation and benefits package (more information on benefits listed below).

 Why Join ClearGov 

 Remote and flexible work environment

 Meaningful work that impacts communities across the United States

 Collaborative, high-performing team

 Competitive compensation and benefits

 Opportunities to grow as we scale 

 Benefits 

 Medical, dental & vision insurance

 FSA, HSA, and/or Dependent Care FSA (US)

 Life + AD&D insurance, plus short-term and long-term disability insurance (US)

 Life + disability insurance (Canada)

 401(k) (US) / RRSP (Canada) with 3.5% match

 10 company holidays

 3 wellness days

 Paid vacation time off

 Sick and safe time off

 Paid parental leave

 Paid bereavement leave

 Paid jury duty + civic service leave

 Employee assistance program

 2 summer days + annual end-of-year "Dimming of the Lights"

 Employee referral bonus program

 How to Apply 
Ready to join us? Apply online today! 

 Equal Opportunity Employer 
ClearGov is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or any other protected characteristic. Hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

jobs.description:
Purpose:


As the Director of Commercial Pricing and Data Governance at UNFI, you are responsible for developing and executing the company's enterprise\-wide pricing strategy while leading the Data Governance function. Your role is critical in driving commercial excellence, ensuring data integrity, and enabling informed business decisions across the organization.



In the area of pricing, your scope includes building and leading a centralized pricing department that will define, govern, and continuously improve UNFI Canada’s brand and customer pricing strategy. This role will move the organization toward a more disciplined pricing model, shifting pricing ownership away from Sales over time so that Sales can remain focused on customer relationships, execution of brand strategies, and commercial growth. You will immediately assume leadership of pricing activities currently managed within SRM and RGM, while developing the structure, tools, processes, resource requirements, governance model, and transition plan required to bring Sales pricing responsibilities into the pricing organization in the medium term. You will establish clear decision\-making protocols, pricing guardrails, escalation processes, analytical capabilities, and best practices to support consistent, data\-driven pricing decisions that improve margin performance, strengthen customer and supplier strategies, and deliver both immediate and long\-term revenue value.



In the area of Data Governance, you will lead the Retalix Pricing, Retalix Maintenance, and MCB teams. You are accountable for ensuring data quality, governance, and integrity across Supplier Services, including pricing updates, GS1 data management, new brand onboarding information, and system master data maintenance. Your leadership will ensure that core data processes are effectively managed and aligned with business and operational requirements.



By partnering closely with cross\-functional teams and senior leaders, you will enable the successful execution of UNFI's strategic priorities through the effective use of data and analytics. You will foster a culture of accountability, agility, and data\-driven decision\-making while ensuring alignment with UNFI's vision and objectives. Ultimately, your role is to drive sustainable revenue growth, improve profitability, and maximize the value of data as a strategic asset across the organization.



Job Responsibilities:



Lead Pricing Strategy (50%)


* Develop the brand and customer pricing strategy for UNFI Canada
* Review and optimize our current pricing tools and governance
* Immediately take on SRM/RGM pricing and bring forward the recommendation (inclusive of tools and resources) to take pricing on from the sales team
* Establish and enforce guardrails, policies, and pricing strategies to ensure adherence to revenue targets, margin optimization, and overall revenue growth.
* Serve as a subject matter expert and provide deep understanding of customer economics, supplier dynamics, and market sensitivities to enable win\-win pricing and solution proposals.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including Sales, Supplier Services, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Legal, Finance, and IT, to address executional barriers, develop innovative pricing solutions, and align strategies with organizational objectives and initiatives.
* Collect and communicate IT business requirements and play key role in deployment of technical and system enhancements to ensure minimal risk to internal and external customers


Data Governance (30%)


* Drive the implementation of data governance practices and ensure effective utilization of data analytics for prescriptive insights across all teams, supporting data\-driven decision\-making processes
* Conduct continuous reviews of revenue strategies, team processes, and systems to identify areas for improvement, scalability, and efficiency gains.
* Drive pricing research projects, evaluate competitive pricing strategies, and analyze market impacts to provide actionable recommendations for business growth and revenue optimization.
* Lead the data team that is responsible for Retalix Maintenance, Retalix pricing, MCB and GS1 inputs
* Develop plans for the department that optimize, simplify and automate daily pricing routines.
* Automate and simplify our MCB processes
* Lead out Debit balance meeting and process


Leadership and Coaching (20%)


* Conduct continuous reviews of revenue strategies, team processes, and systems to identify areas for improvement, scalability, and efficiency gains.
* Drive pricing research projects, evaluate competitive pricing strategies, and analyze market impacts to provide actionable recommendations for business growth and revenue optimization.
* Lead the development of pricing tools and materials for use in different department inclusive of training
* Partner with sales leadership to ensure RGM principles are applied in annual planning process
* Performs other duties and projects as assigned
* Leads and supports teams’ daily activities in review growth strategy execution


Job Requirements:



Education:


* Bachelor’s degree in finance, marketing, business, or equivalent experience.



Experience:

jobs.description:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients. 

 At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute. 

 To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com 

 What you'll be doing 

 As a member of CIBC’s AI, Data and Analytics team, the Senior Director – Decision Science will lead the Insurance Decision Science team and be responsible for developing and executing strategic initiatives across a range of CIBC Insurance products and projects. This is a senior technical leadership role that combines actuarial, statistical, data science and AI enablement capabilities. The role naturally involves a comprehensive understanding of Creditor (Bank Authorized) and Non-Authorized insurance products. You’ll exercise a high degree of independent judgement, setting the technical direction and standards for decision science activities that support pricing, profitability, growth, forecasting, portfolio performance and strategic decision making. You will develop and maintain trusted relationships across the Insurance business, larger Retail Banking organization and the technology and data science communities. In addition, you’ll translate sophisticated analysis of complex business information into clear recommendations for executives and business leaders, while providing independent challenge to assumptions, forecasts and proposed courses of action. You’ll drive innovation across areas of your responsibility and apply expert interpersonal, communication and problem-solving skills.

 At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You'll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you'll spend 1-3 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote. 

 How you'll succeed 

 Strategy and Planning – Contribute to long-term strategy for the business in collaboration with insurance product and business leaders. Translate actuarial and advanced analytics into decisions on pricing, profitability, growth, forecasting and portfolio performance; identify opportunities, develop strategic proposals and independently challenge key assumptions and targets. Collaborate with internal partners to oversee, communicate and align business plans and ensure delivery on strategy and intended business outcomes.  
 Technical Skills - Set and maintain standards for actuarial, statistical, data science and AI-enabled methods, models, tools and controls. Apply quantitative methods to identify, assess and validate the drivers of profitability, growth, market share, portfolio performance and risk exposure, and synthesize complex analysis to influence business decisions and outcomes. Establish forward-looking performance measurement, forecasting, product analysis and decision-support capabilities that enable timely action, rather than reporting results alone.
 People Management - Own the team’s capability and talent strategy, including workforce planning, succession, hiring, development, coaching and deployment of actuarial and analytics talent against business priorities. Build differentiated technical capabilities, establish clear role and proficiency standards, and create development pathways that strengthen the team over time. Manage capacity to ensure initiatives are appropriately staffed, identify capability gaps and remove obstacles to performance. Create a positive work environment and role model by championing CIBC’s mission, vision and values. Comply with policies, standards, guidelines and controls by applying them fairly and consistently so employees understand what to expect.

 Who you are 

 You are a senior actuarial and analytics leader with strong quantitative knowledge and relevant industry experience. You are an actuary, and hold an advanced degree an actuarial, data science, analytics or related technical field, or equivalent experience, and bring senior-level experience in insurance.
 You have a high degree of Insurance product knowledge and understand the regulatory landscape. You have expert knowledge of insurance products (both authorized and non-authorized), banking and insurance frameworks, and the risk and compliance considerations that shape product decisions.
 You can demonstrate extensive experience in product management, strategic planning, and project management sufficient to identify, develop, and implement approved initiatives.  You have strong analytical, problem-solving skills, excellent communication and presentation skills sufficient to prepare and present material to an executive audience.
 You give meaning to data. You enjoy investigating complex problems, and making sense of information. You're confident in your ability to communicate detailed information in an impactful way.
 You’re an effective leader and collaborator. You build strong relationships across teams, use sound judgment, manage multiple priorities effectively and help create an environment where people can do their best work.  You are a technical leader, not a distant administrator. You remain intellectually engaged in the methods, systems, and decisions that determine whether the work succeeds. 
 You act like an owner. You thrive when you're empowered to take the lead, go above and beyond, and deliver results.
 Values matter to you. You bring your real self to work and you live our values - trust, teamwork, and accountability.

jobs.title: Director, Fraud Analytics & Risk Management
jobs.description:
At Manulife Bank, protecting our customers, advisors, and business from financial crime is a critical strategic priority. As Director, Fraud Analytics & Risk Management, you will lead the Bank's fraud analytics and intelligence capabilities, leveraging advanced data analytics, customer risk modeling, and fraud technologies to proactively identify, detect, and mitigate fraud across all banking products, channels, and customer journeys.

 This role is responsible for developing a data-driven fraud management ecosystem that delivers strong customer protection while enabling frictionless banking experiences. Working closely with Operations, Risk, Technology, Digital, Data & Analytics, and external partners, you will drive innovative solutions that enhance fraud detection, strengthen customer risk management, and improve fraud prevention outcomes.

 Reporting to the AVP/VP, Fraud Strategy & Operations, you will play a key leadership role in shaping the future state fraud capability at Manulife Bank.

 Position Responsibilities: 
 Lead Fraud Analytics & Intelligence 
 Develop and execute the Bank's fraud analytics strategy across deposits, lending, mortgages, payments, digital banking, contact centre, and advisor channels.
 Establish proactive monitoring and analytical capabilities to detect emerging fraud risks, customer scams, account takeover attacks, identity theft, synthetic identities, mule activity, and organized fraud networks.
 Leverage internal and external data sources to identify fraud trends, vulnerabilities, and opportunities for control enhancement.
 Lead fraud intelligence and root-cause analysis activities to continuously improve detection and prevention effectiveness.
 Build meaningful analytics, dashboards, and executive reporting to support fraud management decision-making.

 Own Customer Risk Scoring & Fraud Decisioning 
 Design, develop, and continuously optimize customer fraud risk scoring models across the customer lifecycle.
 Enhance risk-based authentication, transaction monitoring, and fraud intervention strategies.
 Leverage behavioural analytics, device intelligence, digital signals, transaction patterns, and external intelligence to improve customer risk segmentation.
 Monitor model performance and ensure appropriate governance, oversight, validation, and recalibration.
 Support development of real-time fraud detection and decisioning capabilities as the Bank evolves its payments and digital banking ecosystem.

 Advance Fraud Technology Capabilities 
 Lead evaluation, implementation, and optimization of fraud technology solutions that strengthen the Bank's fraud prevention capabilities.
 Partner with vendors to implement prevention and detection fraud toolkits
 Develop business cases and strategic recommendations for fraud technology investments.
 Manage vendor relationships, performance expectations, and ongoing solution effectiveness reviews.

 Strengthen Fraud Risk Management 
 Lead comprehensive fraud risk assessments across products, processes, channels, and strategic initiatives.
 Partner with Enterprise Risk Management and Compliance teams to ensure fraud risks are appropriately identified, measured, monitored, and mitigated.
 Define and maintain fraud risk indicators, thresholds, risk appetite metrics, and reporting frameworks.
 Identify control gaps and drive remediation strategies.
 Support regulatory, audit, and governance reviews related to fraud risk management.

 Enable Data-Driven Fraud Prevention 
 Partner with Analytics on developing predictive models to improve fraud detection and prevention outcomes.
 Leverage machine learning, network analytics, behavioural analytics, anomaly detection, and AI-enabled capabilities where appropriate.
 Balance fraud loss reduction objectives with customer experience considerations.
 Translate complex analytical findings into actionable business recommendations for senior leadership.

 Lead and Develop a High-Performing Team 
 Build and lead a team of fraud analytics, fraud intelligence, and risk professionals.
 Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, accountability, and customer focus.
 Coach and develop talent while building future fraud analytics capabilities for the Bank.
 Serve as a trusted advisor to executives and stakeholders on fraud risk trends, emerging threats, and mitigation strategies.

 Required Qualifications: 
 University degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Business, Finance, Risk Management, or a related discipline.
 10+ years of experience in fraud analytics, fraud risk management, financial crimes, banking analytics, or advanced data analytics. 
 Deep understanding of fraud risks across retail banking products and customer journeys.
 Experience developing fraud detection models, customer risk scoring frameworks, and fraud monitoring programs.
 Experience managing fraud technology vendors and implementing fraud 

 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills. 
 Graduate degree in a quantitative or business discipline. Professional certifications such as: Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) 
 Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS) 
 Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) 

 Experience with machine learning and AI-enabled fraud detection solutions. 
 Experience supporting real-time payments, digital banking, and emerging payment ecosystems.
 Experience working with SQL, Python, SAS, Power BI, Tableau, machine learning and predictive analytics tools, fraud detection and case management platforms, identity verification technologies, behavioural analytics solutions, and device intelligence platforms to support data-driven decision-making, fraud prevention, and operational effectiveness.

 Success in This Role 
 You will be successful if you:
 Demonstrate strategic thinking and strong business acumen.
 Drive measurable improvements in fraud control effectiveness.
 Proactively identify emerging fraud risks before they impact customers.
 Build strong partnerships across the Bank and Enterprise.
 Translate complex fraud risks into actionable business recommendations.
 Balance customer experience, operational efficiency, regulatory requirements, and risk management objectives

 We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.

 As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.

Job Description 

 What is the opportunity? 
 As Associate Director, you will take a leading role and undertake analysis to design, develop, and provide ongoing maintenance of the quantitative models used in internal risk management and regulatory capital reporting. In this role you will support capital markets trading and investment portfolios across different asset class. This includes working with the business and the broader risk teams to develop Value-at-Risk (VaR) models, which facilitates the bank’s effective risk management and governance on market and counterparty credit risk model usage.

 What will you do? 
 Develop Value-at-Risk (VaR) models for various financial instruments. 
 Develop computer program to implement the methodology or test methodology soundness.
 Remediate model issues from internal validation, internal audit as well as external regulators.
 Create documentation for the risk models that will satisfy the regulatory expectations (for example, SR-11-7 guidelines published by the Fed).
 Develop and implement performance monitoring framework for VaR models. Conduct model performance monitoring on a regular basis. Summarize the monitoring results into documentation and present results in review committees. 
 Work with market data team to ensure the accuracy and completeness of the market data used to support the various models.  
 Provide comprehensive explanation to risk managers, senior management and regulators regarding methodology analysis.  

 Must-have  
 Over 1 years of working experience in quantitative analytics field.
 Good knowledge of regulatory requirements under statistical regression models, market risk models and regulatory rules. Broad product knowledge across fixed income, equity and derivative instruments. 
 Excellent programming skills (Python or equivalent).
 Proficiency in data management and visualization tools, including databases (SQL/Tableau).
 Ability to collaborate effectively and contribute to team objectives.
 Adaptability to changing circumstances in dynamic environments.
 Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complex information clearly.

 Nice-to-have 
 Prior experience in a trading or risk modeling role.
 Proficiency in developing statistical models using complex, large-scale time series datasets.
 Be familiar with secondar trading market of fixed income instruments in USA.

 We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. ### **Join the Renewed Seneca, The Next Seneca.**



At Seneca Polytechnic, we offer a flexible working environment that supports innovative thinking and encourages exploring new ideas and approaches. As we adapt to an ever\-changing landscape, we continue to promote opportunities for career growth and development. We focus on health and well\-being in all ways to provide great employee experience.

  



**Are you a technology leader who can simplify complexity?**
------------------------------------------------------------


At Seneca Polytechnic, technology powers every aspect of the student, employee, and academic experience. As Seneca continues to strengthen its leadership in artificial intelligence within the postsecondary sector, we are investing in modern enterprise applications, cloud platforms, data capabilities and AI\-enabled solutions that support teaching, learning and institutional operations. We are looking for a technology leader who can navigate complex enterprise environments, build trusted partnerships and deliver practical, scalable solutions that advance Seneca's strategic priorities.  

  

Reporting to the CIO, the Director, Enterprise Software Solutions leads the teams responsible for enterprise applications, systems integration, business intelligence, application development and production support. You will shape Seneca’s information solutions strategy, modernize its digital environment and help ensure technology investments improve teaching, learning, institutional services and student success.

--------------------

----------------------------

* Progressive leadership experience in information solutions, enterprise applications or solution architecture within a complex organization.
* Strong technical depth and a willingness to remain actively involved in architecture, design and delivery within a lean, multidisciplinary environment.
* A track record of turning complex business and technology challenges into practical, maintainable solutions that deliver measurable value.
* Experience designing integrated enterprise solutions and leading modernization initiatives from planning through implementation and support.
* Knowledge of application architecture, systems integration, data and analytics, cloud services and modern delivery practices, with hands\-on experience applying or deploying enterprise AI capabilities using solutions from major cloud and AI technology providers.

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
**Position purpose**

The Director of Finance is accountable for the integrity of KHI’s financial management and provides strategic financial advice to the Executive Director and Board of Directors. The position leads financial planning, accounting, reporting, controls and funding administration to support organizational sustainability and responsible stewardship of housing assets and public resources.

The role combines senior financial leadership with hands\-on oversight appropriate to KHI’s size. The Director works with operations staff to understand service needs and translate them into affordable plans, and maintains productive relationships with the City, Region, auditors, lenders and other funding partners.

**1\. Financial strategy, budgets and forecasting**

· Lead the annual operating and capital budget process, establish assumptions and timelines, and consolidate departmental submissions.

· Prepare multi\-year financial plans, property\-level analysis, cash flow forecasts and scenario modelling; identify affordability pressures and options.

· Monitor actual results against budgets and forecasts, explain variances and recommend corrective action.

· Advise on reserves, debt, mortgage maturity and end\-of\-operating\-agreement implications, and long\-term funding needs.

· Provide financial analysis for service changes, major purchases, agreements and organizational initiatives.

**2\. Accounting and financial operations**

· Oversee the general ledger, financial coding, accruals, account reconciliations and timely monthly, quarterly and annual close.

· Ensure accurate processing and reconciliation of accounts payable, accounts receivable, banking, tenant revenue and other financial transactions.

· Work with housing operations to reconcile rent charges, subsidies, arrears, adjustments and write\-offs; support consistent financial controls over tenant accounts.

· Maintain appropriate capital asset records and accounting treatment for capital expenditures, grants, restricted funds and reserves.

· Monitor cash requirements, banking arrangements and authorized investment activity in accordance with approved policies.

· Oversee applicable tax filings, rebates and statutory remittances, obtaining specialist advice when required.

**3\. Housing funding and compliance**

· Maintain a complete register of funding agreements, restrictions, reporting obligations, deadlines and accountable staff.

· Lead financial submissions to the Region and other funders, including budgets, subsidy reconciliations, grant claims and year\-end reports.

· Oversee financial administration of applicable capital and housing programs, including COCHI, OPHI and CMHC\-funded initiatives where relevant.

· Track eligible expenditures, funding receipts, contributions and commitments; maintain supporting documentation for claims and funder reviews.

· Identify and promptly escalate potential ineligible costs, funding shortfalls, missed milestones or repayment exposure.

· Work with operations and project leads to coordinate financial information with non\-financial program reporting.

**4\. Capital planning, asset renewal and development**

· Partner with operations to translate asset condition information and renewal priorities into long\-term capital funding plans.

· Develop business cases and financial models for retrofits, redevelopment, new housing and major capital investments.

· Monitor approved project budgets, contracts, commitments, actual costs and forecast costs to completion.

· Evaluate funding and financing options, affordability impacts and financial risks; support applications and negotiations with authorized decision\-makers.

· Report emerging project variances and recommend funding or scope adjustments through the appropriate approval process.

**5\. Governance, audit and risk**

· Prepare timely financial statements, dashboards and decision reports for the Executive Director, Board and relevant committees.

· Attend meetings as required and explain financial performance, forecasts, funding issues and proposed decisions in accessible language.

· Lead the external audit, prepare working papers and supporting schedules, and coordinate responses and follow\-up on audit findings.

· Develop and maintain financial policies, delegated authorities, purchasing and payment controls, and appropriate segregation of duties.

· Monitor financial risks, fraud exposure and control weaknesses; escalate material issues and implement approved remedies.

· Maintain secure financial records, documented procedures, backup coverage and effective handover arrangements.

**6\. Team leadership and organizational support**

· Set priorities and performance expectations for finance staff; provide coaching, feedback, development and workload planning.

· Build staff capacity through documented procedures, cross\-training and practical guidance on financial responsibilities.

· Support procurement and contract administration with financial review, budget confirmation and compliance with approved authorities.

· Maintain accessible financial records of contracts, insurance, funding and other commitments in coordination with responsible colleagues.

· Provide verified financial records and analysis to support legal, insurance and dispute matters when requested, working with the Executive Director and counsel.

· Improve reporting and workflows while maintaining reliable service and appropriate controls.

· Undertake other related responsibilities consistent with the purpose and level of the position.

**Qualifications and competencies**

· CPA designation in good standing; degree in accounting, finance, business or a related discipline.

· Substantial progressive financial management experience, including staff leadership and accountability for budgeting, financial reporting, audit and controls.
