jobs.title: Associate Director, Data Sciences
jobs.description:
SOTI is committed to providing its employees with endless possibilities; learning new things, working with the latest technologies and making a difference in the world.

Job Title
: Associate Director, Data Sciences

Location:
Mississauga, Ontario, Canada

Work Model:
Hybrid

Who We Are 

It all started with a classic story about one developer’s vision. In 1995, Carl Rodrigues, President and CEO of SOTI, has developed solutions for managing mobile device screens from a desktop. An innovation that has put him ahead in what is now one of the largest growing markets – Enterprise Mobility Management (EMM). Today, more than 17,000 enterprise customers around the world depend on us to secure, manage, and support their mobile operations, with millions of devices managed worldwide.

SOTI’s two decades of success has built strong partnerships with leading mobile platform providers and device manufacturers. We are deeply committed to researching and developing solutions that address today’s toughest mobility challenges. We strive to go where nobody has gone before.

What’s In It for You? 

The People - From our humble origins in our founder’s basement to our industry-leading position today, SOTI has worked hard to foster a company culture that we can all believe in. A culture that emphasizes personal growth, continuous innovation, and fun.  

The Growth - Our environment fosters new ideas, fresh perspectives, and the ability to take them over the goal line. SOTI is a fast-paced environment with a global reach that encourages you to make your mark and be part of something big! 

The Technology - You’ll get the chance to work with leading-edge technologies and take on complex and interesting projects as part of highly collaborative and agile teams. You will work alongside SOTI’s partners, which include leading tech giants that will keep you on the cusp of emerging technologies. 

What We’re Looking For

As Associate Director of Data Sciences, you will spearhead the strategic direction of AI and data intelligence initiatives at SOTI, transforming complex data challenges into enterprise-wide innovations that drive competitive advantage and long-term growth.

Reporting to senior leadership, you'll oversee the evolution of our data science capabilities, ensuring alignment with business objectives while mentoring high-calibre teams to deliver transformative AI solutions.

What You’ll Do

Spearhead the Data Science function responsible for developing and delivering AI-driven capabilities across SOTI’s product portfolio.
Define, execute, and continually refine the enterprise-wide AI strategy, integrating machine learning, advanced analytics, and data intelligence to optimize product capabilities, enhance customer outcomes, and boost operational efficiency across SOTI’s global portfolio.
Stay current with emerging developments in artificial intelligence and machine learning and translate them into practical innovations that strengthen SOTI’s competitive position.
Partner closely with Product Management and Development teams to embed predictive insights, anomaly detection, and automation into SOTI One product constituents.
Guide and mentor a team of data scientists and ML engineers, fostering a culture of experimentation, innovation, and delivery excellence.
Drive the development of scalable machine learning pipelines and data platforms capable of processing large-scale device telemetry and operational data.
Collaborate with engineering teams to operationalize models in production environments using modern MLOps practices.
Proactively identify and prioritize AI opportunities through market analysis and stakeholder alignment, leveraging analytics for advanced product intelligence, predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, and actionable operational insights that deliver measurable ROI for enterprise customers.
Advise executive leadership on AI trends, risks, and investment priorities, crafting roadmaps that align data science initiatives with SOTI’s long-term business goals and regulatory landscape.

Experience You’ll Bring

Graduate degree in computer science, software engineering, applied mathematics, data science, statistics, or other related field
10+ years in analytics, data science, or related fields, with 5+ years in senior leadership roles overseeing cross-functional teams and strategic AI implementations.
Strong communication and leadership skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and translate complex analytical concepts into product value.
Proven experience delivering machine learning capabilities within production SaaS or enterprise software products.
Strong understanding of statistical modeling, machine learning, and modern AI techniques including supervised learning, anomaly detection, time-series analysis, and deep learning.
Demonstrated experience in strategic planning, including developing AI roadmaps, budgeting for data science initiatives, and evaluating partnerships or acquisitions to accelerate innovation.
Experience working with large-scale data platforms and cloud environments such as Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services.
Experience building production-grade ML pipelines including model training, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
Experience working with large telemetry datasets, distributed data processing systems, or real-time analytics platforms is considered an asset.

About SOTI

SOTI is the world's most trusted provider of mobile and IoT management solutions, with more than 17,000 enterprise customers and millions of devices managed worldwide. SOTI's innovative portfolio of solutions and services provides the tools organizations need to mobilize their operations and optimize their mobility investments.

SOTI extends secure mobility management to provide a flexible solution for comprehensive management and security of all mobile devices and connected peripherals deployed in an organization.

At SOTI, we celebrate the uniqueness of our global teams and are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are curious problem solvers who are committed to bringing the best mobile and IoT management solutions to the market. We offer careers with #EndlessPossibilities.

What are you waiting for? Apply today!

If you want to bring your ideas to life, apply at SOTI today.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring

SOTI uses AI tools to support parts of our recruitment process, such as reviewing resumes, screening qualifications, and creating interview questions. These tools assist our team only-final hiring decisions are made by people, not automation. For privacy-related questions, please contact privacy@soti.net
.

We are committed to providing accessible employment practices that are in compliance with the requirements under the Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). If you require accommodation during any stage of the recruitment process, please notify People & Culture at careers@soti.net
.

We are seeking an accomplished strategy executive to lead and scale a high-impact strategy practice across the Americas within a global digital experience and transformation environment. This role combines executive advisory, business development, thought leadership, and strategic team leadership to drive measurable client and business outcomes. You will advise senior executives on brand differentiation, customer experience, data activation, personalization, and AI-driven transformation. As a key contributor to business growth, you will shape complex strategic pursuits, develop differentiated service offerings, and strengthen market positioning. You will also champion AI-native approaches that improve research, strategic development, and consulting operations. Working closely with Creative, Data & AI, and Technology leaders, you will build a high-performing team and help organizations unlock new opportunities at the intersection of technology, creativity, and data. This is a fully remote, full-time opportunity open to candidates residing in Ontario or Québec.

Accountabilities

Executive client advisory: Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to CMOs, CIOs, marketing leaders, and other senior stakeholders. Guide clients through complex business challenges involving brand strategy, customer experience, data, technology, personalization, and AI. Develop and communicate compelling points of view on emerging trends and connect brand differentiation with data-driven customer engagement.
Strategic pursuits and business development: Partner with account teams to identify, qualify, and develop high-value opportunities before formal procurement or proposal stages. Help clients define their business challenges and strategic priorities, evaluate potential investments, and position integrated solutions spanning brand, creative, data, AI, and technology.
Pursuit leadership: Lead strategic opportunities from initial identification through final client presentations and deal closure. Develop persuasive narratives, differentiated value propositions, and solution strategies while collaborating with commercial and pricing teams to align recommendations with business objectives. Coach presentation teams and translate lessons from successful and unsuccessful pursuits into continuous improvements.
Offering development: Transform client needs and market insights into scalable, repeatable service offerings. Define how strategy, brand, data activation, personalization, and AI capabilities are packaged, positioned, and commercialized. Continuously refine offerings to reflect evolving technologies, AI capabilities, and market demand while ensuring consistency across practices.
Thought leadership and market presence: Represent the organization at industry conferences, executive forums, analyst briefings, and client events. Develop original research, intellectual property, and thought leadership that establish market credibility and strengthen positioning in AI-driven experience innovation. Build relationships with analysts, strategic partners, and influential industry stakeholders.
Strategy practice leadership: Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of strategists across the Americas. Establish scalable operating models, methodologies, tools, and ways of working that support sustainable growth and consistent delivery.
AI-native transformation: Design and implement AI-enabled approaches to research, information synthesis, strategic development, pursuit support, and practice operations. Identify opportunities to improve productivity, decision-making, and client value through practical AI adoption.
Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with Creative, Data & AI, Technology, commercial, and account leadership teams to deliver integrated solutions and strengthen client relationships. Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, knowledge-sharing, and continuous learning.

Requirements

Senior strategy and consulting experience: Significant experience in strategy consulting, digital consulting, business transformation, or a related executive advisory discipline.
Executive advisory expertise: A proven track record advising CMOs, marketing leaders, and senior executives on business growth, strategic positioning, and transformation initiatives. Ability to engage credibly with CIOs and technology leaders on how technology investments translate into business outcomes.
Deep digital and customer experience knowledge: Strong understanding of brand strategy, customer experience, data activation, personalization, marketing transformation, and AI-driven business opportunities.
Business development and pursuit leadership: Demonstrated success leading complex, multidisciplinary strategic pursuits from opportunity qualification through proposal development, executive presentations, and deal closure.
Practice and team development: Experience building and scaling high-performing strategy or advisory teams, establishing effective operating models, and developing methodologies and business practices for growing consulting organizations.
AI-enabled strategy capabilities: Proven ability to introduce and scale AI-enabled or AI-native approaches within strategy, consulting, or advisory environments. A forward-thinking mindset and the ability to translate emerging capabilities into practical business value are essential.
Executive communication and storytelling: Exceptional presentation, communication, and strategic storytelling skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly, influence senior decision-makers, and develop compelling business narratives.
Stakeholder management: Ability to navigate complex, matrixed organizations, build trusted relationships, and influence stakeholders across multiple functions and organizational levels.
Preferred qualifications: External industry visibility through speaking engagements, published thought leadership, analyst relations, or industry participation; experience across brand, marketing, data, and technology transformation; established relationships with technology or strategic alliance partners; and experience supporting global clients and large-scale transformation programs.
Location and language requirements: Candidates must reside in Ontario or Québec. English fluency is required for all candidates, including those based in Québec, due to regular collaboration with teams across the Americas and occasional engagement with teams in Europe.
Professional mindset: Intellectual curiosity, collaborative leadership, adaptability, and a commitment to challenging conventional approaches while supporting continuous learning and innovation.

Candidates who do not meet every qualification are still encouraged to apply if they bring relevant experience, diverse perspectives, and a strong willingness to learn.

Benefits

Annual salary: CAD $170,000–$230,000, depending on experience and location.
Remote work: Fully remote position for eligible candidates residing in Ontario or Québec.
Comprehensive insurance: Choice of Gold, Silver, or Bronze coverage options, with employer contributions of up to 80% depending on the selected plan. Coverage includes short-term and long-term disability.
Virtual healthcare: Access to virtual healthcare services through Dialogue via Sun Life, including consultations and prescription renewals.
Mental health and well-being: Employee and Family Assistance Program and comprehensive mental health support.
Personal Spending Account: CAD $500 to support eligible expenses, including healthcare reimbursements, gym memberships, public transit, office supplies, or RRSP contributions.
Retirement savings: Employer matching of 100% of eligible RRSP contributions through a Deferred Profit Sharing Plan (DPSP), up to 4%. RRSP contributions can begin immediately, while DPSP participation begins after three months of service. DPSP vesting occurs after 24 months of service.

Holiday flexibility: Company closure during the winter holidays and flexible scheduling throughout the year, including opportunities to enjoy Friday afternoons off when weekly hours have been completed.
Professional growth: Opportunities to influence business strategy, develop innovative AI-driven capabilities, strengthen executive relationships, and lead transformation initiatives across a global consulting environment.

Director, Virtual Care Technology Applications

We are looking for a highly technical, business-oriented Director, Virtual Care Technology Applications to help lead the strategy, modernization, and evolution of our Virtual Care program within Pharmacy and Healthcare Technology.

This role will look across the end-to-end Virtual Care ecosystem, including the current solution, business capabilities, technology architecture, operational dependencies, provider experience, integrations, vendor landscape, and future growth opportunities. This individual will bring forward innovative ideas, provide practical recommendations, influence key decisions, and help shape a roadmap that supports business growth, improved patient and pharmacy experiences, and operational excellence.

This technical leadership role requires a seasoned hands-on leader who can operate at every level — from shaping business strategy to diving deep into complex technical solutions alongside their teams. The ideal candidate brings a track record of leading cross-functional teams through ambiguity, bridging the gap between business priorities and technology execution, while charting a clear path from the program's current state to an elevated future state.

What You'll Do

Provide strategic and technical leadership across the end-to-end Virtual Care program.
Assess the current Virtual Care solution focused on the provider experience, including its strengths, weaknesses, risks, dependencies, scalability, stability, and long-term viability.
Develop a strong understanding of the business, product, operational, and technology landscape supporting Virtual Care.
Partner with business, digital, product, operations, architecture, engineering, security, infrastructure, and vendor teams to shape and evolve the Virtual Care roadmap.
Bring forward innovative ideas, solution options, and strategic recommendations that help improve provider experience and efficiency while supporting long-term business objectives.
Influence key decisions by clearly outlining business value, technical feasibility, risk, cost, complexity, timelines, and long-term sustainability.
Guide technology choices, application design, architecture direction, and modernization opportunities.
Ensure Virtual Care solutions align with enterprise architecture standards, technology strategy, security expectations, privacy requirements, and healthcare technology objectives.
Work with delivery teams to remove blockers, improve execution velocity, and ensure initiatives remain aligned to roadmap priorities.
Partner with operations teams to improve application stability, resiliency, supportability, monitoring, incident response, and production performance.
Provide guidance to engineering and delivery teams to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable, reliable, and designed for future growth.
Translate complex technical concepts into clear business language for senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
Prepare and present recommendations, decision points, roadmap options, risks, and trade-offs to support informed decision-making.
Collaborate across a matrixed environment and build alignment between business needs, digital priorities, technical strategy, and operational realities.
Support investment planning, vendor discussions, technology evaluations, and business cases related to the Virtual Care platform.
Help ensure technology investments deliver meaningful value to patients, pharmacy teams, healthcare professionals, and the broader organization.

What You'll Bring

An undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Significant experience in technology leadership, enterprise consulting, solution architecture, application development, or a related field, ideally within healthcare, pharmacy, digital health, or another regulated environment.
Proven ability to serve as a senior technology advisor or solution leader in complex, matrixed enterprise environments.
Strong understanding of end-to-end technology ecosystems, including applications, integrations, infrastructure, cloud, data, security, operations, vendors, and user experience.
Experience assessing current-state environments and developing practical future-state roadmaps, modernization strategies, architectural proposals, and business cases.
Strong knowledge of modern architecture and development practices, including cloud platforms, microservices, APIs, distributed systems, enterprise integration, and legacy modernization.
Ability to evaluate technology options and recommend solutions that balance business value, technical complexity, cost, risk, sustainability, and total cost of ownership.
Experience guiding application modernization, platform stabilization, technology consolidation, cloud transformation, vendor evaluation, platform selection, and technology investment planning.
Proven ability to influence decisions and build alignment across business, technology, operations, vendors, executives, and cross-functional delivery teams.
Strong communication, facilitation, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.

Marketing

About The Role

Blacksmith Agency runs PPC and SEO for clients across multifamily, B2B and technical verticals. As Director of Digital Marketing you lead that department. The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist report to you and they are the specialists in their channels. Right now nobody owns this function, which is the whole reason this seat is open.

This is a management seat, not a senior individual contributor one.
You will not be building campaigns, and on technical SEO your strategist will know more than you do. That is the arrangement, not a gap. You carry channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale. The strategists carry the execution of it, and you carry whether the department delivers.

What You Own

The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist: their quality bar, their development, their reviews, and the call when someone is not going to get there.
The standard the work is held to. What a good audit looks like, what gets checked before work leaves the agency, how an account is reported. You write it and you hold two specialists to it.
Client results across the whole function, including whether our reporting is honest. Nobody here is auditing attribution and GA4 accuracy today.
The escalation when an account is at risk. You diagnose it, you direct the strategist who fixes it, and you are on the call with the client.
Channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale.
What we tell sales we can credibly deliver, before it gets sold.
The hiring plan for the department, and first-round interviews for your own team, within about a quarter.

What You Need

Strategists or specialists who have reported to you, where their reviews, their development and the decision when someone was not working out were yours. Managing accounts is not this.
7+ years across paid media and SEO. Owning one channel while sitting beside the other does not count here.
Enough depth in Google Ads, GA4, Search Console, Meta and Microsoft Ads to tell good work from work that merely looks good. That is a lower bar than doing it and a higher bar than reading a report.
One account you turned around that you can talk through: the metric, the figure before, the figure after, and why the change worked. Whose hands were on the keyboard matters far less than whether the diagnosis was yours.
Comfortable being the client-facing owner when an account is underperforming. That call comes to you, not to the strategist.
Agency experience carrying many accounts at once.

Please do not apply if

Nobody has ever reported to you, or you have never owned someone's review or had to performance-manage anyone.
You have only ever run one channel.
All of your experience is in-house on a single brand.
What you actually want is to keep building campaigns yourself. That is not a lesser ambition, it is a different job, and this is not it.

None of these are preferences we bend on. They are how we screen, so applying anyway costs you an hour and gets you a no.

Process

Three conversations, then a decision. A thirty minute screen with our recruiter, a first round with the founder this seat reports to, and a final. No take-home project and no panel interview.

How To Apply

Four fields at the link, then a short 6 minute Predictive Index assessment. Use the same email throughout. No cover letter.

, full-time

The role ensures technology and cybersecurity risks are identified, assessed, mitigated, monitored, and reported in alignment with the firm’s risk appetite, regulatory expectations, and business strategy.

This role requires a visionary leader with a deep understanding of cybersecurity principles, risk management, and compliance frameworks. The ideal candidate will possess strong communication and leadership skills, the ability to navigate complex regulatory landscapes, and a commitment to continuous improvement in the face of a rapidly evolving cybersecurity environment.

What will you do?

jobs.title: Senior Director, Enterprise Data & Governance
jobs.description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We’re looking for a Senior Director, Enterprise Data & Governance
to join our Data team in Canada.

You will partner directly with the Business and serve as the chief architect of our corporate data strategy, bridging the gap between deep technical infrastructure and executive business vision. You will lead your global team to drive seamless data flows, optimize day-to-day data operations, and transform our data ecosystem into a highly governed, scalable, and AI-ready asset.

You will be a key player in our Data Office, applying your data expertise and elevating data standards across the organization. If you are a seasoned data executive who thrives on mastering complex SaaS data lifecycles (from ERP, CRM and billing engines to predictive AI consumption layers) this is the opportunity you've been waiting for to maximize the use of data to fuel business growth and make a tangible impact!

Please note that this role is a hybrid role located in Montreal, Canada.

What You'll Be Doing

Leadership, Team & Stakeholder Management

People Management & Culture: A proven track record in people management, with a dedicated focus on driving career growth, mentorship, and hands-on support. You know how to cultivate a high-performing culture rooted in teamwork, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Global Pod Leadership & Accountability: Experience leading a global team of Data Analysts inside agile data Pods, owning the overall performance and results delivered. You will ensure your team works hand-in-hand with diverse business partners to build data models, manage pipelines, and analyze performance—enabling critical insights and operational efficiencies across Enterprise data domains (including Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Operations).
Strategic Partnership: Partner closely with C-suite and VP-level Business stakeholders to develop and execute a comprehensive Enterprise Data strategy aligned with business and technology objectives.
Roadmap Ownership: Oversee the development of data roadmaps for your Pods, ensuring deep compatibility with Enterprise Financial ERPs, planning tools, and subscription billing engines, while shaping the broader Data Office roadmap to industrialize data.

Enterprise Data Architecture & Master Data Management (MDM)

Architecture Strategy: Maintain a deep understanding of our products, systems, and underlying data architecture to ensure clean logical isolation and robust data lineage.
MDM Design: Design, champion, and execute a comprehensive Master Data Management (MDM) strategy to establish a trusted "Single Source of Truth" across core operational systems, Lightspeed Products and core financial infrastructure.
Exploratory Modelling: Leverage deep system knowledge to develop exploratory data models across diverse data sources, supporting the Business with insightful datasets, enterprise reporting, and smart surfacing.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with the Data Solutions team to co-develop pod-specific data models, transitioning agile, domain-focused insights into scalable, production-grade assets that align with enterprise architecture and governance.

Data Governance, Compliance & Quality Management

Framework Establishment: Collaborate with Business stakeholders to establish, promote, and implement strict data governance policies, standards, and procedures.
Data Integrity Enforcement: Monitor data quality and ensure data integrity across Lightspeed by fostering accountability, investigating discrepancies at the source, documenting findings, and driving continuous improvement.
Regulatory Compliance: Mitigate corporate risk by ensuring global compliance across diverse data footprints against data privacy regulations.

Advanced Analytics & AI-Driven Consumption

Analytics Standards: Lead the development and adoption of the highest analytics standards and methodologies among the Data Office and across the organization.
Advanced Data Mining: Lead analysis and mining of large data sets to derive actionable insights using prescriptive, descriptive, predictive, exploratory, and inferential analysis.
Next-Gen Consumption: Support your team in creating measurement plans that move the organization beyond static dashboards into dynamic, semantic, and AI-driven data surfacing models (GenAI tools, predictive modeling, and automated alerting).
Cross-Functional Synergy: Collaborate with analytic engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to understand complex requirements and help create user-friendly solutions.

What You Need To Bring

Extensive Experience: 15+ years of dedicated experience in data operations, master data management (MDM), or data architecture roles, with at least 7+ years in a senior executive or directory-level leadership position.
Technical Mastery: Strong technical skills, including Strong technical literacy and familiarity with cloud data stacks, specifically Google Cloud Platform (GCP) BigQuery and Looker, alongside core SQL and GitHub capabilities. Experience with transformation and modeling tools like Dataform is a strong plus.
Systems Fluency: Hands-on experience navigating the data footprints of Enterprise ERPs and Planning tools (e.g., NetSuite, Oracle, Pigment), complex Order Management Systems (OMS), CRM platforms (Salesforce/HubSpot), and Billing & Subscription Management infrastructure.
SaaS Acumen: Strong business acumen and an understanding of the SaaS business model, multi-tenant architectures, and key SaaS performance metrics (MRR, LTV, CAC, NRR), with a passion for bridging the gap between technical insights and business strategy.
Linguistic Fluency: Exceptional communication skills in English (written and spoken) to articulate complex insights with clarity and impact, alongside strong interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional global teams. Professional fluency in French is strongly appreciated but not mandatory.
Execution & Mindset: Excellent organizational and project management skills, a self-starter mentality, and the proven ability to drive multiple priorities autonomously in a fast-paced setting. Strong instincts for identifying high-impact work aligned with business priorities, comfortable saying no, negotiating scope with stakeholders, and proposing tradeoffs..

Be a changemaker

You’ll Enjoy

A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work
A culture that celebrates performance
The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard
Career-defining opportunities

Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled.

Flexible paid time off and remote work policies
Equity options, because this is your company too
Contributions to your pension plan. Your future matters
Training opportunities to grow your skills and career
Health and wellness credit so you feel your best
Time off to volunteer and give back to your community
Interest groups, employee led networks, social committees to sponsored sports teams
Computer purchase program to get your personal Macbook
Enhanced parental leave to support growing families

Fuel your growth. Find your people.

At Lightspeed, your growth is our priority. We invest in you with continuous learning opportunities, global mobility and benefits designed to support you—all within a driven, diverse and inclusive team that’s passionate about empowering our communities

Please note that we ask applicants to disclose any criminal convictions, and we conduct criminal record checks as part of our hiring process for this role.

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who We Are

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

jobs.description:
About The Role:

Grade Level (for internal use):

12

About The Role

Join S&P Global Ratings’ Financial Services practice as part of the Non-Bank Financial Institutions team, a group of approximately 15 analysts covering asset managers, financial market infrastructure companies, and finance companies.

In this role, you will lead credit analysis across a portfolio of complex financial institutions and contribute to independent credit opinions relied on by market participants. You will combine rigorous financial analysis, market insight, and sound judgment while helping the team strengthen analytical quality, develop junior colleagues, and responsibly adopt new technology.

What You’ll Do

Impact

Deliver high-quality, forward-looking credit analysis that supports clear and well-supported rating opinions.
Identify emerging risks by connecting company performance, peer trends, market developments, and broader financial services themes.
Contribute market-facing research and insights that help investors, issuers, and other stakeholders understand evolving credit risks.

Responsibilities

Core Analytical & Delivery

Lead surveillance and analytical updates across an assigned portfolio, ensuring accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and clear reasoning.
Evaluate financial and credit data, validate inputs, reconcile key metrics, and document analytical assumptions and model changes.
Use approved generative AI and automation capabilities to enhance research and analytical workflows while maintaining appropriate human oversight.

Stakeholder & Market Engagement

Translate complex analysis into clear, decision-useful written and verbal communication for rating committees and external stakeholders.
Build trusted relationships with issuers, investors, and market participants and contribute to thought leadership and strategic initiatives.

Team Contribution & Capability Building

Coach junior analysts on credit fundamentals, financial modeling, analytical quality, and responsible use of technology.
Help improve analytical processes, tools, and workflows and support the testing and adoption of new capabilities.

Risk Management & Operating

Maintain high standards for methodology, documentation, confidentiality, data governance, and responsible AI use.

Compensation / Benefits Information

For U.S. candidates: S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $123,000 USD to $192,000 USD. Final base salary will be based on geographic location, experience, skill set, training, licenses, and certifications. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan.

For Canadian candidates: S&P Global states that the anticipated range of compensation for this position is 111,000 CAD to 165,000 CAD. Final compensation will be based on performance, geographic location, experience, skill set, training, licenses, and certifications. In accordance with Ontario regulations effective January 1, 2026, this posting provides information on expected compensation. S&P Global will not be utilizing artificial intelligence in our hiring process. All interviewed candidates will be informed of hiring decisions within 45 days of their interview. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

What We’re Looking For

Required Skills and Experience

Proven credit and financial analysis skills, including the ability to translate complex information into clear, evidence-based conclusions.
Strong understanding of financial services and the ability to connect sector and market developments with emerging credit risks.
Strong written and verbal communication skills for rating committee materials and engagement with issuers, investors, and other market participants.
Experience coaching or mentoring junior analysts and strengthening analytical quality through constructive feedback and review.
Strong judgment and attention to accuracy, analytical rigor, documentation, confidentiality, and governance.

Preferred Or Helpful Experience

An S&P Global employee at this level would typically have 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in corporate credit analysis or a related financial services field.
Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent required. A master’s degree or professional certification (such as CFA) is highly valued. We welcome candidates from traditional finance disciplines as well as diverse academic backgrounds that support innovative and critical thinking.
Experience using generative AI, large language models, data tools, or automation within analytical workflows, with appropriate validation and governance.
Experience improving processes through standardization, tooling, or automation and supporting the testing and adoption of new capabilities.

Additional Information

We require all candidates who reach the final stage of our interview process to attend at least one in-person interview, which is ordinarily at your nearest S&P Global Ratings office. This must be completed before we can proceed to an offer.
Employees are required to work from the office a minimum of two days per week.

About S&P Global Ratings

At S&P Global Ratings, our analyst-driven credit ratings, research, and sustainable finance opinions provide critical insights that are essential to translating complexity into clarity so market participants can uncover opportunities and make decisions with conviction. By bringing transparency to the market through high-quality independent opinions on creditworthiness, we enable growth across a wide variety of organizations, including businesses, governments, and institutions.

S&P Global Ratings is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global is the world’s foremost provider of credit ratings, benchmarks, analytics and workflow solutions in the global capital, commodity and automotive markets. With every one of our offerings, we help many of the world’s leading organizations navigate the economic landscape so they can plan for tomorrow, today.

For more information, visit www.spglobal.com/ratings

What’s In It For
You?

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. The Company:

Exclusive Floors is British Columbia’s largest provider and installer of flooring and tile and a long-standing leader in the industry, with an exceptional reputation in the market. For over 40 years, the company has served builders, developers, designers and homeowners with exceptional service, deep product expertise and industry-leading installation quality. Exclusive Floors is searching for a Director of Finance to strengthen financial leadership, provide greater insight into business performance, and help build the systems and processes needed to support continued profitable growth.

The Role:

The Director of Finance will be a visible and influential leader across the organization, with full ownership of the day-to-day finance function. As a key member of the leadership team, this person will lead and develop an experienced finance team, ensure accurate and timely reporting, and bring financial insight and sound judgment to business decisions. The Director will have a key leadership role in the implementation of NetSuite, strengthen financial processes and controls, manage risk, and provide the insight needed to support the company’s continued growth.

The Responsibilities:

Take ownership of the day-to-day finance function, including financial reporting, payables, collections, cash management and financial discipline.
Ensure accurate and timely financial reporting, including monthly statements, cash flow reporting and executive reporting.
Lead annual budgeting and forecasting, providing clear visibility into business drivers and expected results.
Develop meaningful financial and operating KPIs that provide leadership with timely insight into performance.
Be a strategic finance partner to the President and leadership team, bringing financial insight and sound judgment to key business decisions.
Analyze profitability, costs, trends and growth opportunities, translating financial information into clear recommendations.
Partner with sales and operations to support profitable growth while managing financial and contractual risk.

jobs.description:

Job Description Summary:

The Senior Technical Director defines and drives the technical strategy across the DataEdge portfolio. In close partnership with Product Management, Engineering, Support, and executive leadership, this role aligns product roadmaps, platform investments, and architectural decisions with customer needs, business objectives, and Rocket’s strategy to become a platform company.

The DataEdge portfolio includes Rocket’s data integration, replication, synchronization, virtualization, and data intelligence solutions. It helps customers unlock enterprise data across distributed, cloud, and mainframe environments by making trusted data available where it is needed. As AI adoption accelerates, DataEdge delivers trusted, connected, and actionable information to the applications, platforms, models, agents, and intelligent business processes that power modern digital enterprises.

This role will evolve the portfolio into an integrated platform through cloud-native architecture, shared services, AI-enabled innovation, and cross-product collaboration. The Senior Technical Director will also work with peer technical leaders to shape the Data Modernization business unit’s technical strategy, identify shared opportunities, and align architecture and investment decisions across portfolios. Success requires technical leadership and the ability to build alignment and shared ownership.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Partner with Product Management to define the DataEdge platform strategy and translate business priorities into a shared, cross-product technical roadmap.
Build alignment across Product, Engineering, and Architecture, balancing product needs with DataEdge platform objectives and the shared technical direction of the Data Modernization business unit.
Work with peer technical leaders to shape the Data Modernization business unit’s technical strategy, align investments, and identify shared platform opportunities.
Drive reusable services, APIs, frameworks, and common platform capabilities while consolidating overlapping technologies.
Define cloud-native strategies for deployment, configuration, scalability, observability, security, and operational excellence.
Partner with Product and Engineering to identify, prioritize, and deliver AI platform capabilities, intelligent automation, MCP, and agentic systems that create measurable customer value and competitive differentiation.
Represent the DataEdge technology vision internally and externally. Use customer input, industry trends, analyst perspectives, emerging technologies, and competitive insight to shape strategy and investment priorities.
Shape DataEdge’s role in the broader data, analytics, and AI ecosystem through technology partnerships, industry standards, open APIs, and interoperability frameworks.
Raise engineering effectiveness across the portfolio by advancing AI-enabled development, testing, documentation, modernization, and delivery practices.
Lead architecture reviews, communicate decisions and tradeoffs, and mentor Principal Engineers, architects, and other senior technical leaders.

Required Qualifications:

12+ years of software engineering, architecture, or technical leadership experience.
Proven experience defining architecture and technology strategy across multiple enterprise products or platforms and contributing to strategy across a broader business or portfolio.
Strong expertise in LLMs, agentic systems, retrieval architectures, enterprise AI integration, responsible AI patterns, and emerging interoperability standards such as MCP.
Demonstrated delivery of AI-enabled product capabilities and adoption of AI-enabled engineering practices.
Deep expertise in cloud-native architecture, containers, Kubernetes, distributed systems, and modern software delivery.
Experience building shared platforms, services, APIs, or reusable frameworks and leading technology consolidation.
Successful partnership with Product Management on strategy, roadmaps, prioritization, and investment decisions.
Demonstrated ability to work with peer senior technical leaders to shape strategy, resolve cross-portfolio tradeoffs, align technical investments, and influence without direct authority.
Demonstrated ability to shape ecosystem strategy across enterprise data, analytics, and AI, including work with customers, technology partners, industry standards, open APIs, and interoperability frameworks.
Exceptional communication and facilitation skills, including with executive leaders, with demonstrated experience mentoring Principal Engineers, architects, and other senior technical leaders.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IS, or related technical discipline.

Notre travail soutient une société prospère où les gens peuvent s’épanouir et saisir des occasions. Il renforce la confiance des consommateurs et des entreprises, aide les organisations à trouver des moyens créatifs de déployer des capitaux, habilite des institutions sociales et économiques justes, fiables et efficaces, et permet à nos amis, à nos familles et à nos collectivités de profiter de la qualité de vie qui accompagne un avenir durable. Étant le plus grand cabinet de services professionnels détenu et exploité à 100 % par des Canadiens dans notre pays, nous sommes fiers de travailler aux côtés de nos clients pour avoir une influence positive sur tous les Canadiens.

En incarnant notre raison d’être, nous aurons une influence marquante.

Diversifiez votre carrière au sein du Cabinet.
Tirez parti d’avantages souples, proactifs et pratiques qui favorisent une culture de bien-être et la création de liens solides.
Approfondissez vos connaissances grâce au mentorat d’experts et à du coaching au travail.

--

À quoi ressemblera votre journée type

En tant que leader fonctionnel d’Oracle EPM Planning (directeur ou directrice), vous serez responsable des initiatives de planification d’entreprise et de transformation de la fonction finance, et guiderez les clients pendant la stratégie, la mise en œuvre et l’adoption.

À Ce Titre, Vous Devrez

Superviser la prestation de bout en bout des missions Oracle EPM Planning, y compris l’étendue, le plan de travail, la gestion des risques et des problèmes (RAID), le suivi financier, la gestion de la qualité et les résultats globaux de la prestation.
Animer des ateliers d’établissement des exigences et de conception des processus, traduire les besoins d’affaires en solutions fonctionnelles, en approche de configuration et en plans de mise en œuvre.
Assumer la responsabilité de la conception de la solution et des décisions en matière d’architecture et fournir des directives à cet égard, en assurant l’harmonisation avec l’architecture d’entreprise, l’évolutivité et la maintenabilité à long terme.
Assurer la direction fonctionnelle des solutions Oracle EPM Planning, y compris Hyperion Planning et la gamme complète de modules EPBCS, en assurant l’alignement sur les objectifs du client et les pratiques exemplaires.
Guider les équipes tout au long de la conception du modèle de planification (catalyseurs, hypothèses, scénarios, flux de travail, production de rapports) et s’assurer que les décisions de conception sont adaptables et justifiables.
Aider les clients à définir des processus de planification et des modèles opérationnels futurs, en tirant parti des capacités Oracle EPM pour améliorer l’efficacité et les renseignements.
Collaborer avec les parties prenantes du client au sein des équipes des finances, des TI et de la haute direction pour favoriser la prise de décisions, résoudre les problèmes et maintenir l’alignement dans l’ensemble du programme.
Superviser les activités de test et de déploiement, notamment la stratégie de test, le tri des défectuosités, l’état de préparation aux essais d’acceptation par l’utilisateur et la planification du déploiement, afin de s’assurer que les solutions répondent aux exigences et sont adoptées avec succès.
Diriger et encadrer les membres de l’équipe de prestation de services (conseillers et conseillers principaux) afin de promouvoir une solide discipline d’exécution et leur perfectionnement grâce au coaching et à une rétroaction de qualité.
Contribuer aux efforts de développement des affaires par l’entremise d’offres de service, d’estimations, d’un soutien en matière de solutions et de présentations aux clients.
Demeurer au courant des nouveautés liées au produit Oracle EPM et intégrer les innovations pertinentes à la prestation de services, en particulier les capacités d’IA/IGR telles que la planification prédictive, Auto Predict et IPM Insights, afin d’améliorer l’exactitude des prévisions et les perspectives d’affaires.
Soutenir l’adoption de résultats propulsés par l’IA, comme des perspectives fondées sur l’IA et l’automatisation narrative, lorsque cela est possible dans l’écosystème Oracle EPM.

Le candidat retenu aura l’occasion de faire partie de notre premier cabinet de services-conseils qui travaille à la fine pointe de mises en œuvre d’Oracle Cloud. Vous travaillerez auprès d’une grande variété de clients et jouerez un rôle important dans certaines des mises en œuvre les plus stimulantes à l’échelle mondiale.

Renseignements sur l’équipe

L’équipe adopte et incarne la raison d’être du Cabinet – c’est-à-dire avoir une influence marquante –, tout en vous poussant à vous surpasser, vous-même et votre équipe, afin de trouver des solutions aux problèmes les plus importants de nos clients, de nos gens et de la société.

jobs.title: Director, Security Operations, Information & Corporate Security
jobs.description:
Purpose. Performance. People.

Joining CPP Investments means joining one of the world’s most admired and respected institutional investors to drive a single mandate: to deliver strong, sustainable returns for generations of Canadians.

With a long-term horizon and global reach, we deploy capital at scale across public and private markets. Our size, stability, and disciplined investment philosophy allow us to pursue complex opportunities and build enduring partnerships worldwide.

For our people, this means meaningful work with tangible impact, real opportunity, and collaboration with exceptional colleagues who value partnership and performance. Here, you’ll contribute to outcomes that matter alongside team members committed to excellence and shared success.

The Role

As Director, Information Security Operations, you will play a critical role in protecting CPP Investments' technology, information, and business operations by leading the delivery and continuous evolution of enterprise security operations capabilities.

This senior individual contributor role provides technical leadership across vulnerability management, AI security operations, security monitoring, detection engineering, incident response, data loss prevention, and insider risk. Working collaboratively across Technology & Data and business teams, you will influence security outcomes, lead complex initiatives, and strengthen CPP Investments' cyber resilience through expertise, partnership, and execution.

The Team

Information Security enables CPP Investments to protect its people, technology, information, and business operations by delivering secure, resilient, and risk-informed capabilities that support the organization's global investment mandate.

The Security Operations team safeguards the organization through proactive monitoring, threat detection, vulnerability management, incident response, and continuous improvement of security capabilities. The team partners closely with Technology & Data and business stakeholders to strengthen cyber resilience and manage evolving security risks.

Accountabilities

Lead enterprise security operations across vulnerability management, AI security operations, security monitoring, detection engineering, incident response, data loss prevention, and insider risk.
Drive risk-based vulnerability management across infrastructure and cloud environments by prioritizing remediation and partnering with stakeholders to reduce risk.
Design, implement, and continuously improve security detections, AI-enabled security capabilities, and Security Operations Centre (SOC) processes.
Act as Incident Commander during cyber security incidents, leading technical response, stakeholder communications, recovery activities, and post-incident improvements.
Provide senior technical expertise and trusted guidance on security risks, controls, and remediation strategies while leading cross-functional security initiatives.
Lead security operations audit activities, including evidence collection, control reviews, remediation planning, and reporting.
Advance the maturity of Security Operations by developing operational metrics, contributing to strategic roadmaps, and mentoring peers through technical leadership and knowledge sharing.

What You Bring

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Business, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
7–10+ years of progressive hands-on experience in information security with demonstrated expertise across multiple security operations disciplines.
Professional security certification(s) such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCSP, GIAC (GCIH, GCFA, GDAT), SABSA, or equivalent are preferred.
Strong technical knowledge of vulnerability management, incident response, detection engineering, cloud and container security, SIEM/XDR platforms, data loss prevention, and insider risk.
Experience applying AI technologies or recognized AI security frameworks within security operations, with knowledge of security and regulatory frameworks including ISO 27001, NIST, COBIT, ITIL, OSFI B-13, PIPEDA, and SOX.
Proven ability to communicate effectively with technical and executive audiences while leading complex cross-functional initiatives and security incidents.
Demonstrated sound judgment, analytical thinking, collaboration, and a commitment to CPP Investments' Guiding Principles of Integrity, High Performance, and Partnership.

You are motivated to contribute to something larger than yourself, approach complex challenges with rigor, and hold yourself to high standards in a collaborative, performance-driven environment.

We provide colleagues with cutting-edge AI tools, dedicated learning time, and practical support to help them deliver with greater impact.

Inclusion & Accessibility

CPP Investments is committed to equitable access to employment and building a workforce that reflects diverse talent and perspectives. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Attention: Protect Yourself from Fraud

CPP Investments is committed to a secure and transparent recruitment process. We will never ask candidates for payment or financial information at any stage of hiring. All legitimate opportunities are posted on our careers page, and communications will come from our applicant tracking system, Workday.

CPP Investments may use AI tools to help screen and assess applicants by analyzing resumes and applications for relevant skills and experience. These tools support, but do not replace, human decision-making.

This highly senior Director role will have full revenue responsibility for Starlink and Connectivity solutions in Canada. The primary focus is Top Fortune / large enterprise business, followed by SLED and government opportunities. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise working with Canada’s largest enterprise organizations and ecosystems, building robust channel ecosystems, and establishing high-level relationships with leading Canadian enterprises. You will build the strategy, the team, the partnerships, and the revenue engine.

Responsibilities

Build and own the complete go-to-market strategy for Starlink Enterprise in Canada from scratch, with primary focus on large enterprise and Top Fortune accounts, followed by SLED and government
Own full revenue responsibility for Starlink and Connectivity solutions across the Canadian market
Establish and scale strategic relationships with Canada’s largest enterprise organizations, key ecosystems, and channel partners
Build a robust multi-tier channel and partner ecosystem to accelerate market coverage and growth
Identify, develop, and close large opportunities with Canada’s top enterprises, while also pursuing high-value civil, provincial, municipal, education, and broader government opportunities as a secondary priority
Recruit, build, and lead a high-performing Canadian sales and channel team
Consistently meet and exceed revenue targets by identifying high-impact opportunities and closing complex deals
Develop, champion, and defend alternative go-to-market and partnership strategies internally
Partner closely with market access, government affairs, finance, legal, product, and engineering teams
Gather market and customer requirements and collaborate with product and engineering to shape Starlink offerings for the Canadian enterprise market
Represent Starlink at key Canadian industry, enterprise, and government conferences and events

Basic Requirements

Bachelor’s degree
12+ years of progressive experience in enterprise sales, business development, or sales leadership (ideally with significant Canadian market experience)

Preferred Skills And Experience

Proven track record of building a market, GTM strategy, and sales/channel organization from the ground up
Deep existing relationships and experience working with Canada’s largest enterprise organizations and ecosystems
Strong expertise building and scaling robust channel and partner ecosystems
Extensive experience selling complex technology or connectivity solutions into large enterprise / Top Fortune accounts
Experience with Canadian government, provincial/municipal, and education (SLED) sectors as a secondary strength
Demonstrated ability to operate with high autonomy and full revenue ownership of a regional business
Strong sales track record with consistent achievement of ambitious revenue targets, preferably in satellite, telecommunications, connectivity, or technology solutions
Independently motivated self-starter with exceptional ownership mentality and the ability to build structure in ambiguous environments
Outstanding interpersonal, executive presence, presentation, and negotiation skills
Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills across business and technical issues
Highly detail-oriented, resilient, and results-driven with excellent customer and partner interface skills
Working knowledge of Starlink’s network infrastructure (or ability to rapidly develop it) sufficient to communicate value to sophisticated enterprise customers and partners
Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing complex external relationships

Additional Requirements

Must be available to work extended hours and weekends as needed
Willingness to travel extensively (approximately 50%+) across Canada to customer and partner locations, as well as to other SpaceX sites as required
Preference for candidates based in Canada or with strong willingness to relocate

McKesson, l’une des 10 premières entreprises du classement Fortune Global 500, touche à pratiquement tous les aspects des soins de santé et s’emploie à faire une réelle différence. Nous sommes reconnus pour notre capacité à offrir un savoir, des produits et des services qui rendent les soins de qualité plus accessibles et plus abordables. Chez nous, la santé, le bonheur et le bien-être de nos gens et des personnes que nous desservons sont prioritaires—et nous tiennent à cœur.

Ensemble, nous façonnons l’avenir de la santé pour nos patients, nos communautés et nos équipes. Si tu souhaites dès aujourd’hui contribuer à la santé de demain, nous aimerions avoir de tes nouvelles.

McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

À propos du poste

McKesson
est à la recherche d’un(e) Directeur(trice), Gouvernance des données
stratégique et expérimenté(e) pour diriger les programmes de gouvernance des données à l’échelle de l’entreprise afin d’améliorer la qualité des données, la conformité réglementaire, la confiance des parties prenantes et l’excellence opérationnelle. Cette personne définira et mettra en œuvre des stratégies de gouvernance couvrant la gouvernance des données, la gestion des métadonnées, le catalogage des données, la qualité des données, la gestion des données maîtres (MDM) et les capacités de traçabilité des données (data lineage).

Le ou la titulaire collaborera étroitement avec les équipes d’affaires, technologiques, de gestion des risques, de conformité et de données afin d’établir des cadres de gouvernance, des normes, des politiques et des contrôles soutenant la prise de décisions fondée sur les données et le respect des exigences réglementaires. Ce rôle requiert une solide combinaison de leadership, d’influence, d’expertise en gestion des données et d’engagement des parties prenantes au sein d’un environnement organisationnel complexe.

Ce que vous ferez

Diriger la stratégie de gouvernance des données à l’échelle de l’entreprise, y compris le modèle opérationnel, les politiques, les normes et les mécanismes de contrôle.
Favoriser l’adoption et l’optimisation des plateformes de gouvernance et de catalogage des données.
Établir et superviser les programmes de qualité des données, de gestion des métadonnées, de gestion des données maîtres et de traçabilité des données.
Collaborer avec les équipes des Risques, de la Conformité, de la Protection de la vie privée, de la Sécurité et de l’Audit afin d’assurer la conformité réglementaire et la maturité des pratiques de gouvernance.
Développer des indicateurs de gouvernance, des KPI de santé des données et des rapports destinés à la haute direction.
Travailler avec les parties prenantes de l’entreprise pour définir la propriété des données, l’intendance (data stewardship), la reddition de comptes et les priorités de gouvernance.
Diriger des équipes multidisciplinaires responsables d’initiatives d’envergure en gouvernance et en gestion des données.
Recruter, développer et mobiliser des équipes performantes en favorisant une culture de responsabilité, de collaboration et d’amélioration continue.

Exigences de base

Plus de 12 ans d’expérience professionnelle en gouvernance des données, gestion des données, architecture des données, analytique, conformité ou dans un domaine connexe, dont au moins 4 ans d’expérience en gestion d’équipes.
Baccalauréat ou expérience professionnelle équivalente.
Expérience dans la direction de programmes et de modèles opérationnels de gouvernance des données à l’échelle de l’entreprise.
Expérience dans l’implantation ou la gestion de plateformes de catalogage, de gestion des métadonnées ou de gouvernance des données.
Expérience en gestion de la qualité des données, traçabilité des données, intendance des données et contrôles de gouvernance.
Expérience de collaboration avec des équipes de conformité, de gestion des risques, de protection de la vie privée, d’audit ou de réglementation.
Capacité démontrée à diriger des initiatives transversales et à influencer des parties prenantes de haut niveau.
Expérience dans l’élaboration de politiques, de normes, de KPI et de cadres de reddition de comptes en matière de gouvernance.

Compétences et expérience privilégiées

Maîtrise en gestion de l’information, informatique, administration des affaires, analytique des données ou dans un domaine connexe.
Expérience dans des secteurs réglementés tels que les soins de santé, les produits pharmaceutiques, les services financiers ou l’assurance.
Connaissance de plateformes de gouvernance des données telles que Collibra, Alation, Informatica, Microsoft Purview ou des outils similaires.
Expérience avec les principes DAMA-DMBOK et les cadres de gestion des données d’entreprise.
Connaissance des règlements en matière de protection des données, des mécanismes de gouvernance et des cadres de gestion des risques.
Expérience à diriger des initiatives de transformation des données à l’échelle de l’entreprise.
Excellentes compétences en communication auprès des dirigeants et en gestion du changement organisationnel.
Certifications pertinentes en gouvernance des données, gestion des données, protection de la vie privée ou technologies infonuagiques.

Déplacements, environnement de travail et exigences physiques

Capacité à voyager jusqu’à 20 % du temps, selon les besoins de l’entreprise.
Modalités de travail hybrides ou à distance pouvant être offertes selon les besoins de l’entreprise et la situation géographique.
Capacité à participer à des réunions virtuelles et en personne et à travailler efficacement dans un environnement soutenu par la technologie.

jobs.title: Director, Fraud Data and Analytics
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 264919

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

The Team

The Global Fraud Technology team develops and manages enterprise fraud capabilities that protect Scotiabank, its customers, and its employees across all channels and products. The Fraud Data & Analytics organization is responsible for the data, analytics, intelligence, and AI foundations that power fraud detection, fraud response, scam prevention, investigations, and risk management capabilities across the Bank.

We partner closely with Fraud Operations, Fraud Strategy, Data Science, Risk Management, AML, Payments, Digital Banking, Enterprise Data Office, and Enterprise Technology teams to deliver trusted, scalable, and governed fraud data capabilities that support real-time decisioning, advanced analytics, machine learning, regulatory reporting, and operational insights.

The Role

The Director, Global Fraud Technology – Fraud Data & Analytics is accountable for the strategy, delivery, governance, and operation of the Bank’s fraud data and analytics ecosystem. This role leads teams responsible for fraud data platforms, feature engineering, data products, fraud intelligence capabilities, reporting and visualization platforms, model enablement services, and AI-driven analytical solutions.

The Director is responsible for ensuring fraud data is trusted, accessible, timely, secure, and governed while enabling advanced analytical capabilities that improve fraud detection effectiveness, customer protection, operational efficiency, and business decision-making.

The role works closely with business and technology leaders to define the future-state fraud data strategy and drive enterprise-wide adoption of modern data and AI capabilities.

Key Accountabilities

Strategy & Leadership

Develop and execute the multi-year fraud data and analytics strategy aligned with enterprise fraud, risk, and technology objectives.
Define the target-state fraud data architecture and operating model supporting realtime and batch analytical workloads.
Establish strategic roadmaps for fraud data platforms, data products, AI enablement capabilities, and analytical services.
Partner with senior business and technology stakeholders to prioritize investments and define long-term analytical capabilities.
Drive innovation through the adoption of modern data platforms, advanced analytics, AI, and machine learning technologies.
Lead strategic vendor and technology partner relationships supporting fraud data and analytics capabilities.

Fraud Data Platform Ownership

Own the fraud data ecosystem supporting fraud detection, fraud response, investigations, scam prevention, and fraud intelligence functions.
Establish scalable and resilient data platforms supporting high-volume transactional and behavioral data processing.
Drive modernization initiatives involving cloud-native data architectures, streaming platforms, data lakes, and analytical environments.
Ensure seamless integration of internal and external fraud data sources across the enterprise.
Deliver high-quality, trusted, and governed fraud data assets for operational and analytical consumption.

Data Products & Feature Engineering

Lead development and management of enterprise fraud data products and reusable analytical assets.
Establish feature engineering capabilities supporting fraud detection models, AI solutions, and advanced analytics initiatives.
Build and maintain fraud-specific feature stores and analytical datasets.
Drive standardization, reuse, and scalability across fraud data assets.
Partner with business stakeholders to define and prioritize strategic data products.

Analytics & Fraud Intelligence

Deliver enterprise fraud intelligence capabilities that provide actionable insights into fraud trends, emerging threats, scam typologies, and customer risk.
Enable advanced analytical capabilities including network analytics, graph intelligence, behavioral profiling, anomaly detection, and predictive analytics.
Partner with Fraud Strategy and Fraud Operations teams to identify opportunities for fraud loss reduction and operational optimization.
Establish enterprise reporting and visualization capabilities supporting executive, operational, and regulatory reporting needs.
Drive analytical innovation through the application of AI and emerging technologies.

AI & Model Enablement

Provide technology platforms and services supporting fraud data science and machine learning teams.
Enable the full model lifecycle including development, deployment, monitoring, explainability, performance measurement, and governance.
Support deployment of AI-driven fraud capabilities across detection, response, and intelligence functions.
Establish MLOps and analytical operations capabilities that improve model reliability and scalability.
Partner with Model Risk Management and Validation teams to support governance requirements.

Data Governance & Risk Management

Establish and maintain data governance frameworks supporting fraud data assets.
Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, privacy obligations, data retention standards, and information security policies.
Define and monitor data quality standards, controls, lineage, and stewardship practices.
Partner with Enterprise Data Office and Risk Management teams to strengthen fraud data governance and accountability.
Ensure appropriate controls exist around analytical models, reporting, and data usage.

Operational Excellence

Establish performance metrics, service-level objectives, and operational controls across fraud data platforms.
Drive continuous improvements in data quality, availability, timeliness, and operational efficiency.
Ensure platform resiliency, disaster recovery readiness, and operational support processes meet enterprise standards.
Manage portfolio budgets, vendor relationships, and strategic investments.
Deliver measurable business outcomes through improved data accessibility, analytical capabilities, and operational effectiveness.

Talent Leadership

Build, lead, and develop high-performing teams across data engineering, analytics engineering, platform engineering, data management, and analytical enablement functions.
Coach and mentor senior managers, architects, and technical leaders.
Foster a culture of innovation, experimentation, continuous learning, and operational excellence.
Champion Agile delivery methodologies, DataOps, MLOps, and product-oriented operating models.
Develop succession plans and talent strategies for critical leadership and technical roles.

General

Champions a customer-focused culture to deepen client relationships and leverage broader Bank relationships, systems, and knowledge.
Understands how the Bank’s risk appetite and risk culture should be considered in day-to-day activities and decisions.
Actively pursues effective and efficient operations in accordance with Scotiabank’s Values, Code of Conduct, and Global Sales Principles while ensuring the adequacy, adherence to, and effectiveness of business controls relating to operational, compliance, AML/ATF/sanctions, conduct, model, and technology risk.

What You Will Bring to Succeed Must Have

10+ years of progressive technology leadership experience in data, analytics, AI, or enterprise platform organizations.
5+ years of experience leading large-scale data and analytics platforms within financial services, fraud, risk, AML, or related domains.
5+ years of leadership experience managing managers and multidisciplinary technical teams.
Deep expertise in modern data architectures, data engineering, streaming technologies, cloud data platforms, and analytical ecosystems.
Experience supporting machine learning, AI, and advanced analytics capabilities in production environments.
Strong understanding of fraud analytics, fraud intelligence, feature engineering, and model enablement concepts.
Experience implementing enterprise data governance, data quality, lineage, and stewardship programs.
Strong knowledge of cloud platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Azure.
Experience managing strategic roadmaps, budgets, vendor relationships, and transformation initiatives.
Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience operating within highly regulated financial services environments.

Nice to Have

Experience supporting fraud detection, fraud response, financial crime, AML, or cyber analytics functions.
Experience with graph databases, network analytics, fraud intelligence platforms, and behavioral analytics solutions.
Knowledge of MLOps, AI governance, model risk management, and analytical operations frameworks.
Experience with real-time streaming technologies and event-driven analytical architectures.

Experience leading global teams across multiple geographies.

We are technology partners who help the business transform how our employees around the world work.
