Position Overview

Our Client is a long established Toronto-based family office. Supporting financial, investment, philanthropic and personal interests, the office exercises responsibility over a complex group of corporations, partnerships, trusts, investment entities and a private foundation, together with real estate and other family-owned assets throughout North America.

As the office continues to evolve and expand, they are seeking a VP, Finance and Treasury to take a leadership role within its finance function. Reporting to the CEO this role will provide leadership across financial reporting, tax planning and compliance, treasury, financial operations and risk management. As a trusted advisor, this individual will translate complex financial matters into clear recommendations that support wealth preservation, tax efficiency and long-term family objectives. The role will also oversee the finance team, coordinate external professional advisors and strengthen financial systems, controls and reporting.

The ideal candidate is an experienced CPA with substantial tax expertise and a background supporting high-net-worth families or complex private investment structures. They will combine strategic financial judgment with the ability to oversee detailed financial and tax matters, build trusted relationships and operate with exceptional discretion. This is an attractive opportunity to influence the financial stewardship of a diverse family office while supporting investment activities, intergenerational planning and philanthropic priorities.

Role Responsibilities

Provide financial leadership across the family office and its affiliated entities, advising on financial strategy, tax, business decisions and risk.
Oversee accounting and financial reporting for corporations, partnerships, trusts, investment entities and the private foundation, ensuring accurate and timely financial statements, management reports and coordination of external audits and reviews.
Direct budgeting, forecasting and financial analysis, developing reporting and dashboards that provide clear insight into financial performance, commitments and future funding requirements.
Lead tax planning across personal, corporate, trust, foundation and investment structures, working with external advisors to implement tax-efficient strategies and oversee Canadian and U.S. tax returns, information reporting and regulatory filings.
Support estate and succession planning, including intergenerational wealth transfer, in collaboration with family members, legal counsel and tax advisors.
Manage treasury, cash flow and liquidity across entities, overseeing banking and custodian relationships, financing arrangements and capital requirements to support investments, operations, properties and family expenditures.
Coordinate financial reporting for investment portfolios and private investments, reviewing performance, capital calls, distributions and liquidity needs with investment managers and external advisors.
Provide financial oversight of real estate holdings, private residences and other family-owned assets, and contribute financial analysis and due diligence for acquisitions, dispositions, financing transactions and major expenditures.
Oversee cross-border financial operations and related payroll, tax and compliance obligations for Canadian and U.S. activities, coordinating the work of advisors and service providers across jurisdictions.
Strengthen governance, accounting policies and internal controls; assess financial, operational, tax and regulatory risks; coordinate insurance reviews; and safeguard confidential family information.
Lead, mentor and develop the finance team, establishing clear expectations and promoting accountability, collaboration, responsiveness and service excellence.
Manage relationships with external accounting, tax, legal, banking, investment and other professional advisors, ensuring coordinated support and clear, actionable advice for family members and leadership.
Improve financial systems, reporting tools and processes through technology, automation and standardized practices that enhance efficiency, reporting quality and control.

Desired Qualifications

CPA (or equivalent) with a university degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce or a related discipline and at least 10 years of progressive finance, accounting and tax experience, including significant leadership responsibility.
Experience within a family office, private investment office, asset management firm, public accounting firm, private equity environment or complex private enterprise.
Significant experience supporting high-net-worth families and overseeing complex structures involving corporations, partnerships, trusts, foundations and investment entities.
Strong Canadian and U.S. tax expertise relevant to individuals, corporations, trusts, estates and charitable organizations, with experience coordinating cross-border financial and tax matters.
Demonstrated expertise in financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, treasury management and internal controls across multiple entities.
Understanding of investment management, private markets, real estate and wealth management structures, including their financial reporting and liquidity requirements.
Proven ability to lead and develop finance teams and coordinate external professional advisors and service providers.
Strong commercial judgment, strategic thinking and analytical skills, with the ability to assess complex issues and develop practical recommendations.
Excellent communication and relationship management skills, including the ability to explain financial and tax matters clearly and build trust with family members, senior leadership and advisors.
Exceptional discretion, integrity and professionalism, together with a responsive service orientation and the ability to manage competing priorities in a highly confidential environment.
Completion of CPA Canada’s In-Depth Tax Program, Advanced Tax Program or an equivalent tax specialization; an MBA, CFA, CBV, TEP or other relevant designation would be an asset.

jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 269904

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

Role

The Director, Market Risk and Counterparty Credit Risk Run and Analytics, will lead the technology teams responsible for production support, analytics platforms, and critical risk calculation systems supporting Market Risk and Counterparty Credit Risk.

This role is accountable for ensuring stability, reliability, and effective delivery across three core areas:

Run and Production Support
Analytics Platforms
VaR and Stress Testing Systems

The successful candidate will bring strong Capital Markets Risk knowledge, deep technology leadership experience, and the ability to influence both internal teams and senior stakeholders to build a stable, scalable, and future-proof technical environment. The use of AI, automation, and modern engineering practices is becoming a core expectation for this role.

What will we expect from you?

Run and Production Support

Lead the enhanced support team responsible for day-to-day production stability across Market Risk and Counterparty Credit Risk applications.
Partner closely with Risk Officers, Trading users, Front Office stakeholders, and Technology teams to resolve issues quickly and reduce recurring production riskAct as the technology gatekeeper to production, ensuring changes, releases, configurations, and deployments follow appropriate testing, controls, release management, and risk review processes.
Maintain strong oversight of production health, including incident management, SLA performance, stability metrics, resiliency, and operational risk reduction.
Ensure high availability, integrity, and reliability of critical risk systems and business processes.
Drive continuous improvement in support practices, monitoring, automation, incident prevention, and root cause remediation.

Analytics Platforms

Lead the analytics technology team supporting capital calculation, business intelligence, reporting, and analytics capabilities for Market Risk and Counterparty Credit Risk.
Oversee platforms and capabilities including LMS(Limit Management System), Tableau, Power BI, and FRTB Aggregation.
Ensure analytics solutions are stable, scalable, well-controlled, and aligned with business needs.
Partner with stakeholders to define priorities, manage delivery, and improve the usability, quality, and reliability of analytics outputs.
Drive modernization of analytics platforms, including automation, self-service reporting, data quality improvements, and adoption of AI-enabled capabilities where appropriate.
Rationalize applications by migrating to enterprise approved targets and manage the application hygiene such as end of life, vulnerabilities and cyber security aspects, and reducing manual work for app hygiene with AI-enabled capabilities.

VaR and Stress Testing Systems

Lead the technology team responsible for the critical VaR platform that produces VaR (Value at Risk), Stress Testing and PFE (Potential Future Exposure) outputs.
Ensure the VaR and Stress Testing platforms meet expectations for accuracy, timeliness, resiliency, auditability, and regulatory readiness.
Oversee operation support, enhancements, controls, and modernization of the VaR technology stack.
Partner with Market Risk, CCR (Counterparty Credit Risk), Model Risk, Quants, Infrastructure, and Engineering teams to strengthen the platform and reduce operational risk.
Ensure the platform can support evolving business, regulatory, and risk management requirements.

Strategic Leadership

Influence the technology strategy for Market Risk and Counterparty Credit Risk by working with the team, stakeholders, and peer technology leaders to define a future-proof architecture.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to challenge, escalate, and drive upstream teams to resolve recurring production, data, and process issues at their source.
Build and execute a roadmap that improves system stability, scalability, resiliency, controls, and engineering efficiency.
Promote AI, automation, and modern engineering practices to reduce manual effort, improve production support, and accelerate delivery.
Provide technical direction and challenge existing practices where needed to improve long-term platform health.
Negotiate priorities, timelines, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs with business and technology stakeholders.
Communicate clearly with senior leadership on production risk, delivery status, strategic priorities, and investment needs.

People Leadership

Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of technology professionals across support, analytics, and risk systems delivery.
Ensure the team has the right structure, skills, procedures, and governance to support critical risk platforms.
Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, engineering excellence, continuous improvement, and production discipline.
Develop talent, support succession planning, and create opportunities for team members to grow.
Promote collaboration across Technology, Risk, Front Office, Infrastructure, Data, and Engineering teams.

What You Will Bring To Succeed

Minimum 10 years of experience in Risk Technology, Capital Markets Technology, or a related technology leadership role.
Strong knowledge of Capital Markets Risk, including Market Risk, Counterparty Credit Risk, VaR, Stress Testing, FRTB, risk monitoring, capital requirements, and regulatory expectations.
Proven experience leading teams responsible for production support, technology delivery, and complex risk platforms.
Experience supporting business-critical systems used by Market Risk, Credit Risk, Trading, Sales, or Front Office users.
Strong understanding of production controls, change management, incident management, release governance, and operational risk reduction.
Experience with analytics and reporting platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar BI tools.
Strong technical background, including experience with Python, Bash scripts, SQL, databases, data platforms, application architecture, and modern software delivery practices.
Ability to influence senior stakeholders and technology teams to align on strategy, priorities, and execution.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technology and risk issues to senior management.
Degree in Computer Science, Finance, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with VaR, Stress Testing, FRTB Aggregation, LMS, Tableau, and Power BI.
Knowledge of Python, Java, Linux, databases, infrastructure, networking, and cloud or distributed architecture.
Experience modernizing legacy platforms and improving resiliency of business-critical systems.
Experience using AI, automation, or advanced monitoring to improve support, delivery, and operational efficiency.
Familiarity with regulatory, audit, and control expectations for risk technology platforms.

Success Measures

Improved stability, resiliency, and support quality across Market Risk and Counterparty Credit Risk systems.
Strong production gatekeeping discipline with reduced release risk and fewer recurring incidents.
Clear roadmap for analytics, VaR, Stress Testing, and run modernization.
Increased automation and practical adoption of AI across support and delivery processes.
Strong stakeholder confidence in the team’s ability to support critical risk platforms and deliver strategic improvements.

The Workplace

We are technology partners who help the business transform how our employees around the world work
We have an inclusive and collaborative working environment that encourages creativity, curiosity, and celebrates success!
You'll get to work with and learn from diverse industry leaders, who have hailed from top technology companies around the world

jobs.title: Senior Director, Corporate Strategy & Development
jobs.description:
Are you ready to embark on a career that truly affects people around the world? Trulioo invites you to be a catalyst for change in the dynamic realm of digital identity verification. As the global front-runner in our industry, we are redefining how businesses grow, innovate and comply online.

Picture yourself at the forefront of innovation, contributing to our award-winning platform that enables organizations worldwide to quickly onboard customers, optimize costs and combat fraud. Fueled by Silicon Valley support, Trulioo stands as the trusted platform that can verify more than 5 billion people and 700 million business entities spanning 195 countries.

But Trulioo is more than a tech company. We are a united force of dedicated experts committed to establishing trust online - and we’re proud to be recognized as a BC Top Employer for the second consecutive year
, reflecting our commitment to an inclusive, collaborative, and people-first workplace.

Headquartered in Vancouver and with strategic hubs in San Diego and Dublin, we foster a culture of collaboration and open communication. Our offices support a hybrid model and staff typically work three days per week at a hub location. Join us where excitement meets innovation and contribute to a world where trust and technology unite.

What We Offer

Comprehensive Benefits: We provide a robust benefits package for full-time, permanent employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans with company match, paid time off, parental leave, and an annual education & training stipend (equivalent to $1,000 in local currency). Specific benefits may vary by location and will be discussed further during the interview process.
Flexible Hybrid Working Environment: Our offices are designed to support both collaboration and flexibility. Enjoy weekly lunches, quality coffee, and regular social events. Many locations also feature parent rooms, on-site gyms, comfortable lounges, and adaptable workstations to support your comfort and productivity.
Wellness: We care about your well-being. Team members have access to wellness workshops and events, as well as a complimentary Headspace subscription to help you stay focused, grounded, and energized.
Employee Resource Groups: Belonging is an important part of doing your best work. Our ERGs provide an inclusive space, support and community for employees of diverse backgrounds and allies. We host informative, fun sessions and celebrations that are often open to the entire organization.

Position Summary

Trulioo is seeking a Senior Director of Corporate Strategy & Development to help shape the company’s strategic direction and translate it into coordinated action across the business. Working closely with the Chief Risk & Strategy Officer, this leader will own the continued evolution of Trulioo’s strategic blueprint, strengthen alignment between corporate strategy and functional priorities, and guide execution of the company’s most important strategic initiatives.

This role will build the intelligence, governance, and execution capabilities that allow Trulioo to anticipate market change and make informed choices about where and how to compete. The Senior Director will bring together customer, competitive, regulatory, economic, industry, and product insights to test strategic assumptions, identify emerging opportunities and risks, and inform decisions across organic investment, partnerships, and acquisitions.

This is a highly visible enterprise leadership role at the intersection of strategy, product, transformation, capital allocation, and corporate development. The ideal candidate combines forward-looking strategic judgment with the ability to operationalize ideas—building roadmaps, mobilizing accountable leaders, guiding complex programs, and creating the governance needed to turn strategy into measurable results.

This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.

This will be a full-time, permanent position, working remotely.

What You'll Be Doing

Corporate Strategy and Strategic Blueprint Support

Continuously test the strategy against market forces, competitive dynamics, regulatory developments, customer needs, technology shifts, and emerging opportunity areas.
Partner with the Chief Risk & Strategy Officer to prepare strategic recommendations and decision materials for executives, the Board, external advisors, and other key stakeholders.
Design scenario analyses that evaluate strategic assumptions, alternative market outcomes, competitive responses, investment choices, and potential disruptions.
Identify material risks to the strategy and partner with the Enterprise Risk Office to assess exposure, define responses, and integrate strategic risks into enterprise governance.
Develop clear points of view on competitive positioning, market adjacencies, thematic investments, and the capabilities Trulioo will need to win over the long term.
Co-lead recurring strategy reviews and recommend when elements of the strategic blueprint should be accelerated, refined, reprioritized, or recast.

Strategy Alignment and Execution

Translate the strategic blueprint into enterprise priorities, functional goals, measurable outcomes, and clear execution roadmaps.
Partner with executive and functional leaders to align their strategies, investments, roadmaps, OKRs, KPIs, and/or incentives with the company’s strategic direction.
Define the scope, activities, sequencing, investment requirements, accountabilities, dependencies, and measures of success for major strategic programs.
Establish and chair governance forums that track progress against strategic priorities and create clear paths for decision-making and escalation.
Partner with the Transformation Office and accountable workstream leaders to mobilize initiatives, resolve cross-functional blockers, measure progress and performance, and redirect execution when outcomes move off course.
Create recurring feedback loops, including shared metrics reviews and strategy check-ins, to identify misalignment early and improve execution.
Communicate the strategy across the organization in ways that build understanding of Trulioo’s direction, strategic choices, and highest-priority activities.

MAPS and Capital Allocation Governance

Lead MAPS—Trulioo’s quarterly Market Aligned Product Strategy program—to connect corporate strategy and market intelligence with product strategy, investment decisions, and roadmaps.
Bring together Product, Engineering, Strategy, Risk and Reg, Sales, Marketing, and GTM leaders to evaluate emerging customer needs and market opportunities.
Guide structured decisions on whether Trulioo should build, buy, partner, watch, or pass in response to identified opportunities.
Oversee the development of MAPS insight packages covering regulatory change, voice of the customer, competitive moves, market potential, cost of missed opportunity, industry trends, and product performance.
In coordination with the Office of the CFO, develop and operate a disciplined capital allocation governance program that connects strategic priorities with investment decisions.
Build decision frameworks that clarify opportunity, strategic fit, expected value, investment requirements, trade-offs, risks, and measures of success.
Produce a forward-looking point of view on capital allocation priorities informed by Trulioo’s competitive position, portfolio performance, and emerging growth opportunities.

Corporate Development and M&A

Support the development of Trulioo’s Build, Buy, and Partner strategy by identifying capability gaps and evaluating inorganic paths to accelerate the strategic blueprint.
Support market mapping, opportunity screening, target identification, strategic fit assessments, and ongoing target monitoring.
Coordinate cross-functional due diligence, including workstream planning, information synthesis, issue escalation, decision support, and executive reporting.
Contribute to due diligence activities and deal-structure considerations in partnership with Finance, Legal, Product, Technology, Risk, and external advisors.
Develop scalable models, AI agents, and analytical tools that strengthen opportunity screening, target intelligence, diligence, and transaction decision-making.
Capture relevant integration considerations during diligence and translate findings into clear implications for value creation, execution complexity, and transaction risk.

Market Insights and Strategic Intelligence

Design and operate Trulioo’s enterprise market insights program as a continuously running intelligence engine for strategy, product development, investment, and commercialization.
Produce forward-looking insights, including market landscapes, competitive positioning, opportunity sizing, thematic investment perspectives, regulatory outlooks, and voice-of-the-customer analysis.
Build repeatable methods for gathering, validating, synthesizing, and distributing intelligence across the organization.
Translate complex signals into clear strategic implications, executive-level reporting, and actionable recommendations.
Deliver relevant insights to executives, Product, Engineering, Risk and Regulatory, Marketing, Sales, and GTM teams through recurring briefings, dashboards, decision forums, and targeted analyses.
Develop measures that demonstrate how market intelligence improves strategic decisions, product prioritization, capital allocation, and commercial outcomes.

What You'll Bring

15+ years of experience across corporate strategy, corporate development, strategic finance, management consulting, market intelligence, transformation, or related leadership roles.
Significant experience in one or more relevant sectors, including payments, financial services, banking, marketplaces, SaaS, fintech, identity, fraud, or RegTech.
A degree in economics, business, finance, strategy, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
A builder mindset and strong experience working and deploying AI tools and models to improve functional processes, drive automation, rethink problem solving, and transform traditional ways of working.
Demonstrated experience developing corporate or product strategies and translating them into enterprise priorities, functional roadmaps, investment decisions, and measurable outcomes.
Experience operating in complex, global, and highly cross-functional organizations.
Experience leading large-scale strategic or transformation programs involving multiple executives, functions, and dependencies.
Meaningful experience supporting acquisitions, including opportunity assessment, target screening, due diligence, transaction analysis, and integration planning.
Advanced analytical and scenario-planning capabilities, with the ability to work through ambiguity and make clear recommendations from incomplete or conflicting information.
Exceptional executive communication skills and experience preparing materials for executive leadership, Boards, and external advisors.
The judgment and executive presence to influence senior leaders, challenge assumptions, facilitate difficult trade-offs, and drive decisions.

Nice To Have

Exposure to identity verification, fraud prevention, credit insights, financial crime, or regulatory technology.
Experience supporting IPO readiness, public-company strategy, or Board-level capital allocation processes.
Direct experience leading post-acquisition integration or value-creation programs.
An advanced degree in economics, business, finance, or a related discipline.

Thriving at Trulioo

At Trulioo, you’re not just an employee. You’re a valued member of our Trulicrew on a journey of professional and personal growth with a world-class organization. jobs.description:
With 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food.

Sur La Table is seeking a Director, Ecommerce and Marketing Analytics
to define how data, insight, and AI drive decision-making across the company.

This role serves as the analytical hub of the organization
, supporting eCommerce, Marketing, Finance, Retail, Merchandising, Inventory Planning, and Operations. While embedded within the eCommerce organization, the mandate of this role is company-wide: to transform data into insight, insight into implications, and implications into clear recommendations that drive action.

This is not a reporting role. It is a foundational leadership role responsible for establishing analytical standards, governing AI-enabled workflows, ensuring data integrity, and elevating how decisions are made across the business.

This position will report into the Senior Director of Ecommerce.

What you get to do:

Company-Wide Insight Leadership

Serve as the primary analytics leader across eCommerce, Marketing, Finance, Retail, Merchandising, Inventory Planning, and Operations.
Own problem definition for analytics - determining which business questions matter and what decisions insights should inform.
Move analysis beyond “what happened” to “why it happened,” “how it happened,” and “what we should do next.”
Proactively mine data to identify risks, opportunities, inefficiencies, and performance drivers.
Influence senior leaders through clear implications and actionable recommendations.

Data Integrity, Metrics & Standards

Own the integrity, governance, and usability of core commerce, customer, and operational datasets across platforms (eCommerce, POS, CDP, email, data warehouse).
Validate insights using business context and commercial logic — not just technical correctness.
Define, document, and continuously evolve company-wide KPI frameworks in partnership with Finance and functional leaders.
Identify and resolve cross-functional metric misalignment to ensure a single, trusted understanding of performance.
Establish standards for data quality, documentation, and analytical transparency across the organization.

AI-Enabled Analytics & Insight Workflows

Leverage AI as a core component of advanced analytical work, including hypothesis generation, exploratory analysis, pattern detection, insight synthesis, and narrative development.
Design, operationalize, and scale repeatable AI-assisted workflows that support recurring company-level decisions (growth, margin optimization, inventory productivity, forecast alignment).
Establish validation frameworks to pressure-test AI-generated outputs against source data, historical performance, customer behavior, and commercial logic.
Embed AI-enabled insights into planning, forecasting, and executive performance reviews.
Promote responsible, explainable, and outcome-driven AI usage across analytics workflows.

Web, Customer & Commerce Analytics (Heap)

Own web and digital analytics strategy using Heap, including funnel performance, customer journey analysis, and conversion optimization.
Ensure tracking integrity and event schema accuracy, including review of structured data formats (e.g., JSON, data layers) in partnership with Product Engineering.
Translate behavioral data into commercial implications that influence merchandising, marketing, inventory, and operational decisions.
Ensure behavioral insights are aligned with downstream systems and financial realities.

Cross-Functional Integration

Reconcile demand, margin, inventory, and operational perspectives into cohesive performance narratives.
Support planning, forecasting, and performance alignment across Finance, Retail, Merchandising, and Operations.
Challenge assumptions and reframe business narratives using data-backed insight.
Serve as a connector between commercial strategy and operational execution.

Leadership & Enablement

Establish analytical standards that prioritize clarity, trust, commercial relevance, and decision impact.
Reduce reactive ad hoc work by building scalable, decision-focused reporting and automation frameworks.
Design the structure, workflows, and expectations for the analytics function.
Hire, mentor, and develop junior analytics talent once foundational systems are established.
Champion a modern, insight-driven analytics culture across the company.

What you bring:

8+ years of experience in Analytics, Strategy, or Data Leadership roles.
Demonstrated experience leading analytics across multiple business functions.
Strong experience in commerce-driven businesses (retail, eCommerce, CPG, marketplace).
Comprehensive knowledge of all traffic acquisition channels and their downstream impact on site behavior, using that expertise to develop reliable forecasts that drive strategic decision-making.
Advanced SQL and strong analytical modeling capabilities.
Demonstrated experience designing and governing AI-enabled analytics workflows.
Strong capability to pressure-test AI-generated insights against data, customer behavior, and commercial logic.
Hands-on expertise with Heap or similar event-based web analytics platforms.
Comfort working with structured data formats (e.g., JSON), event schemas, and data instrumentation.
Experience defining KPI frameworks and resolving cross-functional metric misalignment.
Proven ability to translate complex data into clear, compelling stories that inform and influence executive decision-making - moving leadership from insight to action with confidence and conviction.
Track record of proactive insight generation, not reactive reporting
Ability to work standard Eastern Time business hours

What’s in it for you? Joining Sur La Table isn’t just about having a seat at the table—it’s about helping redesign the table entirely. You’ll be challenged, stretched, and supported as you grow faster than you thought possible. In addition to competitive compensation, we offer:

Executive Access: Work directly with brand CEOs and senior leadership, solving real business problems and earning mentorship from top operators.
AI-First Skill Building: Get hands-on with the most advanced AI tools in the market. From automation to prompt engineering, you’ll build a modern tech stack that sets you apart in any industry.

Job Description

What is the opportunity?

RBC's AI Group is building the future of AI-powered banking, and our research teams are at the forefront of this transformation. Reporting to the VP, Applied AI Research & Solutions, the Senior Director, AI Research will lead a team of world-class machine learning researchers and research engineers to develop cutting-edge AI algorithms that directly power RBC's products and services.

This is a unique opportunity to bridge frontier AI research with real-world business impact. You'll work at the intersection of innovation and application by translating the latest advances in machine learning into production-ready solutions that serve millions of clients across credit, fraud detection, market intelligence, pricing optimization, and generative AI applications.

As a member of RBC Borealis AI, you'll leverage RBC's unique data assets and strategic partnerships to push the boundaries of what's possible in AI, while ensuring your work delivers measurable business value aligned with RBC's $1 billion AI ambition.

What will you do?

AI Research Leadership:

Lead and mentor a high-performing team of AI researchers and research engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and impact-driven solutions.
Direct the development of novel machine learning algorithms and models across one or more domains: credit risk, fraud detection, market prediction, pricing & optimization, or generative/agentic AI. Leverage RBC and external data to deliver differentiating solutions and intellectual property to the business.
Define AI roadmaps with ML models that balance advancing the state-of-the-art with delivering tangible business outcomes aligned to RBC's strategic priorities.
Build and retain top-tier AI talent by creating an environment that attracts leading researchers from both academia and industry.
Act as a thought leader and partner to RBC businesses and functions and advise on the art of the possible for AI in these domains.
Evaluate new areas for AI investment, complete proof of concept testing and evaluation.

Applied Research & Business Impact:

Partner closely with the VP, AI Research and Innovation team to operationalize frontier research and translate breakthroughs into applied solutions.
Collaborate with VP, Solutions Engineering & Delivery to ensure AI algorithms are production-ready, scalable, and integrated seamlessly into RBC's enterprise platforms.
Drive rapid experimentation and iteration to test and validate models against real-world business problems, ensuring measurable ROI.
Develop intellectual property and publish research findings that position RBC as a thought leader in AI innovation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

Act as a trusted technical advisor to business partners across RBC's lines of business, translating complex AI concepts into actionable insights.
Work with platform teams to leverage RBC's AI & data infrastructure (Lumina) for model development, training, and deployment.
Partner with AI Governance & Evaluation teams to ensure all models meet regulatory, ethical, and compliance standards.
Engage with external research communities, academic institutions, and industry partners to stay ahead of emerging AI trends and technologies.
Champion responsible AI practices, embedding fairness, transparency, and bias mitigation into the research lifecycle.
Identify opportunities to advance RBC's AI capabilities through experimentation with emerging technologies (e.g., foundation models, multimodal AI, reinforcement learning).
Contribute to RBC's AI thought leadership through publications, patents, conference presentations, and community engagement.
In this role, you will communicate and interact frequently with RBC partners and/or employees located across Canada and/or worldwide.

Must Have:

PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.
10+ years of experience developing and deploying machine learning models in industry settings, with at least 3-5 years in leadership roles and people management.
Experience translating research prototypes into production-grade solutions at scale, preferably in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, etc.).
Strong publication record and recognized thought leadership in AI/ML (conference papers, patents, technical blogs, or open-source contributions).
Demonstrated ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical stakeholders, communicating complex concepts clearly to senior leadership.

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Content Strategy
jobs.description:
Verndale is a digital experience agency dedicated to driving growth by helping businesses create meaningful human connections in an increasingly digital world. With offices in Boston, Montreal, Los Angeles, Quito, and hubs across the Americas, we partner with marketing and technology leaders to deliver personalized web, mobile, and ecommerce solutions that elevate customer experiences.

At Verndale, we thrive on collaboration and innovation, offering a full range of services that span strategy, design, development, personalization, SEO, analytics, and digital advertising. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, striving to create a climate of respect essential for both individual and company success.

If you're ready to be part of a passionate team dedicated to making an impact and driving growth, we invite you to explore a career at Verndale.

About The Role

As we expand our Marketing Services practice, we are seeking an Associate Director, Content Strategy: a senior, client-facing content strategist who can lead enterprise content programs across discovery, design, build, migration, governance, AI search, personalization, and performance.

This role sits within the Marketing Services team and reports to the VP, Content Strategy. The Associate Director will help turn content strategy from a project deliverable into a governed content system that fuels discoverability, relevance, and measurable business impact across human and AI-driven journeys.

The ideal candidate is strategic and hands-on. They know how to build content strategy into complex digital programs, integrate it with design, technology, analytics, SEO, AI search, and personalization, and produce polished client-ready deliverables. They must also be AI fluent and ready to build practical solutions using AI tools, not simply experiment with them.

Verndale is fully remote enabled. This position can be remote, with a preference for candidates based in Canada.

Responsibilities

Lead content strategy workstreams across discovery, design, build, migration, and optimization programs.
Oversee and execute editorial content strategy, including content inventories, content assessments, transformation strategy, message planning, and editorial planning.
Oversee and execute UX content strategy, including content audits, gap analyses, taxonomies, content hierarchies, copy planning, and content planning for design and migration.
Oversee and execute delivery content strategy, including content matrices, governance models, workflows, guidelines, migration support, and authoring guidance.
Facilitate client workshops, stakeholder interviews, content working sessions, and alignment meetings that connect content decisions to business goals and audience needs.
Present polished deliverables, recommendations, project updates, and decision points to marketing, digital, technology, and executive stakeholders.
Design content approaches that support AI Search, Answer Engine Optimization, Generative Engine Optimization, personalization, site search, related content, filtering, and content reuse.
Develop structured, governed, machine-readable content strategies, including taxonomy, metadata, schema guidance, content models, prompt-ready source content, and reuse patterns.
Use AI tools to improve content inventories, audits, gap analyses, taxonomy exploration, migration mapping, content QA, prompt testing, answer testing, and content performance review.
Build repeatable AI-assisted workflows, prompts, QA routines, documentation, and review protocols that improve speed and quality without sacrificing judgment, accuracy, or governance.
Influence the pilot, adoption, and improvement of content-related AI tools in partnership with Strategy, SEO and AI, Personalization, Analytics, Experience Design, and Technology teams.
Help clients understand where AI can improve content operations, where human review is required, and how to govern AI-enabled content workflows responsibly.
Define and improve content lifecycle processes across planning, creation, review, approval, publishing, optimization, maintenance, and retirement.
Set content quality standards, review criteria, performance indicators, and documentation practices that can be used consistently across programs.
Identify process gaps, quality risks, content ownership issues, and workflow blockers, then recommend practical improvements.
Create content governance models that clarify roles, responsibilities, decision rights, approval paths, editorial standards, and maintenance cadences.
Support compliance-aware content processes for clients in regulated, brand-sensitive, or multi-stakeholder environments.
Use analytics and performance data to assess content effectiveness and inform future content planning, optimization, and governance decisions
Develop taxonomies, metadata models, tagging strategies, and structured data approaches that help power navigation, search, personalization, content relationships, and reporting.
Guide information architecture work including navigation strategy, sitemaps, content hierarchy, page-level content planning, and content inputs for wireframes and visual design.
Lead content migration strategy, including inventories, keep/edit/kill analysis, migration mapping, content matrices, content models, authoring requirements, and migration readiness.
Help establish repeatable methods and level-of-effort guidance for taxonomy, information architecture, and migration work so these activities can be scoped and delivered consistently.
Partner with Business Development, Client Services, and Practice Leads to shape content strategy solutions for proposals, pitch meetings, and active accounts.
Scope and estimate content strategy activities across discovery, redesign, migration, AI search, personalization, content operations, and optimization programs.
Contribute to packaged content strategy offerings, delivery standards, internal templates, case studies, POVs, and thought leadership.
Serve as a senior content strategy voice on strategic accounts and as an escalation point for content strategy delivery and quality.
Help identify opportunities to grow content strategy revenue within broader Marketing Services and Experience engagements.
Coach cross-functional teammates on content strategy methods, client facilitation, deliverable quality, and content decision-making.
Create enablement materials that help internal teams understand content strategy, AI-ready content, taxonomy, migration, and governance.
Lead through example, advocacy, and mentoring while supporting a collaborative, high-performing team culture.
Help build fluency in AI-assisted content workflows across the practice, including prompt development, source evaluation, quality review, and responsible tool use.

Qualifications

8+ years of experience in content strategy, content design, content operations, digital strategy, or a closely related discipline.
3+ years of experience leading workstreams, mentoring content strategists, enabling cross-functional teams, or guiding client stakeholders.
Deep experience across editorial content strategy, UX content strategy, delivery content strategy, content governance, and content operations.
Strong knowledge of digital redesigns, platform implementations, CMS programs, content migrations, and enterprise digital transformation activities.
Experience with content management systems and digital platforms such as Sitecore, Optimizely, Adobe Experience Manager, Contentstack, Drupal, WordPress, or similar systems.
Demonstrated ability to create taxonomies, metadata models, content models, information architecture inputs, content matrices, migration plans, and governance documentation.
AI fluency, including practical experience using generative AI and LLM-based tools to support content strategy, content operations, research synthesis, content QA, taxonomy development, migration planning, and optimization.

jobs.title: Director, AI Delivery Squad Lead, Underwriting
jobs.description:
The Director of AI, Delivery Squad Lead is accountable for the end-to-end execution of AI powered underwriting initiatives (i.e., Life Insurance Underwriting, Automated Underwriting, Underwriting Decision Support, Advisor Underwriting Experience, and Underwriting Transformation). The role translates Solutioning-defined priorities into delivered AI solutions, ensuring execution with speed, quality, and measurable business impact.

This role requires a deep understanding of life insurance risk assessment and underwriting decision-making to ensure AI solutions appropriately balance growth, customer experience, risk selection, and operational efficiency.

This role is the single point of accountability for delivery execution, ensuring initiatives are effectively scoped, sequenced, executed, and aligned to timelines, capacity, and governance requirements.

The role also provides financial oversight of the delivery portfolio, coordinates dependencies across IT, data, architecture, and business stakeholders, and ensures delivery teams have clear scope, sequencing, and execution expectations.

Position Responsibilities

End-to-End Delivery Execution

Own the full lifecycle delivery of assigned AI initiatives, from execution planning and backlog readiness through production deployment, adoption, and value realization.
Translate prioritized initiatives into clear work packages, defined scope, team tasks, sequencing, and delivery timelines; ensure the squad understands priorities, responsibilities, and expected outcomes.
Lead the day-to-day execution of data scientists and cross-functional squad members by setting clear accountabilities, monitoring commitments, and maintaining delivery momentum and discipline.
Proactively identify risks, remove blockers, and resolve delivery issues to maintain pace and quality.
Establish and maintain the squad’s delivery operating rhythm, including sprint planning, backlog management, quality controls, and performance reviews.

Translation of Strategy to Execution

Apply deep domain expertise in life insurance risk assessment, underwriting philosophy, and risk selection to guide solution design, prioritize opportunities, and ensure AI capabilities address meaningful underwriting challenges.
Convert Solutioning priorities into execution-ready plans
Leverage deep domain expertise to tailor execution plans to operational, regulatory, and market context, driving measurable business impact
Actively bridge business strategy and technical delivery by contextualizing priorities with industry trends, stakeholder needs, and organizational objectives to ensure alignment and value realization.
Align delivery to business strategy and defined scope
Execute approved priorities within established intake and governance frameworks; provide delivery feasibility, capacity, dependency, and sequencing input without owning intake or portfolio prioritization decisions.

Underwriting AI Delivery Leadership

Lead execution of the underwriting AI portfolio, ensuring each approved initiative progresses through planning, build, validation, production deployment, adoption, and outcome measurement.
Translate underwriting priorities into executable roadmaps and delivery plans.
Partner with underwriting leaders to modernize underwriting operations through AI.
Partner with underwriting leaders to plan and execute change, training, communications, and operating-process updates required for adoption of AI-enabled underwriting capabilities.
Lead the translation of complex underwriting challenges into data-driven and AI-enabled solutions through close collaboration with data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders.
Identify opportunities to standardize and reuse underwriting data, models, components, controls, and delivery patterns across products and business units, and coordinate their implementation with platform owners.
Balance growth, risk, operational efficiency, and customer experience objectives.

Cross-Functional Delivery Orchestration

Lead cross-functional delivery across data science, engineering, product, business teams, and shared services.
Orchestrate delivery across underwriting, actuarial, product, distribution, data science, engineering, risk, compliance, technology, architecture, and other shared-service partners.
Maintain an integrated dependency plan across systems, data, architecture, controls, operating processes, and delivery partners; resolve or escalate constraints before they affect committed milestones.
Confirm stakeholder decisions, control requirements, operating readiness, and handoffs at each stage of the delivery lifecycle.

Portfolio Management & Delivery Orchestration

Maintain the integrated delivery portfolio view for approved underwriting AI initiatives, showing alignment to segment priorities, OKRs, AI strategy, dependencies, milestones, capacity, risks, and expected outcomes.
The portfolio may include automated underwriting platforms, underwriting requirement optimization, advisor-facing underwriting assistants, underwriting knowledge and decision-support capabilities, fraud detection, and future-state underwriting transformation initiatives.
Translate the approved roadmap into sequenced, executable portfolio plans with defined milestones, dependencies, resource requirements, and capacity constraints.
Coordinate delivery across initiatives by identifying cross-portfolio dependencies, assessing execution trade-offs, and escalating decisions that require Product, Solutioning, or stakeholder prioritization.
Maintain disciplined execution through project controls, risk management, performance reporting, and transparent escalation; recommend re-baselining when assumptions or commitments change and drive approved corrective actions.

Resource & Budget Management

Own resource and financial planning for the approved delivery portfolio, aligning squad capacity, external spend, and funding requirements to committed outcomes and delivery milestones.
Monitor actual and forecast spend, explain variances, and identify emerging resource or funding constraints early enough to support corrective action.
Provide leadership with decision-ready budget updates, including actuals, forecasts, variance drivers, funding risks, and cost estimates for approved or emerging opportunities..

Delivery Governance & Reporting

Operate within established intake, delivery governance, risk, compliance, architecture, and responsible AI frameworks, ensuring required approvals and evidence are completed before key delivery gates.
Contribute delivery estimates, dependency assessments, resource requirements, acceptance criteria, and technical feasibility input so approved initiatives are ready for squad execution.
Provide timely, decision-oriented reporting on progress, milestones, capacity, financial performance, risks, dependencies, outcomes, and required leadership actions.

Value Realization

Ensure each initiative has approved KPIs, baseline measures, target outcomes, accountable business owners, and an agreed measurement approach before delivery begins.
Track delivery, adoption, operational, customer, risk, and financial measures through implementation and value realization.
Collaborate with Finance stakeholders to validate assumptions, estimates and realized value, and support reporting aligned to business expectations
Measure and report underwriting outcomes, including increased capacity and new-business throughput; reduced cycle times, unnecessary requirements, and operating costs; higher straight-through processing rates; improved underwriting consistency; and a better advisor experience.

People Leadership

Build squad delivery capability by coaching cross-functional teams, strengthening delivery practices, and reinforcing predictable, high-quality execution.

Required Qualifications

Life insurance underwriting, risk assessment, and risk selection principles, including understanding mortality and morbidity drivers, underwriting decision frameworks and AI-enabled decision support.
Experience with insurance product manufacturing and distribution, including advisor and customer experience.
Experience operating in regulated insurance and compliance environments.
Enterprise AI product and solution delivery experience, including cross-functional execution from planning through production deployment and value realization.
Understanding of agentic AI patterns and safeguards, including orchestration, planning, memory, tool use, permissions, auditability, failure handling, and human escalation.
Experience with grounding, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt design, evaluation, observability, and responsible AI controls for accurate, reliable, and compliant GenAI solutions.
Experience delivering enterprise GenAI solutions, with knowledge of foundation models, orchestration, APIs, vector retrieval, data integration, deployment, adoption, and value realization.
Experience applying advance analytics, machine learning, AI, or decision science to solve complex underwriting, risk management, or insurance business challenges.
Demonstrated ability to manage delivery risks, dependencies, resources, budgets, governance, and executive-level portfolio reporting.
Strong stakeholder leadership and ability to bridge underwriting business priorities with technical delivery.

When You Join Our Team

We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.

jobs.description:
Position Description

Ready to join an organization that values innovation, inclusion, community involvement, and the opportunity to influence decisions?

CGI is more than an IT company. We combine local relationships and accountability with access to global capabilities, industry expertise, and delivery talent. CGI offers a competitive total rewards package that includes a share purchase program, profit sharing, professional development programs and flexible work arrangements.

CGI Edmonton is seeking an experienced Director, Consulting Services – Growth & Strategy to help build and scale our commercial business in the Edmonton market.

This is a leadership role focused on originating net new executive relationships, identifying client priorities, shaping differentiated consulting and technology opportunities, and closing profitable engagements that create long-term client value, recurring revenue, and future backlog.

This role is suited to a true market builder, someone who creates opportunities rather than waits for them, can open doors at the executive level, and has the commercial discipline to move opportunities from initial conversation through contract signature and successful transition to delivery.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Success in this role will be measured by the Director's ability to:

Establish meaningful executive relationships within priority Edmonton accounts.
Create qualified opportunities rather than relying primarily on inbound demand.
Convert client priorities into differentiated, commercially viable CGI solutions.
Build and maintain a credible pipeline with clear client-supported next steps.
Win new clients and expand initial engagements into long-term relationships.
Deliver signed bookings and profitable backlog that contribute to future revenue growth.
Maintain accurate forecasts and strong commercial discipline.
Mobilize CGI's broader organization effectively in a matrixed environment.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

10 or more years of experience in complex business-to-business technology, consulting, or managed services sales, account growth, or consulting leadership.
Significant recent experience developing business within Edmonton or the broader Alberta market.
An established network of relationships within Edmonton and Alberta's commercial business community.
A proven record of building qualified pipeline and achieving or exceeding sales, bookings, or revenue objectives.
Experience engaging and influencing C-suite executives, senior business leaders, CIOs, CTOs, CFOs, and operational decision makers.
Experience positioning and selling services such as business consulting, systems integration, application development, data and AI, modernization, cybersecurity, or multi-year application management services.
Strong commercial and financial acumen, including experience with pricing, cost models, contribution margin, contracting and opportunity risk.
Strong written, verbal, presentation, facilitation and negotiation skills.
Ability to maintain a regular in-market presence with clients and the Edmonton business community.

Leadership attributes

A proactive, entrepreneurial approach to market development.
Strong consultative selling and executive relationship skills.
The ability to listen carefully, understand business problems, and translate them into actionable opportunities.
Commercial discipline and a willingness to qualify out opportunities that do not warrant investment.
Creativity in developing solutions, value propositions and paths into new accounts.
Resilience, personal accountability and comfort operating in an evolving growth environment.
The ability to influence and mobilize people without relying on direct reporting authority.
A collaborative approach that balances individual sales accountability with one team outcomes.
A commitment to client value, delivery credibility, and long-term relationships.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Management Information Systems, Computer Science or a related discipline.
An equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience will also be considered (10+ years).

CGI is providing a reasonable estimate of the pay range for this role. The determination of this range includes various factors, including but not limited to skill set level, geographic market, experience and training, and licenses and certifications. Compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,000 - $215,000.

Why CGI

At CGI, you will have the opportunity to shape a new growth portfolio while drawing on the capabilities of a global organization. You will work with experienced leaders, consulting and technology specialists, and delivery teams to help Edmonton organizations address meaningful business priorities.

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

At CGI, we value the strength that diversity brings and are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. At Ontario Health, we are committed to developing a strong organizational culture that connects and inspires all team members across the province. Our vision is that together, we will be a leader in health and wellness for all. Our mission is to connect the health system to drive improved and equitable health outcomes, experiences and value. How we work together is reflected through our five values: integrity, inspiration, tenacity, humility and care. 

What Ontario Health offers: 

Role

At Ontario Health, your growth and well-being aren’t just supported—they’re celebrated every step of the way. Here, you have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while shaping a fulfilling and sustainable career. Based on your role, you may receive:

Comprehensive health coverage from day one, with fully paid medical, dental, and vision benefits to support you and your family’s health
Flexible health care or wellness spending accounts, plus an inclusive program to support your overall well-being
A premium defined benefit pension plan, ensuring long-term financial security
Competitive vacation entitlement that encourages time to rest and recharge
Three personal days and two float days annually, providing added flexibility to support work-life balance, in addition to vacation days
Ongoing learning and career development opportunities designed to help you grow, advance, and thrive in your profession
A collaborative, values-driven workplace where integrity, care, humility, inspiration, and tenacity shape everything we do
Opportunities to participate in Communities of Inclusion, fostering belonging, equity, and the sharing of diverse perspectives across our team

Want to make a difference in your career?  Consider this opportunity.

Ontario Health is seeking a strategic, collaborative leader to oversee the multidisciplinary Health System Analytics team of 30–40 professionals. The Director will shape high-impact analytic products, tools, methods and models that inform health system planning, performance measurement, policy, resource allocation and quality improvement.

Combining deep expertise in health care data and analytics with exceptional people leadership, the Director will balance ongoing commitments, strategic initiatives and rapid-response priorities; strengthen organizational capability; and translate complex findings into clear, actionable insights for senior leaders and health system partners.

Here Is What You Will Be Doing

Key Responsibilities

Lead and inspire the team: Provide strategic direction to a multidisciplinary team of 30–40 staff, including managers and individual contributors; foster an open, inclusive and innovative culture; and oversee recruitment, coaching, performance and retention.
Set the analytics agenda: Partner with senior leaders across clinical programs, Regions and corporate portfolios to establish a rolling product plan aligned with organizational priorities.
Deliver trusted analytics: Guide the development of high-quality, methodologically sound, documented and replicable products, including multi-year forecasting and capacity-planning models and analyses of performance, trends and variation.
Advance methods and innovation: Champion leading analytic practices and the responsible adoption of advanced and emerging methods, including artificial intelligence.
Turn evidence into action: Translate complex results into accessible visualizations, presentations, dashboards and concise reports, providing strategic insights and recommendations to senior health system leaders.
Build strong partnerships: Collaborate with internal leaders, clinicians, subject matter experts, researchers, the Ministry of Health and other partners to define needs, manage risks and deliver meaningful outcomes.
Enable sustainable delivery: Oversee work plans, staffing, budgets and financial forecasts, and partner with Digital Excellence in Health on the infrastructure and solutions required to support the team.
Grow analytic capacity: Sponsor the enterprise-wide Analytics Forum, strengthen skills and collaboration, develop external partnerships, and share Ontario Health’s work through stakeholder forums, publications and conferences.
Provide enterprise leadership: Represent Health System Analytics on internal and external committees, governance tables and working groups.

Education And Experience

Here is what you will need to be successful:

Bachelor’s degree in Health or Business Administration, Public Health, Epidemiology, Economics, Data Sciences or another relevant field; a Master’s degree or PhD is an asset.
At least 5 years of relevant work experience, including 3 years experience leading, developing, and supporting teams via projects, programs and/or people leadership preferably within healthcare, public sector, or large complex organizations
Proven ability to manage large, complex data and analytics operations.
Working knowledge of Ontario’s health system and the ability to collaborate effectively with senior leaders, clinicians, researchers, scientists, staff and external partners in a multidisciplinary environment.
Leadership experience in equity, diversity, inclusion and anti-racism is an asset.

Knowledge And Skills

Proven ability to manage high-performing teams to excellent, demonstrable results
Strong judgement, strategic thinking, problem-solving and reasoning skills involving highly complex issues that often have limited precedent.
Broad understanding of the health care and public sector environment, including changing priorities, trends, legislative requirements and/or other internal and external emerging issues and their potential impacts on goals, priorities and activities within the function and across the organization.
Exceptional communication skills, including strong facilitation skills and the ability to create and deliver effective presentations to senior level decision-makers.
Demonstrated relationship-building and stakeholder management skills, including experience leading change initiatives.

This role leads conversations about how technology roadmaps, investments, and priorities can support each client’s business goals, improve employee productivity, reduce technology friction, and manage risk. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in Canada.

Bringing broad technology expertise and an understanding of each client’s operating environment and business priorities, this role translates client priorities into practical technology strategies, roadmaps, budgets, and recommendations. Working with client leaders and Microserve teams, the role helps clients make informed technology decisions and prioritize initiatives based on value, risk, readiness, and available budget.

Strategic Technology Leadership

jobs.title: Director of Financial Strategy
jobs.description:
Are you a strategic finance leader who thrives in a collaborative, evolving environment and is passionate about using financial insight to support organizational impact? Canada’s National Ballet School (NBS) is excited to invite applications for the position of Director of Financial Strategy. This is an exciting opportunity to provide strategic financial leadership, strengthen enterprise-wide decision-making, and help shape the continued evolution of NBS’ Finance function.

About Us

Canada’s National Ballet School (NBS) is a leading arts and education institution dedicated to excellence in dance training, community programming, and health initiatives. NBS has 300+ employees supporting programs ranging from professional ballet training and community engagement to groundbreaking health initiatives. NBS fosters a collaborative, creative environment rooted in inclusion and continuous growth.

The Role

Reporting to the Chief Strategy and Operations Officer (CSOO) and working closely with the Executive Director and Artistic Director, the Director of Financial Strategy is a key member of NBS’ Senior Management team. This role provides strategic leadership in financial planning, analysis, enterprise intelligence, decision support, and the continued evolution of Finance systems and processes.

Working alongside the School’s Controller, the Finance Director will help transform the Finance function from a primarily reporting-oriented service into a stronger source of strategic insight and organizational decision support. The role will partner with leaders across NBS to align financial resources with organizational priorities, strengthen financial performance, and support the School’s long-term sustainability.

Why You’ll Love This Role

You’ll play a key role in shaping the financial strategy and long-term sustainability of a leading Canadian arts and education institution
You’ll work closely with senior leaders and organizational stakeholders to connect strategy, resources, and financial performance
You’ll have the opportunity to modernize and strengthen Finance systems, processes, technology, and analytics
You’ll use financial modelling, forecasting, and enterprise intelligence to support meaningful organizational decisions
You’ll lead and develop a Finance team while fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing workplace culture
You’ll contribute to NBS’ continued growth, innovation, and organizational impact through strategic financial leadership

What You’ll Do

Strategy, Budgeting and Forecasting: Lead long-range planning, annual budgeting, forecasting, scenario analysis, and modelling, aligning resources with NBS’ priorities. This position contributes to key outcomes outlined in Momentum 2023: NBS’ Strategic Plan 2025–2030.
Insight and Enterprise Intelligence: Lead management reporting, performance analysis, and data use to inform decisions, manage risks, and support resource allocation, revenue growth, and cost efficiencies.
Cross-Organizational Partnership: Collaborate with HR, payroll, compensation, benefits, pensions, student financial aid, and operations on integrated planning and reporting.
Finance Transformation and Team Leadership: Modernize systems, processes, and workflows to improve efficiency, data quality, and automation, while mentoring and developing Finance staff in a collaborative, inclusive culture.
Governance, Sustainability and Risk: With the Controller, support data governance, internal controls, compliance, and accounting standards, and oversee treasury, investments, cash flow, insurance, and financial risk.
Audits, External Relationships and Board Reporting: Support the annual audit, maintain relationships with auditors, financial institutions, and legal counsel, and serve as primary financial liaison to the Board of Directors and the Finance, Audit, Pension, and Investment Committees.
Equity and Senior Leadership: Champion equitable, transparent financial practices and contribute to organizational priorities as part of the Senior Management team.

What You Bring

First and foremost, we value strategic finance leaders who bring strong financial expertise, sound judgement, collaborative leadership, and a commitment to using financial insight to support organizational impact. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every qualification listed.

Degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, or related field (MBA or graduate degree an asset)
10+ years of progressive financial and operational management experience, including senior-level strategy, analysis, and decision support
Expertise in planning, budgeting, forecasting, modelling, scenario analysis, and management reporting
Experience leading change and evolving financial systems, with advanced proficiency in emerging technology tools
Strong leadership and talent development skills
Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
Solid grasp of governance, internal controls, compliance, risk management, and reporting
Clear communicator who can translate complex financial information for diverse audiences and prioritize in a fast-paced environment
Commitment to Equity, Diversity, Inclusion, Accessibility, and Belonging in financial and people decisions
Assets: analytics experience; not-for-profit, charitable, arts, education, or cultural sector experience

Compensation

Salary Range: $130-000.00 - $140,000.00 annually commensurate with experience and aligned with internal equity.

Total Rewards

Employer-matched Defined Contribution Pension Plan
Paid vacation time
Commitment to work-life balance
Professional development opportunities

Employee discount at The Shoe Room, our dance retail store
Subsidized lunch, beverages, and snacks at our onsite café
Collaborative and inclusive work environment with opportunities to participate in employee engagement initiatives
