The application window is expected to close on: 10/15/2026

This is a hybrid role with two days per week at Cisco’s Atlanta, Toronto or RTP offices. Alternate locations will be considered on an exception basis.

Members of the Finance organization at select locations will generally be expected to follow a hybrid work model, which includes two days of in-office attendance each week, with limited exceptions.

Meet The Team

The Market Insights team delivers the market intelligence behind executive decision-making at Cisco. We size markets, track the competitive landscape, and analyze customer behavior to inform where Cisco invests, builds, and competes.

We’re a team of analysts, data scientists, engineers, and market intelligence leaders focused on the practical application of data to hard business problems. Using proprietary data and machine learning, we surface new market opportunities and flag risks early. Every insight we produce is built to be acted on, so that resource allocation and product roadmaps rest on objective evidence rather than assumption.

Your Impact

As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you’ll sit between our data architecture and the strategic decisions it informs. Working with experts from the team, you’ll build the analytical solutions and dashboards that support the market insight analysis in the team and help visualize to give executives clear understanding into market performance — sizing opportunities, measuring how we’re performing against them, and translating what the data says into recommendations leaders can act on.

Responsibilities

Market Analysis: Run deep-dive analyses across large, disparate datasets — internal telemetry, third-party analyst data, public financial disclosures — to identify trends, anomalies, and growth opportunities in the global technology market.
Market Sizing & Forecasting: Build and maintain TAM models and forecasts for priority segments, tracking forecast accuracy and refining methodology over time.
Visualization: Develop and maintain interactive dashboards that turn complex datasets into insight an executive can absorb in two minutes.
Gen AI Integration: Apply LLMs and agentic workflows to synthesize unstructured sources — analyst reports, earnings calls, customer feedback — and to accelerate recurring reporting and narrative development.
Data Modeling: Architect and optimize the data models behind our analytical platforms for accuracy, scalability, and performance, and continuously improve the collection and reporting workflows that feed them.
Stakeholder Partnership: Work with Sales, Product Management, and Strategy to turn open business questions into analytical work, and own the reporting cadence that supports their planning.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field — Business Analytics, Data Science, Economics, Computer Science — or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years in business intelligence, data analysis, or a similar analytical role.
Advanced SQL for data extraction and manipulation.
Hands-on experience with Tableau, Power BI, or a comparable visualization platform.
Strong grounding in data modeling, relational databases, and data warehousing.
Demonstrated experience applying LLMs to business problems — automating analysis, synthesizing unstructured data, or building agentic workflows.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, AWS Redshift, or Google BigQuery.
Python or R for statistical analysis and automation.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

Wealth Management Data & AI is responsible for delivering innovative AI capabilities across all of Wealth Management’s global businesses. We are building a high-impact team that will deliver cutting-edge AI solutions for our Digital and Global Investment teams. In this role, you will have the rare opportunity to help shape the future of our business and power innovative offerings fit for the next generation of Wealth Management clients. We’re looking for a critical problem solver to bring strong strategy, business, and product focus to the AI solutions we build. This role exists to ensure our technical team’s strengths and efforts are consistently aimed at the highest-impact problems, land seamlessly in end-user workflows, and create measurable value for the business.

As Director, Strategy and Product Management, you will sit at the intersection of our technical team and our business counterparts. You’ll partner with business leaders and stakeholders to identify the right problems to solve with AI, work side-by-side with technical team to translate those problems into well-scoped solutions, and stay close to end-users to ensure out solutions fit their needs and get high adoption. You’ll be the voice of the business inside the technical team, and the voice of the technical team inside the business.

What will you do?

Strategy and Business Leadership

Partner with business leaders and stakeholders to identify the highest-impact business problems where AI can create outsized value, and surface opportunities that the business may not have considered;
Develop and communicate a clear strategy and roadmap for the team’s AI portfolio, aligned with broader Wealth Management Data & AI priorities
Assess the business case and expected ROI of potential AI solutions, including the financial, operational, client experience, and risk dimensions of impact;
Prioritize the team’s portfolio of initiatives, balancing near-term wins with longer-term, higher-ambition bets, and adjusting priorities as conditions evolve;
Act as the ongoing business owner for the team’s portfolio, liaising with stakeholders across the development lifecycle to ensure alignment, momentum, and business value capture;

Product Management

Develop a deep understanding of end-user workflows, and ensure our solutions integrate into those workflows seamlessly;
Build a working understanding of the business’ technology stack, and guide the technical team on which platforms, systems, and data sources our solutions should integrate with, and how;
Help the technical team translate business requirements into a clear development plan, including scoping, sequencing, and trade-off decisions on functionality, model choice, and delivery approach;
Define business and technical success metrics for each solution, and put in place the measurement mechanisms needed to track performance against them through and beyond deployment;
Champion a test-and-learn approach to AI product development, promoting experimentation, structured pilots, and the use of evidence to drive decisions about scaling, iterating, or sunsetting solutions

Stakeholder Engagement and Communication

Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with senior business stakeholders, end-user communities, technology partners, and control functions such as risk, compliance, and legal;
Communicate vision, strategy, progress, and outcomes clearly and credibly to senior leadership, ensuring transparency, alignment, and buy-in;
Represent the business perspective inside the technical team, and the technical team’s perspective inside the business, translating fluently in both directions;
Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and industry trends, and translate external developments into practical implications and opportunities

What do you need to succeed?

Must-have

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field – Master's or MBA is a plus;
8+ years of experience in a top-tier technology company, financial service organization, fintech, or consulting firm, ideally with meaningful exposure to AI or machine learning products;
Proven experience as a Senior or above Product Manager, with a track record of successfully shipping products in an enterprise environment that drive business impact and customer satisfaction;
A track record of identifying high-impact business problems and delivering technology solutions that produced measurable business outcomes in a large, complex enterprise;
Strong background in AI technologies and their application in product development, with the ability to translate business needs into clear product and technical requirements, and translate complex technical realities back into business language;

This is a remote position; however, candidates must be located in the same country, city, or region where the job is posted. The successful candidate must be available to attend a local office, meeting, training session, or company event if requested.

Please only apply if you are based in the location listed on this job posting. Remote does not mean the position is open worldwide.

Compensation:
C$180,000–C$200,000 base salary
, based on experience, plus a performance-based annual bonus targeted at 15%–20% of base salary

Build Financial Clarity Across a Growing Group of Companies

Rothenbury Group
owns and operates technology-enabled businesses across real estate, property management, brokerage, leasing, maintenance, staffing, media, and other service industries.

We are hiring an experienced Vice President of Finance
to strengthen financial reporting, cash-flow visibility, forecasting, controls, documentation, and executive decision support across the group.

This is a senior finance leadership role for someone who can enter a complex, multi-company environment, assess the current state of financial information, identify gaps and risks, establish priorities, and provide management with clear, practical recommendations.

The successful candidate will work closely with senior leadership while coordinating with internal finance staff, accountants, bookkeepers, tax advisors, legal counsel, lenders, banks, vendors, consultants, and other external partners.

Our Hiring Process

Please apply with your resume and a brief summary of your senior finance experience.

If your background aligns with the role, you will receive an email within 24 to 48 hours of applying
with a link to complete a pre-recorded online interview
.

The interview will help us better understand your finance leadership background, technical capabilities, reporting approach, judgment, and experience working with complex financial information. Selected candidates will then be invited to continue through the next stage of the interview process.

Your Mandate

The Vice President of Finance will be responsible for creating greater visibility, organization, accuracy, and accountability across the group’s financial operations.

You Will Be Expected To

Assess the condition of financial records, reporting processes, controls, and supporting documentation
Identify missing information, unexplained balances, inconsistencies, financial risks, process gaps, and priority action items
Improve cash-flow visibility, budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and management reporting
Build clear reporting structures that help leadership understand performance, obligations, risks, and upcoming decisions
Strengthen reconciliations, approval processes, internal controls, and finance operating discipline
Coordinate effectively with internal teams and external financial, legal, tax, banking, and advisory partners
Provide practical recommendations that support immediate decisions and long-term financial improvement

Key Responsibilities

Review, organize, analyze, summarize, and reconcile financial and accounting information across multiple companies
Review banking, payroll, tax, ownership, investment, corporate, vendor, client, receivable, payable, budgeting, and forecasting records
Prepare executive summaries, management reports, financial models, dashboards, schedules, trackers, reconciliations, workpapers, and memoranda
Develop clear reporting on cash position, cash-flow requirements, expenses, receivables, payables, budgets, forecasts, and financial risks
Identify incomplete records, unexplained transactions, reporting weaknesses, control concerns, and process failures
Improve finance-related document organization, file structures, naming conventions, supporting records, and document readiness
Strengthen month-end, reconciliation, and management-reporting processes
Support budgeting, forecasting, scenario analysis, financial modelling, and operational finance planning
Review and improve internal controls, approval workflows, finance policies, and accountability standards
Coordinate with accountants, bookkeepers, tax advisors, legal counsel, lenders, banks, vendors, consultants, and other external partners
Clearly communicate assumptions, limitations, unresolved questions, risks, recommendations, and required next steps
Support financial clean-up projects, transitions, system changes, special reviews, and other senior finance initiatives
Provide senior leadership with accurate, timely, and decision-ready financial information

Required Experience And Qualifications

The successful candidate will have:

10+ years of progressive experience in finance, accounting, controllership, FP&A, corporate finance, or senior financial management
At least 5 years in a senior finance leadership position, such as Vice President of Finance, Director of Finance, Controller, Head of Finance, or an equivalent role
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Economics, or a related field
A CPA, CA, CMA, CGA, MBA, or comparable senior finance qualification is strongly preferred
Strong experience reviewing complex financial records, reports, reconciliations, budgets, forecasts, and supporting documentation
Advanced understanding of financial reporting, cash-flow management, budgeting, forecasting, internal controls, and finance operations
Experience preparing executive-level reports, dashboards, financial models, trackers, memoranda, and management updates
Strong ability to identify financial gaps, inconsistencies, control weaknesses, process issues, and business risks
Experience working with accountants, bookkeepers, tax advisors, legal counsel, lenders, banks, vendors, consultants, and executive stakeholders
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including financial modelling, reconciliations, reporting, and structured data analysis
Experience using accounting systems and managing information related to banking, payroll, receivables, payables, vendors, clients, budgets, forecasts, and corporate records
Excellent written communication, documentation, and presentation skills
Strong judgment, discretion, organization, and attention to detail
Ability to manage evolving priorities and provide clear recommendations with limited supervision

Experience That Will Stand Out

Preference May Be Given To Candidates With

Experience overseeing finance across multiple companies, entities, business units, or operating divisions
Real estate accounting or finance experience
Property management accounting experience
Asset management or development accounting experience
Experience working in a founder-led, entrepreneurial, or rapidly growing organization
Experience improving an existing finance function rather than only maintaining established systems
Experience strengthening reporting, financial controls, documentation, systems, or cash-flow visibility during a period of growth or transition
Experience combining strategic finance leadership with hands-on financial review and problem-solving

The Leader Who Will Succeed Here

The right person is highly analytical but also practical.

They can review a large volume of financial information, determine what is reliable, identify what is missing, and separate immediate financial risks from lower-priority clean-up work. They are comfortable working with senior management and can explain complex financial matters clearly and directly.

They do not simply identify problems. They organize the work, establish priorities, recommend solutions, and create the reporting and financial discipline required to support better decisions.

They are equally comfortable reviewing detailed reconciliations, preparing executive reporting, coordinating with external advisors, and advising leadership on financial priorities.

What Success Looks Like

Success In This Role Will Mean

Leadership has clearer and more reliable visibility into the financial position of the group
Cash-flow requirements, financial obligations, risks, and upcoming decisions are easier to understand
Financial records and supporting documentation are organized, complete, and decision-ready
Management reporting is timely, accurate, and useful
Reconciliations, controls, approvals, and finance processes operate with greater discipline
Missing information and unresolved financial issues are identified and assigned clear next steps
Accountants, bookkeepers, advisors, and internal teams operate with stronger structure and accountability
The finance function becomes more scalable as Rothenbury Group continues to grow

Compensation and Opportunity

The base salary range for this position is C$180,000–C$200,000
, based on the candidate’s finance leadership experience, professional designation, multi-company background, technical capabilities, industry exposure, and overall fit.

The Successful Candidate Will Also Be Eligible For a Performance-based Annual Bonus Targeted At 15%–20% Of Base Salary. Bonus Performance May Be Assessed Using Factors Such As

Financial reporting accuracy and timeliness
Cash-flow visibility and forecasting quality
Strength of financial controls
Completion of reconciliations and financial clean-up priorities
Improvement in management reporting
Finance-process discipline
Quality of executive decision support
Progress in building a scalable and accountable finance function

This is an opportunity to take on a senior finance leadership position with meaningful influence across a diverse and growing group of businesses.

jobs.description:
At Index Exchange, we're reinventing how digital advertising works—at scale. As a global advertising supply-side platform, we empower the world’s leading media owners and marketers to thrive in a programmatic, privacy-first ecosystem. Our platform is trusted by some of the world’s largest brands and media owners and plays a crucial role in the business model of the internet.

At the core of it all is our engineering-first culture. Our engineers tackle internet-scale problems across tight-knit, global teams. From moving petabytes of data and optimizing with AI to making real-time infrastructure decisions, Indexers have the agency and influence to shape the future of advertising. We move fast, build thoughtfully, and stay grounded in our core values.

About The Role

With an Exchange Platform that handles more than 650 billion real-time auctions every day, the Director, Exchange Platform
will be responsible for the operation, innovation and invention of the exchange platform, leading a world class team.

What We’re Looking For

A pragmatic and strategic technology leader:

Define the roadmap for performance profiling, tooling, optimization, and latency reduction across the entire exchange platform.
Exceptional hands-on technology leader to ‘drive and own’ the performance optimization, vision, direction, and technology roadmap for system performance and optimization
Design, develop, and drive: implementation of all performance- and latency-critical services and pipelines in our exchange; performance profiling and optimization tooling and frameworks, and integrate same into our build and validation pipelines
Establish and advance best practices and standards for performance and latency critical pipelines, and ensure that all Index engineering teams subscribe to same
Manage all requirements related to performance and latency metrics and observability
Develop and champion the near-term targets against long term strategy for continuous performance and latency improvements for our exchange
Make significant contributions while working cross functionally across engineering on the strategic technology roadmap for the company

A Builder And Amplifier Of World Class Engineering Teams

Lead architecture and design with a particular focus on pervasive performance and latency optimization, profiling, and observability
Collaborate to build and evolve technology planning, design, and architectural process for all of Index, driving collaborative engagement and enabling innovation from the entire organization
Organize and drive integrated release planning and coordination and design across platform, software, analytics, and infrastructure teams
Drive alignment across all agile engineering teams, with a strong focus on best in class architectural and technology standards and engineering best practices
Design and build quality, performance, security, efficiency, and reliability in from day one, and inspire other team members to do the same
Prototype, vet, and champion new technology introductions to our platform
Represent our performance capabilities and strategies to diverse internal teams, as well as to external partners and customers
Act as a respected technical role model and mentor for engineering teams, leading, motivating, and challenging a diverse globally distributed technology team

Growth Focused Architectural Leadership

Build, maintain, and drive the technology strategy and roadmap in close collaboration with architects
Champion quality and data driven decisions, development, and delivery
Offer pragmatic technology leadership, balancing long-term R&D investments with near-term execution and business impact
Communicate design decisions and influence technology and product direction of peers and executive leadership
Deliver to commitments, communicating changes in plans whether they be design or timeline modifications honestly and transparently

Leadership Role Model And Exemplar

Able to build credibility and rapport; adept at modifying one's behavioral style to respond to the needs of others while maintaining own objectives
A technologist’s technologist - able to lead high performance technology teams by example
Ability to manage, build and complement high performance teams with a natural ability to level-up high-performing engineers
A strong leader who can lead, manage, and inspire teams both locally and remotely
An aggressive problem solver who can provide creative solutions to complex situations and obtain buy-in from those affected
Able to take initiative to define and prioritize specific goals and objectives, and to do the same for others
A team player that works hard, admits their strengths and weaknesses, and has the flexibility to improve by learning new things
Inspirational and results-oriented leader, capable of earning the trust and respect of high performing engineering teams

Here’s What You’ll Be Doing

Hiring the right people, helping people grow both technically and personally, creating a stronger sense of ownership at the individual and team level
Bring a passion for technology, experience developing systems at scale, on multiple tech stacks and love launching as much as you love delivering results.
Provide consistent and steady feedback to your team – both positive and constructively critical. You are transparent with your team, and work to keep stakeholders informed of progress and issues.
Experience with Agile environments of all flavours, understand practices associated with different methodologies and when to use them.
Make an impact on Engineering and IX as a whole. Share your experiences at Town Halls, improve best practices, mentor engineers across teams.

Here's What You Need

Bachelors or Masters in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent
10+ years of experience in large scale commercial software development environments
Significant technology leadership experience with high volume low latency distributed platforms and large scale performance and latency optimized pipelines and platforms
Skilled in performance profiling and optimization, and how to drive the technology roadmap concurrent with the feature roadmap
Demonstrated history as an advocate and coach for robust architectural patterns and frameworks, test driven development, and frequent delivery
Expert in large-scale system profiling, concurrency, and memory management, and designing and building distributed systems
Expert in establishing pragmatic performance metrics, observability, and targets for large-scale systems (industry scale platform experience preferred)
Demonstrated ability developing, advancing, and evolving a robust technology roadmap
Demonstrated history of developing architectural designs and standards, platforms, and frameworks that are effectively leveraged by many development teams
Experience with large scale distributed stores and streaming pipelines (AeroSpike. Kafka, Flink, Spark, Hadoop, Parquet, Elasticsearch, Vertica, etc) in large-scale high-throughput environments
Skilled at profiling and optimizing high-volume transaction flows using advanced analytics and machine learning
Ability to leverage continuous integration and robust build/test automation, with a preference for cross-platform stacks and containerization (Git, Sonar, Kubernetes, etc.)
Demonstrated ability to provide leadership to globally distributed high performance teams, driving greenfield development in fast moving industries

jobs.description:
About The Job

Do you think like a management consultant, thrive in a startup environment, and can’t stop thinking about the intersection of data, technology, and marketing?

With over 2000 employees, offices on five continents, and world-class clients like Samsung, L’Oreal, and Mattel, Artefact
is a consulting firm that transforms data into value and business impact. We’ve recently launched in the US with offices located in NYC and Los Angeles, and we want you to join us as an integral part of our founding team!

Who We Are

Founded and headquartered in Paris, Artefact is a next-generation consulting firm, specializing in data, analytics & AI consulting, dedicated to transforming data into business impact across the entire value chain of organizations. We are proud to say that we help our clients grow their data and digital capabilities, and that we’re also growing in parallel.

We have 2000 employees across 36 offices who are focused on accelerating digital transformation. Our state-of-the-art data technologies, lean AI agile methodologies, and cohesive teams of the finest business consultants, data analysts, data scientists, data engineers, and digital experts are all dedicated to bringing extra value to every client. We design data-based solutions to meet our clients' specific needs, always conceived with a business-centric approach and delivered with tangible results. Our data-driven services are built upon the deep AI expertise we've acquired with our 1000+ client base around the globe.

Find out more at artefact.com.

What You Will Be Doing

You will lead a team of AI & machine learning engineers and managers, driving the design and delivery of production-grade AI solutions — from classical machine learning models to LLM-powered applications — and the pipelines that power them. You’ll bring senior technical judgment to architecture and model decisions, partner closely with clients and business stakeholders — including hands-on pre-sales work shaping proposals and solution designs — and define how context engineering, agent harnesses, and fine-tuning practices get embedded into every solution, while reporting into senior AI/technology leadership on strategy and priorities.

AI & ML Solution Architecture: Leading the design, build, and optimization of production AI systems — classical machine learning models, LLM applications, and agentic systems — ensuring scalability, reliability, and cost-efficient inference.
Context Engineering: Defining and standardizing context engineering practices — prompt and system design, RAG architectures, vector stores, memory management, and tool/function calling — so models receive the right information at the right time.
Harness Engineering: Directing the build of robust agent harnesses — orchestration layers, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and observability — that make LLM systems reliable, safe, and measurable in production.
Fine-Tuning Pipelines: Leading the design and operation of fine-tuning and model adaptation pipelines — training data curation, supervised fine-tuning, evaluation, and deployment — to specialize models for client use cases.
Platform Stack: Architecting and deploying solutions on Google Gemini Enterprise and Vertex AI as the primary stack, applying working knowledge of Microsoft AI Foundry and AWS Bedrock where client contexts require.
Team Leadership: Managing, mentoring, and developing a team of AI & ML engineers; setting technical standards and fostering best practices and knowledge sharing.
Pre-Sales & Business Development: Supporting pre-sales activities — scoping engagements, building demos and proofs of concept, and presenting solution architectures to prospective clients alongside account teams.
Machine Learning Modeling: Overseeing the development of classical and modern ML models — predictive modeling, forecasting, recommendation, and deep learning — choosing the right technique for each business problem, LLM or not.
Contributing to AI Strategy: Partnering with senior leadership to shape GenAI architecture direction, tooling decisions, and platform roadmap within your area.

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate has a substantial Data Science and machine learning background with 8+ years of experience, including at least 2–3 years working on LLM architecture, agentic design, and harness & context engineering.
Expertise in generative AI/LLM engineering (context engineering, agent harnesses, RAG, and fine-tuning) and in classical machine learning modeling, with proven production deployments.
Master’s degree (or higher) in computer science, engineering, statistics/mathematics, or a related field.
Hands-on command of core machine learning libraries (scikit-learn, XGBoost, etc.), agentic SDKs (LangGraph/LangChain, Google ADK, Claude Agent SDK), and fine-tuning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow).
Experience building fine-tuning pipelines end to end: training data curation, supervised fine-tuning, evaluation, and deployment.
Solid grasp of AI system design: ML model lifecycle (MLOps), agents, tool use, evaluation harnesses, guardrails, and observability.
Deep experience with Google Gemini Enterprise / Vertex AI; basic working knowledge of Microsoft AI Foundry and AWS Bedrock.
Experience leading and growing engineering teams, and supporting pre-sales: proposals, demos, and solution scoping with clients.
Excellent communication skills and comfort collaborating across teams and with stakeholders.
Strong business acumen with an interest in business-facing work.
Adaptability and a start-up mentality to thrive in a dynamic environment.

Preferred

Google Gemini Enterprise ecosystem (Vertex AI, Agent Builder) as the primary stack; basic knowledge of Microsoft AI Foundry and AWS Bedrock

Why Join Us

We are united by our values
and strengthened by our hybrid expertise
.

There is always a way: We're from the breed of does, of diggers, of makers. Because ideas are valuable only if executed.
Client trust is won on the field: Addressing client needs flows better hands on at their side.
If not used, it is useless: Our love for technology translates into a steep desire for adoption, true brilliance is about impact.
If not shared, our work is not done: Sharing knowledge is the best way to button up a mission, benefitting clients and colleagues.
We learn everyday: Tech is a land where everything moves at the speed of light, you better be ready to challenge yourself.

Every transaction matters. Every Canadian matters. At Interac, we protect both — driving trust, security, and inclusion, so our digital economy thrives.

Security certifications such as CISM, CISA, and CRISC.
Experience with implementing an Information Security Management System (ISMS) and ISO 27001 certification a benefit

Sound and practical business minded approach to implementation of a GRC program.
Experienced in the ability to influence and guide others across the organization to solve challenging problems.
Experience with leading GRC platforms, technologies and solutions is an asset
Build and foster strong relationships through collaboration, influencing change, and building consensus
You bring your real self to work and you live our values – trust, teamwork, open communication and accountability.

We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

Responsibilities

The Associate Director, Market Access & Reimbursement Strategy Specialty Portfolio (Oncology, Immunology and Neuroscience) is accountable for the achievement of pricing, reimbursement and access for Lilly in-market brands and new products in the specialty portfolio.

This is a leadership rol where the incumbent leads, coaches and develops a team of head office-based Market Access Strategy Managers, and oversees activities related to the establishment and achievement of Market Access objectives for Launch brands, in-market brands and new product planning. The incumbent also owns the market access strategy for a key brand and undertakes work as an individual contributor to brand-specific activities.

The role reports to the Head of Pricing, Reimbursement and Market Access and partners closely with the Associate Director – Field Patient Access and Associate Director of Pricing to ensure continuous information-sharing and collaboration. As a member of the Market Access Leadership Team, the incumbent helps sets strategic direction for the department and ensures strong collaboration across teams and work streams.

Location:

This is a hybrid role – onsite presence at our Toronto office will be 10 days or more per month (or at least 50% of the time), determined in collaboration with your manager and based on business needs.

This role is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as participation in the Lilly Bonus Program and a car allowance.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Market Access Strategy & Leadership

Lead a team of head office-based Market Access Managers supporting the specialty portfolio (Oncology, Immunology and Neuroscience), including: goal-setting, performance management, capability building, project prioritization and resource allocation and budget ownership across brands and therapeutic areas;
Develop and coach team members to create a high performance team and encourage career development.
Provide strategic oversight for the following activities, undertaken by head office-based Market Access Managers across launch brands, in-market brands and new product planning:
Develop the Market Access Plan and pricing strategy for launch brands, in-market brands and new products, using collaborative, cross-functional mechanisms and collaboration with regional teams to ensure it is based on deep understanding of customer/stakeholder needs, as well as the needs and realities of the business
Ensure alignmenet from the affiliate leadership team on the core components of the Market Access Plan, namely: the Market Access objective, underlying assumptions and upsides/downsides; contingency plan; strategic intent and major tactics
Develop access solutions for out of pocket market including close collaboration with patient support program team.
Develop value dossiers for national and regional Health Technology Assessment (HTA) bodies and payers (public and private) including health economic arguments and models and robust budget impact analysis
Lead new product planning, including early Market Access assessments, pricing and access assumptions, and evidence needs ahead of launch, in partnership with international and cross-functional team
Lead in-market lifecycle planning for established brands, including new indications, listing renewals and response to changes in the policy environment

Collaborate with the associate director of pricing and forecasting to develop business cases for approval of list and net prices at the local level and above-country

Individual Key Brand Ownership

Own the end-to-end Market Access strategy for an assigned key brand, from the Market Access Plan through HTA submissions, provincial and private payer listings, out of pocket market solution and lifecycle management
Represent Market Access on the brand team and provide Market Access input into brand planning, forecasting and launch decisions
Act as the primary Market Access contact for the cross-functional brand team with Pricing, Medical, HEOR, RWE, Marketing and the field-based Patient Access team
Remain accountable for brand-level Market Access deliverables and timelines alongside people leadership responsibilities

Essential Requirements

Bachelor’s degree or higher required, ideally in a scientific field
Minimum of 5 years of experience in market access, pricing, reimbursement or related functions in the pharmaceutical industry
Significant pharmaceutical industry experience
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach and develop a team towards excellence
Proficiency with AI powered tools
Strong interpersonal and influencing skills, with the ability to align cross-functional partners and senior leaders
Strong bias for action; makes timely decisions, prioritizes effectively and moves work forward in ambiguous situations.
Working knowledge of the Canadian HTA, pCPA, and provincial and private payer landscape

Additional Skills/Preferences

Bilingual (English and French) is considered an asset
Advanced degree preferred

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Chief Technology Officer based in Canada.

This is a senior technology leadership opportunity focused on shaping the future of enterprise software that supports critical public-sector and justice systems. You will own the technology strategy, architecture, product development, and engineering direction across a complex software portfolio. The role combines long-term technical vision with hands-on organizational leadership, modernization, product thinking, and operational excellence. You will work closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to align technology investments with customer needs and business priorities. A major part of the mandate will be building a high-performing technology organization while advancing secure, scalable, reliable, and configurable platforms. You will also help identify emerging technologies and new opportunities, including the practical application of AI and data-driven capabilities.

Accountabilities

Develop and lead a multi-year technology strategy and roadmap aligned with long-term organizational goals, ensuring the technical vision is understood and adopted across the business.
Establish a customer-centric, problem-first product development approach that ensures teams understand user needs, business challenges, and desired outcomes before committing to technical solutions.
Identify emerging technologies, market opportunities, partnerships, and potential acquisitions that can strengthen existing products and create new sources of value.
Advise executive leadership on technology investments, build-versus-buy decisions, strategic partnerships, acquisitions, and other major technology initiatives.
Define the architectural vision and engineering principles for secure, scalable, configurable, modular, repeatable, and maintainable systems that can evolve as customer and business needs change.
Promote platform thinking through reusable services, APIs, shared components, and common capabilities that can support multiple products and business units.
Lead modernization of the technology portfolio by balancing investment in existing platforms with technical debt reduction, consolidation, modernization, and next-generation capabilities.
Lead the engineering organization with a culture centered on ownership, craftsmanship, continuous improvement, pragmatic decision-making, quality, reliability, and security.
Advance modern engineering practices while balancing speed of delivery with operational resilience, product quality, cybersecurity, and long-term maintainability.
Support the organization's transition toward Agile methodologies and Scrum-at-Scale, helping teams adopt effective delivery practices and continuous improvement.
Build strong partnerships across departments, creating alignment around technology priorities, timelines, resources, dependencies, and organizational goals.
Translate complex technical concepts into clear business language for executives and non-technical stakeholders while bringing business context and customer priorities back to technical teams.
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing technology organization through organizational design, leadership development, succession planning, workforce strategy, and recruitment of critical technical talent.
Establish and maintain appropriate standards for security, privacy, compliance, and data governance, including requirements relevant to government agencies, courts, and criminal justice environments such as CJIS.
Oversee technology investment, performance, operational resilience, and resource allocation to ensure systems remain reliable, scalable, secure, and prepared for business continuity.
Establish effective technology governance and risk-management practices in partnership with Security, Cloud Operations, IT, Legal, and business leadership to manage architectural, cybersecurity, regulatory, and third-party technology risks.

Requirements

Bring 12+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 5 years in senior technical leadership positions such as CTO, VP of Engineering, Head of Engineering, or a comparable role.
Demonstrate proven experience leading and scaling engineering organizations and enterprise software platforms in complex technology environments.
Possess deep expertise in software and systems architecture, including distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, APIs, data platforms, scalability, security, and modern engineering practices.
Bring strong product judgment and experience making customer-driven product and technology decisions based on real user needs and business outcomes.
Demonstrate a track record of establishing compelling technical visions and successfully aligning engineering teams, executives, and other stakeholders around strategic priorities.
Have excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage effectively with executives, engineers, customers, partners, and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience in government technology, justice or court systems, legal technology, or other regulated public-sector environments is highly desirable.
Experience incubating new products or working within a startup, innovation lab, venture environment, or similarly entrepreneurial setting is preferred.
Hands-on experience applying artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data-driven technologies to real-world products is preferred.
Experience working in Agile environments or formal training in Scrum or Agile methodologies is expected.
Hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline; an advanced degree is considered an advantage.
Be comfortable operating as a strategic technology leader while remaining close enough to engineering, architecture, product, and customer needs to make informed decisions.
Candidates must be eligible to work in Canada without employer-sponsored visa or work authorization support.

Benefits

Competitive annual compensation of CAD $225,000–$275,000 for the Canada-based position.
Quality medical, dental, and vision coverage.
Discretionary profit-sharing opportunities for eligible employees.
Competitive paid time off and paid holidays.
Canadian GRRSP retirement program.
Annual professional development funding of at least $1,500 USD per employee, depending on role.
Access to extensive book libraries to support personal and professional development.
Opportunities to travel between offices and to client locations.
Opportunity to lead technology strategy for software that supports foundational justice and public-sector systems.
Exposure to enterprise architecture, modernization, AI, cloud technologies, cybersecurity, data governance, and regulated technology environments.
Significant influence over technology organization design, engineering culture, product strategy, and long-term technical direction.
Opportunity to work with experienced technical, executive, product, and cross-functional teams on technology with meaningful societal impact.

How Jobgether Works

to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

jobs.title: Associate Director, Mid-Market Leveraged Finance, Corporate Client Group
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**What is the opportunity?**


Reporting into a Senior Director, you will support the Mid\-Market Leveraged Finance (MMLF) team in realization of the Corporate Client Group’s (CCG) objectives through the structuring, delivery and account management of senior leveraged lending relationships principally to Private Equity (PE) owned/backed companies. MMLF is responsible for ensuring adequate legal, accounting, business, and financial due diligence is completed within RBC’s risk appetite to support the extension of leveraged loans, and ongoing monitoring, account management and realization of additional ancillary business for client and sponsor relationships. MMLF is mandated to support loan origination across Canada and within the majority of industries.

**What will you do?**

* Assist in generation, assessment and completion of financings with private equity sponsor owned businesses, and ongoing management and monitoring of the MMLF portfolio
* Develop an understanding of RBC credit appetite and the broad MMLF (and CCG) credit portfolio
* Assist in the preparation of materials for both internal and external purposes (e.g. credit submissions to Group Risk Management (GRM)and presentation materials to support new lending opportunities)
* Perform appropriate due diligence including, but not limited to, identifying and substantiating key risks; developing company specific financial modelling and sensitivity analysis, with focus on understanding cash flows; industry reviews from a variety of sources to provide team with comparable company information and industry insight on trends and areas of opportunity; and PE/sponsor diligence, including investment track record/ returns and partnership with capital providers
* Interact and develop working relationships with other Associates/Associate Directors within CCG and Capital Markets to facilitate deal execution by sharing key practices and transaction experience
* Support CCG Relationship Management team in the preparation and presentation of marketing pitches to existing and potential clients
* Follow up and engage with RBC partners and functions including GRM, Capital Markets, Personal and Commercial Banking, Wealth Management, and others
* Provide research, analysis, and data (market, industry, client, and competitor) to support MMLF advice on the optimal capital structure required to meet strategic objectives with each client relationship
* Provide analysis and support to Managing Director/Senior Director(s)/Director(s), MMLF on risk and return associated with loan transactions and client relationships

**What do you need to succeed?**

**Must\-have**

* Undergraduate degree with a focus in Business, Economics, Mathematics or other problem solving fields
* 2 – 5 years of work experience in a related field, including corporate lending/finance and/or risk management
* Understanding of finance and accounting with the ability to translate concepts to specific transactions
* Ability to model financial sensitivity and scenario worksheets
* Strong collaboration, written and oral communication, analytical and technical skills
* Problem solving skills and comfort working with ambiguity and ability to synthesize various data points/analysis into a defensible position/conclusion

**Nice\-to\-have**

* Graduate degree with a focus in Business, Economics, Mathematics or other problem solving fields
* CPA, CFA or other relevant professional designation – ongoing or completed
* Credit experience
* Strong computer literacy with emphasis on Excel and PowerPoint presentation skills
* Bilingual (French and English) communication skills

**What’s in it for you?**


We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

* Ability to make a difference and lasting impact
* Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high\-performing team
* Opportunities to do challenging work

jobs.title: Director, Cybersecurity – Information Technology
jobs.description:
Alberta Blue Cross® is an Alberta based organization dedicated to delivering exceptional customer experience and community leadership. We’re committed to providing the best health coverage to over 1.8 million members and take an active role in promoting wellness. We believe in what we do—and place trust in our employees to deliver our vision.

Working at Alberta Blue Cross® means having a career where you’ll be recognized for your contributions. We value diversity, encourage our team members to maintain a healthy work-life balance and provide opportunities for career growth.

Overview

We have an exciting opportunity for a Director, IT Cybersecurity to join our dynamic IT team. Reporting to the Director, CISO, this position is a senior enterprise leader responsible for shaping, governing, and advancing the cybersecurity strategy for Alberta Blue Cross. This role provides authoritative oversight of the cybersecurity portfolio and ensures the organization is equipped with a resilient, risk‑based security posture that protects our systems, data, and reputation. The role ensures that our cybersecurity team continues to be a strong partner for IT and the business, that our cybersecurity practice is optimized, and that we are positioned for rapid response to cybersecurity events and incidents.

A key mandate of this role is to define and execute our cybersecurity strategy, and to continuously evolve our risk-based cybersecurity program to strengthen our organization’s resilience.

What You Will Do

Lead and inspire our cybersecurity teams, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability and high performance.
Direct and oversee a team of cybersecurity managers and subject matter experts.
Mentor and develop team members to strengthen capability, support growth and build an engaged, high-performing workforce.
Define and execute a multi‑year cybersecurity strategy aligned to enterprise objectives, risk appetite, and regulatory expectations.
Manage and support the continuous assessment of our cybersecurity practice.
Build and maintain strong relationships with senior executives, business leaders, and technology partners to influence decision‑making and embed cybersecurity into enterprise planning.
Establish and maintain strategic external partnerships to strengthen our practice and represent Alberta Blue Cross.
Lead cybersecurity governance to provide effective management of the cybersecurity program and enable risk-based decision making.
Oversee the entire cybersecurity practice to ensure our cybersecurity risk is within the organization’s tolerance levels.
Lead the management and evolution of our cybersecurity policy, standards, runbooks and methodologies.
Ensure compliance to internal and external standards, regulations and audit expectations.
Partner with business leaders and technology teams to ensure alignment, manage dependencies, and drive successful outcomes.
Direct the response to critical and enterprise‑wide cybersecurity incidents, ensuring coordinated action, executive communication, and rapid recovery.

POSITION SCOPE

Strategic alignment with Enterprise Risk, Privacy, Legal, Human Resources, and other key partners to ensure a unified approach to risk and compliance.
Accountability for the IT cybersecurity portfolio, including governance, operations, risk management, and strategic planning.
Drive significant operational impact in delivery performance, prioritization discipline, risk mitigation, and value realization.
Influence senior leadership and executive teams with cybersecurity insights to support strategic decision.
Manage the budget and spend for the entire cybersecurity portfolio.
Oversight of the cybersecurity partner ecosystem, ensuring scalable, resilient, and high‑quality service delivery.

Key Accountabilities

Accountable for the current state and management of the risk associated with IT cybersecurity.
Continuous monitoring of emerging threats, technologies, and regulatory changes to inform strategic investments and roadmap evolution.
Thought leadership in modern cybersecurity practices, advocating for innovation and continuous improvement.
Alignment of cybersecurity initiatives with enterprise risk, privacy, legal, and HR frameworks.
Preparation and delivery of cybersecurity reporting to executive leadership and the Board of Directors.
Leadership of enterprise‑wide incident response, ensuring coordinated action and timely resolution.
Representation of Alberta Blue Cross on national committees and regulatory bodies, strengthening our influence and industry alignment.

KEY SUCCESS MEASURES

Demonstrated reduction and effective management of cybersecurity risk across the organization.
Strong organizational resilience and rapid response to cybersecurity threats and incidents.
Timely closure of audit findings and compliance gaps.
Mature, repeatable, and well‑governed cybersecurity processes.
High confidence in cybersecurity leadership from executives, IT, and business partners.
Clear, well‑defined roles and responsibilities across the cybersecurity organization.
High levels of cybersecurity awareness and engagement across the enterprise.
Measurable improvements in mean time to detect and respond to cybersecurity events.

What You Will Have

Bachelor’s degree in information technology or a related field; advanced education or cybersecurity certifications are strong assets.
10+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, including 5+ years overseeing enterprise cybersecurity portfolios.
Strong knowledge of, and experience with, NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, capital planning, and value realization.
Proven ability to build and lead high-performing teams while fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability and trust.
Strong strategic thinking and data-driven decision making skills.
Composure and leadership presence during high intensity and critical cybersecurity events.
Excellent communication and relationship building skills with the ability to influence at all levels, including executives.
Demonstrated change leadership; guiding teams through transformation with resilience, clarity, and empathy.
A forward-looking, innovative, and adaptable mindset with the ability to anticipate organizational needs.
Demonstrated curiosity and commitment to lifelong learning; actively exploring new ideas, asking questions, and seeking knowledge to fuel innovation.
Ability to thrive in dynamic environments, adapt quickly to shifting priorities while guiding others to embrace new ways of working with empathy, patience, and persistence.
Ability to inspire and develop talent; build high performing, engaged teams through coaching, mentoring, and accountability.
Demonstrated strengths in negotiation, budgeting, planning, organizing, and delegation.
Experienced in partnering with senior leaders to shape and deliver strategies that drive measurable results.

COMPETENCY MATRIX

Strategic thinking

Description – Ability to align portfolio decisions with enterprise strategy.
Proficiency level – Advanced.
Evidence – Demonstrated in portfolio alignment outcomes.

Leadership

Description – Builds high-performing teams and leads change.
Proficiency level – Advanced.
Evidence – Feedback, team outcomes.

Analytical Skills

Description – Use critical thinking and data for decisions and forecasting.
Proficiency level – Advanced.
Evidence – Dashboard use, forecasting accuracy.

Collaboration

Description – Works across business units effectively.
Proficiency level – Advanced.
Evidence – Cross-functional success cases.

Incident commandership

Description – Ability to thinking critically and stay composed during response to high intensity cybersecurity events
Proficiency level – Advanced.
Evidence – Effective leadership of cybersecurity events.

BEHAVIORAL INDICATORS

Strategic thinking:

Consistently anticipates enterprise impacts before decisions are made.
Connect portfolio choices to external market and organizational context.

Leadership:

Model calm, confident leadership during ambiguity.
Actively coach team members and builds successors.

Analytical skills:

Employ critical thinking leveraging data to challenge assumptions and drive prioritization.
Simplify complex information for executive decision making.

Collaboration:

Proactively seek alignment across business functions.
Resolve conflicts by focusing on outcomes, not positions.

Incident commandership:

Demonstrate effective leadership during highly intense cybersecurity events.
Skilled at managing and leveraging relationships with partner divisions to ensure a coordinated and highly effective response to cybersecurity events.

This position will remain open until a suitable candidate is selected.

We offer the opportunity to work in an innovative, high-energy team-focused environment. If you have the qualifications we are looking for, apply online at careers.ab.bluecross.ca

jobs.title: Vice President, Corporate Strategy
jobs.description:
At Sienna, we empower our team members across Ontario, British Columbia, Saskatchewan and Alberta to help our residents live the life they desire and deserve. Our purpose is simple: to cultivate happiness in daily life!

What Sienna Offers:
We aspire to cultivate an environment and culture where team members feel valued, heard and empowered to do meaningful work. We offer a number of programs and benefits that support team members’ financial, personal and professional needs:

A competitive compensation and vacation package
Employer Paid Health & Dental Benefits
RRSP with Company Match
Share Ownership and Reward Program (SOAR)
Employee Share Purchase Plan with Company Match
Continuous learning and growth so you have the skillset needed to succeed and take on new challenges
A welcoming culture that values diversity and differing perspectives, experiences and beliefs

What You’ll Be Doing

Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer & Executive Vice President, Investments, the Vice President, Corporate Strategy serves as a trusted advisor to the Executive Team and senior leaders across the organization. The role is responsible for accelerating Sienna's most important growth, innovation, and business improvement opportunities by bringing structure, analytical rigor, and cross-functional leadership to strategic initiatives.

Working in partnership with business leaders, the Vice President leads the evaluation of strategic opportunities, development of business cases, assessment of risks and market dynamics, and creation of implementation roadmaps that support informed decision-making and successful execution. Strategic initiatives remain owned by the appropriate operating or functional leader, with Corporate Strategy providing the dedicated capacity and expertise required to move opportunities from concept to execution-ready plans.

This hands-on role provides leadership in enterprise strategy, innovation, market intelligence, and growth opportunities. With the support of an analyst, the role also supports the annual strategic planning cycle.

How You’ll Succeed

Identify, evaluate, and advance high-priority strategic growth and business improvement opportunities aligned with Sienna’s long-term objectives.
Transform early-stage concepts into well-defined strategic initiatives supported by rigorous analysis and actionable recommendations.
Partner with executive leaders to assess opportunities related to growth, innovation, workforce transformation, new services, ancillary revenue streams, operational excellence, and business model innovation.
Lead comprehensive assessments of strategic opportunities through market research, customer insights, competitive analysis, operational feasibility reviews, financial modeling, and risk evaluation.
Develop robust business cases that clearly articulate value creation opportunities, investment requirements, implementation considerations, risks, and anticipated returns.
Conduct scenario analysis and evaluate strategic alternatives to support executive decision-making.
Establish consistent methodologies and frameworks for evaluating strategic initiatives and growth opportunities across the organization.
Create and implement a disciplined approach to evaluating, prioritizing, piloting, and scaling new business opportunities.
Develop recommendations regarding market entry, service innovation, customer experience improvements, and long-term growth strategies.
Evaluate strategic opportunities through the lens of resident experience, team member engagement, operational effectiveness, and shareholder value creation.
Monitor industry trends, demographic shifts, consumer preferences, competitive activity, policy developments, regulatory changes, and emerging market opportunities affecting the seniors living, healthcare, and hospitality sectors.
Assess external market dynamics and competitive developments to identify opportunities and risks affecting Sienna’s strategic direction.
Provide executive leadership with actionable insights regarding emerging trends and strategic implications for the organization.
Establish clear accountabilities, deliverables, timelines, and decision-making frameworks for strategic initiatives.
Develop implementation roadmaps outlining resource requirements, milestones, risks, economic impacts, governance considerations, and measures of success.
Support the design and launch of pilots and proof-of-concept initiatives.
Support business leaders through the early stages of implementation before transitioning ongoing accountability to operational ownership.
Partner with the CEO, CFO, Executive Team, on key enterprise strategic priorities.
Support the development and execution of Sienna’s long-term strategic plan, ensuring alignment with corporate objectives, growth priorities, and financial goals.
Support annual and multi-year strategic planning activities.
Prepare executive-level reports, presentations, and recommendations for senior leadership and Board discussions.

Who You Are

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Public Policy, Healthcare Administration, or a related field.
MBA from a leading business school strongly preferred.
Additional postgraduate education in Strategy, Finance, Economics, Organizational Leadership, Healthcare Administration, or related disciplines is considered an asset.
10 to 15 years of progressive experience in corporate strategy, management consulting, business transformation, operations, corporate development, or related executive leadership roles.
Significant experience within a leading strategy consulting firm or an equivalent strategic advisory environment.
Demonstrated experience partnering directly with executive leadership teams and influencing senior business leaders.
Proven success developing and evaluating strategic growth opportunities, enterprise business cases, and investment decisions.
Demonstrated success identifying and advancing enterprise-wide growth and innovation initiatives within complex organizations.
Experience working within a complex, multi-site operating environment.
Experience within senior living, healthcare, hospitality, consumer services, retail, or other service-oriented sectors is considered an asset.
Exceptional strategic thinking, analytical reasoning, and structured problem-solving capability.
Advanced business case development and strategic assessment skills.
Exceptional ability to translate ambiguous business challenges into clear workplans and actionable recommendations.
Excellent executive communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
High intellectual curiosity and the ability to rapidly understand new business challenges and opportunities.

What You Need To Know

An Overview Of Your Future Role At BBA

BBA supports all players across the energy ecosystem, including power generation, transmission and distribution. We also support large industrial energy users, mainly in the mining, oil and gas sectors. More recently, we’ve seen growing demand from a new category of large energy consumers, particularly data centres. To date, BBA’s involvement in the data centre market has been largely reactive, with developers and builders reaching out to us for our expertise in grid interconnections and power systems. Going forward, BBA will take a deliberate and proactive approach to this market by establishing a dedicated data centre business line.

Drawing On More Than 45 Years Of Experience Solving Complex Electrical Challenges, BBA’s Go-to-market Strategy Will Be Guided By The Following Principles

Avoid commodity building design and leverage strategic partnerships where appropriate.
Focus on projects larger than 25 MW.
Lead the high-voltage scope.
Lead grid integration activities.
Lead substation design and delivery.
Lead generation strategy development.

An Overview Of Your Mandates And Responsibilities

You’ll source and ensure successful delivery of power projects to meet the energy needs of large-load clients, primarily data centres. You’ll also occasionally support other industrial, community and utility clients operating in remote or partially grid‑connected environments. Initially, the role will focus on regional clients across Canada and gradually expand to include the U.S. market.

As a renewable power professional, you’ll lead the modelling, optimization and delivery of complex energy projects involving renewable technologies, including wind, solar PV, BESS, thermal and hydroelectric power. Your work will include studies, roadmaps and project execution.

BBA operates within a matrix structure, and the New Large Loads business line you’ll lead has both national and international focus. The business line is accountable for defining market strategy and overseeing sector performance. To deliver on its mandates, it works closely with BBA’s operational teams and disciplines across Canada and the USA. While most projects are executed through these regional teams, the business line may also directly manage and deliver certain strategic initiatives.

Business development

Coordinate the development and execution of BBA’s data centre market strategy
Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients and stakeholders across the data centre, utilities and industrial sectors
Support the development of short‑, medium‑ and long‑term opportunity pipelines while identifying cross‑selling opportunities for BBA’s services
Support project sourcing efforts by identifying opportunities that align with regional priorities across Canada and evolving data centre power needs
Contribute to proposal development, client positioning and pursuit strategies for power and energy mandates
Maintain a strong understanding of energy market trends, particularly for data centres, off‑grid, hybrid and utility‑linked power systems.

Operations

Serve as project manager and technical lead for selected strategic projects, including project development support, feasibility studies, roadmaps and execution mandates
Provide subject‑matter expertise in the modelling, optimization and integration of renewable and hybrid power systems (wind, solar PV, CSP, BESS, thermal storage, hydroelectric)
Oversee technical reviews and coordinate engineering and design activities across disciplines
Work closely with BBA’s multidisciplinary teams across Canada to ensure execution excellence and alignment with client objectives
Help develop internal expertise in data centre development, power system optimization, hybrid energy solutions and renewable integration
Support the development of tools, methodologies and reference models for studies, roadmaps and system optimization
Participate in knowledge sharing and thought leadership activities, including internal training, technical contributions and industry engagements.

Business acumen
Strategic vision
Action and results-driven
Ability to see beyond established standards
Constantly seeking sustainable and agile solutions
Rigour and ethical
Accountability and entrepreneurship
Client-oriented with existing network
Organizational agility.

Engineering degree in a related discipline from a recognized university
At least 15 years of relevant experience
Experience in data centre development and execution, wind and/or solar power energy, consulting engineering, business development and project execution
Registered as a Professional Engineer in Canada
Experience in equipment selection, capital cost and operating cost estimates
Available to travel to domestic or international destinations is required.

BBA is one of Canada’s leading private consulting engineering firms, with over 45 years of experience serving the energy and natural resources industry.

Our people are the foundation of our success. Their passion and excellence have earned us recognition as one of Canada’s Best Employers and Best Managed Companies , and we’re committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels empowered to grow, lead and be themselves.

Our teams bring together engineering, environmental and commissioning expertise to deliver practical, innovative and sustainable solutions—from strategy to execution. With 20 offices across Canada, the U.S. and Latin America, we combine local presence with international reach, offering clients close collaboration and field-ready support.
