jobs.title: VP, Strategic Finance Partner - Operations
jobs.description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary

The Vice President, Strategic Finance Partner - Operations leader serves as the senior finance advisor to the Global Operations organization. The role shapes strategy, drives profitable growth, optimizes resource allocation, supports critical financial decisions, and leads global finance teams to maximize business performance and long-term value creation.

As a trusted member of the leadership team, the Vice President evaluates investments, assesses risks and trade-offs, and provides financial leadership on the business's most critical decisions. Partnering across the business, Controllership, Centers of Excellence, Finance Transformation, and other Global Finance functions, the role connects strategy to measurable outcomes, drives accountability, and enables informed decision-making.

Responsibilities

Strategic Business Partnership

Serve as the primary finance thought partner to executive leaders within the supported function, shaping strategic priorities, the growth agenda, and the choices that define where the business competes and invests.
Bring an independent, commercially grounded point of view to strategy discussions; challenge assumptions, surface blind spots, and influence executive decisions through insight rather than reporting.
Participate as a full member of the functional leadership team and contribute to the setting of business strategy, not only its financial translation

Strategic Decision-Making

Frame the most consequential decisions facing the function, define the options under consideration, and establish the criteria and trade-offs leadership will use to choose between them
Set the analytical agenda; determine which questions need answering and commission the required modeling and analysis from the Financial Planning and Analysis Center of Excellence
Translate analytical output into clear recommendations, and hold the line on decision quality, pace, and follow-through

Future-Focused Business Models and Scenarios

Define the design of forward-looking business and economic models used to evaluate new markets, pricing and commercial models, partnerships, and operating model shifts
Shape scenario and sensitivity frameworks around the strategic uncertainties that matter most, and use them to pressure-test the durability of the strategy.
Interpret long-range outlooks and competitive, market, and macro signals to anticipate inflection points before they show up in results

Input on Business Strategy

Co-own the functional strategy and long-range plan with business leadership, ensuring strategic choices are economically sound and value-creating
Advise on growth, portfolio, and capability-building choices, including build, buy, and partner options, and their implications for the operating model

Capital and Portfolio Choices

Guide where capital, talent, and management attention are deployed across competing strategic priorities
Challenge and endorse major business cases on strategic merit and expected value, rather than preparing them
Advocate for reallocation away from lower-value activity and advise on the structural economics of the function
Sponsor post-decision reviews so the organization learns from the bets it has placed

Partnership with the Center of Excellence

Partner with the Center of Excellence for planning cycles, forecasting production, model building, standard reporting, and data management; help define requirements and quality standards
Set priorities and service expectations with Center of Excellence leadership, and translate its output into executive-ready insight, narrative, and recommendations

Team Leadership

Lead a focused senior business partnering team built for judgment, influence, and strategic insight, shifting from transactional throughput to business outcome
Create a culture of curiosity, constructive challenge, speed, collaboration, and accountability for business outcomes
Develop finance talent capable of operating credibly with executives and building succession for partnering roles
Foster a strong operating rhythm across the business, Strategy, and the Center of Excellence

Qualifications

Required Experience

Proven years of progressive finance experience, with a clear track record in strategic finance and executive-level business partnering
Experience partnering with major business functions such as Global Operations, Product, Engineering, Information Technology, Marketing, Customer Success, or Corporate Functions
Proven record of influencing strategy and major investment decisions at the executive level
Strong command of value creation, long-range planning, scenario design, and business model economics
Experience operating in a model where planning, modeling, and reporting are delivered by a shared Financial Planning and Analysis Center of Excellence

Preferred Experience

Experience in large-scale, global, or high-growth organizations, ideally including business partnering, corporate strategy, and global leadership exposure
Demonstrated ability to influence executive decision-making without direct authority
Deep knowledge of the supported function's strategy, competitive dynamics, and value drivers
MBA, CPA, CFA, or equivalent advanced business credential preferred

Competencies

Demonstrates strategic thinking, a growth mindset, and sound business judgment
Influences executive stakeholders and communicates with clarity and impact.
Applies strong commercial and financial acumen to complex business decisions
Frames complex, ambiguous decisions and clarifies options and trade-offs
Prioritizes capital, talent, and resources against the highest-value opportunities
Constructively challenges leaders while balancing competing priorities
Collaborates effectively across functions, geographies, and levels of the organization
Builds, develops, and inspires high-performing global teams

jobs.description:
Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We Are Proud Of

The work we do and the innovation we drive
Our values of share, care and dare
A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

We are seeking a visionary and hands-on Technical Director to join our Cloud & DevOps Practice in Canada. This senior leadership role combines deep technical expertise, strategic consulting, solution architecture, and delivery leadership to help clients modernize their platforms, accelerate software delivery, and unlock value through cloud-native technologies and AI-powered solutions.

The ideal candidate brings extensive experience across Microsoft Azure
, modern web application architectures including Next.js
, and emerging Agentic AI technologies
. You will guide enterprise transformation initiatives, shape technical strategy, mentor engineering teams, and partner with business stakeholders to deliver innovative solutions at scale.

Role Responsibilities

Technical Leadership
Define and drive technical vision, architecture strategies, and best practices for cloud and DevOps engagements.
Lead the design and delivery of large-scale cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure.
Establish engineering standards, governance frameworks, security controls, and operational excellence practices.
Act as a trusted advisor to client executives, technology leaders, and product organizations.

Agentic AI & Innovation

Lead the design and implementation of Agentic AI solutions leveraging modern AI orchestration frameworks, LLMs, copilots, autonomous workflows, and intelligent agents.

As the organization advances its enterprise priorities, it is strengthening the information management, technology, cybersecurity and AI capabilities that enable our mission and support our people.

Reporting to the Executive Vice-President, Corporate Services and CFO, the Vice-President, Information Management and Information Technology (IM/IT) provides enterprise-wide leadership, governance and oversight for information management, technology, AI and cybersecurity across the CMA. A highly engaged and collaborative leader, they will align IM/IT investments, platforms and practices with organizational strategy, enterprise architecture, risk requirements and approved priorities.

The Vice-President will develop an integrated enterprise information management and technology strategy, operating model and roadmap, and establish clear decision rights, standards and governance for technology, information management, cybersecurity, data architecture and AI. Working closely with the Executive Leadership Team, relevant governance bodies and business leaders at the CMA, they will provide strategic counsel on opportunities, investments, dependencies and risks, while ensuring clear reporting on performance and value realization.

This role is accountable for enterprise information management, including data governance, architecture, enterprise information platforms, analytics capabilities, and responsible AI governance, adoption and enablement. The Vice-President will also direct reliable technology operations and service delivery across cybersecurity, cloud and network infrastructure, identity and access management, enterprise applications, collaboration platforms, integrations, backup, disaster recovery and business continuity. They will oversee operating budgets, technology lifecycle planning, vendors and contracts, and hold delivery partners accountable for service, project and risk outcomes.

The Vice-President will lead the transformation and modernization of the IM/IT operating model, enhance operational planning, portfolio management and delivery disciplines, and strengthen the capabilities and capacity required to meet evolving enterprise needs. Working in close partnership with business leaders, they will ensure priorities and trade-offs are transparent, demand is aligned with organizational capacity, and investments deliver practical and measurable value. They will balance reliable day-to-day operations with longer-term modernization, build the internal capabilities and cross-enterprise partnerships required for the future, and reinforce disciplined execution, project governance and benefits realization.

The Vice-President, IM/IT will be a visible, compelling and highly engaged leader who brings energy, optimism and momentum to a team navigating significant change. Through an accessible and hands-on leadership style, they will set clear direction, recognize contributions, develop leaders and capability, and foster the confidence, cohesion and accountability needed for the team to succeed.

jobs.title: Senior Director Finance
jobs.description:
SinaLite is a leading wholesale trade printer and custom packaging provider, serving 20,000+ print businesses, resellers, and entrepreneurs across Canada and the US. With 26 years of printing experience and over $45 million invested in cutting-edge print technology, we help our clients maximize their print profits — and we're just as invested in helping our own team grow. We were named a 2025 Regional Finalist in Canada's Best Managed Companies Program, and we're looking for our next Senior Director of Finance to help us keep raising the bar.

Compensation: $160,000 - $200,000

Location: 335 Steelcase Rd East, Markham, ON (In Office)

About The Opportunity

SinaLite and Willowpack are looking for a Senior Director of Finance to join our leadership team and take ownership of the financial strategy, discipline, and decision support required to support two growing manufacturing businesses.

This is a hands-on senior leadership role for an experienced finance professional who understands that strong finance leadership goes well beyond reporting the numbers. You will help shape business decisions by bringing greater visibility and discipline to cash, working capital, manufacturing costs, margins, investments, and financial risk.

SinaLite is an established wholesale printing business focused on protecting and expanding margins, while Willowpack is a rapidly growing packaging manufacturer requiring disciplined management of capital, working capital, and costs as it scales.

We're looking for a skeptical, analytical, and commercially minded finance leader who is comfortable challenging assumptions, getting into the details, developing a strong finance team, and giving leadership the financial clarity needed to make better decisions.

For the right individual, this role offers a clear opportunity to grow into a VP-level position within approximately two years.

What You'll Be Responsible For

Cash, Liquidity & Working Capital

Build and own a rolling 13-week cash forecast and longer-term liquidity models.
Develop, measure, and report key working-capital metrics, including DPO, DIO, DSO, and the cash conversion cycle.
Partner with Operations, Sourcing, and the Controller to improve inventory, receivables, and payables performance.
Model the cash and working-capital impact of business growth and changing operating conditions.
Manage banking and lender relationships, credit facilities, and lease obligations.

Manufacturing Costing & Margin Management

Develop and maintain accurate job, product, and SKU-level costing across our manufacturing operations.
Ensure costing accurately reflects materials, labour, yield, scrap, and other production costs.
Partner with Sales to establish pricing guardrails, cost-based pricing floors, and margin expectations.
Provide clear financial reporting that allows leadership to understand the economics and performance of SinaLite and Willowpack independently.

FP&A & Strategic Decision Support

Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range financial planning.
Translate strategic objectives into measurable financial targets and forecasts.
Develop forward-looking, probability-weighted risk and opportunity assessments covering both profitability and cash.
Build financial business cases for capital expenditures, investments, and major strategic decisions.
Track investment performance and returns following implementation.
Provide leadership with scenario modelling and data-driven recommendations to support major business decisions.

Compliance, Controls & Government Funding

Oversee government funding opportunities, including applications, claims, compliance, and reporting.
Ensure compliance with applicable Canadian and U.S. tax, regulatory, and financial reporting requirements.
Strengthen internal financial controls, policies, and procedures appropriate for a growing manufacturing organization.

Finance Team Leadership

Assess the existing finance structure and identify opportunities to strengthen capabilities.
Recruit, coach, and develop finance and FP&A talent.
Ensure team members are positioned effectively across controllership, treasury, and FP&A responsibilities.
Build greater financial accountability across the organization.
Help operational and functional leaders understand the financial impact of their decisions.

Systems, Data & AI

Maximize the value of NetSuite and our broader financial reporting systems.
Identify opportunities to automate recurring reporting and financial analysis.
Use AI, analytics, and emerging technologies to improve the speed and quality of financial insights.
Champion a data-driven approach to decision-making throughout the organization.

Qualifications

CPA designation required.
10+ years of progressive finance experience, including at least 5 years in senior financial leadership within a manufacturing environment.
Strong manufacturing cost accounting experience, including job/product costing, inventory, material yield, and scrap.
Proven experience managing cash and working capital through periods of rapid business growth.
Strong FP&A, forecasting, scenario modelling, and financial modelling capabilities.
Experience evaluating capital expenditures and developing investment business cases.
Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and lead high-performing finance teams.
Experience working within an entrepreneurial, privately held, or founder-led organization.
Experience within printing, packaging, converting, or a related manufacturing industry is a strong asset.

What We're Looking For

The Right Person For This Role Is Someone Who

Challenges assumptions — You don't accept a number simply because it was presented to you. You validate it, understand it, and speak up when something doesn't make sense.
Gets into the details — You can operate strategically while still being willing to dig into the numbers when necessary.
Thinks ahead — You identify financial risks and opportunities before they become obvious.
Communicates directly — You can translate complex financial information into clear recommendations for leaders across Finance, Operations, Sales, and other functions.
Takes ownership — You approach decisions with a business-owner mentality, high integrity, and accountability for outcomes.
Builds strong teams — You develop talent, raise expectations, and create a finance function capable of supporting continued growth.
Is comfortable challenging leadership — You have the confidence and executive presence to pressure-test assumptions and provide a different perspective when the numbers support it.

Why Join SinaLite & Willowpack?

This is an opportunity to take on a highly influential finance leadership position across two distinct manufacturing businesses at different stages of growth.

You'll have the opportunity to directly influence how we manage cash, evaluate investments, improve manufacturing margins, scale Willowpack, and make strategic decisions across the organization.

We're also looking for someone who can grow with us. For a high-performing finance leader who demonstrates the ability to operate as a trusted financial partner to the President and leadership team, this role offers a pathway toward VP-level leadership within approximately two years.

If you're a hands-on finance leader who enjoys challenging assumptions, solving complex manufacturing finance problems, building strong teams, and turning financial data into better business decisions, we'd like to hear from you.

Accessibility

SinaLite is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible workplace in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, 2005 (AODA). We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities.

Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process. If you require accommodation, please notify us at hr@sinalite.com, and we will work with you to meet your needs in a timely and respectful manner.

Information received relating to accommodation will be addressed confidentially.

jobs.title: Director of GTM Data, Processes, and AI Enablement
jobs.description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform
for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers
, including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining
Autodesk Operations Solutions
, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations.
Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

The Role

MaintainX (part of Autodesk) is hiring a Director of GTM Data, Processes, and AI Enablement to own critical foundations of our GTM teams, including:

Customer and prospect data within our CRM;
Core CRM processes that enable selling across GTM teams (e.g., opportunity workflows, territory assignment processes); and
Our internal GenAI and automation efforts driving efficiency, effectiveness, and productivity of our GTM teams

This role also owns the integration of the MaintainX GTM teams into Autodesk GTM systems, processes, and GTM motions, for the core functional areas of the role – a key area of focus for the next 6 to 18 months.

The role sits in the broader MaintainX Revenue Strategy and Operations team and leads a small team of data quality analysts, but we expect this role to drive the majority of its impact through others outside of their direct team. Across all functional areas, this role will be working with, influencing, and directing the work of senior stakeholders, front-line managers, and ICs across Marketing, Rev Ops, Enablement, and GTM Engineering. We need someone with deep functional expertise that knows best practices and has rapid pattern recognition for solutions to GTM issues, who is technical enough to be credible with engineers, and is practical enough to be trusted by sellers to get work done.

What You'll Do

Own CRM data quality and governance

Set the strategy, standards, and governance for leads, contacts, accounts, and account hierarchies. That includes parent/child structures, holding companies, franchises, PE portfolios, and multi-site customers.
Move data quality from cleanup to prevention. Put in intake controls, matching and dedupe rules, and enrichment precedence, and track them on a data quality scorecard with targets.
Show leadership what data gaps cost in revenue, and make GTM data ready for AI use cases.
Lead the team doing this work, including writing requirements for GTM Systems to implement.
Develop deduplication strategies and processes to manage a dual CRM environment across MaintainX and Autodesk

Drive core CRM-based processes and workflows

Own CRM territory management developing the processes and systems requirements to implement the territory design and strategy defined by GTM leadership and Rev Ops teams.
Own our rules of engagement: account ownership, crediting, and conflict resolution across segments, regions, and teams – including both MaintainX selling in isolation and coordination between MaintainX and Autodesk sellers
Own optimization of CRM processes and workflows for end user teams, including building an understanding of current processes, identifying points of improvement, working with GTM systems and Rev Ops teams to define business requirements
Collaborate with Rev Ops, Enablement, and GTM systems teams to ensure field teams know how to use our systems and processes as they change, through release communications, training, and documentation.

Lead the GTM AI program for field teams

Run out GenAI and automation program for GTM field teams end to end: intake, prioritization and resource allocation across GTM and Engineering, operating cadences, solution evaluation, executive readouts, field enablement.
Lead discovery with Sales leaders to find the highest-value automation and agent opportunities. Align leadership and our GTM engineering team on one prioritized roadmap.
Own business requirements, build-vs-buy recommendations, and testing for centrally built solutions. Partner with Engineering to build and launch them.
Set the standards for how teams build their own solutions: knowledge base governance, a quality bar, and a path for scaling proven team-built tools across the org.
Own rollout with Enablement and measure adoption and ROI. The measure is workflows changed, not trainings delivered.

Lead integration efforts for MaintainX GTM into Autodesk

Own the GTM integration plan, governance and coordination across the workstreams, including: systems and data, account mapping and ownership, territories, sales process alignment, rules of engagement for joint selling, and enablement.
Coordinate stakeholders across both organizations. Run the cadence, track risks and dependencies, and escalate decisions.
Be accountable for integration outcomes, not just coordination.

About You

10+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM strategy at a B2B SaaS company, including 3+ years leading people.
Deep expertise in core sales processes, territory design, and rules of engagement.
Strong command of the CRM data model: Salesforce objects, account hierarchies, matching, and enrichment. You define and specify; you don't need to configure.
Hands-on experience bringing AI into GTM workflows (LLMs, agents, workflow automation), with results you can measure. Fluent enough to work credibly with engineers.
A track record of leading large cross-functional programs through influence, including with VP and C-level leaders.
M&A or GTM integration experience is strongly preferred.
Clear writing and speaking. You can make complex tradeoffs understandable to sellers, engineers, and executives.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running.
Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits.
Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

Belonging.
We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.

Mackenzie Investments

IGM Financial Inc. is a leading wealth and asset management company in Canada, managing approximately $ 310 billion in assets as of December 31, 2025 . It offers financial planning and investment services to over two million Canadians through IG Wealth Management and Mackenzie Investments.

Mackenzie Investments, founded in 1967, is a key part of IGM's business model, serving as a comprehensive asset-management partner for Canadian financial advisors and their clients.

At Mackenzie Investments You Can Build Your Career with Confidence.
We are proud to be recognized as one of Canada’s Top 100 Employers for the fourth consecutive year and one of Canada’s Best Diversity Employers. Our vision and strategy aim to innovate the industry and support Canadians in achieving their financial goals.

Join our team to engage in continuous learning and skill development in a supportive environment. Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work environment, where you spend three days a week in the office, connecting, collaborating, and enjoying quality time with your amazing colleagues ! Our Values: Be better ; we strive for improvement in everything we do . Be accountable ; we foster clarity and are empowered to act responsibly . Be a team ; we are united to drive collective impact to achieve our goals .

Overall Job Purpose

Accountable for enterprise strategy, standards, and guardrails across security platform and infrastructure engineering, with a direct mandate to mature Threat Intelligence and DevSecOps as day to day operating capabilities. Shapes policy enforcement, resolves systemic constraints across multiple teams, and influences senior stakeholders on investment, resilience, and risk trade-offs, translating enterprise considerations into actionable governance aligned to Technology standards.

Key Accountabilities

Enterprise Strategy, Standards, and Guardrails
Define and evolve enterprise platform and infrastructure standards spanning tooling, pipelines, shared services, automation, resilience, recoverability, and observability, and drive adoption across portfolios.
Serve as trusted advisor on the highest-complexity platform, infrastructure, and operational resilience issues across multiple teams.
Threat Intelligence Enablement
Own the enterprise standards for threat intelligence collection, enrichment, and dissemination so that intel drives compensating control recommendations for operators.
Translate threat intelligence into prioritized, evidence-based guardrails and detection requirements across the security ecosystem.
DevSecOps and Secure Delivery
Sponsor policy-as-code, automation, and knowledge automation practices so security controls are codified, machine-testable, and enforced within pipelines.
Define safe automation and CI/CD enablement patterns that embed security guardrails into build, test, deploy, and operate workflows.
Systemic Constraint Resolution
Resolve systemic platform and infrastructure constraints impacting delivery speed, reliability, security, capacity, stability, or recoverability across multiple teams.
Resilience, Incident, and Operational Readiness
Drive observability, resilience, and incident learning at enterprise scale, including telemetry, alerting, capacity, and DR readiness, to improve service maturity.
Influence, Investment, and Escalation Governance
Influence roadmap and investment decisions with evidence-based trade-offs on capability, risk, resilience, cost, and scalability.
Determine when initiatives require escalation due to enterprise or regulatory impact and ensure consistent engagement with architecture and risk forums.
Partner with senior stakeholders to align priorities and sequencing when constraints materially impact outcomes.
AI-Enabled Practices
Shape and sponsor AI-enabled platform and infrastructure strategy, including automation, predictive monitoring, and policy-as-code, aligned to security and governance.
People and Capability Uplift
Mentor senior ICs and strengthen capability uplift through communities of practice and standards forums.
Continuous Improvement
Identify recurring friction and enable durable fixes across the platform and infrastructure ecosystem.

Qualifications

Post-secondary education in Technology or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Extensive progressive experience delivering enterprise platform and infrastructure services and enablement.
Proven influence on standards, governance alignment, and risk-informed decisions across multiple teams.
Demonstrated leadership-by-influence with senior stakeholders and governance forums.
Deep expertise in automation, CI/CD enablement, observability, recoverability, and secure operations.
Ability to shape AI-enabled strategy and guardrails at scale.
Demonstrated depth in Threat Intelligence and DevSecOps as core operating disciplines.

The expected annual base salary range for this role is $149,500 - $192,500
which is determined based on skills, knowledge and experience and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for annual short-term incentive, health and well-being benefits, retirement and savings plan, paid time off and career development.

EMPLOYEE BENEFITS & INSURANCE: competitive health and dental coverage, flexible plan for you and your family and short-term & long-term disability plans.
RETIREMENT SAVINGS PROGRAMS: voluntary Defined Contribution Pension Plan

Director of Finance & Administration

Groundswell Food Group, Inc. (DBA Mitsoh)
Location: Remote
Reports to: Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
About Mitsoh

Mitsoh is building a new generation of clean-protein foods rooted in tradition and made for modern lifestyles. Our products are crafted with a focus on high-quality ingredients, nutritional integrity, and responsible sourcing. As a rapidly growing CPG food company, we operate with world-class manufacturing and food safety standards aligned with GFSI-recognized programs.

We are seeking a hands-on and strategic Director of Finance & Administration to build the financial infrastructure, controls, and administrative systems required to scale Mitsoh into a world-class food manufacturing company and consumer brand.

Position Overview

The Director of Finance & Administration is responsible for leading Mitsoh’s finance, accounting, and administrative functions, including financial reporting, planning and analysis, product costing, cash management, HR and payroll administration, and business systems.

Reporting to the CEO and leading a small team, this role partners closely with operations, supply chain, and commercial teams to drive margin visibility, cost discipline, and data-driven decision-making across both the manufacturing and brand sides of the business. This is a builder’s role — equally comfortable setting strategy with leadership and rolling up sleeves to close the month.

Key Responsibilities

Accounting & Financial Reporting

Own the full accounting cycle, including month-end close, reconciliations, and preparation of accurate, timely financial statements

Maintain the integrity of the general ledger, chart of accounts, and financial controls as the company scales

Manage accounts receivable, accounts payable, collections, and customer/vendor account reconciliation

Oversee inventory accounting, including raw materials, WIP, finished goods, and reconciliation of physical counts to system records

Manage external accountant, audit, and tax relationships, including year-end preparation and regulatory filings

Financial Planning & Analysis

Lead annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, and scenario planning aligned with company growth objectives

Deliver monthly reporting packages with variance analysis and plain-language commentary for leadership and the board

Build KPI dashboards and reporting across revenue, margin, cash, and operational performance

Provide financial modeling and analysis to support pricing, capital investment, and growth decisions

Product Costing & Margin Management

Own standard costing for manufactured products, including BOMs, yields, labor, and overhead absorption

Analyze cost variances between standard and actual production performance and drive corrective visibility

Deliver margin analysis by product, channel, and customer across DTC, retail, and distributor networks

Partner with operations and supply chain on COGS reduction, waste, and yield improvement initiatives

Revenue, Trade & Channel Finance

Manage revenue recognition and channel-specific billing across DTC, retail, and distributor accounts

Track and validate trade spend, promotions, chargebacks, and distributor deductions

Support commercial teams with customer profitability analysis and pricing guidance

Monitor and reconcile e-commerce platform payouts, fees, and settlements

jobs.description:
Your impact begins here

As Associate Director, Financial Planning & Analysis, you will head the Financial Planning & Analysis team at Novo Canada. You will own the budgeting of ex-factory sales and costs, manage operating profit and guide how resources are allocated, giving the President, CFO and Executive Team the clarity to decide and act. Your work helps the affiliate reach its financial and strategic goals and keeps our products available to the people who rely on them.

What You’ll Bring

You combine strong financial expertise with the leadership to build a high-performing team.

You Will Also Bring

A bachelor/master’s degree in business administration, finance, business economics, accounting or auditing.
At least 5 years of experience in finance, with proven success in numbers-driven analysis, planning and reporting.
Experience presenting to senior management and executives, and the ability to explain quantitative analysis clearly.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and a track record of planning, prioritising and following through while proactively managing risks.
A proven track record in complex, cross-affiliate project management.
An understanding of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and internal controls.
Proficiency in SAP, Business Warehouse and Excel.
In-depth understanding of the global budgeting process at Novo or a company of similar size.
A leadership style that builds trust, gives honest feedback, sets clear priorities and keeps things simple, especially through change.

What You’ll Do

You will lead the full financial planning cycle for Novo Canada and the commercial terms that connect our products to customers.

Your Work Will Help To

Lead, develop and plan the work of the Financial Planning & Analysis team, including hiring, succession, individual development plans and performance dialogue, and manage the team budget.
Oversee the affiliate P&L, including ex-factory sales, cost of goods sold and total operating costs, and own the total ex-factory sales forecast and targets.
Run the annual budget and rolling estimate processes, challenging submissions, ensuring compliance with corporate guidelines and anchoring approved targets across the business, while advising the President and CFO on resource allocation and supporting the Executive Team’s cost target.
Deliver monthly and quarterly reporting to management, the region and headquarters on sales, expenses and operating profit, flagging issues early and proposing corrective actions.
Own gross-to-net including rebate accruals under provincial Product Listing Agreements, and weekly sales performance reporting.
Lead priority initiatives for Financial Planning & Analysis and contribute to value-creation projects across Executive Team areas, and work with other affiliates to share best practices and keep planning simple and value-adding.

Who You’ll Work With

You will join Finance & Operations at Novo Canada as a member of the Finance & Operations Leadership Team. You will lead the Financial Planning & Analysis team, which you will help shape and grow.

Your closest partners will be the President, the CFO and the Executive Team. You will bring a financial perspective to the commercial teams, joining their management meetings, and support Line of Business colleagues with managing investments, month-end closing and training on financial processes.

You will also work with regional finance, headquarters, the Pricing Committee and colleagues in other affiliates, and directly with buyers at key wholesalers. These relationships let you turn numbers into clear, timely decisions.

What You Can Expect Here

You will take on a leadership role where your voice shapes decisions at executive level. The role gives you a broad view of the business, from budgets and operating profit to trade strategy, pricing and launches, and the opportunity to build new skills through cross-functional and cross-affiliate work.
You will be trusted to own your area and make decisions, with clear performance expectations and a culture that rewards results. You will also help your team thrive and grow through coaching, development plans and ongoing dialogue about performance and development.

At Novo, you'll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Job Description 

 What is the opportunity? 
 Lead RBC Corporate Treasury's quantitative ALM methodology development, modelling, research and analytics, focusing on interest rate risk measurement and management. Lead development of behavioral and market risk models, supporting pricing and risk measurement for non-trading on-balance sheet products, mortgage and loan commitments, securitization, and term funding. Interest rate risk represents the bank’s largest structural book market risk, with effective measurement and management critical for shareholder value preservation. The team you’ll lead also supports RBC’s Pension Investment Group modeling and measurement, across a diverse set of asset classes, strategies, and ALM topics.

 Lead research, methodology and model development relating to structural interest rate risk, consumer behaviour econometric modeling and forecasting (e.g., prepayment, redemption, pull through, product flows, term / mix preferences), economic capital models, balance sheet dynamics, and retail product and embedded option pricing models, in RBC’s domestic and international banking book balance sheets
 Lead development of diffusion, historic simulation, factor models, and deposit rate models in support of pricing, valuation, and risk measurement including economic capital, economic value and net interest income risk
 Lead and / or collaborate in development and implementation of tools and disciplines to monitor, analyze and identify ALM risks, as required

 Collaborate with Finance and Treasury partners to ensure alignment of ALM risk measurement, FTP, and financial performance management systems, as required

 Graduate degree in a quantitative field such as financial engineering, mathematics, engineering, or economics

Key Responsibilities


1\. Operational Oversight \& Administrative Management

* Own and manage all non\-billable (internal) operational duties to reduce administrative workload on billable site managers.
* Maintain centralized oversight of policies, procedures, and documentation standards for all assigned sites.
* Ensure compliance with safety, security, and regulatory requirements through regular audits and reporting.
* Coordinate multi\-site operational planning, scheduling, and resource allocation in alignment with client needs.
* Track and report operational performance metrics, providing actionable insights to client site leadership.
* Observe customer operational workflows, documentation, and reporting templates and recommend improvements to client site management to drive consistency and performance across locations.


2\. Employee Development \& Talent Management

* Lead talent development programs for site leadership teams, including onboarding, training, mentoring, and career progression planning.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, provide coaching, and create individual development plans for site managers.
* Facilitate leadership readiness programs to prepare emerging leaders for future management roles.
* Ensure new leaders are equipped with the skills and tools needed before assuming management positions.


3\. Process \& Quality Improvement

* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency and service quality.
* Develop and maintain a knowledge base of best practices, lessons learned, and standard operating procedures.
* Coordinate cross\-site initiatives to align maintenance, safety, and operational excellence programs.
* Oversee root cause analysis and lessons\-learned documentation following incidents, ensuring consistent follow\-up.
* Maintain relationship with client site management for quality assurance feedback.


4\. Stakeholder Communication \& Coordination

* Act as the primary liaison for operational matters between the VP of Data Center Operations, site managers, and corporate teams.
* Act as primary account manager for a data center operations client.
* Support internal communications, ensuring that site managers receive timely updates and clear direction.
* Collaborate with HR, Finance, and other support functions to resolve site\-level personnel or process issues.
* Receive client feedback and escalations on team performance.
* Report data, metrics, and feedback to client in support of reporting and collaboration.


Qualifications

* 5\+ years in operations leadership, preferably in critical infrastructure or technical services.
* Proven experience in employee development, team leadership, and performance management.
* Strong organizational, planning, and project management skills.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder engagement abilities.
* Experience implementing process improvements and operational standards across multiple locations.
* Deep understanding of data center infrastructure and operations.


Position Impact


Under the Director of Data Center Operations, site managers will be empowered to focus on, and be supported in, delivering exceptional service to our customers. This role will be instrumental in strengthening our leadership pipeline, improving operational efficiency, and ensuring long\-term customer satisfaction.

jobs.title: Sr Director, Enterprise Data and AI Platform
jobs.description:
Dayforce is a global human capital management (HCM) company headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, and Minneapolis, Minnesota, with operations across North America, Europe, Middle East, Africa (EMEA), and the Asia Pacific Japan (APJ) region.

Our award-winning Cloud HCM platform offers a unified solution database and continuous calculation engine, driving efficiency, productivity and compliance for the global workforce.

Our brand promise - Makes Work Life Better™ - Reflects our commitment to employees, customers, partners and communities globally.

About The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Sr. Director, Enterprise Data and AI Platform to define and execute the strategy, architecture, and delivery of Dayforce's enterprise data, AI, and contextual intelligence capabilities. This leader will drive the evolution of our modern data ecosystem, enabling trusted, scalable, and AI-ready data solutions that support business functions across Sales, Marketing, Finance, HR, Customer Success, Support, Services, Legal, and other enterprise organizations.

This role is responsible for architecting and evolving our Enterprise Data Foundation on Microsoft Fabric and Azure, enabling advanced analytics, machine learning, and enterprise reporting. In addition, this leader will architect and build the Enterprise Context Layer—a trusted semantic and knowledge platform that unifies business context, metadata, governance, permissions, and enterprise knowledge to power analytics, intelligent automation, AI agents, and next-generation conversational experiences.

As part of this transformation, the role will lead the strategy and implementation of the Enterprise Agentic AI Platform, enabling employees to interact with enterprise data through secure, AI-powered conversational experiences that complement and, over time, transform traditional dashboards and reporting.

The successful candidate will lead a global organization of data, AI platform, and engineering professionals, including managers, direct reports, and external partners. This highly strategic yet hands-on leadership role requires deep technical expertise, strong architectural vision, exceptional cross-functional leadership, and a passion for delivering innovative, AI-driven solutions that accelerate business outcomes.

This position reports to the VP, Enterprise Data, Analytics and Governance.

What You'll Get To Do

Enterprise Data, AI & Context Leadership

Lead and grow the global Enterprise Data, AI Platform, and Context Engineering organization.
Define the long-term strategy and roadmap for the Enterprise Data Foundation, Enterprise Context Layer, and Enterprise AI Platform.
Own the architecture, execution, and evolution of enterprise data, semantic, knowledge, and AI platforms.
Lead delivery of large-scale, cross-functional data engineering and AI transformation initiatives.

Enterprise Data Foundation & Modern Data Platform

Lead enterprise data engineering, ingestion, transformation, semantic modeling, and data product development.
Design scalable, secure, and governed data platforms supporting analytics, AI, and operational workloads.
Ensure high availability, performance, scalability, and operational excellence across enterprise data platforms.

Enterprise Context Layer & Knowledge Architecture

Architect and build the Enterprise Context Layer, including semantic models, business knowledge, metadata, permissions, and enterprise context services.
Drive enterprise standards for semantic modeling, metadata management, knowledge architecture, and reusable context services.
Enable trusted business context that powers analytics, AI agents, intelligent automation, and enterprise applications.

Enterprise AI Platform & Conversational Experiences

Define the enterprise AI platform strategy, architecture, and technology roadmap.
Lead implementation of Agentic AI platforms, orchestration frameworks, RAG solutions, vector search, MCP services, and intelligent automation capabilities.
Lead the strategy, architecture, and delivery of enterprise conversational AI experiences that enable natural language interaction with enterprise data.
Partner with the Decision Intelligence team to deliver AI assistants that leverage trusted enterprise context and progressively replace traditional dashboards and reports.
Establish enterprise MLOps and LLMOps practices for machine learning and generative AI, including model lifecycle management, prompt and model evaluation, monitoring, observability, retraining, and responsible AI governance.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and establish enterprise AI architecture, governance, and security standards.

Governance, Security & Architecture

Define and enforce enterprise data governance, security, and AI governance practices.
Define standards and governance for AI model lifecycle management, including model registry, monitoring, explainability, compliance, and responsible AI practices.
Ensure data availability, protection, compliance, and SLA performance across enterprise platforms.
Participate in Architecture Review Board (ARB) governance and enterprise technology strategy.
Manage platform budgets, vendor relationships, and strategic technology partnerships.

Skills And Experience We Value

10+ years of experience leading enterprise data, AI platform, or engineering organizations.
Demonstrated ability to lead large-scale transformation initiatives and manage complex programs, budgets, and vendor relationships.
Strong business partnership, executive communication, and change management skills.
Expertise in modern data platforms, including Azure Cloud, Microsoft Fabric, Data Lake/Warehouse/Mesh, data integration technologies, Power BI, and Tableau.
Strong understanding of enterprise context management, metadata management, ontology design, and semantic modeling.
Knowledge of Agile methodologies, particularly SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework).
Skilled at cross-functional collaboration and aligning technology delivery with enterprise priorities.

What Would Make You Stand Out

Advanced degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.
Experience designing enterprise semantic layers, knowledge graphs, metadata platforms, and enterprise knowledge management solutions.
Experience building enterprise AI platforms utilizing RAG, vector databases, MCP, Agentic AI, and conversational AI architectures.
Experience implementing Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and enterprise MLOps/LLMOps frameworks, including model registry, deployment, monitoring, and governance.
Proven experience delivering enterprise conversational analytics and AI-powered business experiences.
Demonstrated ability to translate business knowledge into reusable, AI-ready data and context models.
Deep understanding of enterprise AI operational practices, including model governance, observability, responsible AI, and continuous delivery of machine learning and generative AI solutions.

What’s In It For You

Dayforce is fueled by the diversity of our talented employees. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider and embrace ALL individuals and what makes them unique. We believe our employees should be happy and healthy, with peace of mind and a sense of fulfillment.

We encourage individuals to apply based on their passions.

Dayforce encourages personal and professional growth. We offer excellent time away from work programs, comprehensive wellness initiatives and recognition through competitive pay and benefits.

With a commitment to community impact, including volunteer days and our charity, Dayforce Cares we provide opportunities for you to thrive both in your career and personal life. Our focus is not just on your job but on supporting you to be the best version of yourself.

This job posting is for an existing vacancy

Artificial intelligence may be used in the screening, assessment, or selection of applicants for this position.

About The Salary Ranges

Please note that the salary range mentioned in this job description should serve simply as a guide. The final compensation offered may vary based on a variety of factors, including bonuses and/or incentives, or a candidate’s experience, skills, budget and location. Our company is committed to providing a fair, equitable, and competitive package that reflects the value an individual brings to the organization.

Further, our back office support teams, including but not limited to Human Resources, are primarily English speaking. Due to the significant high volume of interactions with these English-speaking co-workers, managers, stakeholders and/or clients, which is inherent to this position, it is not possible to reorganize the company's activities to avoid this requirement.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Director (Remote, Winnipeg)
jobs.description:
Blacksmith Agency

Marketing
Full time
Remote (USA, Canada or South Africa)

About The Role

Blacksmith Agency runs PPC and SEO for clients across multifamily, B2B and technical verticals. As Digital Marketing Director you lead that department. The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist report to you and they are the specialists in their channels. Right now nobody owns this function, which is the whole reason this seat is open.

This is a management seat, not a senior individual contributor one.
You will not be building campaigns, and on technical SEO your strategist will know more than you do. That is the arrangement, not a gap. You carry channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale. The strategists carry the execution of it, and you carry whether the department delivers.

What You Own

The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist: their quality bar, their development, their reviews, and the call when someone is not going to get there.
The standard the work is held to. What a good audit looks like, what gets checked before work leaves the agency, how an account is reported. You write it and you hold two specialists to it.
Client results across the whole function, including whether our reporting is honest. Nobody here is auditing attribution and GA4 accuracy today.
The escalation when an account is at risk. You diagnose it, you direct the strategist who fixes it, and you are on the call with the client.
Channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale.
What we tell sales we can credibly deliver, before it gets sold.
The hiring plan for the department, and first-round interviews for your own team, within about a quarter.

What You Need

Strategists or specialists who have reported to you, where their reviews, their development and the decision when someone was not working out were yours. Managing accounts is not this.
7+ years across paid media and SEO. Owning one channel while sitting beside the other does not count here.
Enough depth in Google Ads, GA4, Search Console, Meta and Microsoft Ads to tell good work from work that merely looks good. That is a lower bar than doing it and a higher bar than reading a report.
One account you turned around that you can talk through: the metric, the figure before, the figure after, and why the change worked. Whose hands were on the keyboard matters far less than whether the diagnosis was yours.
Comfortable being the client-facing owner when an account is underperforming. That call comes to you, not to the strategist.
Agency experience carrying many accounts at once.

Please do not apply if

Nobody has ever reported to you, or you have never owned someone's review or had to performance-manage anyone.
You have only ever run one channel.
All of your experience is in-house on a single brand.
What you actually want is to keep building campaigns yourself. That is not a lesser ambition, it is a different job, and this is not it.

None of these are preferences we bend on. They are how we screen, so applying anyway costs you an hour and gets you a no.

Process

Three conversations, then a decision. A thirty minute screen with our recruiter, a first round with the founder this seat reports to, and a final. No take-home project and no panel interview.

How To Apply

Four fields at the link, then a short 6 minute Predictive Index assessment. Use the same email throughout. No cover letter.

jobs.title: Director, Education Design & Intelligence
jobs.description:
Position Title:
Director, Education Design & Intelligence

Employment Type:
Full-Time Staff | Non-Union

Annual Salary Range:
$120,000 - $130,000

Division:
Education

Reports To:
Vice President, Education

Location:
2180 Yonge Street, Toronto, ON

TVO Media Education Group (TVO) is devoted to inspiring learning that changes lives and enriches communities. We are an internationally recognized digital learning organization that strives to engage, inform, and educate Ontarians of all ages.

Who We Are

We are an agency of the Ontario Ministry of Education and a registered charity that contributes to learning, civic engagement, and public service media across Ontario. We provide free, trusted, and accessible educational content that can support Ontarians of all ages, regardless of background, location, or circumstance. To fulfill our mandate, TVO delivers curriculum-connected resources through TVO Learn and TVOkids, offers Ontario’s largest online high school through TVO ILC, and produces journalism, documentaries, current affairs programming, and podcasts with TVO Today that help Ontarians understand the issues shaping their communities.

What We’re Looking For

TVO’s purpose is to inspire learning that changes lives and enriches communities. Our mission is to create engaging learning experiences for all through quality content, services, and technology. To realize our vision of becoming a globally recognized digital learning organization, we must continually reimagine how learning experiences are designed and delivered.

Artificial intelligence is reshaping education, from assessment and academic integrity to learner pathways, instructional practice, and support. These changes create extraordinary opportunities while raising important questions about equity, accessibility, ethics, and educational quality. TVO has an opportunity to help lead this transformation.

The Director, Education Design & Intelligence will shape how TVO responds. Working across TVOkids, TVO Learn, Mathify, TVO ILC, and emerging lifelong learning initiatives, this leader will guide TVO Education’s approach to AI, advance future-focused learning design, build staff capability, and ensure our learning experiences remain relevant, inclusive, and impactful. This is the opportunity to help TVO Education design what learning becomes next.

The Role

Reporting to the Vice President, Education, the Director, Education Design & Intelligence leads TVO’s Learning Experience Design and Production functions, with direct accountability for the Manager, Learning Experience Design and the Production Manager.

The Director works in close partnership with the Director, Curriculum & Course Production, Director, Content Engagement, and Director, Academic Services. Together, the Directors bring complementary expertise to the design and delivery of TVO’s education portfolio. The Director, Education Design & Intelligence contributes specialized leadership in learning design, AI integration, emerging technology, professional learning, and production.

Operating at the intersection of learning science, educational design, artificial intelligence, and digital innovation, the Director translates emerging developments into practical strategies, standards, and learning experiences that strengthen learner outcomes and organizational capability.

How You Will Make An Impact

Learning Design, Pathways & Assessment

Lead the human-centred design and continuous improvement of learning experiences across TVO’s education portfolio, ensuring they are inclusive, accessible, pedagogically grounded, and responsive to changing learner needs.
Establish and maintain shared learning design principles, standards, and frameworks that guide how educational experiences are conceived, developed, evaluated, and improved across programs and platforms.
Work in close partnership with the Director, Curriculum & Course Production, Director, Content Engagement, and Director, Academic Services to strengthen learner journeys, pathways, engagement, and educational outcomes.
Lead the continuous review and modernization of assessment and evaluation practices across TVO Education, responding to developments in AI, academic integrity, learner evidence, and emerging approaches to teaching and learning.
Establish processes for regularly evaluating learning design standards, assessment approaches, and learner journeys, using research, learner feedback, outcomes data, prototyping, and testing to guide continuous improvement.
Examine how AI and emerging technologies are reshaping curriculum, instruction, assessment, learner supports, credentialing, and progression, and translate those developments into practical opportunities for TVO.
Embed collaborative design practices that centre diverse perspectives, lived experiences, accessibility, and learner needs.

AI Strategy, Emerging Technology & Professional Learning

Develop and lead TVO Education’s AI in Education strategy, guiding principles, and implementation roadmap.
Establish responsible, ethical, equitable, accessible, and learner-centred approaches to integrating AI into educational experiences, services, and internal workflows.
Work closely with the Vice President, Education, the Chief Technology Officer, and technology teams to align AI and educational priorities with platform development, system integration, technology roadmaps, data governance, privacy, and security requirements.
Identify, evaluate, and recommend emerging technologies, tools, platforms, and practices that can advance TVO’s educational mission and improve learning experiences.
Provide timely advice to Education leaders on the educational opportunities, risks, and implications of AI and other disruptive technologies.
Develop and implement a professional learning strategy that builds AI literacy, digital fluency, instructional capability, and confidence across the Education division.
Create learning experiences, communities of practice, guidance, and resources that help employees use emerging technologies effectively, critically, creatively, and responsibly.
Foster a culture of curiosity, experimentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning that enables teams to navigate educational and technological change.
Contribute expertise to the development of AI literacy and fluency initiatives for educators, learners, and families in collaboration with the Directors responsible for programming, content, and academic services.

Learning Experience Design & Production Leadership

Provide direct leadership and strategic direction to the Manager, Learning Experience Design and the Production Manager, developing a cohesive, high-performing, and multidisciplinary team.
Ensure Learning Experience Design and Production operate as an integrated, multifunctional team supporting programming priorities across the Education division.
Work with Directors and program teams to translate educational priorities into clear scopes, design approaches, production plans, and high-quality learner experiences.
Establish effective operating models, standards, processes, and workflows that support quality, consistency, accessibility, efficiency, innovation, and accountability.
Oversee the delivery of educational experiences and digital learning assets, ensuring work is completed to agreed standards, timelines, and program requirements.
Balance portfolio-wide priorities and deploy design and production capacity where it can create the greatest learner and organizational impact.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, creating clarity, encouraging collaboration, and building the capabilities needed for future-focused educational design and production.
Manage budgets, contracts, technology investments, and resources associated with Learning Experience Design and Production, and oversee allocated resources for professional learning and innovation initiatives in AI and emerging educational technology.

Cross-Portfolio Leadership, Collaboration & Sector Engagement

Serve as a fully integrated member of the Education leadership team, contributing to divisional strategy, planning, priority setting, and decision-making.
Work in close partnership with Directors across Education to ensure that learning design, AI, production, technology, and learner experience decisions support shared educational priorities.
Build strong working relationships across TVO so that educational design and AI initiatives are aligned with broader organizational, technology, research, communications, and operational directions.
Represent TVO in provincial, national, and international conversations about AI in Education, learning design, assessment, emerging technology, and the future of learning.
Develop relationships with educational institutions, researchers, government, technology organizations, and innovation networks that can contribute expertise, evidence, or capabilities to TVO’s work.
Identify and help advance appropriate opportunities for research, pilots, technology integration, and collaboration that support TVO’s educational priorities.
Bring emerging research, sector developments, and external perspectives into TVO to inform strategy, program design, professional learning, and continuous improvement.
Help position TVO as a trusted leader in the responsible, equitable, and educationally sound application of AI in publicly funded education.

Qualifications And Experience

What you will bring to TVO

Education

A postsecondary degree in Education, Educational Leadership, Learning Design, Educational Technology, Instructional Design, Digital Learning, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field is required. An equivalent combination of education and significant relevant leadership experience will be considered.

Formal training, research experience, or demonstrated expertise in AI and its applications in education is essential.

The Person

We Are Looking For a Forward-thinking, Intellectually Curious, And Collaborative Leader Who Can Help TVO Navigate The Future Of Learning. The Successful Candidate Will Be

Current, practical expertise in AI in Education and a record of translating emerging developments into responsible implementation.
Strategic thinking that balances innovation with practical delivery.
Demonstrated expertise in learning design, assessment, learner success, and educational transformation.
The systems thinking required to navigate complex organizational, technological, and educational environments.
A collaborative approach to working across teams and disciplines and building trusted professional relationships.
A deep commitment to equity, inclusion, accessibility, and responsible innovation.
Energy for leading through change and helping shape the future of education.
A strong connection to TVO’s public mission and the transformative power of learning.

Leadership Experience

Significant leadership experience in educational design, educational technology, digital learning, AI in Education, innovation, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience developing and implementing AI or digital transformation strategies within educational or learning-focused organizations.
Experience leading organizational capability-building and professional learning initiatives.
Proven success leading innovation and change across multidisciplinary teams.
Experience influencing educational strategy and working effectively with executive leadership teams.
Experience operating successfully in highly collaborative, matrixed environments where influence is as important as direct authority.
Experience managing creative, technical, and educational teams in complex organizations.

Best Workplaces™ in Canada 2020 - 2026 | Best Workplaces™ with Most Trusted Executive Teams 2024 - 2026 | Best Workplaces™ in Financial Services & Insurance 2020 - 2026 | Best Workplaces™ for Mental Wellness 2023 - 2026 | Best Workplaces™ for Giving Back 2022, 2024 | Best Workplaces™ for Inclusion 2021, 2024 | Best Workplaces™ for Women 2021 | Best Workplaces™ in Ontario™ 2020, 2021, 2024 | Best Workplaces™ for Professional Development 2025 | Best Workplaces™ for Young Talent 2026

One of Canada’s Most Trusted Investment Brands.

At Picton Mahoney Asset Management (PICTON Investments),
being alternative isn’t just what we do—it’s who we are.

Founded by industry pioneer David Picton, we’ve spent 20 years challenging conventional wisdom and redefining the investing landscape. As one of Canada’s most trusted investment brands, we are proudly independent—privately run, 100% employee-owned, and deeply committed to delivering results for our clients.

Thinking Alternatively is in Our DNA

With a team of 233 bold thinkers—one-third dedicated solely to investment management—we are specialists, not generalists. Managing over $19.9 billion (September 30, 2026) for institutional and retail clients, we navigate markets with conviction, resilience, and a forward-thinking approach.

We’re more than investors — we’re innovators. We challenge traditional investment mindsets, constantly pushing the boundaries to achieve our mission: To bring greater certainty to investors.

Our success is built on four guiding principles:

Treat investors’ money like our own.
Redefine the way investors invest.
Be human—always approachable.
Succeed together, one investment at a time.

These aren’t just words—they define how we think, how we invest, and how we work.

Now, we’re entering our next chapter. We’re transforming our brand and reshaping the way the world invests. If you think alternatively, embrace an entrepreneurial spirit, and thrive in a dynamic, bureaucracy-free environment, join us and be part of what’s next.

Thriving in Our Entrepreneurial Culture

At PICTON Investments
, you’ll thrive in our creative and dynamic workplace, where collaboration and support are at the core of everything we do. At our firm, you’ll have the opportunity to take on significant responsibilities, work in a flexible environment, and tackle challenging projects from the outset. Our culture is designed for ambitious professionals who want to make an immediate impact while continuing to push boundaries and achieve our greater mission. You’ll be empowered with a high level of responsibility, trust, and flexibility, providing an exciting and creative space for you to help reshape how the world views alternative investments. With competitive total rewards, performance-based bonuses, and a clear path for career growth, you’ll have everything you need to develop both now and over the longer term.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Vice President, Data Engineering to define and lead PICTON's data strategy across investment data, analytics, and AI, and to show what an AI-native data organization looks like in practice.

This is a strategic, hands-on leadership role
. You will be accountable for data across all PICTON's businesses. You'll own the architecture, governance, and engineering capabilities that turn complex financial data into reliable, accessible and actionable products for people and for AI agents. We want someone who embraces AI in their processes and who can bring that way of working across an entire team.

You will work closely with Engineering, Investment, Product, and AI teams
to build a modern data foundation that enables faster innovation and better decision-making.

What You'll Own

Data Strategy & AI-Ready Architecture

Serve as the single accountable owner for data across PICTON's businesses, setting direction, resolving competing priorities, and ensuring every business can rely on consistent, trusted data.
Define and execute PICTON's enterprise data strategy, architecture, and roadmap across Databricks, Snowflake, APIs, applications, analytics, and AI.
Own the technical build that enables PICTON's AI roadmap, working with AI and business leaders to sequence data capabilities so planned AI initiatives have the data, access, and governance they need to ship.
Design the platform so AI is a first-class consumer of data (e.g., well-governed semantic layers, rich metadata, and secure interfaces such as APIs and MCP servers that agents and LLM applications can reliably use).
Make pragmatic architecture decisions that balance performance, security, cost, and business needs, including the cost and governance of AI workloads.
Build a modern data platform supporting portfolio construction, performance, risk, analytics, and AI use cases.

AI-Accelerated Data Engineering & Governance

Lead the design of reliable, scalable pipelines for market, security, portfolio, and historical data, using AI coding assistants and agentic tools to shorten build and iteration cycles.
Apply AI to the data lifecycle itself, including automated data quality checks, anomaly detection, lineage and documentation generation, metadata enrichment, and reconciliation.
Establish practical standards for data quality, lineage, governance, security, and ownership, including guardrails for how AI tools and agents access sensitive financial data.
Evolve financial data models and semantic layers so data is consistent and reusable across products, teams, and AI systems.

Leadership, Mentorship & Culture

Build and lead a high-performing Data Engineering and Data Platform team
.
Partner with Engineering, Investment, Product, and AI leaders to translate business needs into effective data solutions.
Identify opportunities to leverage modern data and AI technologies to create competitive advantage.
Communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and business stakeholders.

What We're Looking For

10+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms, architecture, or technology leadership, including significant team leadership experience.
Experience owning data across multiple business lines or functions, including balancing their competing needs and driving shared standards.
Experience building agentic AI solutions: designing agents and workflows that use tools, retrieve from enterprise data, and operate within clear security and governance boundaries, along with practical approaches to evaluating their accuracy and reliability.
Strong experience with modern cloud data platforms, particularly Databricks, Snowflake, SQL, APIs, and distributed data pipelines.
Deep understanding of financial and investment data, including securities, portfolios, market data, performance, risk, and time-series data.
Experience building data platforms that support analytics, applications, and AI/LLM workloads, including retrieval, semantic layers, and structured data access for models.
Strong understanding of data governance, quality, lineage, security, and ownership, and how these extend to AI systems.
Ability to move between strategic thinking and technical detail, making pragmatic architecture decisions.
Strong business acumen and exceptional communication and stakeholder-management skills.
Hands-on, current use of AI in your own workflow. You regularly use tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar to build, debug, document, and analyze, and you can give concrete examples of where it changed your speed or output.
Experience with LLM evaluation, observability, or AI cost management in production and familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar standards for connecting AI to enterprise systems.
A track record of mentoring engineers and shaping team culture. You can point to people you've developed and to teams that took on more ownership and improved how they work under your leadership.

Our Commitment to Employees

At PICTON Investments
, we take pride in enhancing our employees' experiences through a comprehensive suite of exceptional perks and programs. Our benefits include corporate fitness reimbursement and discounts, VersaFi memberships (formerly Women in Capital Markets), Picton investment counseling and portfolio management services, volunteer and charitable donation matching, maternity and parental leave top-up, recognition awards, semi-annual performance bonuses, a generous annual vacation entitlement (minimum of 15 days per year), training and development reimbursement, extensive health and dental benefits, a healthcare spending account, and more.

These offerings are designed to support your career growth, well-being, and overall success. Join us and thrive in an environment that values and invests in you!

PICTON Investments
is committed to providing an equitable and fair work environment for everyone and all hiring and other personnel actions will be taken without regard to race, colour, creed, religion, sex, disability, gender identity, gender expression, family status, age, language or national origin. If you require an accommodation at any point in time throughout the application and hiring process, please contact Human Resources at (416) 955-4108 or at accessibility@pictoninvestments.com.

PICTON Investments
does not accept unsolicited resumes, emails, calls, or any other form of communication from third-party recruitment agencies. Any unsolicited outreach, including commercial electronic messages, will neither be acknowledged nor considered.

Please note: We use AI-assisted tools to support parts of our recruitment process, including summarizing interview notes and aligning candidate profiles with job requirements. All decisions are made by our hiring team.
