jobs.title: Director of Finance-CPA Required
jobs.description:
About EVORETRO

EVORETRO is a fast-growing consumer products company expanding across Canada, the U.S., Europe, and international markets.

As we continue to scale our distribution network, product portfolio, inventory, and international operations, we are looking for a hands-on Director of Finance & Strategic Planning
to lead our finance function and help structure the next stage of our growth.

This is not a traditional accounting-only role
.

We are looking for a CPA who wants to be close to the business — someone who can understand the numbers, challenge assumptions, improve profitability, protect cash flow, strengthen financial controls, and help management make better decisions.

Reporting closely to the CEO and working with the leadership team, this person will lead and develop our internal finance team and collaborate with banks, accountants, tax specialists, government partners, and other external advisors.

The Role

As Director of Finance & Strategic Planning, you will be a key financial partner to the CEO and leadership team.

You will lead a finance team of approximately three people across accounting, bookkeeping, controllership, and financial analysis.

Your role will be to bring structure, visibility, discipline, and strong financial judgment to a rapidly growing international business.

You will help management answer important questions such as:

• Where are we generating the strongest margins?
• Where are we losing profitability?
• How much inventory should we purchase?
• How much working capital do we need?
• How do we improve cash flow?
• Where should we invest?
• Which customers, products, countries, and channels are the most profitable?
• What are the financial risks of a new warehouse, 3PL, market, or expansion project?
• How should we structure pricing and customer programs?
• How should we finance continued growth?

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Analysis

• Develop and manage annual budgets, financial forecasts, and long-term financial planning
• Maintain rolling cash-flow forecasts and proactively identify liquidity requirements
• Prepare financial dashboards and management reports for the CEO and leadership team
• Analyze actual performance versus budget and forecast
• Identify financial trends, risks, opportunities, and areas requiring management attention
• Build financial models to support strategic and operational decisions
• Provide financial analysis and recommendations for leadership and EOS meetings

Profitability & Commercial Finance

• Analyze profitability by product, SKU, customer, channel, country, and project
• Support pricing strategy and margin optimization
• Maintain strong governance around official price lists
• Review discounts, rebates, customer programs, and commercial terms
• Review private-label and special-project quotations
• Support financial analysis for large customer opportunities and distributor programs
• Identify margin leakage, unprofitable activities, and cost-saving opportunities
• Help management improve overall gross margin and operating profitability

Cash Flow & Working Capital

• Monitor and optimize working capital
• Oversee financial analysis related to inventory purchasing and purchasing commitments
• Monitor accounts receivable and accounts payable performance
• Help improve inventory turns and reduce excess or slow-moving inventory
• Support purchasing decisions with cash-flow and profitability analysis
• Monitor payment terms, customer credit exposure, and supplier commitments
• Support foreign exchange and cash-management decisions
• Proactively identify future financing requirements

Finance Team Leadership

• Lead, structure, and develop EVORETRO’s internal finance team
• Establish clear responsibilities, accountability, and reporting standards
• Oversee the quality and timeliness of financial reporting
• Strengthen month-end and year-end processes
• Develop stronger financial procedures and internal controls
• Support professional development within the finance team
• Ensure management receives accurate, timely, and decision-useful financial information

Controls, Compliance & Governance

• Establish and improve financial controls, policies, and approval processes
• Strengthen governance around purchasing, pricing, discounts, payments, and major expenditures
• Coordinate Canadian and U.S. tax matters with external tax specialists
• Support analysis related to U.S. sales tax, nexus, and corporate structure
• Work closely with external accountants, auditors, and advisors
• Ensure appropriate financial documentation and compliance processes are maintained
• Support annual financial statements, tax filings, and other reporting requirements
• Identify financial risks and recommend corrective actions

Banking, Financing & External Partners

• Manage relationships with banks and financial institutions
• Support financing activities and credit facility management
• Prepare financial information required by lenders and financial partners
• Support negotiations related to loans, credit facilities, foreign exchange, and other banking services
• Coordinate with accountants, tax specialists, government agencies, and other external advisors
• Identify and evaluate grants, tax credits, and government programs

Strategic Growth & Investment Analysis

• Evaluate the financial impact of new warehouses, 3PLs, and logistics partners
• Analyze international expansion opportunities
• Review major capital investments and strategic projects
• Build ROI and payback analyses
• Support decisions related to new countries, channels, product categories, and business initiatives
• Evaluate the financial implications of growth opportunities before commitments are made
• Support management with capital allocation decisions

Qualifications & Requirements

• CPA designation required

• 7+ years of relevant finance experience
• Previous experience managing or leading a finance/accounting team
• Strong background in FP&A, controllership, commercial finance, or a combination of these areas
• Strong understanding of cash flow, profitability, margins, working capital, and financial controls
• Strong Excel and financial modeling skills
• Strong analytical and business decision-making abilities
• Ability to translate complex financial information into clear business insights and recommendations
• Comfortable working in both a strategic and hands-on capacity
• Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to operate in a fast-growing environment
• Strong communication and leadership skills
• Comfortable challenging assumptions when appropriate
• Experience working closely with senior leadership
• Experience working with banks, accountants, tax specialists, and other external advisors

Experience in the Following Is an Asset

• Distribution
• Wholesale
• Retail
• E-commerce
• Consumer products
• Import/export
• Inventory-intensive businesses
• International operations
• U.S. expansion
• Multi-currency businesses
• Licensed consumer products
• Interest in or experience with the collectibles, trading card, hobby, gaming, or related industries

Who We Are Looking For

• We are looking for someone who combines strong financial fundamentals with commercial judgment.
• You should be comfortable moving from a cash-flow forecast in the morning to a pricing discussion, inventory investment decision, bank meeting, or profitability review later in the day.
• You are someone who wants to understand the business behind the numbers.
• You ask questions.
• You challenge assumptions.
• You identify financial risks before they become problems.
• You help management understand the financial impact of decisions.
• And most importantly, you help build the financial discipline required to support sustainable growth.

Why Join EVORETRO?

At EVORETRO, you won’t simply report the numbers.

You will help shape how the company grows.

This role will have a direct impact on:

• Cash flow
• Profitability
• Pricing
• Inventory investment
• Financial controls
• Financing strategy
• International expansion
• Business performance

You will work closely with the CEO and leadership team and play a meaningful role in strengthening the company’s financial infrastructure as the business continues to scale internationally.

This is an opportunity for a CPA who enjoys being close to operations, commercial decisions, and leadership — while bringing the financial discipline, controls, and strategic insight required by a growing international company.

If you are looking for a hands-on finance leadership role where your expertise can directly influence growth, profitability, cash flow, and major business decisions, we’d like to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Why Join BoomerangFX?

BoomerangFX is redefining how private-pay healthcare practices operate and grow. Recognized through Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500 program as one of North America’s fastest-growing technology companies, BFX brings together practice management software, digital marketing, and AI-powered solutions to help healthcare providers build stronger, more profitable businesses.

With offices across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, Australia, and India, we are building a global healthcare technology company with an ambitious vision: to become the AI operating system and growth infrastructure for private-pay healthcare.
Our next phase requires financial leadership and operational discipline to turn rapid growth into lasting enterprise value.

As Director of Finance & Operations
, you will work closely with the CEO and leadership team to shape strategic plans, strengthen financial oversight, and improve performance across the business.
This is a hands-on leadership opportunity with meaningful influence over how BFX invests, operates, and scales. We are looking for an accomplished CPA who brings verifiable experience in high-growth software or technology-enabled companies—and the judgment, ownership, and execution skills to help build our next stage of growth.

Your Role in a Nutshell

You will lead financial oversight, strategic planning, board reporting, and operational performance management across multiple business lines and international markets.
Working closely with the CEO and departmental leaders, you will translate business strategy into budgets, forecasts, operating priorities, and measurable results. You will strengthen cash management, improve profitability, evaluate growth investments, and ensure leadership has accurate information to make timely decisions.
The ideal candidate combines rigorous accounting and financial management skills with commercial judgment and proven operational leadership. You must be comfortable challenging assumptions, holding teams accountable, and moving between strategic analysis and detailed execution.

What You Will Do

Financial Oversight and Control

Oversee accounting, financial reporting, internal controls, and the integrity of financial information across the business.
Lead timely monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting, including financial statements, variance analysis, and management commentary.
Oversee billing, revenue recognition, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and payroll controls.
Coordinate external accountants, auditors, and tax advisers to meet reporting and compliance obligations.
Strengthen financial policies, approval processes, and controls as the company scales.

Cash Management and Profitability

Own cash-flow planning, including a rolling 13-week cash forecast and longer-term liquidity projections.
Improve collections, working capital, spending discipline, and visibility into cash commitments.
Analyze profitability by product, service, customer segment, and market.
Identify and execute opportunities to improve gross margins, control operating costs, and increase cash generation.
Evaluate spending and investment proposals against expected returns, payback periods, and business priorities.

Operational Oversight

Partner with departmental leaders to establish operating plans, budgets, KPIs, and clear accountability for results.
Lead regular performance reviews, identifying gaps and ensuring corrective actions have owners and deadlines.
Oversee cross-functional improvement initiatives that strengthen productivity, resource utilization, and execution.
Assess headcount plans, vendor contracts, procurement, and operating expenditures.
Improve workflows, reporting systems, and data quality through automation and appropriate use of AI.
Lead and mentor finance team members while building effective partnerships across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and Operations.

Strategic Planning and Business Analysis

Lead annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, and the financial component of strategic planning.
Develop financial models, scenario analyses, and business cases for hiring, pricing, product investments, partnerships, and international expansion.
Monitor SaaS and recurring-revenue metrics, including ARR, retention, churn, gross margin, customer acquisition costs, and payback.
Translate financial and operational data into clear recommendations on where to invest, improve, defer, or stop.
Balance growth opportunities with disciplined progress toward sustainable profitability.
Support financing, due diligence, acquisitions, and other strategic initiatives as required.

Board and Executive Reporting

Own preparation of board financial packages, executive dashboards, and performance presentations.
Provide clear analysis of financial results, forecasts, cash position, business risks, and recommended actions.
Explain the operational drivers behind performance and highlight material changes against plan.
Ensure board and executive reporting is accurate, consistent, timely, and supported by reliable information.

What We’re Looking For

Mandatory Qualifications

CPA designation in good standing.

At least 10 years of progressive, relevant professional experience following university graduation.

Demonstrated, verifiable experience in high-growth software, SaaS, or technology-enabled companies.
Candidates must be able to substantiate their responsibilities and achievements through specific examples and professional references.
Proven accountability for financial oversight, including accounting, financial statements, internal controls, budgeting, forecasting, and cash management.
Demonstrated operational oversight beyond finance, with experience driving cross-functional performance and execution.
Direct experience in strategic planning, financial modeling, and evaluating business investments.
Hands-on experience preparing board reporting and presenting financial insights to senior executives, boards, or investors.
Strong understanding of recurring-revenue business models and the relationship between growth, retention, margins, and cash.
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills and experience with accounting, ERP, and financial reporting systems.
Proven ability to lead teams, influence stakeholders, and hold others accountable for commitments.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to turn complex information into practical business recommendations.

Experience That Will Set You Apart

Helping a growth company achieve break-even or materially improve profitability.
Managing multiple entities, currencies, or international operations.
Experience in healthcare technology or businesses combining software subscriptions and services.
Implementing finance systems, reporting automation, or AI-enabled process improvements.
Supporting capital raises, acquisitions, or transaction readiness.

How You Work

You take ownership, exercise sound judgment, and follow through. You are commercially minded, analytical, and comfortable operating in an environment where priorities evolve quickly. You challenge assumptions constructively and build practical processes that help people make better decisions and deliver results.

What is in it for you:

Location:
Onsite – 5 days per week (Mississauga, Ontario)
Compensation:
$120,000 - $130,000 annual base salary + 25% annual target performance bonus
Total Target Compensation:
CAD $150,000–$162,500 annually.
Performance objectives will reflect measurable outcomes in profitability, cash management, financial reporting, and operational execution.
Equity:
Eligible to participate in BoomerangFX Stock Option Plan after 6 months, subject to plan terms.
Benefits:

Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage.
Paid vacation.
Free on-site parking.
Opportunity to work closely with the CEO and senior leadership on consequential business decisions.
Meaningful responsibility for building the financial and operational foundations of a growing global technology company.
Opportunity to shape how BFX allocates capital, improves performance, and scales internationally.

How to Apply

Submit your résumé with a brief summary of your experience in high-growth software or technology-enabled companies, including two or three measurable financial or operational results you personally delivered.
Shortlisted candidates should be prepared to discuss their experience with financial oversight, operational leadership, strategic planning, and board reporting. CPA credentials, employment experience, and professional references will be verified.

Accessibility Statement

BoomerangFX is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals and are dedicated to accommodating people with disabilities. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application process, please contact recruitment@boomerangfx.com.

Posting Description:
**Director, PathWise Actuarial Implementation and AI\-Enabled Process Transformation**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


The Life Solutions division at Aon is seeking a Director to lead large\-scale PathWise implementation projects. This role also supports AI\-enabled process transformation initiatives for life and annuity insurers across North America. This client\-facing role combines actuarial expertise, implementation leadership, and technology\-enabled transformation to help insurers modernize modelling, reporting, workflow automation, AI\-enabled systems, and operational workflows.  

The Director will work within Aon Life Solutions, part of Aon’s Reinsurance Strategy and Technology Group to translate business needs into practical implementation plans, scalable operating models, and measurable delivery outcomes. This role will be based in Canada. **Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada. This role is not eligible for sponsorship, and we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa or work permit.****Aon is in the business of better decisions**
----------------------------------------------


At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.
As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.**What the day will look like**
-------------------------------

**Implementation and Client Delivery*** Lead and support large\-scale PathWise implementation projects for life and annuity insurers across North America.
* Handle key implementation workstreams, including model migration, data integration, testing, reconciliation, workflow design, documentation, training, and production deployment.
* Translate client business objectives and current\-state processes into clear delivery plans, target\-state solutions, and implementation roadmaps.
* Develop and migrate actuarial models and production processes for valuation, pricing, financial reporting, capital, ALM, and risk management use cases.
* Support delivery governance, issue resolution, risk management, collaborator communication, post\-implementation stabilization, and client knowledge transfer.

**AI\-Enabled Process Transformation and Innovation**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Identify, prioritize, and continuously refine opportunities to use automation and AI\-enabled capabilities to improve actuarial modelling, reporting, reconciliation, documentation, and analysis processes across the PathWise lifecycle.
* Collaborate closely with the PathWise AI and development teams to translate business difficulties into clear AI use cases, feature requests, and improvements.
* Help clients redesign legacy actuarial workflows into more efficient, scalable, governed, and technology\-enabled operating models.
* Contribute to reusable implementation assets, process transformation playbooks, documentation templates, workflow designs, and AI\-enabled delivery accelerators.
* Lead or support pilots of new PathWise AI features, capturing user feedback and performance metrics, and consolidating insights into actionable recommendations for the PathWise AI roadmap
* Promote responsible and controlled use of AI\-enabled capabilities, including review, validation, traceability, documentation, and governance, and contribute to standard guidance on AI\-enabled workflows

**Business Development and Market Support**
-------------------------------------------

* Support PathWise growth in the North American life and annuity market through client solutioning, demonstrations (including AI\-enabled capabilities), proposals, implementation estimates, and project planning.
* Partner with senior leaders in client discussions on actuarial modernization, implementation strategy, process automation, AI\-enabled transformation, and business value.
* Develop proof\-of\-concept materials and presentations on PathWise capabilities, implementation guidelines, and emerging insurance industry issues.
* Develop and share case studies, training materials, and thought leadership that showcase successful AI\-enabled PathWise use cases and evolving capabilities

**How this opportunity is different**
-------------------------------------


PathWise is Aon’s high\-performance actuarial software platform, enabling insurers to model liabilities, assets, capital, and related business processes with speed, transparency, flexibility, and control. The platform supports modern actuarial modelling, scenario analysis, financial reporting, ALM, risk management, and enterprise\-scale production processes.
In this role, you will help clients migrate models and processes into PathWise, improve actuarial production workflows, and apply automation and AI\-enabled capabilities across requirements, model development, testing, reconciliation, documentation, workflow monitoring, and reporting. You will also help identify new AI applications within PathWise, develop improvements with the PathWise AI team, and promote adoption of emerging capabilities across client and internal teams.**Skills and experience that will lead to success**
---------------------------------------------------

* 10\+ years of experience in life insurance, life reinsurance, actuarial consulting, financial technology, actuarial modelling, or enterprise platform implementation.
* Experience with valuation, pricing, ALM, hedging, capital, financial reporting, risk management, model governance, or related actuarial functions.
* Experience supporting or leading implementation, modernization, migration, or transformation projects within actuarial, finance, risk, or insurance technology environments.
* Solid understanding of life and annuity products, reserves, capital, financial reporting, ALM, and risk management.
* Practical experience with actuarial mode

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts is a global, luxury hotel management company. We manage over 130 hotels and resorts and 50 private residences in 47 countries around the world and growing. Central to Four Seasons employee experience and social impact programming is the company’s commitment to supporting cancer research, and the advancement of diversity, inclusion, equality and belonging at Four Seasons corporate offices and properties worldwide. At Four Seasons, we are powered by people and our culture enables everything we do.

Director, Digital Experience Platform, Web & ECommerce

The Director, Digital Experience Platforms, Web & eCommerce provides senior leadership for Four Seasons’ web and eCommerce digital platforms, overseeing platform engineering, platform management, DevOps, release quality, compliance, and security operations.

The role balances strategic platform ownership with hands-on team leadership, ensuring that digital platforms, including FourSeasons.com, microsites, eCommerce, and related digital properties, operate with excellence, stability, and continuous improvement.

The Director partners closely with Brand & Marketing Technologies, Hotel Digital Operations, Digital Analytics, Quality Assurance, and the broader Technology Innovation & Data organization.

The ideal candidate is proactive, collaborative, technically curious, and comfortable working with both business users and developers.

What You’ll Be Doing

Platform Leadership & Strategy

Provide strategic direction and oversight for all web-based digital experience platforms, including FourSeasons.com, eCommerce platforms, and microsites.
Manage platform roadmaps, prioritization frameworks, and delivery standards across web and eCommerce to ensure alignment with project delivery and other company initiatives.
Partner with senior stakeholders to align platform investments with business objectives, ensuring platforms support luxury guest experience goals.
Lead vendor relationship management and technology evaluations (e.g., platform providers, CDN partners, analytics and monitoring tools).
Establish success measures for AI-enabled capabilities, including guest adoption, conversion, content efficiency, service quality, operational performance, and risk indicators.
Evaluate when to build, buy, configure, or integrate AI capabilities, ensuring decisions align with enterprise architecture, data, security, privacy, and procurement standards.

Team Leadership & Development

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of platform engineers and platform management analysts.
Establish clear goals, expectations, and performance frameworks aligned to Four Seasons career progression models.
Foster a collaborative, accountable team culture focused on quality, ownership, and continuous improvement.
Manage hiring processes, including role definition, interviews, and onboarding for platform-focused roles.
Develop and coach technical leaders, establishing clear ownership, succession planning, talent development, and career growth strategies.

Platform Engineering & Operations

Oversee platform engineering practices including monitoring, alerting, infrastructure oversight, and release coordination.
Deep understanding of cloud-native architectures, distributed systems, integration patterns, platform engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, and AI/LLM Ops practices.
Ensure robust observability across web platforms using tools such as Elastic, Dynatrace, and Adobe Analytics.
Govern platform release cycles, change advisory board (CAB) processes, and production deployment standards.
Drive incident management, escalation handling, and SLA compliance across all web platforms.

Lead the consolidated 3-year long-range planning process, including financial performance, cash flow, capital requirements, liquidity and financing capacity.

Review regional and functional plans at the consolidated level to ensure alignment with overall corporate and financial objectives.

Partner closely with Finance Business Partners and operational leadership across the organization.

Prepare and present forward-looking financial analysis, scenarios, recommendations and executive-level materials.
Perform sensitivity analysis across earnings, cash flow, capital investment, liquidity, commodity pricing and other key business drivers.
Provide senior leadership with a holistic view of the organization's financial outlook and strategic capital priorities.

Ideal Background

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
In this Director of Finance position - this is a rare opportunity to join a local BC-based company that is scaling up! A fast-growing company now at 8 million gross revenue (with stretch goals this year to reach 10 million) in the business services insurance space that is making customers' lives easier with compassion and data. You will work alongside the CEO and leadership team - your voice will be heard, and your inputs can be implemented in days, not years.If you are keen on joining a local and growing company, where ideas are heard and implemented, and prides itself on daily improvement - this is for you!

Top level:

The Director of Finance is a senior financial leader responsible for overseeing the organization’s financial operations, planning, reporting, and strategic financial management. To be clear, you are the sole individual in finance on the leadership team - and will have the opportunity to build around when the timing is right.

This role provides financial insight and leadership to executive management while ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and effectiveness of the company’s financial processes.
The Director of Finance will lead budgeting and forecasting, financial reporting, cash flow management, financial analysis, internal controls, and long-term financial planning. The successful candidate will be a strategic business partner who can translate financial data into actionable recommendations and help drive sustainable growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities:

Financial Leadership & Strategy

Develop and execute financial strategies aligned with the organization’s overall business objectives.
Serve as a trusted financial advisor to the CEO, executive leadership team, and other senior stakeholders.
Provide financial analysis, insights, and recommendations to support strategic and operational decision-making.
Evaluate business performance, profitability, investments, and growth opportunities.
Establish financial policies, processes, controls, and performance standards.

Budgeting & Forecasting

Lead the annual budgeting and planning process.
Develop financial forecasts and regularly update projections based on business performance and market conditions.
Monitor actual results against budgets and forecasts, identifying trends, risks, and opportunities.
Partner with department leaders to improve financial accountability and resource allocation.

Financial Reporting & Analysis

Oversee timely and accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting.
Completion of all T2s
Prepare management reports, dashboards, and financial presentations for senior leadership and, where applicable, the Board of Directors.
Analyze revenue, expenses, margins, cash flow, working capital, and key performance indicators.
Develop meaningful financial metrics to measure business performance.

Accounting & Controls

Oversee accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, payroll, and financial close processes.
Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax requirements, and regulatory obligations.
Maintain strong internal controls and financial governance.
Coordinate with external auditors, tax advisors, banking partners, and other financial service providers.

Cash Flow & Risk Management

Manage cash flow forecasting and liquidity planning.
Monitor working capital and optimize cash management.
Identify financial, operational, and business risks and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.
Support insurance, banking, financing, and other financial arrangements as required.

Team Leadership

Lead, mentor, and develop the finance and accounting team.
Establish clear goals, performance expectations, and professional development plans.
Promote a culture of accountability, accuracy, continuous improvement, and business partnership.
Evaluate and improve finance systems, processes, and technology.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
CPA, CFA, MBA, or other relevant professional designation is an asset.
5+ years of progressive experience in finance, accounting, financial planning and analysis, or a related discipline.
Demonstrated experience leading budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and strategic analysis.
Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial controls, and business finance.
Experience managing and developing finance professionals.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Excellent communication and presentation abilities.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and financial reporting/ERP systems.

Preferred Experience

Experience in a senior finance leadership role within a growing or complex organization.
Experience with financial systems implementation, process improvement, and automation.
Strong commercial and operational understanding, with the ability to connect financial performance to business strategy.
Experience managing external auditors, tax advisors, lenders, and other external stakeholders.

Financials:

Pay Range - 120k to 170k
Comprehensive benefits program - including dental care, vision care, and paid time off
Annual bonus based on profitability on business

jobs.title: Director, Product Automation
jobs.description:
Job Description:

ICUC is the global leader in Social Media solutions for over 20 years. To date, the ICUC team consists of over 350 people, in over 35 countries, covering 50 languages around the clock. In an environment where the only constant is change, we create common ground between brands and audiences across communities and social media. Fueled by a unique culture built in and around meritocracy, we bring the passion, the know-how and the balance necessary to maintain the charted course we set for ourselves: to be the best, we employ the best. Are you ready to be part of the ICUC team?

The Role

ICUC is creating a new leadership role to own our automation and AI strategy across the business. This is a product and innovation mandate, not a workforce-efficiency one: the Director, Product Automation is responsible for how AI and automation get built into the actual work we do for clients — community management, strategy, insights, monitoring, and social listening, so our teams can work faster, with more precision, and with sharper focus on the client.

This is a founding, leadership-level position. You'll set the vision and build the function from the ground up, working closely across leadership to make sure ICUC's AI and automation strategy is as strong internally as it is in how we tell that story to the market.

What You'll Be Doing

Automation & AI Strategy

Own ICUC's automation and AI strategy as it applies to our products and service delivery
Evaluate, pilot, and select tools and technologies that make our core services - community management, strategy, insights, monitoring, and social listening - faster, more precise, and more scalable, without compromising the quality clients expect.
Define a standardized, scalable automation blueprint for ICUC's service offerings, rather than one-off, client-by-client fixes.
Build the reporting infrastructure needed to measure automation impact including efficiency gains, quality, and margin — across our platform ecosystem.
Bring a product mindset to this work: treat automation and AI capability as a product to be designed, tested, and iterated, not a back-office project.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Partner closely with Operations, Product Marketing and Growth to translate our internal automation and AI capability into external go-to-market positioning and messaging.
Collaborate with Marketing to align messaging with ICUC's broader brand and content strategy.
Work across delivery, operations, and client success teams to ensure new tools and workflows are adopted in practice, not just approved in theory.

Organizational Leadership

Represent automation and AI strategy at the leadership table, helping shape how ICUC positions itself against AI-native competitors and evolving client expectations.
Build and champion a clear, company-wide narrative for what "AI-enabled, human-powered" means at ICUC, internally and externally.
Mentor and influence teams across the business to build automation literacy and confidence, without a large direct team of your own at the outset.

What You Bring To The Table

Proven experience building or scaling a product, automation, or AI/technology strategy function, ideally within a services, agency, or martech environment.
A track record of taking automation or AI capability from concept to measurable operational impact.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; comfortable partnering with marketing, delivery, and executive stakeholders who may have different priorities.
Familiarity with social media, community management, or social listening platforms is a strong asset.
Experience navigating the reporting and data limitations of enterprise martech platforms and building workarounds or systems to close those gaps.
A genuine product-innovation mindset: curious about tools and technology but always tying it back to what makes the client experience better.
Comfortable operating as a founding leader in a new function - able to build structure and process without waiting for someone else to define it.

Our community comes from all walks of life, and so does our team—united by a shared commitment to create real, lasting change. jobs.title: Technology Procurement Leader
jobs.description:
Who we need

Reporting to the CFO, illumin
is hiring a Technology Procurement Lead
to own procurement across illumin, with a primary focus on SaaS, software, technology services, hardware, and other corporate vendors. The role will include procurement responsibilities outside of IT .
You will take ownership of the full procurement lifecycle, driving cost optimization and strong commercial outcomes through strategic sourcing, negotiation, vendor consolidation, licence optimization, and disciplined vendor management. As a hands-on individual contributor, you will partner across the organization to strengthen purchasing decisions, secure favourable commercial terms, identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary spend, and ensure illumin receives maximum value from its vendor relationships.

This is a full-time, hybrid position, working in our Toronto office three days per week.

What you bring:

The procurement experience. You have deep procurement experience, including significant exposure to SaaS, software, technology services, and hardware. You have managed procurement activities across the lifecycle, from sourcing and vendor evaluation through negotiation, contracting, renewals, and ongoing vendor management.

The commercial mindset. You have a proven track record of achieving meaningful cost savings and securing strong commercial terms. You know how to identify opportunities for vendor consolidation, licence optimization, and spend reduction, and you are confident leading negotiations that balance cost, value, and business needs.

The technical aptitude. You can quickly understand software, technology services, licensing models, pricing structures, and market alternatives. You are comfortable researching technologies, vendors, and competitors, analyzing your options, and using those insights to strengthen purchasing decisions and negotiations. Experience with ServiceNow Procurement and Sourcing Operations is an asset.

The judgment and initiative. You bring strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills and can confidently assess options, make recommendations, and move work forward. You are organized and comfortable managing competing priorities, operating independently, and taking ownership of your deliverables.

The interpersonal skills. You are a clear and confident communicator who can build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and partners across Finance, IT, Security, Legal, HR, Marketing, and other areas of the business. You can understand different priorities, ask thoughtful questions, advocate for strong commercial outcomes, and bring stakeholders together around procurement decisions.

Compensation

At illumin, we believe compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of both experience and impact. The salary range for this role is $120,000–$140,000 plus bonus.

Compensation is determined based on skills, experience, and the scope and complexity of the role. We value open conversations about compensation and are happy to discuss our approach at any stage of the hiring process.

What's in it for you

Ownership and impact. You will own procurement across the organization, with a primary focus on SaaS, software, technology services, hardware, and other corporate vendors. You will have the autonomy to research alternatives, negotiate commercial terms, consolidate vendors, optimize licences, and identify meaningful savings. Your work will directly influence how illumin manages technology investments and vendor spend.

Influence and exposure. Reporting directly to the CFO, you will have visibility into procurement priorities and purchasing decisions across the business. You will partner with Finance, IT, Security, Legal, HR, Marketing, and business leaders, bringing your procurement expertise and commercial perspective to decisions that improve cost efficiency and strengthen the value illumin receives from its vendor relationships.

Professional growth. At illumin, we are dedicated to pushing the boundaries to improve and reach our full potential, both as individuals and as a company. You will deepen your expertise in technology procurement while expanding your exposure across the business. You will also have the opportunity to strengthen procurement policies, workflows, controls, and tools, helping shape a more disciplined and scalable approach to procurement.

How you will make an impact:

Own the procurement lifecycle. You will lead procurement from sourcing and vendor evaluation through negotiation, contracting, renewal, and termination, with a primary focus on SaaS, software, technology services, hardware, and other corporate vendors. You will partner with Finance, IT, Security, Legal, HR, Marketing, and business leaders to understand requirements and make informed purchasing decisions.

Drive cost optimization. You will identify and deliver meaningful savings through negotiation, vendor consolidation, licence optimization, and the elimination of unnecessary spend. You will advocate for illumin’s best interests in vendor discussions, securing strong pricing, terms, and commercial outcomes.

Strengthen purchasing decisions. You will research technologies, pricing models, competitors, and market alternatives to inform procurement decisions and strengthen your position in vendor negotiations. You will bring together market insight, spend data, and business requirements to identify opportunities and ensure illumin is getting the right value from its investments.

Manage vendors and contracts. You will oversee contracts, renewals, and vendor performance, ensuring agreements continue to meet business needs and deliver expected value. You will maintain visibility into upcoming renewals, monitor vendor performance, and proactively identify opportunities to renegotiate, consolidate, or make changes.

Improve procurement processes. You will review and strengthen procurement policies, workflows, controls, reporting, and tools, including ServiceNow. You will help create a more disciplined, efficient, and transparent approach to procurement while supporting effective vendor management across the organization.

Who we are

At illumin, we are transforming the advertising landscape. Our platform offers an integrated space for journey planning, execution, and reporting. It empowers marketers to connect with their audiences in powerful ways through real-time data and easy-to-use visual tools. By seamlessly combining media planning and buying in an intuitive interface, marketers can take complete control of their campaigns, meeting customers wherever they are in the buying journey and maximizing the impact of their ad spend through personalized insights for smarter decision-making.

We are at a pivotal moment, evolving into a product-led company with a team of over 100 skilled professionals and new leadership guiding our path forward. By harnessing the power of data, advancing our AI capabilities, and deeply investing in our people, we are preparing for a future that will redefine what’s possible in journey advertising.

Our work is guided by two beliefs: that the ability to execute is paramount to success and that we are only as good as our people. As we grow and transform, we are looking for team members (illumineers) who share our bias for speed, delivery over perfection, and an entrepreneurial mindset. Joining us now is a chance to be part of our transformation.

What else should you know about us?

We are undergoing a transformative shift. We are embracing change and the opportunities that come with it, empowering every illumineer to innovate, experiment, and bring forward new ideas. Whether accessing new technology, restructuring workflows, or expanding your team, you will have full support if you can make the business case.

We are a broad and diverse team, but we all share a passion for success, a drive to do more, and a love of creating connections. We hire for talent and commitment and provide the guidelines and guidance to elevate skills, knowledge, and abilities across all areas. This is a place where proven methods meet bold ideas, offering opportunities to grow personally and professionally.

To support a healthy work-life balance, we offer a flexible work environment, a meal credit for your in-office days, and a free massage with an RMT in-house every eight weeks. That is in addition to our comprehensive benefits, which include life, AD&D, long-term disability insurance, and coverage for prescriptions, dental, vision, mental health, and professional health services. You will also have access to a workplace advisor, the Vitality Wellness app, and a $300 annual healthcare spending account.

Apply now

If you want to seize the opportunity to impact a company and influence an industry, and you have 70% of what we are looking for, apply now. We can't promise an interview, but we will consider your whole application.

What you can expect from our interview process:

A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in the role, your background, and what you are looking for in your next opportunity. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered interview platform. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.

An in-person interview with the COO. This will be an opportunity to discuss illumin’s business priorities, growth strategy, and the role procurement plays in supporting the organization. You will have the opportunity to share how your experience and approach can contribute to strong commercial outcomes and cost optimization, while learning more about the broader business.

A final interview with the Hiring Manager. You will have the opportunity to discuss your experience leading procurement initiatives, managing technology vendors, driving cost savings, and negotiating commercial agreements. You will also learn more about the priorities and expectations of the role and have time to ask any remaining questions.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**



SickKids Foundation, with over 50 years of philanthropic impact is Canada's largest charitable funder of child health research, learning and care, raising over $200 million last year. As a national charity, SickKids Foundation invests in national and international initiatives to benefit children in Canada and around the world. As the fundraising partner to The Hospital for Sick Children (SickKids), we are aligned in supporting Precision Child Health (PCH), the future of tailoring medicine to each child's unique traits so SickKids can diagnose faster, treat smarter, and predict better.



We are driven by our core values of integrity, collaboration, excellence, innovation, and inclusion, with goals of delivering a superior donor experience, investing in our people and culture, driving innovative and sustainable fundraising, and disrupting the market through data and technology.



SickKids Foundation is committed to an inclusive culture by embedding equity, diversity and inclusion in our policies, practices, and behaviours. We aim to build awareness and skills in this area, both internally and with our partners. Our commitment extends to creating a safe, positive work environment. For details on our Equity, Diversity \& Inclusion commitment, please click here. (https://www.sickkidsfoundation.com/aboutus/equitydiversityandinclusion)



We’re committed to attracting and retaining passionate individuals to help create a healthier future. That’s why SickKids Foundation is looking for a new Associate Director, Data Engineer.


**Description of the Position**



Reporting to the Director, Data Science \& Engineering, the Associate Director, Data Engineer designs, builds, and operates enterprise\-grade data platforms that deliver trusted, well\-governed data across SickKids Foundation. The role will help establish and evolve a production\-grade cloud platform using medallion architecture principles, with a focus on reliability, data quality, cost efficiency, and scalable delivery.



As a senior hands\-on technical contributor, you will set engineering standards, support platform incident response, enable self\-serve analytics and AI\-powered data products, and provide specialized technical guidance to data and analytics partners across the Foundation.


**You will**


* Design, build, and operate enterprise\-grade data engineering platforms using modern cloud technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks, aligned to bronze, silver, and gold medallion architecture principles.
* Build and maintain robust, idempotent ETL/ELT pipelines with embedded validation, data quality checks, clear lineage, and repeatable delivery workflows.
* Design data models and semantic layers that make trusted data accessible for analytics, reporting, and self\-serve business intelligence.
* Establish platform observability through query profiling, cost attribution, utilization metrics, alerting, and SLO/SLA monitoring; lead day\-to\-day response to data availability and performance incidents.
* Define and enforce coding standards, CI/CD patterns, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code practices to support consistent, secure, and scalable platform deployment.
* Partner with business stakeholders, Data \& Analytics, IT/Infrastructure, and Security teams to translate requirements into reliable platform capabilities and support appropriate access, governance, and compliance.
* Enable AI and advanced analytics use cases, including natural\-language querying and AI\-powered data products, by partnering with stakeholders to identify and deliver high\-value opportunities.
* Stay current with developments in cloud data platforms, AI, and emerging engineering practices, bringing relevant advancements into the platform roadmap and providing technical guidance to analysts, BI developers, and engineering partners.


**Qualifications**



While we know that for any job posting no one candidate will possess the qualifications being sought in equal measure, below is an outline of the qualifications we believe are important for a candidate to bring to the position or for the successful candidate to develop while in the role:


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\-7 years of hands\-on data engineering or platform engineering experience, ideally spanning the full lifecycle of architecting, building, and operating production data platforms.
* Deep technical expertise with modern cloud data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, or Databricks and strong knowledge of medallion/lakehouse architecture.
* Strong data modelling and database design skills for analytics and business consumption, including dimensional modelling and semantic layers for self\-serve BI.
* Hands\-on experience developing production\-grade ETL/ELT pipelines and working with data quality, governance, CI/CD, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code practices.
* Experience establishing observability, performance monitoring, reliability standards, and incident\-response practices in production data environments.
* Working knowledge of AI and advanced analytics tooling, including approaches that support natural\-language querying and AI\-powered data products.
* Strong technical judgment, problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non\-technical stakeholder groups.
* Knowledge of foundational data domains, business processes, and enterprise applications is an asset.


We’re looking for a passionate individual who is interested in moving the dial and making a difference. We are an environment that looks to attract hardworking and committed people; people who want to challenge themselves and grow with a globally recognized brand that continues to change the world. If this describes you, consider joining our team. We look forward to reviewing your application.

Director, Finance & Operations

Toronto | Full-time | In person

About AXL

AXL is an AI venture studio with a mission to flip the script of Canadian innovation—creating great companies that carry Canadian values and innovations to the world.

We are looking for a Director of Finance & Operations to build the financial and operational foundation that will enable AXL to grow.

The Role

This is not a conventional comptroller role. We need an entrepreneurial, systems-minded operator who combines financial discipline with a relentless focus on improving how the organization works.
You will treat AXL’s operations as a product and our team members as its customers. When a process fails, your first response should be to understand why—and then simplify, automate, or redesign it. 

While you should be biased towards action, you will not perform every function yourself. AXL works with bookkeepers, lawyers, accountants, technology providers, and other specialists. You will determine what capabilities are needed, engage the right people and tools, and ensure that their work is timely, integrated, and excellent.

You also do not need to be a programmer. You must be able to identify opportunities for automation, define the desired outcome, assemble the right resources, and define the goals for an implementation.
You will report to the CEO and work across AXL and the companies we create.

What you will own

Budgeting, forecasting, cash-flow planning, financial reporting, and controls.
Oversight of bookkeeping, payroll, payables, receivables, tax, audit, insurance, and regulatory obligations.
Clear, decision-useful financial information for the leadership team.
The financial and operational foundations used to launch new ventures.
AXL’s relationships with bookkeepers, accountants, lawyers, banks, insurers, technology vendors, and other providers.
Clear responsibilities, deliverables, and accountability across employees, contractors, and vendors.
The design and continuous improvement of internal workflows and services.
The identification and implementation of useful automation and AI-enabled tools.
A coherent operational environment in which systems, providers, and processes work together.
A world-class internal experience that allows team members to focus on AXL’s mission rather than administration.

What success looks like

Within your first 3 months:
The entire leadership team has a reliable, forward-looking view of AXL’s finances, commitments, and risks.
Our fund investors have a reliable report on their investments designed and delivered.
Core financial and operational responsibilities have clear ownership and are completed consistently.
External providers operate as part of an integrated system, with strong oversight and no important work falling through the gaps.
Employees spend materially less time on administrative tasks.

jobs.description:
**Join a Challenger**  

  

At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Serving nearly 4 million Canadians from coast to coast, we offer a wide variety of financial services from banking and lending, to trust and credit union solutions.  

  

We've been at this since 1970, challenging the conventions of traditional banking with smarter, faster, and more connected financial experiences.  

  

**What's kept us moving?** The people behind it all: challengers who ask better questions, push back on old assumptions, and look for a better way forward.  

  

If you're driven to help reshape how banking works for Canadians and the businesses that power our economy, this could be your next big opportunity.  

  

We can’t wait to get to know you!

**The Work**
------------



The Senior Director, Enterprise Execution is responsible for helping EQB translate strategic priorities into business outcomes.



Working directly with executive leaders across the organization, this role leads a focused portfolio of the Bank's most important enterprise initiatives and strategic priorities. These are high\-impact, cross\-functional efforts that are critical to delivering EQB's strategy, growth ambitions, and financial objectives. The role serves as a bridge between strategy, execution, and outcomes, ensuring that the Bank's biggest priorities maintain momentum, overcome obstacles, and deliver the impact they were intended to achieve.



Enterprise Execution acts as an execution partner to leadership, bringing structured problem\-solving, strategic thinking, and execution discipline to a select group of enterprise priorities. The role combines elements of strategy execution, enterprise leadership, organizational effectiveness, and executive problem\-solving, helping translate strategic ambition into measurable results.



The ideal candidate combines the structured problem\-solving capabilities of a top\-tier strategy consultant with the practical execution mindset of an experienced operator. They are highly comfortable working in ambiguous situations, quickly building credibility with senior stakeholders, and driving progress on complex challenges that cut across multiple business units. They are intellectually curious, commercially minded, and action\-oriented. They know how to move seamlessly between strategy and execution, challenge and support, analysis and action. Most importantly, they have a demonstrated ability to help organizations deliver on their most important priorities and achieve meaningful outcomes.



### **Strategic Initiative Leadership \& Enterprise Priorities (55%)**


* Lead a portfolio of EQB's highest\-priority enterprise initiatives and strategic priorities, including CEO\- and CFO\-sponsored programs.
* Partner directly with executive sponsors and act as a trusted advisor to mobilize, accelerate, and deliver initiatives that are critical to achieving the Bank's strategic and financial objectives.
* Provide hands\-on leadership for complex cross\-functional initiatives requiring enterprise coordination, senior stakeholder alignment, and disciplined execution.
* Shape implementation approaches, execution strategies, operating models, and delivery plans to maximize organizational impact.
* Challenge assumptions, strengthen plans, and improve decision\-making through structured problem solving and rigorous analysis.
* Identify and resolve issues, risks, dependencies, and organizational barriers that could impede successful execution.
* Bring an enterprise\-wide perspective that helps ensure initiatives advance broader corporate objectives.
### **Strategic Execution \& Outcome Realization (25%)**


* Ensure approved business cases and strategic objectives translate into measurable business, customer, operational, and financial outcomes.
* Partner with initiative leaders to strengthen execution plans and improve the likelihood of successful outcomes.
* Identify emerging risks, dependencies, and barriers requiring intervention and help drive resolution.
* Provide executive visibility into initiative progress, key decisions, and areas requiring leadership attention.
* Work closely with Finance, initiative owners, and business leaders to understand expected versus realized outcomes and identify opportunities to improve performance.
* Conduct initiative reviews and post\-implementation assessments to reinforce accountability and continuous improvement.
* Promote a culture of disciplined execution and ownership across enterprise priorities.
### **Enterprise Planning \& Prioritization (10%)**


* Lead the annual enterprise initiative prioritization process as part of EQB's strategic planning cycle.
* Partner with business leaders, Finance, and Strategy teams to identify, evaluate, and prioritize initiatives requiring investment and organizational capacity.
* Facilitate discussions regarding sequencing, trade\-offs, resource allocation, and execution readiness.
* Develop an integrated view of enterprise priorities, dependencies, and investment requirements to support executive decision\-making.
* Help ensure organizational focus remains concentrated on initiatives that create the greatest strategic impact.
### **Executive \& Board Effectiveness (10%)**


* Help ensure EQB's most important strategic priorities, enterprise initiatives, and investment decisions are supported by clear, aligned, and decision\-ready executive and Board materials.
* Partner with senior leaders across the organization to elevate the quality, consistency, and strategic coherence of materials presented to Executive Leadership Team and Board forums.
* Ensure major strategic discussions are informed by a cohesive enterprise perspective and supported by fact\-based, well\-structured recommendations.
* Challenge gaps, inconsistencies, duplication, and disconnects across strategic updates, investment proposals, and enterprise initiatives before they reach decision\-making forums.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Pharmacy Experience and Transformation
jobs.description:
**Location:**

243 Consumers Road, Toronto, Ontario, M2J 4W8
At Shoppers Drug Mart, we’re innovating health and wellness in Canada. From prescriptions to walk\-in clinics, and a beloved loyalty program, we’re caring and supporting our customers in new ways every day.  

With more than 1,300 locally owned and operated stores from coast to coast, the Shoppers Drug Mart network is more than a great place to shop, it’s a great place to work. We’re committed to building our talented team who champion collaboration, kindness and inclusivity. Join our team, and help recognize a healthy future for your career and for all Canadians.

**Why this role is important?**


Reporting to the VP, Pharmacy Operations, Clinical Excellence and Transformation, the Senior Director, Pharmacy Experience and Transformation will lead the strategy and execution of transformational initiatives shaping the future of pharmacy at Shoppers Drug Mart.


This role will own the **pharmacy AI, technology, automation and optimization agenda**, while ensuring that the patient and pharmacy team experience remains at the centre of transformation. The successful candidate will identify and scale opportunities that improve how patients access and experience pharmacy care, simplify pharmacy workflows, enhance team member experience and deliver measurable operational and business value.


Working closely with Pharmacy Operations, Technology, Digital, Clinical Excellence, and other cross\-functional partners, this leader will translate emerging capabilities, patient and team insights, and business opportunities into a clear transformation strategy and roadmap. They will be comfortable operating at both the strategic and execution level, taking initiatives from early\-stage discovery and business case development through implementation, adoption, and scale.

 **What You’ll Do**

* Define and lead the Pharmacy Experience and Transformation strategy and roadmap, with a strong focus on AI, automation, technology and the evolving needs of patients and pharmacy teams.
* Own the pharmacy AI agenda, identifying and prioritizing opportunities to apply AI and emerging technologies to improve patient experience, pharmacy workflows, team member experience and operational performance.
* Lead a portfolio of key transformation initiatives, including Experience Insights \& Analysis, Pharmacy Experience Program (PEP), Rx Delivery, AI Call Agent and Assisted Data Entry.
* Translate strategic opportunities into scalable solutions, leading initiatives from discovery, concept development and business case through implementation, adoption and value realization.
* Champion a patient\- and team\-centred approach to transformation, ensuring new technology and process changes make pharmacy interactions simpler, more seamless and more meaningful.
* Identify opportunities to redesign, simplify and automate pharmacy workflows, reducing administrative burden and enabling pharmacy teams to spend more time supporting patients and delivering care.
* Use patient feedback, pharmacy team insights, operational data, market trends and emerging technology to identify opportunities and shape the future pharmacy experience.
* Partner closely with Pharmacy Operations, Technology, Digital, Clinical Excellence and other teams to align business priorities, technology capabilities and investment against the transformation roadmap.
* Lead experience discovery and analysis to better understand patient and team member pain points, unmet needs and emerging expectations, and translate those insights into actionable transformation priorities.
* Establish clear success measures across patient experience, pharmacy team experience, operational performance and financial value, and monitor outcomes to ensure initiatives are delivering meaningful impact.
* Build alignment across senior stakeholders and cross\-functional teams, bringing clarity and structure to complex transformation opportunities and driving decisions required to move initiatives forward.
* Lead and develop a high\-performing team with a strong culture of strategic thinking, innovation, experimentation, accountability and execution.

 **What You’ll Need**

* Senior leadership experience in strategy, AI, digital transformation, technology, customer experience or large\-scale business transformation.
* Demonstrated ability to develop transformation strategies and take complex initiatives from concept and business case through implementation and scale.
* Strong understanding of AI, automation and emerging technologies, and how they can be applied to improve customer or patient experience, frontline workflows and operational efficiency.
* Strong strategic thinking and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to bring structure and direction to complex or ambiguous opportunities.
* A strong human\-centred mindset, with demonstrated ability to translate patient, customer and frontline team needs into meaningful experience improvements.
* Strong business acumen, including the ability to assess opportunities, build compelling business cases and connect transformation investments to measurable value.
* Proven ability to lead complex, cross\-functional initiatives across operations, technology, digital and business teams.
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to align senior leaders around a transformation agenda.
* Experience using data, insights and performance measures to inform strategy, prioritize opportunities and assess impact.
* Experience in pharmacy, healthcare, retail, technology, consulting or another complex operating environment.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high\-performing teams through significant change and transformation.
* Post\-Secondary education in Industrial or Process Engineer / Technology / Business/ Healthcare or Operations
* 7\-10 years' experience, retail preferred
* MBA or relevant advanced degree is an asset.
* Must be available

jobs.title: Senior Director, Group Product Owner - Enterprise Governance, Risk & Compliance (eGRC)
jobs.description:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients. 

 At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute. 

 To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com 

 What you'll be doing 

 As Senior Director, Group Product Owner – Enterprise Governance, Risk & Compliance (eGRC), you'll shape how CIBC identifies, manages, and responds to operational risk. You will shift our programs from manual, periodic, judgment-based activities to connected, AI-enabled capabilities that anticipate risk, automate routine work, and focus people on the decisions that matter most.
 You will lead CIBC's eGRC ecosystem, including the Operational Risk System (ORS) and enterprise operational risk data governance. With a mandate to rethink, not simply maintain, you'll define the target operating model, investment priorities, and product roadmap; simplify and automate risk work with our program team; and use connected data, advanced analytics, generative and agentic AI, and continuous monitoring to surface emerging risk and improve decisions. You will ensure these capabilities are deployed responsibly through strong data, model, security, privacy, control, and human-in-the-loop practices.

 At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You'll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you'll spend 1-3 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote. 

 How you'll succeed 

 Enterprise Strategy and Transformation - Define the ambition, target operating model, and multi-year roadmap for CIBC's eGRC ecosystem. Align partners and investment to the highest risk and regulatory priorities, making bold, evidence-based choices that create lasting value.
 Enterprise Product Leadership - Set priorities from discovery through adoption and continuous improvement. Establish disciplined governance, translate strategy into a clear roadmap, and use customer, risk, operational, and financial insight to accelerate outcomes and demonstrate value.
 Reimagining Operational Risk Programs - Redesign core programs, including risk and control assessments, control management, issues, incidents, losses, scenarios, regulatory change, and reporting. Replace fragmented manual processes with simpler, automated, connected experiences that improve coverage, reduce administration, and focus attention on the highest-risk exposures and actions.
 AI, Automation and Insight-Driven Risk - Make operational risk data a trusted enterprise asset across eGRC and ORS. Set standards for ownership, quality, lineage, access, retention, and traceability; automate workflows, evidence gathering, monitoring, and reporting; and apply analytics and responsible AI to detect patterns, anticipate risk, and recommend action. Measure success through stronger outcomes, earlier intervention, better user experience, and capacity shifted from administration to judgment.
 Executive Governance and Regulatory Confidence - Establish clear decision rights, accountability, and portfolio oversight. Influence senior forums with concise, forward-looking recommendations, and keep the ecosystem resilient and ready for regulatory and audit scrutiny.
 Enterprise Influence and Coalition Building - Unite Business, Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, Resilience, Third-Party, Technology, Data, and Architecture around a shared vision. Resolve trade-offs and build the executive sponsorship and cross-functional ownership needed for enterprise change.
 Investment, Delivery and Strategic Partnerships - Turn ambition into an executable portfolio by aligning funding, capacity, sequencing, and risk to the highest-value outcomes. Drive performance, innovation, and measurable value while keeping eGRC and ORS stable, secure, and fit for purpose.
 Leadership and Capability Building - Build a high-performing team with the product, risk, data, and transformation capabilities to lead at enterprise scale. Create clarity, empower decisions, and foster curiosity, courage, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement. Oversee the eGRC helpdesk to maintain responsive support and turn recurring pain points into improvements.

 Who you are 

 You're an enterprise transformation leader with 10+ years of progressive leadership across risk, compliance, controls, technology, product, or related disciplines, and a record of delivering complex change in a regulated organization.
 You bring deep operational risk judgment. You understand how frameworks, assessments, controls, issues, losses, data, and regulatory expectations connect, and translate that expertise into practical choices without unnecessary complexity.
 You champion trusted data and high-performing partnerships. You have established data ownership, standards, quality, lineage, and remediation practices, and can challenge and inspire strategic technology vendors to improve performance, innovation, risk management, and value.
 You're a visionary, customer-focused product leader who reimagines risk programs through AI, automation, data, and human-centred design. You turn complex user, business, and regulatory needs into a clear roadmap and align stakeholders around measurable outcomes.
 You have a record of delivering transformation at scale, leading multi-year initiatives from business case and design through implementation, integration, operating model change, adoption, and continuous improvement, with measurable results.
 You're an influential executive partner and storyteller who builds trust across boundaries, simplifies complex risk and technology choices, and communicates with the clarity needed to influence executives, governance committees, and delivery teams.
 You're technically fluent and future-focused. You engage credibly with engineering, architecture, data, automation, design, security, and risk teams; understand platforms, integrations, analytics, generative and agentic AI, and responsible AI controls; and scale promising use cases into governed enterprise capabilities.
 You turn ambiguity into momentum by framing problems, testing hypotheses, learning quickly, and adapting as user needs, technology, risk, and regulatory expectations evolve—without losing sight of the long-term ambition.
 You're an inspiring people leader who creates purpose and clarity, develops strong talent, empowers sound decisions, and enables teams to deliver ambitious outcomes together.
 You bring relevant education and professional credibility. An undergraduate or advanced degree in Business, Risk Management, Technology, Finance, or a related field is preferred; relevant risk, audit, technology, product, or project management designations are an asset.
 Values matter to you. You bring your real self to work, and you live our values - trust, teamwork, and accountability.
 #LI-TA

 What CIBC Offers 

 At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.
 We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive salary, incentive pay, banking benefits, a benefits program*, defined benefit pension plan*, an employee share purchase plan, a vacation offering, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.

 Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.

 We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day; a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

 *Subject to plan and program terms and conditions

 What you need to know 
 CIBC is committed to creating an inclusive environment where all team members and clients feel like they belong. We seek applicants with a wide range of abilities and we provide an accessible candidate experience. If you need accommodation, please contact Mailbox.careers-carrieres@cibc.com 

 CIBC is committed to clarity in our hiring process. All roles posted are opportunities we’re actively recruiting for, unless stated otherwise.

 We may ask you to complete an attribute-based assessment and other skills test (such as simulation, coding, French proficiency). 

 We use artificial intelligence tools during the recruitment process. Our goal for the application process is to get to know more about you, all that you have to offer, and give you the opportunity to learn more about us.

We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.

About this team

Global Product Technology (GPT) delivers the platforms and capabilities that power lululemon’s product lifecycle – from 2D/3D design and development to merchandising, sourcing, assortment planning, master data management, and go to market. We partner closely with design, technical development, merchandising, sourcing, and planning functions to accelerate speed to market and elevate quality through PLM modernization, digital product creation, data and integration platforms, assortment planning, size planning, master data management, analytics, decision-making solutions, and AI assisted workflows.
