jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Almost 1.2 million residents call York Region home, making it one of the largest regions in Canada – and the fastest growing with a population that’s expected to grow to more than 2 million by 2041. Our geography, which is comprised of about 1,800 square kilometers over nine different municipalities, is as beautiful, interesting and diverse as our people. Local government is organized in a two-tier structure and we work together with our local municipalities to provide residents and businesses access to a broad selection of services and resources.

WHAT WE OFFER

Consistently named one of Canada’s Best Employers by Forbes, we offer a collaborative, progressive workplace that takes pride in our organizational culture and is committed to living The 13+ Factors of Psychological Health and Safety in the Workplace – aligned with our vision to create strong, caring and safe communities both within and outside our walls.

Defined Benefit Pension Program - With the Ontario Municipality Employees Retirement System (OMERS) defined benefit pension plan, you can confidently retire knowing that you will have income for life. Eligibility from date of hire as a full-time employee and includes employer-matched contributions. Employer of Choice - Recognized as the highest-ranking government employer in Canada and fourth overall among 300 organizations.

Benefits and Wellness - Employees and their loved ones have access to a comprehensive employer-paid benefits plan that includes extended health, dental and life insurance, access to a 24/7 Employee and Family Assistance Program and corporate discounts and purchase plans for day-to-day products and services.

Inclusive and Diverse Workforce - We’re committed to fostering an environment that celebrates all dimensions of diversity and ensures everyone can develop to their full potential, participate freely in society and live with respect, dignity and freedom from discrimination. Our robust Inclusion, Diversity, Equity and Accessibility program continues to grow, and has been recognized by the United Nations and many other organizations for our leadership.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Reporting to the General Manager, Paramedic & Seniors Services, is responsible for the oversight of program planning and operational policy development for the branch including the developing and implementing a strategy for data, quality assurance and analysis needs to ensure value to drive continuous improvement processes and business decisions; man aging compliance and reporting metrics to quantify service quality standards, key performance indicators (KPI’s) and benchmarks; supporting operational divisions in the investigation of clinical performance concerns/issues; leading the development and implementation of the Paramedic & Seniors Services capital planning and delivery (asset management plans and facility maintenance) in consultation with Property Services; overseeing all contracts, agreement and procurement activities; supporting strategic planning, communication planning and budgeting for the branch; acts as Branch liaison with the Commissioner’s office on Department Strategic Planning and Performance; and overseeing branch information technology projects and on-going technology requirements in coordination with Information Technology (ITS) and Integrated Business Services (IBS) Branch.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Business/Strategic Planning, Budget and Financial Management Functions:

Responsible for the overall direction, goal and strategy setting, development of objectives, and for providing leadership oversight to policies and procedures for all of the division’s areas of business related to operational planning services.
Develops and monitors annual and multi-year branch budgets and business plans, grant application process for funding; and coordinates submission of the Branch budget with the support and guidance of the IBS and in accordance with Regional guidelines and by-laws.
Develops the division’s annual business plan, oversees implementation and monitors the action plan for achieving results, regular evaluation of targets and outcomes, taking corrective action where/when necessary and regularly reporting on progress.
Leads Branch management staff through a process of planning and developing long range objectives and continually promotes on-going management commitment to continuous improvement with respect to the division's areas of business.
Oversees preparation of branch decision documents for regional council and the Commissioner of Community and Health Services, including council reports, business cases, and briefing documents.
Coordinates Branch input into Corporate and Department strategic plans.

Data Analysis, Reporting, Quality Assurance and Performance Management Functions:

Leads Branch data strategy development and implementation in alignment with the Department and Corporate strategic initiatives
Develops and implements overarching short and long-term business plans and strategies related to data collection, analysis and metrics to ensure that data provides value add to support and drive future business decisions.
Oversees data and trend metrics, data analysis and CQI metrics required to define service trends, service gaps; utilizes data to determine the need for process reviews and process changes; and determines the applicability of data to support decision making related to programs and services.
Provides oversight to the development of reports on a variety of data analysis and metrics for senior management to support business decisions, resource needs and service delivery improvement.
Oversees the completion and submission of provincial and regional reporting requirements within the Branch
Leads the implementation of quality improvement frameworks for branch operations including quality assurance activities to monitor program effectiveness and support continuous quality improvement.
Oversees development of key program performance metrics; works with management staff to implement programs and manages performance to meet or exceed targets.
Oversees the attainment of accreditation requirements of Seniors Services with accrediting organizations and participates on provincial task force/committees or compliance reviews on issue (s) as directed.

Contracts and Procurement Management Functions:

Oversees the management of all aspects of the procurement processes and contract requirements for the Branch to ensure that all current and future goods and services requirements are met in consultation with Corporate Procurement office, IBS, Legal, Insurance & Risk and Finance.
Leads all procurement plans for the Branch and develops short / long term strategies to meet operational requirements.
Ensure adherence to the Region’s Purchasing By-law, policies and guidelines.

Capital Delivery, Asset Management and Technology Support Functions:

In partnership with the Property Services and the IBS branches, oversees the development and implementation of capital plans for Paramedic & Seniors Services facilities and in consultation with key stakeholders related to the building or replacement of Paramedic & Seniors Services facilities.
Provides oversight to the implementation of comprehensive systems and programs in the management and maintenance of branch facilities in accordance with legislation and regulations, and internal policies, including risk management and in partnership with Property Services and the Integrated Business Services (IBSB) branches.
Directs the development, implementation, and monitoring of Branch technology systems, processes and practices, including hardware/software requirements in collaboration with ITS and IBSB; liaises with vendors, consultants and provincial staff to integrate and implement communication and data base systems.
In partnership with ITS and the IBS branches, leads and manages project teams, technical and user support for the development, implementation, and evaluation of systems and related technology and network applications and voice/data communications that support programs and fleet, and makes recommendation on technology requirements.

4. Human Resource Management and Team Leadership Responsibilities:

Supervises staff, including recruitment, selection, hiring, assigning work, determining training and development needs, conducting performance appraisals and determining/recommending disciplinary action up to and including dismissal, in accordance with collective agreements, Regional policies and practices; ensures adherence to appropriate Regional HR policies and government legislation.

Communication, Liaison and Customer Service Activities:

In consultation with Strategic Department Communications, coordinates Branch internal and external branch communication planning activities
Represents the branch on negotiations with consultants, contractors, external agencies/groups, local municipalities, etc., as directed.
Chairs and/or participates on committees, task forces, working groups and special projects; represents the Region on external committees, meetings, as required.
Prepares Committee and Council reports as well as the preparation of detailed technical reports required for all processes, standards and materials required for project/program approval.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Successful completion of a University Degree in Business, Health, Public Administration, or a related discipline, or approved equivalent combination of education and experience.
Minimum of seven (7) years’ program planning and administration experience, including significant direct senior managerial experience that includes, capital planning and delivery, budget administration and business planning, strategic planning, policy development and implementation, procurement, and experience managing data and quality improvement initiatives, including a minimum of three (3) years’ of direct senior managerial experience that includes program, financial, budget administration and human resource management.
Demonstrated knowledge of applicable legislation, municipal and Regional government organization and structure, industry standards, issues and communities served.
Knowledge of and demonstrated ability in strategic planning, change management design, process and implementation strategies to optimize both quality and cost-effectiveness of services.
Demonstrated political acumen and ability to negotiate, mediate, facilitate and present information to a varied audience.
Knowledge of and demonstrated ability in strategic planning, change management design, process and implementation strategies to optimize both quality and cost-effectiveness of services.
Demonstrated knowledge of the provincial health care system and experience working with local health care providers.
Demonstrated knowledge and application of financial budget and business planning processes.
Strong analytical, problem solving, decision making, report writing and presentation skills.
Computer literacy in a Windows environment utilizing Microsoft Office applications.
As a condition of employment, candidates will be required to provide a satisfactory Police Vulnerable Sector Check (PVSC), tuberculosis screening and proof of immunization in accordance with the Fixing Long-Term Care Act (FLTCA), 2021.
A valid Class “G” drivers’ license, clear of serious offences under the Highway Traffic Act.

jobs.description:
Position Summary...
The Senior Director, Digital and Media is responsible for setting and leading Walmart Canada’s enterprise growth marketing strategy across online and offline media, SEO, and customer engagement.

This role is accountable for building an integrated, full-funnel growth engine that drives customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty, and lifetime value across omni-channel and eCommerce businesses, ensuring marketing investments are aligned to core business priorities and deliver measurable impact. Operating as a senior enterprise leader, this role sets growth priorities, governs investment decisions, and establishes performance standards that guide how media and customer engagement drive business outcomes.

What You'll Do...

Define and own Walmart Canada’s holistic growth marketing strategy across Paid Media, SEO, CRM, Walmart Delivery Pass acquisition and retention, and customer lifecycle management, ensuring alignment to enterprise business priorities.
Strategic leadership across owned marketing media investments for both Store and eCommerce, as well as advertiser-funded offsite retail media programs through Walmart Connect, ensuring media strategies are aligned to Walmart Canada business objectives while delivering measurable value for advertising partners.
Set the strategic vision and operating model for Walmart Delivery Pass marketing, including member acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, and value communication, in close partnership with Product and Membership teams.
Lead customer engagement strategy across CRM channels (email, push, in-app, SMS, personalization, and others), defining lifecycle frameworks that drive frequency, retention, lifetime value, and customer advocacy.
Own enterprise SEO strategy across eCommerce, ensuring organic traffic growth complements paid media, improves efficiency, and strengthens long-term customer acquisition.
Own the enterprise measurement vision across media, CRM, SEO, and Walmart Delivery Pass, establishing KPI frameworks, attribution models, experimentation standards, and incrementality approaches that clearly quantify growth impact.
Provide executive oversight of marketing investment across paid media, lifecycle channels, and membership marketing, ensuring disciplined prioritization, trade-off decisions, and ROI optimization.
Serve as a senior marketing leader partnering with eCommerce, Merchandising, Membership, Walmart Connect, Analytics, Finance, Product, and Technology to align growth priorities, roadmaps, and investment decisions.
Leadership of multi-disciplinary internal teams and agency partners across media, customer engagement, SEO, and measurement, establishing modern operating models, performance standards, and capability roadmaps, while building strong talent pipelines and succession plans that scale with business growth.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
15+ years of progressive experience across growth marketing, media, customer engagement, or digital commerce, including senior leadership roles.
Proven experience managing directors and senior leaders across multiple marketing disciplines.
Deep expertise in paid media, SEO, CRM, lifecycle marketing, and membership-based growth models.
Strong understanding of MarTech and AdTech ecosystems, measurement, attribution, experimentation, and privacy-safe data usage.
Demonstrated ability to translate complex performance data into executive-level insights and decisions.
Experience in retail, grocery, subscription, or omni-channel environments strongly preferred.

Leadership Expectations

Respect the Individual:

Builds high-performing teams; seeks, and embraces differences in people, cultures, ideas and experiences; creates a workplace and experiences where all associates feel seen, supported and connected through culture of belonging so associates thrive and perform; drives a positive associate and customer experience for all.

Creates a discipline and focus around developing talent through feedback, coaching, mentoring, and developmental opportunities; builds the talent pipeline, fosters an environment allowing everyone to bring their best selves to work, empowers associates and partners to act in the best interest of the customer and company, and regularly recognizes others’ contributions and accomplishments; supports strategies and drives initiatives that attract and retain the best talent.

Builds strong and trusting relationships with team members and business partners; works collaboratively and cross-functionally to achieve objectives; and communicates and listens attentively, with energy and positivity to motivate, influence, and inspire commitment and action.

Acts With Integrity

Maintains and promotes the highest standards of integrity, ethics and compliance; models the Walmart values and leads by example to foster our culture; supports Walmart’s goal of becoming a regenerative company by taking action to advance opportunity, sustainability, community, and integrity (e.g., creating fair opportunities for associates and suppliers, driving local giving efforts).

Ensures that teams follow the law, our code of conduct and company policies; promotes an environment where associates feel comfortable sharing concerns, and models our culture of non-retaliation; listens to concerns raised by associates and takes action, and enables others to do the same; holds self and teams accountable for achieving results in a way that is consistent with our values.

Acts as an altruistic servant leader and is consistently humble, self-aware.

Serve Our Customers

Delivers expected business results while putting the customer first and consistently applying an omni-merchant mindset and acting with an Every Day Low Cost mindset to drive value and Every Day Low Prices for customers.

Adopts a holistic perspective that considers data, analytics, customer insights, and different parts of the business when making plans and implementing strategies.

Strive For Excellence

Consistently raises the bar and seeks to improve; demonstrates curiosity and a growth mindset; seeks feedback, asks thoughtful questions, and fosters an environment that supports learning, innovation, learning from mistakes, and intelligent risk-taking; and exhibits resilience in the face of setbacks.

Drives continuous improvements, supervises the adoption of new technology, and supports digital disruption in line with Walmart’s business model.

jobs.title: Director, Talent Management & Workforce Insights
jobs.description:
Putting people first, every day

BDO is a firm built on a foundation of positive relationships with our people and our clients. Each day, our professionals provide exceptional service, helping clients with advice and insight they can trust. In turn, we offer an award-winning environment that fosters a people-first culture with a high priority on your personal and professional growth.

Your Opportunity

Reporting to the Chief Human Resources Officer and serving as a member of the HR Leadership Team, the Director, Talent Management & Workforce Insights
leads a broad enterprise portfolio spanning Total Rewards, Organizational Development, HR Operations and People Analytics. The role is accountable for the ongoing evolution of the firm's people programs, systems and enterprise HR services, ensuring they support business priorities and deliver a consistent and high-quality experience for our people.

Working closely with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition and leaders across the firm, the Director translates the firm's people strategy into practical, scalable and measurable outcomes. Through workforce insights, organizational expertise and disciplined execution, the role enables better people decisions across the firm while helping leaders strengthen organizational and business performance.

Key Accountabilities

Portfolio Leadership

Lead the Talent Management & Workforce Insights portfolio, establishing clear priorities, accountabilities and measures of success.
Translate the firm's people strategy into firmwide initiatives, investments and outcomes that support business objectives.
Use market intelligence, workforce data and business insights to identify, inform and translate opportunities, strategies, risks and decisions into practical recommendations.
Ensure programs, systems and services operate as an integrated portfolio that delivers value for the business and our people.
Drive the ongoing evaluation and continuous improvement of enterprise people programs, policies and services.
Foster strong collaboration across HR to ensure firmwide solutions are practical, scalable and responsive to business needs.

Total Rewards, Performance & Wellbeing

Provide strategic leadership for the firm's Total Rewards portfolio, including compensation, recognition, benefits, wellbeing and performance management.
Ensure rewards programs remain competitive, sustainable and aligned with business priorities, market trends and workforce expectations.
Oversee the design and evolution of reward, recognition and performance practices that support attraction, retention, engagement and a high-performance culture.

Workforce Insights & Analytics

Advance the firm's workforce insights capability by evolving People Analytics into a strategic source of insight and decision support.
Identify workforce trends, risks and opportunities through reporting, analytics and data-driven analysis, translating findings into actionable recommendations.
Strengthen workforce data governance, analytics capability and evidence-based decision-making across HR programs, workforce planning and talent strategies.

Organizational Effectiveness & Development

Lead the evolution of the firm's organizational effectiveness agenda, ensuring BDO has the leadership, organizational capabilities and workforce readiness required to support future business needs.
Partner with business leaders and HR Business Partners to strengthen leadership effectiveness, team performance, organizational design and change readiness across the firm.
Advance scalable organizational development practices that help the firm adapt to changing workforce expectations, emerging technologies and evolving business priorities.

HR Operations & Service Excellence

Provide strategic leadership for HR operations, systems and service delivery, ensuring efficient, consistent and high-quality support for employees, leaders and HR teams.
Modernize HR processes and ways of working by leveraging technology, automation and AI to improve efficiency, user experience and business outcomes.
Establish service standards, governance and performance measures that promote accountability, operational excellence and continuous improvement.

Stakeholder Relationships & People Leadership

Build trusted relationships across the firm and serve as a strategic advisor on talent, workforce and organizational matters.
Lead and develop a high-performing team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement and innovation.
Strengthen leadership capability, succession and organizational effectiveness across the Talent Management & Workforce Insights portfolio.

What You Will Help Us Achieve

Success in this role means:

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer (Part-Time/Fractional)
jobs.description:
BIMM is a Toronto-based agency operating at the intersection of data, technology, and creativity, building high-performing digital products and connected customer experiences for clients across automotive, financial services, telco, and retail. Our technology practice has grown quickly: today it's roughly 60 people delivering close to $13M in direct technology work each year, spanning web, mobile, and backend engineering, QA, and a growing AI practice, in support of some of BIMM's most important client relationships.

Who we're looking for

BIMM is engaging a Fractional Chief Technology Officer to help shape the next phase of our technology organization. Our technology practice is scaling quickly, in size, in the breadth of what we deliver, and in the strategic weight it carries with clients, and we want experienced technology leadership to help design the structure, leadership bench, and operating model that carries us through that growth. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role reporting directly to the CEO, working closely with BIMM's existing technology leadership team.

This is an active role with immediate impact and a clear place on the team.

Engagement:
Part-time / fractional, 2 to 3 days per week. 6-month initial term, with option to extend. We are looking for candidates (within the GTHA) that are able to work out of our beautiful office space in the Distillery District 2 days per week

In this role you will:

Shape the structure.
Partner with BIMM's CEO and technology leadership team to design an organizational structure and operating model that scales with BIMM's growth, across strategy, roadmap, presales, and delivery.
Develop leaders.
Coach and develop BIMM's existing technology leaders, building their capability and confidence to operate at the next level as the organization scales.
Strengthen partnerships.
Build a strong, senior relationship with BIMM's key technology partners, including our work with Audi RED, and help define how BIMM's architecture and delivery teams collaborate with partner organizations.
Govern initiatives & client focus.
Establish the governance and process that lets BIMM invest in its own technology initiatives while maintaining focus on clients, spanning web, mobile, AI, and emerging technology.
Support growth.
Provide senior technical leadership on new business pitches, proposals, and client opportunities.
Shape what's next.
Partner with BIMM's CEO on what long-term technology leadership should look like as the organization continues to scale.

Success in the first 90 days:

A clear view of BIMM's technology organization, its strengths, and where structure needs to evolve to support growth.
A proposed organizational and operating model, developed in partnership with the CEO and current leadership team.
Regular working sessions established with BIMM's technology leaders.

Success in the first 6 months:

New structure and ways of working in motion.
A sustainable model in place for balancing strategy, roadmap, presales, and delivery across a growing team.
A strong, senior relationship established with BIMM's key technology partners.
A clear recommendation delivered to the CEO on BIMM's long-term technology leadership needs.

Requirements

Extensive experience leading technology organizations, ideally within an agency, consultancy, or professional services environment.
Experience leading global teams that blend local, nearshore, and offshore resourcing, and able to advise on evolving BIMM's own model.
Experience operating in a fractional, interim, or advisory capacity.
A strong track record managing complex client and partner relationships, including joint venture or embedded delivery models; automotive experience is an asset.
A leader who develops people as much as technology, comfortable coaching and building senior teams.
Broad technical credibility across web, mobile, AI, QA, and architecture (BIMM's core stack includes React, Node.js, native Swift, and Kotlin Multiplatform).
Comfortable operating at the executive table and directly with clients and partners.

Even if you don’t meet all of the above requirements, we still encourage you to apply!

Culture: Our squad is fun, friendly and entirely egoless. Our social committee plans BIMM bashes, Tasty Thursdays and quarterly outings like candle making workshops, board game nights, Jays games and cooking classes. BIMM is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all applicants for employment without discrimination. Please let us know if accommodation for the recruitment or interview process is required, and we will work with you to make sure your needs are met.

jobs.description:
Company Description
PORTA – Tradizione Italiana is one of North America’s fastest-growing frozen pizza brands, bringing authentic Italian craftsmanship to over 3,000 retail locations across the U.S. and Canada. Developed by the culinary team behind Terroni, PORTA combines chef-curated recipes with premium ingredients sourced from Italy to elevate frozen food standards. The brand uses traditional techniques, such as slow-fermented dough and flash-freezing at peak freshness, to deliver restaurant-quality pizza at home in under 15 minutes. While pizza is the foundation, PORTA’s broader mission is to make authentic Italian cuisine effortless at home and bring the best of Italy to more tables. Applicants will join a growing company with strong presence in natural retailers and a focus on quality, innovation, and customer experience.

Role Description
The Director / VP of Finance is a full-time, remote role with its head office in Toronto, Canada. This position oversees all finance and accounting operations, including budgeting, forecasting, cash flow management, and monthly, quarterly, and annual closing activities. The role is responsible for preparing, reviewing, and analyzing financial statements and reports, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery to leadership and stakeholders. The Director / VP of Finance will support strategic decision-making by providing financial insights, modeling business scenarios, and evaluating investments, pricing, and product profitability. Day-to-day tasks include managing financial controls, coordinating with external auditors, optimizing systems and processes, partnering with cross-functional teams (such as operations, sales, and supply chain), and building a scalable finance function to support PORTA’s rapid growth.

Qualifications
Strong Finance foundation, including experience leading financial operations and partnering with executive leadership.
Expertise in Financial Planning, including budgeting, forecasting, and long-range financial modeling.
Ability to prepare, interpret, and present Financial Statements, with a deep understanding of accounting principles.
Proficiency in Financial Reporting, including management reporting, KPI dashboards, and board-level presentations.
Advanced Analytical Skills to evaluate performance, assess risk, support strategic decisions, and drive process improvements.
Experience in CPG, food and beverage, or retail environments is strongly preferred.
Proven leadership experience managing teams and building finance capabilities in a growth-oriented company.
Professional designation (CPA, CFA, or equivalent) and a university degree

About You

University or college degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; MBA or CPA an asset
8+ years of progressive finance experience, ideally in CPG, food & beverage, or consumer products. Startup experience is an asset.
Deep FP&A expertise with a proven ability to turn data into strategic recommendations
Strong command of retail and grocery economics, including trade spend, slotting, deductions, retailer margin, and velocity metrics
Commercially minded, with a track record of partnering cross-functionally and influencing senior decision-makers
Experience supporting investors, board reporting, or fundraising, ideally in an early or growth-stage company
Hands-on and resourceful, comfortable operating with a lean team and directing analysts and outsourced support
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to make finance accessible to non-finance stakeholders
Deadline-driven and highly organized, with strong attention to detail
Ability to operate in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities

The Perks

Competitive compensation package
Benefits
Remote work
Free pizza!

Location

This role is hybrid for candidates based in Toronto and fully remote for candidates elsewhere in Canada.

To Apply

Interested in joining the PORTA team? Email careers@eatporta.com

PORTA is committed to providing a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace. Our people are our business and we celebrate our differences, encourage a breadth of perspectives, and offer equal opportunity for all employees to join and excel at our company. Our momentum is growing, and is fueled by innovation, collaboration, and a shared entrepreneurial spirit that drives real results. Founded in 2012 in Mississauga, Ontario, OSL delivers customized sales solutions in retail, direct sales, and customer acquisition, all built on a foundation of integrity, respect, and passion. Our culture thrives on connection, purpose, and growth. If you’re looking for a place where your talents are valued, your ideas matter, and your career can grow, we’d love to meet you.

About the opportunity:

Director, Information Technology and Digital Transformation

OSL Retail Services is a technology-enabled sales and retail services organization supporting some of North America’s leading brands. As Director, Information Technology and Digital Transformation, you will lead the delivery and evolution of enterprise technology services that support corporate operations, field teams, client programs, analytics, and business transformation initiatives.

Reporting to the SVP, Data and Technology, you will lead a team of managers and technical leads, alongside external partners and managed service providers. You will be responsible for ensuring OSL’s technology ecosystem, including cloud platforms, cybersecurity, enterprise applications, service management, AI governance, and digital workplace services, remains secure, scalable, resilient, and aligned to business objectives.

This role is the critical bridge between the SVP’s strategic direction and day to day technology delivery, translating strategy into measurable outcomes, while maintaining a strong focus on governance, operational excellence and value realization.

Location: Mississauga

Role Responsibilities:

Technology Strategy & Direction

Contribute to and execute the multi-year technology strategy in partnership with the SVP, Data and Technology, translating strategic direction into delivery roadmaps, programs, and measurable outcomes.
Identify opportunities where technology, automation, analytics, and AI can improve productivity, compliance, and competitive differentiation, and bring forward business cases for prioritization.
Provide leadership and oversight for technology governance, architecture standards, and enterprise technology decision-making within the role's mandate.
Ensure technology investments are prioritized based on business value, risk reduction, operational efficiency, and strategic alignment.

Enterprise Architecture & Technology Governance

Establish and maintain technology standards, reference architectures, and governance processes across the enterprise.
Ensure technology solutions are scalable, supportable, secure, and aligned with long-term business requirements.
Oversee Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) governance, source code management, release management, and deployment controls.
Drive technology rationalization and reduction of technical debt through platform consolidation and modernization initiatives.
Maintain oversight of enterprise SaaS platforms and ensure effective integration across business systems.

IT Operations & Service Delivery

Oversee enterprise IT service delivery across applications, infrastructure, networks, and SaaS platforms.
Ensure systems are stable, secure, and performant to support retail, field, and corporate environments.
Establish and maintain governance for incident management, change management, and release processes.
Drive continuous improvement in service reliability, responsiveness, and user experience
Ensure technology services support a geographically distributed workforce across retail, field, and corporate environments while maintaining consistent service levels and user experience.

Digital Transformation, Automation & AI Enablement

Lead enterprise modernization initiatives including cloud adoption, platform consolidation, workflow automation, and digital workplace transformation.
Operationalize and mature OSL's established enterprise AI governance program, aligned to ISO 42001 and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, covering employee AI use, AI capabilities within SaaS platforms, and internally developed solutions.
Partner with business leaders to identify automation opportunities that improve productivity, reduce manual effort, and enhance data quality.
Deliver scalable, integrated solutions that support analytics, reporting, and operational decision-making, in partnership with the Business Intelligence and Data Services teams.
Balance innovation with operational resilience, cybersecurity requirements, compliance obligations, and cost management.

Financial Stewardship & Vendor Management

Manage the operational technology budget and contribute to the annual technology planning and investment prioritization led by the Executive Leadership Team.
Establish business cases and ROI measures for major technology investments and transformation programs.
Identify opportunities to optimize cost‑to‑serve through consolidation, automation, and strategic sourcing.
Manage vendor relationships, contract renewals, and licensing across the technology portfolio.

Cross Functional Partnership & Enablement

Build strong partnerships with Operations, Client Services, Finance, HR, Sales, and Analytics teams.
Act as a trusted technology advisor to business leaders, translating needs into scalable, secure solutions.
Represent IT in cross‑functional planning forums, transformation initiatives, and program reviews.
Ensuring technology decisions reflect both business value and operational reality.

Leadership & Team Development

Lead, coach and develop a technology team, alongside external partners responsible for the delivery of enterprise technology services.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer service excellence.
Establish succession planning, skills development, and workforce planning strategies that support future organizational growth.
Ensure team objectives, performance measures, and priorities are aligned to corporate goals.

What You Bring to the Table

10+ years of progressive Information Technology experience, including leadership responsibility for enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, applications, or digital transformation initiatives.
5+ years in a senior leadership role managing cross-functional technology teams, including experience leading through managers or team leads.
Experience leading enterprise cloud transformation initiatives utilizing Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 platforms.
Experience operating within a regulated or compliance-driven environment, including responding to clients or external security and audit requirements.
Experience supporting ISO 27001 or comparable security and governance frameworks.
Experience managing enterprise service management platforms and ITIL-based processes.
Experience evaluating and governing emerging technologies, including Artificial Intelligence and automation platforms.
Experience managing technology budgets and contributing to enterprise-level financial planning.
Experience supporting geographically distributed workforces across retail, field, and corporate environments.
Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or related field or equivalent experience.

Preferred Certifications

ITIL Foundation or higher
CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or equivalent security certification
Microsoft Azure certification
ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor (asset)
Project Management certification (PMP or equivalent) (asset)

Let's Talk Perks

The salary range for this role is $150K to $170K, your final compensation will reflect your years of experience and beyond the numbers, we’re proud to offer a holistic package that includes:

Generous time off: Start with 3 weeks of vacation.
Comprehensive benefits package: Includes medical, dental, vision and a health spending account.
Retirement support: Company-sponsored RRSP matching program to help build your financial future.
Award-winning culture: Proud to be one of Canada’s Best Managed Companies for 8 years running — now a Platinum Club member.
Invested in you: Structured employee development programs designed to help you thrive.

We’re committed to supporting your success every step of the way. What are the next steps?

Step 2: The next step is an in-person interview with the SVP, Data and Technology.
Step 3: Final step is an in-person interview with the Chief Operating Officer.

We’re excited to share that JDRF Canada is now Breakthrough T1D.

We’re the same organization, with the same mission and determination to realize a world free from type 1 diabetes (T1D) – just with a new name and look that reflects what the T1D community needs now and next.

It’s an exciting time to join Breakthrough T1D as we continue to break barriers to help people better manage the disease and enjoy full, healthy lives. Curing T1D is and always will be our north star and we will not stop until breakthroughs get us to a world free from T1D.
Breakthrough T1D is searching for an experienced leader in Information Technology for the role of National Director, Information Technology.

If you’re a strategic, innovative and collaborative leader who would like to lead the next chapter of the organization’s digital evolution by developing and delivering a multi-year information technology strategy, roadmap and portfolio aligned with Breakthrough T1D’s strategic priorities, please read on to see if this is the right fit for you.

Here’s what your primary responsibilities would be:

Works with the Senior Leadership Team to develop and execute a multi-year IT and digital strategy, roadmap and investment portfolio aligned with organizational priorities and supported by business cases, resource plans, budgets, performance measures and clear accountabilities.
Leads Breakthrough T1D’s responsible AI strategy and portfolio, including governance, approved-use standards, privacy and security controls, vendor due diligence, human oversight, staff education, prioritized use cases and benefits measurement.
Provides planning, resourcing, oversight and accountability for the IT portfolio, including enterprise applications, infrastructure, digital platforms, data and analytics, cybersecurity, service delivery and technology-enabled innovation.
Partners with business leaders to assess needs, select solutions and oversee the design, implementation and integration of technologies that support mission delivery, research collaboration, fundraising, advocacy and organizational operations.
Develops, implements and maintains Breakthrough T1D’s cybersecurity framework, policies and controls, aligned with organizational risk, privacy and data sovereignty requirements and applicable standards.
Leads the enterprise data and analytics strategy, including data ownership, quality, classification, integration, retention, privacy, governance, reporting and the development of trusted organizational and constituent insights.
Builds, motivates and retains a highly engaged, customer-centred information technology team aligned with Breakthrough T1D’s values, vision and strategic priorities.

Here’s what we’re looking for:

Knowledge/Skills/Experience
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, business technology or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
A minimum of seven (7) years of progressive leadership experience across information technology, digital transformation, project and portfolio management, enterprise applications, infrastructure, cybersecurity, data and service delivery, including experience leading complex enterprise-wide initiatives and multidisciplinary teams.
Demonstrated experience managing IT environments with cybersecurity, privacy, and data sovereignty requirements comparable to those of federally Canadian organizations.
Demonstrated experience leading enterprise digital transformation involving cloud platforms, enterprise architecture, systems integration, digital products, vendor ecosystems and organizational change.

Working Style
Applies sound judgment, initiative and a strong sense of organization and urgency in a changing environment.
Communicates complex information clearly and credibly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, senior executives and governance bodies.
Demonstrates strong business analysis, project and financial management capabilities and a record of leading successful cross-functional initiatives.
Builds trusted relationships through a collaborative, customer-centred and business-focused approach.

Demonstrated experience overseeing high-volume transactional websites, CRM platforms, digital fundraising or engagement solutions, and internal collaboration and information-sharing platforms; experience with not-for-profit enterprise systems is an asset.
Strong knowledge of cybersecurity, privacy, data sovereignty, records and information management, accessibility, responsible AI, cyber resilience and third-party technology risk in a Canadian context.
Project, program, technology governance, security or service management certification is an asset.
Translates organizational strategy and stakeholder needs into practical technology priorities, investment decisions and outcomes.

The salary range for this role is anticipated to be $125,000 - $160,000, commensurate with skills and experience level of the selected candidate.

Location Preference:
Anywhere within Canada

Application Deadline:
Please submit your resume through our careers website by October 12, 2026.

About Breakthrough T1D

Breakthrough T1D is the leading type 1 diabetes (T1D) research and advocacy non-profit organization in Canada. As we drive toward curing type 1 diabetes, we help to make every day better for the people who live with it.

Breakthrough T1D (formerly JDRF) began in Canada as a grassroots organization in 1974, when a group of dedicated parents came together with a singular goal of finding a cure for T1D. Since the discovery of insulin, Breakthrough T1D has remained at the forefront of T1D research. Breakthrough T1D is committed to investing in the most promising research, advocating for progress by working with governments to address issues that impact the T1D community, and supporting individuals living with this disease.

Breakthrough T1D has a company culture rooted in our Core Values; Adapt and Thrive, Collaborate, Accountable, Innovate, Act with Purpose – if our core values are exemplified in the way that you work, we might be a great fit for each other.

Here’s a few details about what Breakthrough T1D employees receive:

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Product at Brex

The Product team is at the forefront of Brex's mission to empower employees anywhere to make better financial decisions. With a deep understanding of the business, we identify and scope out the most impactful opportunities for Brex to tackle. We are responsible for aligning cross-functional teams — such as Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Design — on key decisions. We set strategy and drive products from inception to launch, enabling Brex to grow rapidly and help our customers reach their full potential.

What You’ll Do

As a Product Leader at Brex, you will be the driving force behind our Growth Product team — overseeing the thoughtful strategy and execution of team and technical systems to drive customer acquisition and onboarding. You will also collaborate closely with our Go-to-Market (GTM) teams to ensure seamless acquisition and onboarding for customers, particularly those with significant and complex spending needs. You will be instrumental in creating features, models, and tools that empower our GTM and Marketing teams to get maximal leverage out of their efforts. You will work closely with cross-functional teams across the organization, based in San Francisco, New York, Seattle, Vancouver, Brazil, and remote locations. Past examples of work in this domain include AI agents for GTM workflows, developing best-in-class GTM data and enrichment systems, ML models for account prioritization, prospect AI classification systems, and more.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in either our San Francisco, Seattle, or New York City office. You must be willing to work in the office at least three days per week on Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. Employees will be able to work remotely for up to four weeks per year, for a minimum of one week at a time.

Responsibilities

Drive product and systems investments that improve GTM metrics such as CAC payback, pipeline conversion, and efficiency.
Define and execute a multi-quarter Growth strategy in partnership with Engineering, Design, GTM, Marketing, Ops, and Data to deliver high-impact, scalable products with measurable business impact.
Embed within Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to identify workflow bottlenecks and lead automation and optimization initiatives.
Analyze GTM funnel and conversion metrics to uncover insights and guide product priorities and roadmap decisions.
Set clear goals, metrics, and success criteria for the Growth team, driving accountability to measurable outcomes.
Manage and develop a team of Product Managers, fostering clarity, ownership, and a culture of high performance.
Oversee core Growth Product and Engineering domains, including account scoring, TAM data, outbound automation, and GTM tooling.
Align stakeholders around an aspirational 6–12 month roadmap that advances GTM efficiency and business growth.
Ensure successful activation and implementation of customers initiatives by partnering with GTM and Customer Success to operationalize tooling and automations.
Continuously refine activation based on feedback and performance data to drive faster time-to-value and sustainable adoption.

Requirements

Relevant experience: 10+ years of experience in product management or management consulting, ideally with direct responsibility for or experience scaling B2B products and GTM systems, with a strong understanding of growth, GTM, and/or marketing pipelines.
Analytical sense: You demonstrate a strong aptitude for and actively use data to inform your decision-making. Basic SQL proficiency is strongly preferred.
Communication: You have proven experience working and communicating effectively with senior leaders and executives, and influencing stakeholders across departments and functions, including Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, CRMX/Business Systems, IT, Legal, and more. You excel at building trust and working relationships.
Systems-thinker: You are a systems thinker, capable of thinking holistically across product, technical, and people systems to identify bottlenecks and opportunities for efficiency, automation, fraud prevention, and product growth within the payables ecosystem.

Compensation

jobs.title: Director, Finance
jobs.description:
About RouteThis

RouteThis is on a mission to revolutionize technical support. We build AI-powered solutions that help Internet Service Providers and Smart Home companies solve connectivity and WiFi problems before the subscriber ever needs to call.

The Role

RouteThis is 10 years in and moving from a SaaS business to an AI-native one. That shift changes the shape of the P&L, the way revenue is recognized and the questions leadership needs Finance to answer. The Director, Finance leads the function through it.

This is an FP&A-led role. The priority is planning, forecasting and cash, with Finance acting as a partner in business decisions rather than a function that reports on them afterwards. The core planning model and reporting structure are being put in place now. The Director will come in as that work lands, understand how and why it was built, and own it from there. There is still plenty to shape, including finance rhythms, spending approvals and forecasting cadence.

This role reports to the Chief Operating Officer, who leads Finance for the company and presents to the board. The Director prepares the finance materials that go to the board and leads the Financial Controller day to day. It is a hands-on role in a lean, AI-enabled team.

What You'll Do

FP&A.
Build and maintain the live weekly forecast across ARR by product line, expense and cash, and lead the annual budgeting process.
Business partnership.
Act as a thought partner to the COO and CEO, bringing forward-looking analysis into strategy and business planning before decisions are made.
Reporting and close.
Own the monthly and quarterly close, including the SaaS versus AI revenue and P&L split, and prepare board and investor materials in partnership with the COO.
Cash and treasury.
Manage runway, covenants, AR and AP, collections and foreign exchange exposure.
Team and rhythms.
Lead the Financial Controller and design the internal finance rhythms the company runs on: collections, spending approvals and forecasting cadence.
Governance.
Support audit readiness, insurance review and internal controls as the company scales.
Cross-functional partnership.
Partner with Sales, Customer Success and Professional Services on unit economics and pricing model support.
AI and tooling.
Use AI and modern finance tools to keep a small team efficient, and keep improving how the function works.

What You Bring

CPA, CA or CMA designation.
Seven or more years of progressive finance experience, with meaningful time in FP&A rather than primarily a controllership or close-focused track.
Experience in a SaaS or subscription business. Exposure to more than one revenue model, or to usage-based revenue recognition, is a strong asset.
Experience preparing board and investor materials and cash forecasts in close partnership with a CEO, COO or CFO.
Fluency building live, rolling financial models.
Comfort operating without a CFO in place and taking ownership of a newly built model and process.
A hands-on, practical approach. You are as comfortable in the detail as you are in a leadership conversation.
Comfort with AI tools and an interest in using them more.
A clear, confident communicator with the CEO, COO and board.

Why RouteThis

Ownership.
Direct visibility to the CEO, COO and board, with real ownership of the finance function.
Timing.
A 10-year-old business with a product that works, moving from SaaS to AI-native. You will see the numbers change and help lead the company through it.
Team.
A close, highly motivated team that prefers to promote from within.
Time off.
Every long weekend, the Friday is off too. The company closes for a week between Christmas and New Year.

Package

CAD $180,000 to $200,000 Competitive benefits through Manulife: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance Employee Assistance Program Equity: Stock Options 3 weeks vacation plus an additional 10 days around statutory holidays
Our downtown Kitchener office has an onsite gym and weekly team lunches. For remote team members we run other social activities.

Location

Headquartered in downtown Kitchener, Ontario, with hybrid work arrangements. Kitchener-based candidates are preferred. We will also consider strong candidates in the Toronto area who can be in Kitchener regularly.

How We Hire

We use AI tools to support our recruitment process, including helping us organize applications and identify early matches based on role criteria. That said, every rejection decision is made by a human. We encourage candidates to apply authentically and avoid relying solely on AI-generated responses, especially during interviews.

Do you feel like you're able to tackle this role? Show us what you got! We absolutely don't expect applicants to check off every box for any of our positions, and welcome you to apply if you feel like you are an excellent fit.

This opportunity is offered through HighlightTA, the on-demand talent team supporting RouteThis's growth.

RouteThis is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial or local law. Please let us know if you require an accommodation due to a disability, and RouteThis will work with you to address your needs.

Job Description:

Role Summary

The AVP Technology Lead – Digital is a strategic technology leader responsible for enabling, scaling, and modernizing Sun Life Canada’s shared digital platforms that support secure, connected, and frictionless Client and advisor experiences. This role provides technology leadership across core digital assets including Secure Web, Public Web, & Secure Mobile, and related enablement platforms such as client identity and access management, and an internal design system.

The role combines strategic leadership, technical oversight, people leadership, delivery execution, operational accountability, and vendor/financial management to drive technology excellence and measurable business value. The AVP partners closely with Product, Client Experience, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Operations, Engineering, and Business leaders to ensure digital assets are resilient, scalable, secure, reusable, and aligned to enterprise priorities.

This role operates in a complex, high-visibility environment where digital platform reliability, modernization, and cross-business enablement are critical to Client outcomes. The leader must be able to bring clarity to a broad mandate, make decisions in ambiguity, and build a high-performing technology organization that balances speed, stability, security, and long-term platform health.

What will you do?

Technology Strategy, Platform Enablement & Engineering
Shape, communicate, and align the digital technology strategy across business units, ensuring it supports near-term delivery commitments and longer-term modernization objectives.
Partner with Business Leads, Product, Client Experience, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Operations, and Enterprise Technology to define platform roadmaps, OKRs, sequencing, and investment priorities.
Provide thought leadership on the evolution of shared digital platforms, including identity, web, mobile, integration, data enablement, and reusable digital capabilities.
Promote technology stack standards, modern engineering practices, automation, and architectural discipline, balancing build vs. buy vs. partner decisions in a complex technology ecosystem.
Ensure design and engineering decisions account for reusability, scalability, security, maintainability, accessibility, and technical debt reduction.
Create the conditions for exceptional digital experiences by enabling business and product teams with reliable, scalable, secure, and reusable platforms.
Platform Delivery & Execution
Accountable for end-to-end delivery of digital platform capabilities, including oversight of internal delivery teams, vendors, system integrators, and total cost of ownership.
Drive delivery excellence by improving velocity, quality, reliability, predictability, and agile maturity across multiple squads.
Track delivery metrics, identify bottlenecks, and implement targeted productivity and delivery maturity improvements.
Serve as the primary escalation point for platform, delivery, vendor, and dependency-related issues, enabling rapid resolution in a complex environment.
Ensure delivery is integrated across product, architecture, engineering, operations, cybersecurity, and business priorities.
Embed test-and-learn, automation, and continuous improvement practices to improve speed, quality, and sustainability.
People Leadership & Capability Development
Lead, mentor, and develop technology leaders and teams, fostering a collaborative, inclusive, accountable, and execution-focused culture.
Design and optimize team structures to support clear ownership, delivery outcomes, modernization priorities, and clear accountabilities.
Partner with Chapter, Engineering, Product, and Business leaders on workforce planning, role clarity, succession planning, and capability development.
Build internal capability in digital engineering, enablement, agile delivery, vendor management, and operational excellence.
Coach leaders to manage performance effectively, clarify ownership, and build resilient teams through change and transformation.
Financial & Vendor Management
Lead budget management, including annual planning, cost tracking, capitalization, forecasting, and investment prioritization.
Manage strategic vendor and system integrator relationships, holding partners accountable for delivery quality, outcomes, knowledge transfer, and value realization.
Drive cost transparency and technology spend optimization across applications, infrastructure, security, vendor, and platform investments.
Identify opportunities to reduce long-term dependency on external partners while strengthening internal platform ownership and capability.
Operational Excellence, Risk & Security
Ensure stability, security, technology currency, resiliency, and end-of-life decommissioning for applications within scope.
Establish governance processes that balance speed of delivery with risk management, audit, regulatory, cybersecurity, and control requirements.
Partner with Application Operations to ensure effective incident management, change management, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning.
Proactively manage operational risk, application health, technical debt, and service reliability across shared digital capabilities.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement
Act as a strategic technology partner to leaders across Product, Client Experience, Business, Operations, Architecture, Cybersecurity, and Enterprise Technology.
Communicate digital strategy, delivery status, risks, trade-offs, and dependencies with clarity and transparency.
Represent the Digital technology function in executive forums, bringing enterprise perspective, external insight, and pragmatic recommendations.
Strengthen alignment between technology investments, business priorities, Client experience outcomes, and enterprise digital strategy.

Accountabilities

Align digital strategy with business objectives, Client outcomes, enterprise standards, and shared technology priorities.
Define and monitor roadmaps, OKRs, modernization priorities, and delivery sequencing.
Oversee execution across delivery teams, vendors, system integrators, and enterprise partners.
Establish governance, track delivery metrics, and drive productivity, quality, and reliability improvements.
Manage budgets, vendor relationships, and cost optimization opportunities.
Build and sustain a high-performing, engaged, inclusive, and platform-oriented technology organization.
Ensure digital platforms are secure, scalable, resilient, reusable, and positioned to support future growth.

What you need to succeed?

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree or MBA is an asset.
10+ years of experience in senior technology leadership roles with demonstrated success delivering complex, mission-critical digital platforms.
Experience leading modernization and enablement of digital platforms such as identity, web, mobile, integration, or client/advisor experience platforms.
Proven ability to lead technology teams through transformation, platform ownership, and operating model evolution.
Strong financial acumen with experience managing sizable technology budgets, vendor portfolios, and total cost of ownership.
Strong stakeholder management, executive communication, and organizational leadership skills.
Experience in regulated financial services is valuable; depth in digital enablement, engineering excellence, and vendor-heavy delivery environments is prioritized.
As this position is posted in several locations, we specify that bilingualism (French, English, both oral and written) is required for Quebec only for the frequent interactions with English and French-speaking colleagues or internal partners across Canada or worldwide

Mindset & Behaviours

Decisive leader comfortable operating in ambiguity, complexity, and transformation.

At Viral Nation,
we specialize in building social-first ecosystems for brands to connect with the modern consumer journey. Our integrated solutions align strategy, talent, media, and technology with culturally relevant creativity to scale the world’s fastest-growing digital brands. The Director, Business Intelligence will lead enterprise-wide analytics strategy and will be responsible for building and leading a high-performing team of analysts delivering actionable insights across sales forecasting, retail performance, campaign measurement, and influencer/paid/social strategy optimization.

This leader will serve as a strategic thought partner to Sales, Marketing, Brand, eCommerce, Finance, and Executive Leadership, translating data into commercial growth opportunities, driving ROI, and embedding analytics into core business decision-making. The role combines strategic vision, technical depth, cross-functional leadership, and team development.

Act as a senior analytics partner to client account, strategy, and service teams by translating client objectives into scalable, best-in-class measurement frameworks that support social-first marketing performance.
Serve as the senior analytics advisor to executive leadership, shaping marketing, retail, and social investment decisions through data-driven insights.
Elevate analytics from reporting to strategic advantage by synthesizing data into clear narratives that inform brand positioning, channel strategy, and enterprise decision-making.
Own end-to-end measurement strategy across paid media, influencer, social, and retail media, ensuring clear linkage between investment and revenue outcomes.
Forecast and quantify incremental revenue and retail lift across eCommerce and offline retail partners by developing predictive models that connect media spend, influencer engagement, and social performance to sales velocity and conversion.
Design and operationalize robust ROI frameworks, including brand lift studies, sales lift studies, incrementality testing, multi-touch attribution, and marketing mix modeling, translating insights into optimized channel mix and budget allocation.
Build scalable measurement systems to evaluate influencer effectiveness, content performance, audience growth, and conversion impact, informing creative strategy and platform optimization.
Identify emerging consumer and digital engagement trends to inform brand strategy, innovation, and go-to-market planning.
Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing analytics team, fostering a culture of analytical rigor, commercial acumen, and executive-ready storytelling.
Design and oversee scalable data collection and reporting infrastructure, including structured databases, automated reporting workflows, dashboards, and standardized presentations.

Qualifications:

Extensive experience in marketing, media, or agency environments, with demonstrated ability to apply analytics and research to drive client strategy and business outcomes.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (Social Sciences, Statistics, Data Science, Business Analytics, or related discipline), or equivalent practical experience.
12+ years of progressive experience in research, analytics, and measurement, with a proven track record of leading complex, high-impact initiatives.
Advanced expertise in primary and secondary research methodologies, including brand tracking, brand and communications strategy, brand lift studies, regression analysis, Market Mix Modeling, social listening, and digital and site analytics.
Deep technical proficiency in analytics and BI technologies, including Python and SQL for analysis and data modeling, Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, and Snowflake for data infrastructure, and BI tools such as Sigma or comparable platforms for scalable reporting and dashboarding.
Demonstrated ability to architect and optimize analytics workflows, data pipelines, and reporting systems that support automation, scalability, and self-serve insights.
Strong executive-level communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Compensation progression is tied to demonstrated performance, expanded scope, and sustained contribution over time, not tenure alone. Employee compensation is reviewed regularly through formal performance reviews and check-ins to ensure alignment with role expectations and impact.
