jobs.description:
🚨 Urgent Hiring — Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. The selection process may take up to 4 weeks, but early applicants are strongly encouraged.

 Ready to lead the financial future of a brand with heart and purpose? 
 At Hadley Designs, we believe every product should fill homes with beauty, learning, and inspiration. We design screen-free learning tools that help children fall in love with learning and help parents feel proud of how they nurture that growth.
 As our Strategic Finance Director, you’ll be the architect of scalable systems that fuel that mission. You’ll bring precision, foresight, and strategic clarity to every financial decision, guiding the company’s growth toward $100M and beyond with confidence and discipline.
 You won’t just manage numbers. You’ll empower a purpose-driven team to think bigger, move faster, and build a lasting legacy.
 About Hadley Designs
 Hadley Designs is a family-founded brand redefining early education through creativity, beauty, and connection. We design screen-free learning tools that spark curiosity and confidence in children while giving parents peace of mind.
 We believe learning should be fun and engaging. Beautiful design creates better learning. We don’t just sell products. We shape futures.
 About the Role
 Your Core Focus
 You’ll own the full finance function, building scalable systems, managing cash flow, driving profitability, and leading financial strategy to support Hadley Designs’ next era of growth.
 What You’ll Do
 Deliver accurate, audit-ready financials by the 20th of each month with full account reconciliation and zero material errors
 Build and maintain a 12-month rolling cash forecast, updated weekly, ensuring perfect liquidity and visibility
 Lead the annual budgeting and forecasting process across all departments with ≤10% variance between forecast and actual results
 Develop automated systems and workflows that reduce manual reporting time by at least 25% within your first year
 Partner with leadership to implement initiatives that increase profitability and improve EBITDA by 2 percentage points in your first 12 months
 Create and document SOPs for close, forecasting, cash flow, and reporting processes
 Implement new systems for expense management, travel, and purchasing by Month 6
 Produce insightful financial dashboards and KPIs that drive better decision-making
 Partner cross-functionally with Product, Sales, and Operations to align growth, cash flow, and inventory planning
 Evaluate technology solutions (ERP, reporting tools) that prepare the company for scale

 How Success Is Measured
 100% of monthly financials delivered on time and error-free
 0 overdrafts, late fees, or missed payments
 ≤10% variance between forecasted and actual EBITDA
 12-month rolling cash forecast maintained weekly
 SOPs for all finance processes documented within 3 months
 System improvements reducing manual work by 25% in Year 1
 Trailing-12-month EBITDA margin up 2 points within first year

 Who You Are 
 You’re a strategic, detail-oriented leader who thrives on clarity, accuracy, and impact. You know how to scale systems, guide teams through growth, and communicate financial insight in plain English. You’re not just reporting numbers, you’re building the foundation for smart, sustainable expansion.

jobs.title: Director of Recruiting & People Strategy
jobs.description:
🚨 Urgent Hiring — Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. The selection process may take up to 4 weeks, but early applicants are strongly encouraged.
 Ready to Empower a Growing Team and Shape Our Future? 
 At Hadley Designs, we believe that learning should be enjoyable, engaging, and screen-free. Millions of parents and teachers trust our beautifully designed, developmentally aligned educational tools to help children grow and thrive. As a fast-growing brand, we are on a mission to make learning meaningful for families around the world.
 We are seeking a  Director of Recruiting & People Strategy  to join our team and build the systems that will drive our next phase of growth. If you are passionate about creating scalable people systems, empowering teams, and cultivating a culture that supports both personal and professional growth, this role offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact.

 About Hadley Designs 
 Hadley Designs is redefining early education with creativity and purpose. Every product we create is hand-drawn and teacher-designed, crafted with care to build confidence and connection. Our screen-free tools help families and teachers make learning fun and meaningful, nurturing curiosity and creativity in children.
 Our Mission: 
We design screen-free products that parents can trust to help their children learn, grow, and reach their full potential. We create beautifully designed, developmentally sound tools that replace noise and distraction with connection, curiosity, and real learning.
 Our Vision: 
We aim to build the most trusted children’s brand in the world, present in millions of homes, reshaping how families learn, connect, and grow. Our products will be so widely used and passed down that generations of children will grow up learning from them and choose them again for their own families.

 Role Overview 
 As the   Director of Recruiting & People Strategy, you will own how Hadley Designs sources, vets, and closes top global talent, and you will own the broader people system that talent steps into. You will partner with leadership to design the recruiting engine that consistently delivers strong top-of-funnel for every open role, and you will scale the people systems that hold a remote, contractor-centric organization together as it grows toward $100M and beyond.

 This is a leadership-tier role with 1 direct report (the People Operations Specialist) and end-to-end ownership of the talent and people functions. Your weeks will be heavier on recruiting in the near term, live pipelines, structured interviews, test projects, employer brand, and steady on People Operations throughout (onboarding, performance frameworks, contractor renewal, leadership enablement).

 Key Responsibilities 

 Talent Acquisition (the #1 outcome of this role): 
 • Recruiting Pipeline Management: Source candidates across LinkedIn, job boards, freelancer platforms, and referrals; filter applicants for red flags, competency match, and scorecard alignment.
 • Test Project & Interview Operations: Run test projects, review submissions, conduct first-round group interviews, and manage candidate experience end-to-end.
 • Sourcing Channel Optimization: Manage and optimize sourcing channels based on performance; build "always hiring" shortlists for recurring high-leverage roles.
 • Employer Brand & Glassdoor Defense: Monitor and manage Glassdoor reviews, organize team review drives, ask for feedback, flag issues, protect brand rating.
 • Hiring Metrics & Funnel Reporting: Deliver weekly hiring pipeline reports broken down by channel and role; track funnel performance against KPIs.

 People Operations: 
 • People Systems Leadership: Design and implement systems for engaging, onboarding, and retaining talent, align
 ed with the company's growth objectives.
 • Organizational Design and Capacity Planning: Collaborate with leadership to ensure that the organizational structure and workforce planning meet the evolving needs of the business.
 • Performance and Development Frameworks: Establish performance expectations, evaluation frameworks, and development pathways that drive accountability and growth across the organization.
 • Talent Experience and Retention: Build a consistent and professional experience for talent that reinforces employee engagement, satisfaction, and retention.
 • Workforce Insights and Reporting: Provide insights and data-driven recommendations to leadership to guide decision-making and improve workforce effectiveness.
 • External Partnerships: Partner with external service providers to enhance and support people operations as necessary.

 How Success Is Measured (two bold sub-headers, each with bullets):

 Talent Acquisition KPIs: 
 • Average time to fill open roles: under 45 days.
 • Weekly applicant volume per active role: 250+ qualified applicants.
 • Weekly hiring pipeline report by sourcing channel: 100% completion, on time.
 • Completed candidate case studies available for review per role per week: 15+.
 • Glassdoor company rating: maintain 4.5+ average across the year.

 People Operations KPIs: 
 • Successful implementation of people systems that directly support the business's ability to scale.
 • Strong employee retention rates, with high performance and engagement.
 • Improved leadership confidence in people systems, talent readiness, and organizational alignment.
 • Predictable, scalable people operations that contribute to the company's growth and success.

jobs.title: Director, Print & Post Operations & Financial Management
jobs.description:
Director, Print & Post Operations & Financial Management will be a Senior leader and second-in-command to the Head of Print & Post. Combines operational leadership with financial and analytics leadership at a senior level, owning day-to-day tactical execution across production operations, vendor delivery, financial governance, reporting, and cost management — so the Head of P&P can focus on strategy, enterprise direction, and transformation. Reduces single-point dependency and develops a strong, resilient operating model across US and Canadian Retirement.

Role Purpose

Combines operational leadership with financial and analytics leadership at a more senior level. Owns day-to-day tactical execution — production operations, vendor delivery, financial governance, reporting, and cost management — enabling the Head of P&P to focus on strategy, enterprise direction, and transformation.

Operations Leadership

Provide day-to-day tactical leadership across production operations (fulfillment, imaging, vendor execution, output integrity, QA).
Ensure operational continuity, SLA performance, and readiness across in-house and outsourced production.
Support the operating model, capability layering, and continuity/backup planning.
Champion production optimization — challenging design, materials, volume, and timing for cost-effective, standardized execution.

Financial & Analytics Leadership

Own overall P&P financial governance, reporting integrity, budgeting, forecasting, and cost transparency across US and Canadian Retirement.
Ensure accuracy and reliability of the P&P financial storyline to senior leadership and Finance.
Set the analytics and reporting strategy, including Power BI / data warehouse direction and data-quality standards.
Lead cost-management and expense-reduction analysis with Operations, Vendor Governance, and the Opportunity Squad.

Leadership Duties

Act as senior second-in-command; own tactical decision-making; hold single-point accountability for compliance across P&P.
Lead, coach, and develop managers and leads; build a resilient, documented, scalable operating model.
Partner at a leadership level with Finance, Procurement, Business/Product, IT, and the transformation squads.
Establish controls, audit readiness, and risk-aware decision-making.

Required Qualifications

Senior leadership experience spanning operations and financial management.
Proven ability to lead teams, manage vendors, and own executive-level financial and operational reporting.
Experience leading data/reporting or analytics capability build (e.g., Power BI / data warehouse).
Strong people leadership, stakeholder management, and cross-functional partnership skills.
Manulife/insurance industry experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Print / mail / production industry experience (or demonstrable ability to ramp quickly).
Experience building or transforming a function from an immature or fragmented state.
Experience developing and mentoring managers as a senior leader.

Industry Knowledge

Print & Post Industry Prerequisites & Operating Principles:

Print/Post Foundations; Finance & Job-Costing; Materials & Inventory; Data, Billing & Reconciliation; Compliance & Data Privacy; Digital Adoption; Continuity & Backup; SLA & Delivery Performance.

Operating Principles

No Touch Workflow; Digital First, Not Digital Only — we print what is Required and Requested; Assertive & Proactive; Sound Judgment & Disciplined Escalation.

When You Join Our Team

jobs.description:
The Company

Cover Genius is the global infrastructure for embedded protection. Active in over 60 countries and all 50 US States, we protect the customers of the world’s largest digital companies, including Klarna, Revolut, Stripe, Priceline, Agoda, Booking.com, Turkish Airlines, Tongcheng Travel, eBay, and Uber, with seamless, end-to-end experiences. Cover Genius has protected more than 73M customers globally across 240M policies with USD $3.2BN in gross written sales.

Coming off a stellar year with 40% YoY revenue growth and a recent $100M capital raise, putting our valuation at $1.9BN, we are accelerating into our next phase of growth. As part of our team, you’ll help drive our AI-first roadmap, developing hyper-personalization engines, agentic distribution, and automated claims infrastructure, while building the scalable technology powering the fast-growing $70B embedded protection market.

Our people are:
Accountable, customer-obsessed, collaborative, driven

Our people are not:
Passive, defensive, siloed, hesitant

About The Role

As Senior Director of Data on our Technology team, you will own Cover Genius' data strategy end-to-end and act as domain lead for Data Products, accountable for its OKRs, roadmap, and delivery. You will work closely with our partnership teams to understand what partners need to see, and give them a clear view of how their insurance business is performing.

To drive success in this role, you will bring a genuine blend of commercial instinct, product judgement, and deep technical credibility — the breadth to lead a business domain, not just an engineering function. You will be as effective influencing at exec level, ours and our partners', as you are leading the engineers and analysts who report to you. Close collaboration with Engineering, Product, Data Science, Analytics, and our own commercial and partner-facing teams will be central to the role — ensuring data becomes a trusted, reusable foundation every other domain can build on with confidence. You will treat AI as a first-class concern of the role — building a platform that AI workloads can trust, exploring AI-enhanced partner propositions, and driving AI-assisted ways of working within your own org.

Key Responsibilities

Work closely with our commercial and partner-facing teams to understand what partners actually need and want from our data, and help shape that into offers they find compelling.
Set product direction for internal and partner-facing data products, partnering with the executive and senior leadership teams to define OKRs and roadmap, and own their execution.
Own the data platform strategy and architecture end-to-end, ensuring it keeps pace as our data grows in volume, velocity, and variety — including the data foundations that AI/ML workloads across the business depend on.
Drive adoption of the data platform across business domains, so Engineering, Data, and Product teams build their solutions on a shared data foundation.
Build governance and data-quality frameworks that make our key data assets trustworthy.
Develop a high-performing Data organisation where people love their work and grow into future leaders.

What You Will Bring

12+ years in data roles spanning platform, product and B2B partner-facing work, including 5+ years leading teams of managers and senior contributors — ideally in a regulated, high-growth B2B business.
You are comfortable working alongside commercial and partner-facing teams, can hold your own in a partner conversation, and have a track record of translating what customers want into propositions that land.
You have owned a roadmap, made hard prioritisation calls between platform investment and customer-facing delivery, and can explain the calls you got wrong.
Strong record of partnering with Engineering, Product, Data Science, Analytics and other data consumers to turn data into a trusted, reusable foundation.
Deep, hands-on architecture credibility on a modern cloud data stack — ideally GCP/BigQuery, Airflow, dbt, and data observability tooling, including experience building and operating data platforms that serve AI/ML workloads.
Proven record of establishing governance and data-quality frameworks that enable delivery rather than block it, and that are adopted across large data-centric organisations.
Practical fluency in data security and privacy in a regulated context such as insurance or financial services.

What You Will Have

Bias for action — you ship incremental improvements continuously rather than waiting for perfect conditions, act decisively, and hold a high bar for what "done" means.
Ownership without excuses — you take personal accountability for team outcomes, including the misses and talk about failures as candidly as wins.
Growth mindset — you share knowledge generously, learn from setbacks and have a track record of developing engineers and managers who go on to bigger roles.
Influence over authority — you push teams to think bigger and drive adoption of standards through credibility and clear reasoning, not mandate.
Partner and customer obsession — you're truly curious about Cover Genius' partners and trace every decision back to the customer experience or partner outcome it improves.

🤔 Why Cover Genius?

At Cover Genius, We Create Magic By Turning The Archaic Into The Extraordinary. We Take One Of The World’s Oldest And Most Complex Industries And Reinvent It With World-class Technology. Cover Genius Doesn’t Just Disrupt Legacy Insurance; We Make The Impossible Feel Effortless. Our Operating Principles Guide Our Mission

Make today matter: We deliver with urgency and excellence. We act decisively, move with intention, and hold a high bar.
Act with accountability: We own our commitments and take pride in delivering results that move us forward.
Grow together: We are a collective of curious minds. We learn from wins and setbacks, share knowledge generously, and elevate each other every day.
Inspire Each Other: We push each other to think bigger and pull together to go further.
Champion Our Customers: We lead with empathy and center the customer, turning complex disruptions into seamless moments of trust.
Flexible Work Environment - Our teams are hybrid. We work from home on a Wednesday and Thursday and attend the office on Monday, Tuesday and Friday with flexibility around start/finish times.
Don't just take our word for it - hear about our culture straight from our people here: story time.

Ready to make an impact?
If you’re looking for a place where you’ll be challenged, trusted, and empowered, we’d love to meet you.

The Legal & Privacy Stuff

Cover Genius promotes diversity and inclusivity. We don't tolerate discrimination, demeaning treatment of anyone, or harassment due to race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or any other legally protected status.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that we may collect, store, and process your personal data for recruitment purposes. To ensure a fair evaluation, we may use AI to assist in sorting applications, but all final decisions are made by our hiring team and no candidate dispositions are automated. We will keep your information on file for three years from the date of your application. For detailed information about how we handle your data and our use of AI, please review our full Privacy Policy .

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Enterprise Data & Analytics
jobs.description:
Pets deserve the best care. At Vetsource, we build the foundation for success, enabling those in the pet healthcare profession and industry to thrive. Our data-powered platform simplifies processes and streamlines systems, helping those we serve create tighter bonds with their customers. From prescription management and pet owner engagement to veterinary business performance data and insights, Vetsource provides comprehensive solutions that give our customers more time and flexibility, and help them foster strong relationships and positive experiences. In a rapidly evolving world, we’re constantly seeking new ways to help our customers chart a course for a better, brighter future for pets and those who care for them.

If you love pets, want to have an impact and join a fantastic organization, Vetsource could be the place for you.

At Vetsource, our teams, much like our customers, are represented through diverse perspectives, life experiences, unique strengths (and love for animals). We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.

We are a team of real people looking for great people to join us, which is why applications are carefully and thoughtfully reviewed by our team. We know that when considering a new opportunity, it's common to weigh your qualifications against the listed job criteria. That said, even if you don’t meet 100% of the job requirements but feel you would be a good fit for the role, we still encourage you to apply!

Who We Are Looking For

Sr. Director, Enterprise Data & Analytics

The Senior Director, Enterprise Data leads Vetsource's enterprise data organization and is accountable for making data a trusted, high-value business asset to drive product innovation and business performance. This role brings together data engineering, analytics, MLOps, AI engineering, and data services under a common strategy and operating model.

Working closely with business leaders, product, security, and technology teams, the Senior Director, Enterprise Data translates business priorities into governed data products, scalable platforms, meaningful insights, and AI capabilities. The role is responsible for measurable improvements in data quality, adoption, and business value for associates, customers, and industry partners.

This is a full-time, remote position .

What You’ll Do

Enterprise Data Strategy and Leadership

Lead the Data as a First Class Citizen initiative, establishing the operating model, standards, investment priorities, and measures required to treat data as a durable enterprise asset.

Own and execute the enterprise data strategy in alignment with company priorities, product strategy, and technology roadmaps.
Lead the Data as a First Class Citizen initiative, establishing the operating model, standards, investment priorities, and measures required to treat data as a durable enterprise asset.
Partner with executive and business leaders to identify the highest-value data opportunities, clarify tradeoffs, and translate strategy into sequenced roadmaps with clear outcomes.
Define and report enterprise data health and value measures, including quality, timeliness, reliability, accessibility, adoption, and business impact.

Analytics and Data Products

Partner with business teams to define critical data domains and common metrics so teams can make decisions using consistent, well-understood information.
Ensure analytical work addresses a clear business decision or workflow and produces measurable value, not simply reports or dashboards.

AI Enablement and Adoption

Develop the data and platform foundations required for AI-powered products, predictive analytics, intelligent automation, and generative AI use cases.
Partner with product, engineering, security, privacy, legal, and business leaders to evaluate and deliver AI use cases with appropriate controls for data access, quality, privacy, safety, traceability, and monitoring.

Build data and AI literacy across the organization through education, reusable patterns, and close partnership with business teams.

Data Governance Trust and Risk

Create a federated governance model that assigns business and technology ownership for critical data and establishes clear decision rights and stewardship responsibilities.
Oversee the enterprise data catalog, business glossary, lineage, quality rules, access policies, retention practices, and issue-management processes.
Partner with security, privacy, compliance, and legal teams to ensure data and AI capabilities meet contractual, regulatory, ethical, and company requirements.

Create a transparent intake and prioritization process that balances strategic initiatives, customer commitments, platform health, regulatory needs, and operational support.

8+ years of leadership experience managing multidisciplinary teams and leaders.

Experience leading analytics and business intelligence capabilities, including governed metrics, semantic models, dashboards, experimentation, or advanced analytics.

You will thrive in a dynamic, growth-oriented environment where priorities evolve quickly, continuous learning is expected, and there may be opportunities to lead and develop finance talent.
This is a unique opportunity to help shape the financial and strategic direction of one of the industry's fastest-growing alternatives platforms. As SLC Management continues to expand across private credit, real estate, infrastructure, and fixed income, you will partner directly with senior leadership on critical growth, investment, and business decisions while building a strong platform for future career advancement.

Planning and forecasting — Own key components of the annual budget, multi-year business plan, and rolling forecast process across business units and corporate functions; partner with business leaders to build, challenge, and validate assumptions

Business partnership — Act as a trusted finance partner to business unit leaders, investment teams, distribution, and corporate functions, supporting ad hoc analysis, business cases, and decision support

Generative AI adoption — Apply generative AI and emerging analytical tools to accelerate and strengthen FP&A work — from research and peer benchmarking to drafting, model documentation, data summarization, and reporting automation — and help establish practical standards for how the team uses these tools responsibly and with appropriate review
Cross-functional collaboration — Work closely with Controllership, Tax, Capital & Treasury, Investor Relations, Human Resources, and Sun Life corporate Finance to ensure consistency and integrity of financial information
Leadership — Where applicable, manage, coach, and develop finance talent, setting clear standards for analytical quality and attention to detail

jobs.description:
At Varicent, we're not just transforming the Sales Performance Management (SPM) market—we're redefining how organizations achieve revenue success. Our cutting\-edge SaaS solutions empower revenue leaders globally to design smarter go\-to\-market strategies, maximize seller performance, and unlock untapped potential. Varicent stands at the forefront of innovation, celebrated as a market leader in the *2025 Forrester Wave Report for SPM*, *2023 Ventana Research Revenue Performance Management (RPM) Value Index*, *Gartner Peer Insights*, *2024 Gartner SPM Market Guide*, and *G2\.* Our solutions are trusted by a diverse range of global industry leaders like T\-Mobile, ServiceNow, Wawanesa Bank, Shaw Industries, Moody's, Stryker and hundreds more. Here's why you'll thrive at Varicent:
* **Innovate with Purpose: Build impactful solutions for customers worldwide.**
* **Join Excellence: Work in a diverse, collaborative, and innovative team.**
* **Shape the Future: Lead in redefining revenue optimization.**
* **Grow Together: Unlock your potential in a supportive environment.**

Join us at Varicent—where your talent and ambition meet limitless opportunities for success!  


**Summary of the Role and Team**



As Director of Deal Desk \& Pricing, you will lead and scale Varicent's Deal Desk function, serving as the central authority for deal governance, pricing operations, quote\-to\-booking processes, and commercial execution. You'll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Renewals, Finance, Legal, Product, and Revenue Operations to drive pricing accuracy, data integrity, operational efficiency, and compliance throughout the customer lifecycle. This role combines strategic leadership with hands\-on execution — you'll establish the processes, governance frameworks, systems alignment, and team structure that enable scalable growth. This is a people leadership role: you'll manage and grow Deal Desk professionals while improving deal velocity, profitability, forecasting accuracy, and operational excellence.


**What You Will Be Doing**



* Lead and develop the Deal Desk team, including coaching, performance management, capacity planning, and workload prioritization.


* Establish and run Deal Desk operating processes: deal intake, approvals, escalations, service\-level expectations, and stakeholder communications.


* Own quote\-to\-booking governance for new business, renewals, expansions, and cross\-sell opportunities, ensuring pricing accuracy and policy compliance.


* Work with Sales and Customer Success on deal structuring, pricing decisions, exception management, and commercial approvals.


* Maintain data integrity and system alignment across Salesforce, CPQ platforms, pricing tools, and related commercial systems.


* Partner with Finance on forecasting activities, revenue recognition requirements, commercial risk assessments, and audit readiness.


* Build and maintain governance frameworks, policies, documentation, and enablement resources that drive consistent business practices.


* Lead process improvement and change management initiatives to reduce deal cycle times and improve scalability and reporting quality.



**What You Bring**



* Demonstrated expertise in Deal Desk, Pricing, Revenue Operations, Commercial Operations, FP\&A, Commercial Finance, or related business functions (typically gained over 10–12\+ years)


* Experience leading teams, programs, or cross\-functional operational functions (typically 5\+ years)


* Experience with complex B2B sales motions, including new business, renewals, expansions, and cross\-sell transactions


* Expertise in Deal Desk operations, pricing governance, quote\-to\-booking workflows, commercial approvals, and process design


* Experience working with Salesforce, DealHub CPQ, or comparable CPQ/CRM platforms


* Solid grasp of how pricing structures, commercial terms, ACV, and contract structures impact forecasting and revenue recognition


* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a track record of using operational data to improve business processes and decisions


* Ability to influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Legal, Customer Success, Product, and Revenue Operations



**Success Outcomes**


***First 90 Days***


* Build a working understanding of Varicent's pricing structure, commercial processes, systems landscape, and quote\-to\-booking workflows.
* Establish strong relationships with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Product, and Revenue Operations stakeholders.
* Assess current Deal Desk processes, governance controls, approval workflows, and reporting capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to improve deal execution efficiency, data quality, and process consistency.


***Within 6 Months***


* Roll out clear governance frameworks, approval structures, and operational standards across the Deal Desk function.
* Raise quote quality, pricing accuracy, and first\-pass approval rates while cutting rework and processing delays.
* Set up consistent forecasting workflows with Finance using Deal Desk insights and commercial data.
* Strengthen data integrity and alignment across Salesforce, CPQ platforms, pricing tools, and related systems.
* Develop scalable team operating rhythms and performance metrics aligned to business objectives.


***Within 12 Months***


* Position Deal Desk as a go\-to strategic partner across Go\-To\-Market, Finance, and Executive teams.
* Show measurable gains in deal cycle times, pricing governance, compliance, and forecasting accuracy.
* Deliver scalable quote\-to\-booking processes that support growth while maintaining strong controls and audit readiness.
* Build a high\-performing Deal Desk organization with clear accountability and operational excellence.
* Create a sustainable operating model that supports revenue growth, profitability objectives, and commercial scalability.

  



This posting is for a **existing** vacancy.

jobs.title: Director, Analytics & Insights
jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

**What we do every day to be our very best**  

Every day at Securian Canada means a day spent helping Canadians and their families build secure tomorrows. We’re agile and innovative, and we aren't afraid to challenge and create, or bring diverse perspectives to our work.
  

  

**Who we need**  

  

As our **Director, Analytics \& Insights**, you'll help shape how data drives decisions across Securian Canada.  

We're looking for a leader who sees beyond dashboards and reports. Someone who is energized by complex business challenges, naturally curious about what drives performance, and passionate about transforming data into meaningful business outcomes. You'll play a pivotal role in **building and evolving an enterprise analytics capability** that empowers leaders with **trusted insights, scalable analytics products, modern business intelligence, and practical AI\-enabled solutions**.  

Reporting to the AVP, Data Solutions, you'll lead a **multidisciplinary team** responsible for Analytics \& Insights, Business Intelligence, and Analytics Engineering. Working across business and technology teams, you'll help create a shared understanding of customers, products, markets, financial performance, and organizational priorities, enabling smarter decisions at every level of the organization.  

This opportunity is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing **strategic thinking with hands\-on leadership**. You'll **influence enterprise priorities**, guide complex analytical initiatives, challenge assumptions, and help leaders translate insights into action.  

The leader we're looking for combines strong **business judgment with technical depth**. You start with the decision that needs to be made, not the tool that will be used. You understand that **data and analytics are strategic business assets** and know how to balance immediate business needs with scalable enterprise solutions. You're pragmatic, collaborative, governance\-minded, and skilled at translating complex analytical concepts into compelling business narratives that drive action.  

Most importantly, you're passionate about **building high\-performing teams**, **developing talent**, fostering collaboration, and creating an environment where people can do their best work while **making a meaningful impact**.  

At Securian Canada, analytics is about more than understanding what happened. It's about helping people make better decisions that support our mission of helping Canadians and their families build secure tomorrows. You'll join a team of talented professionals who are committed to innovation, continuous improvement, and creating solutions that make a real difference across our business.  

The base salary range for this position is between $130,000 to $170,000 depending on experience. Details of our additional benefits are outlined below. This job posting is for an existing vacancy. Only one position is available. However, it may be based in multiple locations: Toronto (ON), or Waterloo (ON), or Montreal (QC).### **What you will do**

  

* Define and execute an analytics and insights roadmap aligned with enterprise, market, customer, and partner priorities.
* Transform strategic business questions into actionable analytical opportunities, KPI frameworks, data requirements, and decision\-support solutions.
* Deliver meaningful insights into business performance, customer behaviour, claims experience, product results, portfolio trends, operational effectiveness, and emerging risks.
* Translate complex findings into clear recommendations and executive\-ready narratives that drive informed decision\-making.
* Establish scalable practices that improve prioritization, delivery, adoption, value realization, and continuous improvement.
* Lead the evolution from fragmented reporting toward trusted, enterprise\-scale analytics products.
* Oversee the development of curated datasets, semantic models, certified metrics, dashboards, scorecards, and client\-facing reporting solutions.
* Partner with Data Pipeline Engineering, Technology, Governance, Finance, and business leaders to strengthen analytics foundations and support critical business priorities.
* Improve self\-service analytics capabilities while reducing manual effort, duplicated logic, and disconnected solutions.
* Ensure analytics products are scalable, reliable, understandable, and centered around real business decisions.
* Identify practical opportunities where advanced analytics, machine learning, predictive modeling, and AI can create measurable business value.
* Prioritize initiatives based on business impact, data readiness, adoption potential, and long\-term sustainability.
* Establish governance, controls, explainability, data quality standards, and operating requirements needed to support responsible AI and advanced analytics.
* Guide innovative solutions from ideation through implementation, ensuring clear ownership, measurable outcomes, and long\-term success.
* Lead, coach, and inspire a team of professionals across analytics, insights, business intelligence, reporting, and analytics engineering.
* Foster a culture focused on analytical excellence, collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and business partnership.
* Provide guidance on analytical problem solving, data\-product design, storytelling, and stakeholder engagement.
* Help team members grow beyond traditional reporting by strengthening skills in problem framing, root\-cause analysis, insight generation, and strategic recommendations.
* Create an environment where innovation, curiosity, and measurable business outcomes are valued and celebrated.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, helping connect business priorities to data\-driven solutions.
* Build strong relationships across Data Solutions, Technology, Finance, Operations, and business teams.
* Influence decision\-making by bringing clarity, insight, and strategic perspective to complex challenges.

jobs.title: Director EIAM Strategy &Technical Product Management (Global Security)
jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

The Director of EIAM Strategy & Technical Product Management
is responsible for defining and executing integrated product strategy across Royal Bank of Canada's Enterprise Identity and Access Management (EIAM) platform.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role
requiring deep engineering involvement and direct accountability for identity lifecycle management, authorization frameworks, governance capabilities, privileged access management, secrets management, and enterprise-wide identity architecture. The successful candidate will drive technical excellence across core security and compliance requirements while leveraging advanced technologies—including AI where appropriate—to enhance EIAM capabilities.

This role demands a technologist with proven hands-on experience designing and implementing complex identity systems, not a product manager focused on go-to-market or business development.

What will you do?

Own unified EIAM platform strategy and roadmap that incorporate emerging technologies and best practices spanning identity lifecycle for platforms such as authorization, authentication, governance, privileged access management, and secrets management
Work closely with lines of business to define and interpret business requirements and map them to appropriate technical specifications which can be leveraged to drive solution architectures and design
Act as a strategic liaison between vendor capabilities and RBC product requirements, ensuring solutions align with enterprise needs and maximize value delivery including driving direction of vendor product roadmap decisions
Evaluate vendor offerings against RBC's technical and business criteria to validate fit and identify capability gaps - Translate business requirements into actionable product roadmap items
Work with Solution and IAM Architects to facilitate disciplined decisions on access related solutions that address business needs within a resourcing and bandwidth context that include IAM engineering, integration and application support, operations and program teams
Prioritize, update, and modify strategies and roadmaps as business needs and vendor landscapes evolve while continuing to drive product strategy and accelerate multiple enterprise IAM initiatives
Serve as the primary point of contact for cross-functional stakeholders on IAM strategy and vendor integration decisions
Develop forward-looking roadmaps aligned with 2-year technology vision (including AI and PAM innovation trends)
Collaborate with Compliance and Risk teams to embed regulatory controls into product design
Mentor product and technical team members on identity architecture, governance strategy, and technical best practices

What do you need to succeed?

Must have:

10 + years of IAM experience, preferably in a financial institution/ large enterprise environment, with one of more of the following: Privileged Access Management (PAM), Secrets Management, Identity Governance & Administration (IGA), Authentication, Authorization, or Cloud/AI IAM solutions
5+ years of demonstrated experience translating business and compliance requirements into technical architecture and policy frameworks
Proven experience evaluating and liaising between vendor products and organizational requirements to ensure optimal solution alignment and value
Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining program and project-level roadmaps that align with architectural and organizational strategies
Proven ability to develop and own comprehensive IAM strategies that leverage emerging technologies and industry trends to address IAM requirements while aligning with Enterprise Architecture
Experience working with one or more of the following: Idira (CyberArk), SailPoint, HashiCorp, Secrets Manager, Entra ID and other IAM related tools and platforms.
Strong track record of creating feasible, realistic roadmaps by incorporating cross-functional perspectives from IAM teams, Cyber Security, and different stakeholders groups
Strategic vision and proven track record translating complex IAM concepts—including authentication architecture, authorization frameworks, identity governance, privileged access management, and compliance landscapes—into cohesive product strategy and roadmap that drives business value.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional technical teams in complex, regulated banking/financial services environments
Proficiency with agile product delivery frameworks and automation technologies
Highly skilled at presenting to senior leadership and executives. Strong ability to communicate IAM strategy, progress, and critical updates in a clear, business-focused manner that resonates with C-suite audiences
Ability to determine the information and communication needs of the stakeholders and project.
Deadline-driven and results-oriented; able to meet consistently high quality standards while handling a variety of tasks and deadlines simultaneously
Excellent interpersonal skills to collaborate across functions and businesses

Nice-to-have
:

CISSP, CISM or other IAM specific certification
Experience with cloud identity platforms (Azure AD, Okta, AWS IAM); knowledge of zero-trust architecture and security frameworks; familiarity with compliance and regulatory requirements (SOC 2, ISO 27001)
Experience leading digital transformation initiatives
Background in Agile or Scrum methodologies
Exposure to API management and microservices security
Prior experience working with IAM configuration, or IAM architecture

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
Ability to make a difference and lasting impact
Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team
A world-class training program in financial services
Opportunities to do challenging work

jobs.title: Vice President, Global Consumer Data & Insights
jobs.description:
Your Opportunity at ARC’TERYX:

As the Vice President, Global Consumer Data & Insights, you are a trusted advisor and strategic partner to the Brand Leadership team and to the Enterprise organization, shaping the future of the Arc’teryx brand through deep consumer understanding and insight-led strategy. You will define and lead the company’s Consumer Insights vision, ensuring the voice of the consumer is embedded at the core of brand and business strategy, decision making and long-term growth.  In this role you influence critical business and brand decisions through compelling storytelling and foresight, translating complex data into clear direction for senior leaders.

Acting as a catalyst for a consumer-first culture, you lead the growth of the company’s insights capabilities, operating models, and tools while building a high-performing global team. You also champion innovation in how the organization anticipates and responds to shifting consumer behaviors, ensuring the brand remains culturally relevant and positioned for sustained growth.

Ideally this role is based out of our North Vancouver office.

Meet Your Future Team:

The Brand team is the direct connection between the guest and the core intention of the Arc’teryx brand. Leveraging an increasingly robust set of consumer insights, we specialize in storytelling and creating incredible experiences that connect people to the transformative power of the mountains. Our functions include enterprise strategy, brand marketing and creative, athletes/ambassador's programs, community, experiences, operations, communications, regional teams, and agency partners. This team is comprised of global HQ and regional offices who aim to become the voice of the consumer within the organization.  You will work in close partnership with functional leaders across channels and regions to bring added value to the business during this high growth era.

You and your team will also support wider executive leadership, aggregating data from commercial, product and business partners to derive insights that inform the enterprise growth strategy.

If you were in the VP, Global Consumer Data & Insights role now, here are some of the core activities you would be doing:

Setting the strategic vision and multi-year roadmap for the global Consumer Insights function, strengthening brand equity, distinctiveness, and consumer connection while ensuring alignment to brand positioning, growth priorities, and long-term strategy

Serving as the enterprise leader and trusted advisor for consumer insights, embedding a consumer-first operating model and insight-led perspectives that shape executive decisions, strategic planning, and innovation across all functions, regions, and business units.

Building, leading, and developing a high-performing global Consumer Insights team, including organizational design, capability building, and succession planning

Translating complex, multi-source data into clear narratives and lead the evolution of advanced analytics, including predictive, prescriptive, and AI-driven approaches, next-gen measurement, and marketing effectiveness/ROI tools, to drive measurable business outcomes

Designing and scaling a global insights operating model and enterprise frameworks — tools, platforms, KPIs, and standardized methodologies — and build strategic external partnerships (agencies, data providers, industry experts) to democratize access and ensure best-in-class capability

Leading consumer segmentation and consolidate data and insights systems across the enterprise (with focus on product, channel, and regional data), anticipating emerging consumer behaviors and market dynamics to unlock acquisition, retention, and growth opportunities

Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:

Shaping the future of brand-building through next-generation insights, leveraging AI, real-time consumer signals, and emerging technologies to create more adaptive, responsive, and culturally relevant brand strategies

Pioneering new approaches to understanding consumer connection and brand experience, evolving beyond traditional research to integrate behavioral, emotional, and cultural intelligence at scale

Future-proofing the Brand by embedding predictive foresight and scenario planning, enabling the organization to anticipate disruption, stay ahead of shifting consumer expectations, and unlock long-term brand growth opportunities

Are you our next VP, Global Consumer Data & Insights?

You have 15+ years of progressive experience across brand, consumer insights, and strategy functions, with a bachelor's degree in a relevant field, and proven capability building consumer insights strategies and frameworks

You have demonstrated success influencing executive leadership, translating insights into brand strategy, positioning, and global brand-building initiatives that drive equity and long-term growth

You have strong analytical and technical fluency, including advanced analytics, predictive modeling, AI-driven insights, and consumer data ingestion, integration, and governance across a multi-market environment

You have an exceptional ability to synthesize complex data into compelling narratives that influence senior stakeholders and drive action

You are a proven people leader who sets clear vision, aligns global teams and cross-functional partners, and builds high-performing, diverse organizations within a complex matrix environment.

Your knowledge of technical apparel, outdoor, performance, or premium lifestyle categories, with in-depth understanding of the outdoor industry and the consumer culture Arc'teryx targets

You have a genuine passion for getting outside that matches your passion for the work

Compensation:
The salary range for this role is USD$224,000 - USD$336,000 

Total Rewards

Most new team members join between the start and midpoint of the range, where you can contribute right away while continuing to grow your craft, your collaborations, and your impact at Arc’teryx. This range reflects market alignment and the scope of the role. Individual pay is determined by your skills, experience, and level of responsibility.

We’re committed to fair, equitable, and competitive pay, reviewed regularly to ensure internal alignment and market relevance. Transparency is part of how we follow through on our commitments and how we honour the value you bring to our team.

In addition to base pay, Arc’teryx supports people through benefits designed to sustain both work and life:

Health & wellbeing
- Extended health, dental, and vision coverage, including mental health support, fertility benefits, gender-affirming care and a 24/7 Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

Financial wellbeing
- RRSP matching and eligibility for Arc'teryx Annual Incentive Plan and access to Employee Stock Purchase program (ESPP) where applicable.

Time & Flexibilit
y - Paid time off, wellness time, and No Wasted Day program (dedicated paid days to get outside & explore).

Family support
- Parental leave top-up and a nesting period for new parents.

Growth, community & gear
- Professional development opportunities, Arc'teryx Academies (outdoor skill-building events) , Employee Belonging Councils, and access to employee discounts and Pro Deals (exclusive discounted pricing on gear).

jobs.description:
Job Description

Toast is recruiting on behalf of a fast-growing public safety technology company that is transforming the global water rescue industry. Their flagship product is a handheld sonar device with built-in AI detection that helps first responders locate drowning victims faster and more effectively. As the company expands its global reach and develops new product lines, they are looking for a driven, hands-on Head of Machine Learning to lead ML strategy, oversee end-to-end development, and solve some of their most challenging embedded ML problems. This role sits at the centre of the company's core technology and strategic vision.

Responsibilities

Define and execute the machine learning strategy in line with evolving product and business objectives
Lead the design and evolution of signal processing and machine learning architectures for production systems
Establish technical standards, best practices, and development processes for ML systems
Evaluate emerging ML technologies and identify opportunities to strengthen product capabilities and competitive advantage
Provide technical leadership on architecture decisions, model selection, and system performance optimization
Oversee the development, validation, deployment, and lifecycle management of machine learning models
Oversee the design, optimization, and scalability of signal processing pipelines
Define model performance metrics and drive continuous improvement through rigorous evaluation and experimentation
Ensure production ML infrastructure, data pipelines, and supporting databases are robust, maintainable, and scalable
Oversee ML Ops practices including model versioning, reproducibility, and monitoring
Set standards for dataset acquisition, quality, governance, and lifecycle management
Lead planning and execution of field data collection initiatives to meet product development and validation goals
Innovate on methods for data labeling, preprocessing, quality assurance, and representativeness across operational scenarios
Continuously expand and refine training datasets to improve model accuracy and generalization
Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and executive leadership to define the AI roadmap and prioritize initiatives
Translate customer needs and operational challenges into innovative ML solutions and product capabilities
Provide technical leadership during customer demonstrations, field trials, and critical deployments
Serve as the organization's subject matter expert on machine learning, advising on technical direction and product strategy
Lead and mentor a high-performing machine learning team within the product development group
Set project priorities, resource allocation, and development plans to deliver on strategic objectives
Drive project execution through effective planning, risk management, and tools such as Jira
Build a culture of technical excellence, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning through technical reviews and knowledge sharing

Requirements

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field
5 to 10 years of experience in machine learning, AI, and software development
Proven track record leading machine learning teams and delivering quality products
Experience with embedded ML on hardware or IoT devices
Experience translating real-world applications and customer needs into ML solutions
Strong proficiency in Python, with hands-on experience using PyTorch and Scikit-learn
End-to-end ML project experience, including data pipelines, data cleaning, preprocessing, model design, training, validation, and deployment
Experience with project management tools such as Jira
Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure
Strong technical communication, documentation, and organizational skills

Nice to haves

Familiarity with sonar systems and sonar data would be a plus
Familiarity with signal processing is considered an asset
Experience with computer vision, such as object detection and Fourier transforms, would be a plus
Experience with IP strategy in AI innovation is considered an asset
Comfort working in open water settings year-round (with appropriate PPE) would be a plus

Benefits

Salary range of $160,000 to $180,000, plus performance-based incentives
Employee ownership opportunities, so you share in the value you help build
Health, dental, and vision coverage
4 weeks paid vacation plus a company-wide closure from December 24 to January 1
Relocation support available for candidates based outside of Vancouver
Flexible and dynamic work environment
Own the core algorithms behind a device first responders use in real rescues, where faster detection means victims are found sooner
Shape the AI roadmap as the company expands globally and launches new product lines
Build and lead the ML team from the ground up, with direct influence on the design and development of the end product

Submit your application, including your resume and cover letter, through our online portal. Our team will carefully review your qualifications and experiences. We take pride in responding promptly, so if your application aligns with our current opportunities, you’ll hear back from us with next steps. Your journey with Toast begins here, and we’re excited to see what you bring to the table!

Vetting Call

If your application is successful, we’ll schedule a vetting call with a member of the Toast team. This 30-45 minute informal conversation is designed for us to get to know you better and assess your skills. Be prepared to discuss your past projects, the challenges you’ve tackled, and the impact you’ve made. This is your chance to shine and show us why you’re a great fit for the roles we offer.

Profile Creation

Once you’ve impressed us in the vetting call, we’ll create an unbiased profile that highlights your experience while minimizing common biases. Instead, we focus on your skills, industry experience, and the impact you’ve made. This way, your profile reflects your true potential and accomplishments.

Client Submission

After crafting your unbiased profile, we submit it to our trusted clients. We work closely with these clients to ensure they understand the value you bring. Throughout their interview process, we remain by your side, providing support and guidance. Our goal is to help you navigate the hiring process smoothly and confidently, ensuring you have the best chance to secure a role that fits your skills and aspirations.

The ITFM (IT Financial Management) practice helps IT leaders around the world answer a hard question with evidence: how does our technology spend compared to our peers, and where should we improve? You will work for a rapidly growing company that understands the importance of supporting employees through flexibility, inclusiveness, learning and development, internal career mobility, measurement of the Employee Experience and actioning on employee feedback, and building strong relationships.

Lead ITFM Benchmarking engagements

Improve the benchmarking service through your expertise — new ways of representing data and new opportunities to enhance the insights delivered.
Keep a pulse on industry trends and best practices in your areas of expertise, contributing ideas that shape the benchmarking service.

Required

Presentation and facilitation experience demonstrated through prior client-facing engagements.

Sound Interesting?

Utilize Salesforce analytics and reporting to support territory optimization, customer segmentation, resource allocation, forecasting accuracy, and strategic business planning.

Reinforce ZEISS’s brand as a trusted market leader in ophthalmic technology and solutions.

DataOps Strategy, Operating Model & Execution

About the role:

BMO Canada Wealth Digital is accelerating the adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI) across its customer-facing digital platforms to enhance client experiences, improve operational efficiency, and enable innovative wealth management solutions. We are seeking an experienced AI Delivery Director to lead the planning, execution, and delivery of strategic AI initiatives that support the evolution of our Wealth Management digital capabilities.

This is a senior delivery leadership role requiring the coordination of cross-functional teams across Engineering, Architecture, Security, Risk Management, Compliance, and Business organizations. The AI Delivery Director will provide end-to-end leadership across the delivery lifecycle, from intake, discovery, and prioritization through implementation, deployment, adoption, and business value realization by adopting and utilizing AI tools in SDLC. Working closely with engineering leaders, product owners, architects, and executive stakeholders, the role will ensure AI-enabled solutions are delivered on schedule, aligned with enterprise standards, and integrated effectively within the broader technology ecosystem.

End-to-End Technology Delivery
Lead delivery across multiple cross-functional product and platform teams, establishing one integrated plan, clear critical path, transparent dependencies, and accountable owners.
Convert the product roadmap into executable technology increments, release plans, capacity models, milestones, and outcome-based commitments.
Drive delivery discipline across scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, risk, and benefits, using forecasts rather than artificial certainty.
Identify constraints early, remove impediments, resolve cross-team trade-offs, and escalate decisions with clear options and recommendations.
Ensure each release has explicit entry, exit, acceptance, operational readiness, and rollback criteria.
AI Engineering and AI SDLC Leadership
Apply deep knowledge of generative AI and agentic systems, including LLM orchestration, tool use, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt and context engineering, evaluations, guardrails, memory, and human oversight.
Embed full-lifecycle AI SDLC practices across requirements, design, build, test, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and model or prompt change management.
Ensure AI quality is measured using fit-for-purpose evaluations covering safety, groundedness, relevance, accuracy, latency, reliability, and client experience.
Champion specification-driven development, automation, reusable engineering patterns, and AI-assisted software delivery where approved.
Ensure deterministic software testing and probabilistic AI evaluation are integrated into CI/CD and release decisions.
Azure, Architecture and Platform Integration
Provide senior technical leadership for solutions deployed on Microsoft Azure and integrated with BMO InvestorLine and Wealth Management platforms.
Partner with solution, enterprise, security, data, and platform architects to maintain an approved, scalable target architecture and prevent local optimization or avoidable technical debt.
Ensure APIs, event flows, data services, identity, access, observability, resilience, and non-functional requirements are designed and delivered end to end.
Drive environment readiness, infrastructure as code, automated deployment, telemetry, performance engineering, capacity planning, disaster recovery, and production support readiness.
Promote reuse of enterprise AI capabilities, shared services, patterns, and controls while preserving clear service boundaries and ownership.
Advanced Agile and Value-Stream Delivery
Establish and continuously improve an advanced Agile operating model organized around persistent, cross-functional teams and measurable client or business outcomes.
Lead portfolio and product-level planning, backlog readiness, dependency management, release forecasting, and flow optimization across multiple teams.
Use evidence-based metrics such as lead time, cycle time, throughput, work in progress, predictability, escaped defects, reliability, evaluation performance, and value realization.
Reduce handoffs, unnecessary governance, meeting load, and blocked work; create fast decision paths and clear single-point accountability.
Coach delivery leaders, Scrum Masters, engineering leads, and teams in modern product delivery, DevSecOps, continuous delivery, and learning-driven retrospectives.
Quality, Risk and Responsible AI
Build quality, privacy, security, regulatory compliance, model risk, accessibility, and responsible AI requirements into delivery from inception, not as release-end checkpoints.
Partner with Legal, Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Model Risk, Data Governance, and Technology Risk to establish proportionate controls and auditable evidence.
Ensure full-spectrum observability across application, infrastructure, data, model, prompt, agent, safety, and client-experience performance.
Lead incident response, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and learning reviews for technology or AI quality events.
Maintain transparent risk, issue, dependency, and decision records and ensure material risks are escalated promptly.
Stakeholder, Financial and Partner Leadership
Serve as the senior technology delivery voice for Em with InvestorLine, Wealth, Technology & Operations, Applied AI, governance partners, and executive forums.
Provide concise, fact-based reporting on outcomes, delivery confidence, risks, financials, quality, and decisions required.
Own technology delivery financial stewardship, resource planning, vendor performance, commercial dependencies, and delivery commitments.
Lead co-build and vendor engagements with clear accountability, knowledge transfer, architecture compliance, security obligations, and measurable outcomes.
Create an inclusive, high-accountability environment that develops leaders, strengthens technical depth, and keeps teams focused on client outcomes.

Key Success Measures

Predictable delivery of roadmap outcomes and releases, with transparent forecast accuracy and controlled scope change.
Measurable improvement in delivery flow, engineering productivity, automation, quality, and time to value.
AI evaluation thresholds and non-functional requirements met before release and sustained in production.
Stable, secure, resilient production performance with effective observability, incident management, and continuous improvement.
Clear ownership, faster decisions, fewer cross-team handoffs, and effective dependency resolution.

Deep practical knowledge of AI/ML and generative AI delivery, including agentic architectures, LLM application patterns, evaluations, guardrails, observability, and responsible AI controls.
Strong knowledge of wealth management and digital investing platforms, including client journeys, advice or guidance experiences, market and portfolio data, trading-related integrations, and regulatory considerations.

jobs.description:
About Us

ZEISS is a global technology and innovation leader in optics and optoelectronics. Founded in Germany in 1846, ZEISS operates in 50+ countries and offers career opportunities across engineering, manufacturing, research, sales, and technology.

As a foundation-owned company, ZEISS is committed to responsibility, quality, and continuous innovation. Employees help shape the future through cutting-edge technology and impactful work. With a strong North American presence since 1925 and 20+ locations, ZEISS partners with industries including semiconductor, automotive, biomedical research, and medical technology, and is a leading manufacturer of eyeglass lenses, camera and cinema lenses, and precision optical systems.

What’s the role?

The Head of Sales ZEISS Medical Technology Microsurgery is responsible for leading the commercial strategy, sales execution, market development, customer engagement, and overall business performance of the Microsurgery business across Canada. The incumbent is accountable for achieving revenue, profitability, market share, and growth objectives while ensuring alignment with ZEISS Canada priorities and the broader Microsurgery strategy across the Americas region.

The role provides leadership across key microsurgical specialties, including Neurosurgery, Otolaryngology (ENT), Spine, Radiation Oncology, Dental, and other emerging clinical segments. Working within a matrix environment, the incumbent collaborates closely with Americas Microsurgery leadership, ZEISS Canada leadership, Marketing, Clinical Applications, Service, Finance, and other key stakeholders to drive sustainable business growth and exceptional customer experiences.

The Head of Sales leads, coaches, and develops a team of Account Managers, fostering a culture of accountability, customer focus, commercial excellence, and continuous development. As a player-coach, the incumbent remains actively engaged in strategic account management, executive customer relationships, major capital equipment opportunities, complex negotiations, Requests for Proposal (RFPs), and other key business pursuits while providing leadership and coaching to the commercial team.

The incumbent leverages Salesforce and commercial analytics to drive forecasting accuracy, pipeline visibility, account planning, business insights, and sales performance across the Canadian Microsurgery business

Sound interesting?

Here's What You'll Do.

Business Strategy & Market Development

Develop and execute the Canadian Microsurgery commercial strategy in alignment with regional and global business objectives.
Identify and evaluate market trends, customer needs, competitive activities and emerging opportunities.
Maintain a comprehensive understanding of the installed base of microsurgical technologies across Canadian healthcare institutions.
Identify upgrade, replacement and expansion opportunities through analysis of customer equipment inventories, utilization trends and technology lifecycles.
Develop business plans to increase market penetration and market share.
Identify new customer segments and growth opportunities across Canada.
Recommend strategic initiatives that support sustainable business growth.

Sales Leadership & Business Performance

Lead all Microsurgery sales activities across Canada.
Deliver annual revenue, profitability and market share targets.
Drive execution of national sales plans and strategic initiatives.
Operate as a player-coach by providing sales leadership, mentoring and performance management while maintaining personal involvement in strategic customer relationships, major opportunities and complex sales pursuits.
Monitor pipeline health, forecasting accuracy and sales performance metrics.
Ensure effective utilization of CRM and commercial excellence tools.
Drive a disciplined sales management process through effective utilization of Salesforce CRM, ensuring data integrity, forecast accuracy, pipeline transparency and opportunity progression.
Establish and monitor key sales performance indicators, including pipeline coverage, win rates, sales cycle duration, forecasting accuracy, account penetration and market share growth.
Leverage Salesforce analytics and reporting tools to identify trends, manage risk, assess territory performance and drive informed business decisions.
Ensure timely and accurate maintenance of customer, opportunity, quotation and competitive information within Salesforce.
Lead long-term capital equipment opportunity planning and sales execution activities to support sustainable revenue growth.
Monitor sales cycle progression and resource requirements for large strategic opportunities.
Lead monthly business reviews and performance discussions.
Develop and monitor annual budgets and forecasts.

Customer & Stakeholder Management

Build and maintain executive-level relationships with key customers and healthcare stakeholders.
Develop strategic account plans for major customers and institutions.
Increase customer engagement and strengthen long-term partnerships.
Partner with service and application teams to ensure excellent customer support.
Represent ZEISS at industry events, conferences and professional associations.

Strategic Accounts & RFP Management

Lead complex capital equipment sales opportunities from prospecting through proposal development, contract negotiation, installation and post-sale follow-up.
Direct Requests for Proposal (RFP), Requests for Quotation (RFQ), public tender and Group Purchasing Organization (GPO) opportunities across Canada.
Develop winning bid strategies and coordinate cross-functional support to deliver high-quality customer proposals.
Monitor hospital capital planning cycles, procurement initiatives and funding opportunities to proactively position ZEISS solutions.
Develop executive-level engagement strategies for key accounts and strategic growth opportunities.

Marketing & Commercial Excellence

Collaborate with Marketing on product launches, campaigns and market development initiatives.
Support product positioning and value proposition development.
Monitor competitive activity and provide market intelligence to regional leadership.
Ensure consistent implementation of sales processes and best practices.
Utilize Salesforce and commercial analytics tools to evaluate customer engagement, marketing campaign effectiveness and sales conversion rates.
Partner Marketing to develop targeted customer acquisition and retention strategies based on CRM insights and market intelligence.

Financial Accountability

Manage sales budgets and commercial investments responsibly.
Contribute to business planning, forecasting and financial analysis.
Partner with Finance to evaluate business performance and identify corrective actions where required.
Support achievement of profitability objectives while balancing long-term growth opportunities.

Leadership & Talent Development

Lead, coach and develop members of the Canadian Microsurgery commercial team.
Establish clear performance expectations and accountability measures.
Conduct performance reviews and development planning.
Support succession planning and talent development initiatives.
Coach and develop the commercial team on effective Salesforce utilization, account planning, opportunity management and sales forecasting best practices.
Foster a culture of accountability through regular pipeline reviews, territory business reviews and data-driven performance management.
Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation and customer focus.
Build and sustain a high-performance sales culture focused on accountability, customer centricity, innovation and continuous improvement.
Develop future sales leaders through coaching, mentoring and structured development plans.
Champion employee engagement initiatives and reinforce ZEISS Leadership Principles across the sales organization.
Demonstrate and promote ZEISS Leadership Principles.

Do you Qualify?

Experience And Education Requirements

MBA or advanced degree considered an asset.
Minimum 8-10 years of progressive medical device or healthcare sales leadership experience.
Demonstrated success leading commercial teams and delivering revenue growth.
Experience working within a matrix organization.
Capital equipment sales experience preferred.
Experience in Neurosurgery, ENT, Spine, Surgical Visualization or related healthcare specialties considered an asset.
Strong strategic planning and business acumen.
Excellent leadership and coaching skills.
Strong financial analysis and forecasting capabilities.
Advanced stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
