www.fhhealth.com
www.pollinfertility.com
www.perennialcare.ca

About the Role

We are seeking a strategic and hands-on Director of Finance to lead and scale our finance function and support the growth and expansion of the business. This role will serve as a key member of the leadership team, partnering closely with the executive team to drive financial performance, support growth initiatives, and shape the company’s long-term strategy. This role will also champion process improvements, automation, and the adoption of modern financial technologies, including AI-driven tools, to transform and elevate the finance function. The successful candidate will bring a forward-thinking, digitally savvy approach to optimizing workflows, enhancing reporting, and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.The ideal candidate is a designated CPA with strong analytical capabilities and a proven track record of building high-performing teams, optimizing financial operations, and enabling data-driven decision-making in a high-growth environment.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Leadership & Strategy
Act as a strategic advisor to the executive team on financial planning, growth, and expansion initiatives
Lead the development of long-term financial strategy aligned with corporate objectives
Translate business strategy into actionable financial plans and performance metrics
Support capital planning, fundraising, and investor relations as needed

Financial Planning & Analysis
Oversee budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling across all business units
Review financial results and identify key drivers, risks, and opportunities
Develop insights on profitability levers, cost optimization, and revenue growth
Establish KPIs and dashboards to enable real-time, data-driven decision-making
Partner with operations and clinical leaders to align financial and business strategies

Financial Reporting & Controls
Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting processes
Ensure accuracy and integrity of financial statements in accordance with ASPE
Strengthen internal controls, policies, and financial governance frameworks
Lead audit processes, tax compliance, and coordination with external advisors
Accounting & Finance OperationsProvide oversight of day-to-day accounting operations, including A/R, A/P, payroll, inventory management and treasury
Drive process improvements, automation, and scalability across finance functions by leveraging modern technologies, including AI, to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and insight generation
Ensure compliance with regulatory, tax, and payroll requirements
Oversee financial operations across a multi-entity organizational structure

Team Leadership
Lead, mentor, and develop the finance team, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement
Build and scale the finance function to support company growth and expansion
Promote cross-functional collaboration across departments
Act as a change agent to reimagine and modernize the finance function from the ground up, delivering strategic insights and building a nimble, high-impact team

Qualifications

CPA designation (required) in good standing
8–12+ years of progressive finance and accounting experience, including leadership roles
Experience in healthcare, technology, or high-growth environments
Strong background in financial planning & analysis, reporting, and operational finance
Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive strategic initiatives
Experience with ERP systems (preferably Odoo) and financial reporting tools
Deep understanding of ASPE and IFRS standards
Exceptional analytical, communication, and leadership skills
Hands-on, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment

Why Join FH Health (Perennial, Pollin and Wellness Haus)?

You’ll be joining a mission-driven, fast-growing organization that’s reimagining healthcare with innovation at its core. This is a unique opportunity to play a leadership role in shaping the financial future of a company making a meaningful impact on patients’ lives.

Apply Now

We look forward to learning more about you. If you're a strategic finance leader passionate about driving growth and innovation in healthcare, we encourage you to apply.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact careteam@perennialcare.ca for assistance.We thank all applicants in advance for their interest in this position, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self.  At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

 When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

 Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

 Job Description: 
 About the Role 

 The Corporate AVP, Underwriting Risk & Governance is accountable for maintaining the organization's underwriting philosophy, risk appetite, technical standards, and governance framework across all life and health insurance businesses. The role serves as a corporate risk subject matter expert on mortality, morbidity, product, underwriting, and fraud risks, providing underwriting risk management guidance to business units globally, with particular emphasis on emerging risks, high-net-worth markets, and the impact of underwriting and product design decisions on long-term business performance.

 The incumbent will lead the evaluation and approval of underwriting and product-related risk initiatives, assess the mortality and morbidity implications of underwriting requirement changes, product innovations, and distribution strategies, and ensure alignment with corporate risk management objectives, with primary focus on our Asia business units and Private Wealth business. The role provides technical leadership to underwriters and input to actuarial, product development, and risk management teams on underwriting-specific risk while championing sound underwriting practices, risk governance, and sustainable growth.

 Operating in a highly collaborative, consultative, and project-oriented environment, the Corporate AVP, Underwriting Risk & Governance will lead complex initiatives across the Asia business units and jurisdictions, influence business unit underwriting leadership and risk management decision-making, and represent the organization on underwriting and insurance industry matters under the direction of the Corporate Chief Underwriter.

 Key Responsibilities 

 Enterprise Underwriting Governance 
 Support and champion corporate underwriting philosophy, risk appetite, and underwriting governance standards.

 Provide enterprise oversight of underwriting practices across life, health, critical illness, disability, and medical reimbursement products.

 Evaluate proposed changes to underwriting requirements, underwriting evidence, accelerated underwriting programs, automation initiatives, and digital underwriting solutions.

 Assess and communicate the mortality and morbidity implications associated with underwriting and product design changes.

 Mortality and Morbidity Risk Management 
 Evaluate mortality and morbidity risks associated with existing and proposed products, underwriting methodologies, and distribution strategies.

 Assess the impact of product features, underwriting evidence requirements, and benefit structures on expected mortality and morbidity outcomes.

 Partner with actuarial, product, and risk management teams to monitor emerging experience trends and recommend mitigation strategies.

 Provide technical leadership on mortality and morbidity risk management across multiple markets.

 Product and Anti-Selection Risk Assessment 
 Assess product design features for anti-selection, fraud, claims, and sustainability risks.

 Identify underwriting controls, medical requirements, and risk management measures necessary to mitigate adverse selection and fraud exposure.

 Provide risk guidance during new product development and product enhancement activities.

 Evaluate the potential impact of product design changes on underwriting outcomes and claims experience.

 Fraud Risk Oversight 
 Identify emerging fraud risks and vulnerabilities within underwriting and product frameworks.

 Recommend underwriting, medical, and operational controls designed to mitigate fraud exposure.

 Partner with claims, investigations, and risk management teams to identify trends and strengthen preventive measures.

 High - Net - Worth and Complex Risk Expertise 
 Provide technical leadership on high-net-worth and Private Wealth underwriting practices, particularly within Asian markets.

 Evaluate large face amount and complex financial underwriting cases.

 Monitor market developments and emerging risk trends impacting high-net-worth and Private Wealth business.

 Support business units in developing prudent underwriting strategies for complex and high-exposure risks.

 Retention and Reinsurance Management 
 Provide leadership and guidance regarding retention management practices.

 Evaluate retention limits, concentration risk, and reinsurance effectiveness.

 Partner with reinsurance stakeholders as permitted to ensure alignment between underwriting strategies and risk transfer objectives.

 Strategic Leadership 
 Lead complex cross-functional underwriting initiatives involving multiple business units, jurisdictions, and product lines.

 Influence senior leaders and business partners on underwriting, mortality, morbidity, and product risk matters.

 Provide strategic recommendations balancing growth opportunities with responsible risk management.

 Serve as a trusted advisor to the Corporate Chief Underwriter on emerging underwriting and insurance risks.

 Technical Thought Leadership 
 Research emerging medical, underwriting, product, and industry developments.

 Participate in the development and maintenance of underwriting manuals, medical guidelines, and risk assessment standards.

 Translate emerging medical evidence and industry research into practical underwriting guidance.

 Represent the organization externally through industry associations, conferences, forums, and professional organizations.

 What you'll need to succeed 
 Minimum 15 years of progressive life and health underwriting experience.

 Minimum 5 years holding an individual underwriting approval authority of at least $30 million (preferred).

 Significant experience assessing complex mortality and morbidity risks.

 Experience underwriting high-net-worth and large face amount business, including exposure to Asian insurance markets.

 Demonstrated experience evaluating underwriting implications of life, health, disability, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and medical reimbursement products.

 Proven experience leading complex underwriting, governance, or risk initiatives across multiple business units or jurisdictions.

 Experience working with reinsurance and retention management frameworks.

 Experience developing underwriting philosophy, guidelines, manuals, and risk governance standards.

 Proven ability to influence business risk management and underwriting leaders.

 Strong strategic thinking and risk assessment capabilities.

 Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

 Ability to work independently with minimal direction while managing multiple concurrent priorities.

 Strong collaboration skills with the ability to drive alignment across diverse stakeholders.

 Comfortable operating in a dynamic environment focused on governance, consultation, project leadership, innovation, and enterprise risk oversight rather than production underwriting activities.

 Preferred Designations 
 FALU

 FLMI

 Additional designations in risk management, supplemental health, or related disciplines.

 What's in it for you 
 Being a member of the Sun Life family, a group of people united by our Purpose: to help Clients and Employees achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives.

 In 2024, Sun Life ranked among the top 100 most sustainable global corporations by Corporate Knights for the 15th consecutive year, leading Canadian insurers. 

 We are proud to be on the 2024 Best Workplaces in Canada list by Great Place to Work. 

 We’re also listed as one of the Best Workplaces for Women and Best Workplaces with Most Trusted Executive Teams.

 Our unique Sabbatical Program gives you the opportunity to take up to 6 weeks off, every five years.

 Care Days available for self-care or care of others (i.e., family or others you may support) and Sick Days to support your well-being.

 The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results. 

 Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

 Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

 We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

jobs.description:
**Join a Challenger**  

  

At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Serving nearly 4 million Canadians from coast to coast, we offer a wide variety of financial services from banking and lending, to trust and credit union solutions.  

  

We've been at this since 1970, challenging the conventions of traditional banking with smarter, faster, and more connected financial experiences.  

  

**What's kept us moving?** The people behind it all: challengers who ask better questions, push back on old assumptions, and look for a better way forward.  

  

If you're driven to help reshape how banking works for Canadians and the businesses that power our economy, this could be your next big opportunity.  

  

We can’t wait to get to know you!

**The Work**
------------



The Senior Director, Financial Planning and Analysis leads the Bank’s enterprise financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, and management reporting activities and oversees the Financial Planning \& Analysis Centre of Excellence within the VP, Financial Planning \& Analysis portfolio. The role establishes an integrated view of financial performance, outlook, risks, and opportunities to support executive decision\-making and disciplined resource and capital allocation.



The role partners with business and functional leaders to translate strategic priorities into financial plans, challenge assumptions, assess performance drivers, and provide timely, decision\-useful insight. It is accountable for the quality, consistency, governance, and continuous improvement of planning and forecasting processes and for establishing a high\-performing Financial Planning \& Analysis Centre of Excellence that scales common standards, tools, models, data, and insight across the Bank.



### **Financial Planning, Forecasting \& Performance Management**


* Lead the annual budget, periodic forecast, and multi\-year financial planning processes, integrating business plans, economic assumptions, balance sheet and income statement drivers, and enterprise priorities.
* Establish planning calendars, standards, controls, accountabilities, and review forums that support complete, accurate, timely, and comparable submissions across the Bank.
* Provide an integrated view of actual and forecast performance, including revenue, net interest margin, expenses, profitability, return on equity, capital implications, and key non\-financial drivers.
* Lead scenario and sensitivity analysis to assess the financial implications of changing market conditions, strategic choices, investments, and emerging risks.
* Identify material variances, trends, and forecast risks; ensure clear ownership of actions and provide concise recommendations to senior leadership.
### **Capital Forecasting, Strategic Capital Allocation, ICAAP \& Stress Testing**


* Lead enterprise capital forecasting and provide a forward\-looking view of regulatory capital, leverage, capital generation, and deployment under the strategic and financial plan.
* Assess capital capacity, requirements, and trade\-offs to support the allocation of capital to strategic investments, business growth, acquisitions, and other enterprise priorities.
* Partner with Treasury, Risk Management, business leaders, and other Finance teams to align capital forecasts with earnings, balance sheet growth, risk\-weighted assets, funding plans, internal capital targets, and management buffers.
* Lead the consolidation of financial forecasts and capital impacts for the Internal Capital Adequacy Assessment Process, enterprise\-wide stress testing, regulatory stress testing, and related scenario analysis.
* Evaluate adverse but plausible scenarios, key sensitivities, and management actions; identify potential capital constraints or vulnerabilities and recommend actions to protect resilience and support strategic objectives.
* Establish robust governance, controls, documentation, and executive reporting for capital assumptions, methodologies, forecasts, stress\-testing outputs, and capital\-allocation decisions.
### **Executive \& Strategic Financial Storytelling**


* Lead the development and presentation of clear, Board\-ready financial narratives that explain enterprise performance, outlook, key drivers, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
* Translate complex financial, operational, and strategic analysis into concise, decision\-oriented messages tailored to the Board, executive leadership, and management governance forums.
* Provide strategic oversight of consolidated financial results and outlook, ensuring consistency across the income statement, balance sheet, capital, business segments, and key performance indicators.
* Connect actual and forecast performance to the Bank’s strategy, external environment, and value\-creation priorities, highlighting the implications of trends, trade\-offs, and emerging issues.
* Establish executive communication standards that are punchline\-first, analytically sound, and supported by clear evidence, sensitivities, and actionable recommendations.
* Coordinate across Finance, Treasury, Strategy, Investor Relations, Risk Management, and business finance partners to maintain a consistent enterprise financial story across Board, executive, regulatory, and external materials.
### **Management Reporting, Data \& Insight**

* Oversee recurring management reporting and dashboards, ensuring that measures, definitions, commentary, and source data are consistent and decision\-useful.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators and financial drivers that connect strategic objectives, operating activity, and financial outcomes.
* Strengthen data quality, model governance, documentation, controls, and review practices for material planning and management reporting outputs.
* Drive automation and simplification of planning, forecasting, modelling, and reporting processes to improve speed, accuracy, transparency, and analytical capacity.

jobs.title: Lead Automation Developer - Vice President
jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


We are seeking a highly skilled Lead Automation Developer for a fully hands\-on, programmatic engineering role dedicated to architecting, refactoring, and maintaining scalable, distributed test automation frameworks for complex, multi\-tier User Interfaces (UI) and decoupled server\-side microservices. This engineering\-centric position requires treating test suites as first\-class software products, applying rigorous object\-oriented design patterns (such as Page Object Model, Singleton, and Factory patterns) and SOLID design principles to eliminate manual verification bottlenecks and minimize technical debt.


Operating within a high\-velocity Agile Scrum environment, you will collaborate closely as full\-stack automation application developers and with product owners to implement shift\-left testing methodologies, designing testability directly into the system architecture from the earliest stages of the software development lifecycle (SDLC).


A core focus of this role is the integration of advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) utilities to enable self\-healing element locators, accelerate programmatic script generation, and perform predictive analytics on test execution telemetry. Ultimately, you will bridge the gap between development and operations by engineering highly parallelized, deterministic automation pipelines that facilitate continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) with zero\-downtime delivery.

  

  

**Responsibilities:**


* **Framework Architecture \& Design:** Architect, implement, and scale robust, object\-oriented automation frameworks for UI and Server\-side components, prioritizing highly reusable Selenium\-based architectures (e.g., Page Object Model, Page Factory, and BDD\-Cucumber).
* **Hands\-On Programmatic Engineering:** Write clean, maintainable, and production\-grade code to develop complex test automation artifacts, including custom libraries, utility functions, and dynamic test scenarios.
* **Shift\-Left Collaboration:** Collaborate with cross\-functional engineering teams during early\-stage sprint planning and grooming to identify automation requirements, define technical acceptance criteria, and establish robust testability hooks within the application code.
* **Methodology Implementation:** Implement and advocate for Behavior Driven Development (BDD) and Test Driven Development (TDD) methodologies, translating Gherkin feature files into executable step definitions.
* **Server\-Side Validation:** Develop and execute automated validation suites for server\-side components, including RESTful APIs, microservices, and database layers using SQL and NoSQL queries.
* **AI Tool Integration:** Explore, evaluate, and integrate cutting\-edge AI tools and machine learning utilities to enable self\-healing test scripts, automate visual regression, and optimize test coverage.
* **Defect \& Execution Analysis:** Analyze automated execution failures, debug complex script or environment issues, and work closely with development teams to resolve defects rapidly.
  

  

**Recommended Qualifications:**


* 8\-12 years of relevant experience in software development.
* **Programming Languages:** Advanced, hands\-on programming proficiency in core languages including **Java**, **Python**, and **JavaScript/TypeScript**, with a deep understanding of object\-oriented programming (OOP) principles, data structures, and algorithms.
* **Development Tools \& IDEs:** Extensive experience utilizing modern Integrated Development Environments (IDEs), specifically **IntelliJ IDEA**, for writing, debugging, and refactoring clean, high\-quality automation code.
* **AI\-Assisted Development:** Hands\-on experience leveraging AI coding assistants, specifically **GitHub Copilot**, to accelerate script generation, refactor legacy code, and optimize test automation workflows.
* **Professional Experience:** Proven professional experience in a hands\-on software development or automation engineering role, with deep expertise in Selenium WebDriver and associated frameworks.
* **CI/CD Pipeline Integration:** Hands\-on experience configuring, maintaining, and optimizing continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Tekton) to trigger automated test suites.
* **Containerization \& Orchestration:** Experience orchestrating automated regression runs within containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes via pipeline\-as\-code configurations.
* **Version Control:** Strong familiarity with version control systems (Git), branching strategies, and pull request workflows within an enterprise environment.
* **Core Competencies:** Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and technical communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex architectural concepts to diverse stakeholders.
  

  

**Education:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical hands\-on software development experience.
* Master’s degree preferred
  

  

  

This job description provides a high\-level review of the types of work performed. Other job\-related duties may be assigned as required.

Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Your Role

The Director, AI Governance and Adoption is responsible for driving the evolution of the enterprise AI governance framework, and facilitating the responsible adoption of artificial intelligence technologies across the organization. Acting as a strategic partner to executives and business teams, this individual supports the identification of opportunities, the integration of value-creating solutions and the development of an AI-literate culture. The incumbent also oversees the development of the practices, policies and governance mechanisms required to ensure the responsible and sustainable use of artificial intelligence technologies.

Key Responsibilities

Governance, Policy & Risk Management

Define and enforce corporate AI policies, directives, and guardrails across all business units.
Operationalize risk controls and decision accountabilities across the entire AI lifecycle (procurement, data retrieval, tool actions, and human oversight).
Build and maintain a central inventory of all internal and third-party AI assets to track systemic risk.

Shadow AI & Secure Experimentation

Audit unsanctioned AI tools ("shadow AI") across departments and facilitate the transition of use cases into secure enterprise environments.
Partner with tech teams to set safety guardrails for low-code/no-code tools, allowing employees to experiment safely.

Leadership, Committees & Alignment

Lead the AI Usage Oversight Committee and coordinate the enterprise AI Steering Committee.
Align AI initiatives with Legal, Privacy, InfoSec, Data Governance, and Journalistic Standards to ensure regulatory compliance.

Adoption, Enablement & Literacy

Develop training programs, playbooks, office hours, and champion networks to boost organization-wide AI literacy.
Help business units integrate deployed AI solutions into their everyday production workflows.

Workflow Re-Engineering & Value Tracking

Direct a cross-functional "Fusion Team" to help management re-engineer legacy workflows for native AI integration.
Define, track, and report performance and governance metrics to prove ROI and accountability.

Vendor Management & Industry Representation

Advise Procurement and Legal on standards for evaluating and onboarding third-party AI vendors.
Represent the organization (CBC/Radio-Canada) at national and international conferences, contributing to public media data provenance standards.

Internal Governance & Executive Alignment

Senior Advisory: Advise executives on AI strategy, run governance committees, and deliver executive leadership-level briefings when required.
Standards & Training: Roll out AI policies across all departments (Media, Tech, Business) and partner with L&D on staff training and literacy initiatives.

AI Adoption & Change Management

Fusion Team Leadership: Stand up and lead a cross-functional team of change management, training, and process optimization specialists.
Workflow Integration: Work with department heads and staff to resolve workflow pain points and drive adoption of approved AI tools.
Tracking & Reporting: Partner with Innovation Leads to establish ROI metrics and report adoption progress, blockers, and learnings to leadership.

External Relations & Industry Networks

Industry and Peer Collaboration: Partner with media organizations, industry groups (EBU, INMA), and analysts (Gartner) to benchmark best practices.
Thought Leadership: Share CBC/RC case studies and governance frameworks with external and public stakeholders.

What You Bring

Qualifications, experience & skills

7+ years of technology leadership experience, with 3 years of supervisory experience required.
At least 5 years explicitly focused on operationalizing data or technology strategy, machine learning, technology risk management, or corporate governance programs.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required. A degree in Information Technology, Computer Systems Analysis, Engineering, or Management Information Systems is preferred.
Bilingualism (English and French).
Enterprise AI Governance: Proven track record building and managing AI oversight programs, governing models and agentic workflows, and developing policies, audits, and control documentation.

jobs.title: Director, AI Technology Delivery
jobs.description:
Hybrid Work Model

About The Role

As Director, Technology Delivery Lead, you are accountable for the end-to-end technology delivery of Em, BMO InvestorLine's premier AI agent. You will lead the integrated delivery system across AI engineering, wealth platforms, Microsoft Azure, data, architecture, quality engineering, cybersecurity, operations, and third parties to deliver safe, resilient, scalable, and measurable client outcomes.

You will operate as the principal technology counterpart to the Product Owner for Em. Together, you are jointly accountable for overall delivery: the Product Owner leads product vision, client value, priorities, and acceptance; the Technology Delivery Lead owns the integrated technology plan, engineering execution, technical quality, production readiness, and predictable delivery. This role is not a program coordination position. It is a hands-on senior technology leadership role with clear decision rights and accountability for outcomes.

Mandate and Decision Rights

Own the integrated technology delivery plan for Em from discovery and architecture through build, evaluation, release, operation, and continuous improvement.
Jointly commit scope, sequencing, release outcomes, and delivery forecasts with the Product Owner, balancing client value, technical feasibility, risk, cost, and capacity.
Make or escalate timely technology delivery decisions across architecture, engineering, environments, data, integration, testing, controls, and production readiness.
Hold delivery teams and partners accountable for agreed outcomes, quality standards, dependencies, and evidence-based release criteria.
Protect the product from unmanaged technical debt, fragmented ownership, late-stage controls, and delivery practices that are not fit for AI.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-End Technology Delivery
Lead delivery across multiple cross-functional product and platform teams, establishing one integrated plan, clear critical path, transparent dependencies, and accountable owners.
Convert the product roadmap into executable technology increments, release plans, capacity models, milestones, and outcome-based commitments.
Drive delivery discipline across scope, schedule, cost, quality, resources, risk, and benefits, using forecasts rather than artificial certainty.
Identify constraints early, remove impediments, resolve cross-team trade-offs, and escalate decisions with clear options and recommendations.
Ensure each release has explicit entry, exit, acceptance, operational readiness, and rollback criteria.
AI Engineering and AI SDLC Leadership
Apply deep knowledge of generative AI and agentic systems, including LLM orchestration, tool use, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt and context engineering, evaluations, guardrails, memory, and human oversight.
Embed full-lifecycle AI SDLC practices across requirements, design, build, test, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and model or prompt change management.
Ensure AI quality is measured using fit-for-purpose evaluations covering safety, groundedness, relevance, accuracy, latency, reliability, and client experience.
Champion specification-driven development, automation, reusable engineering patterns, and AI-assisted software delivery where approved.
Ensure deterministic software testing and probabilistic AI evaluation are integrated into CI/CD and release decisions.
Azure, Architecture and Platform Integration
Provide senior technical leadership for solutions deployed on Microsoft Azure and integrated with BMO InvestorLine and Wealth Management platforms.
Partner with solution, enterprise, security, data, and platform architects to maintain an approved, scalable target architecture and prevent local optimization or avoidable technical debt.
Ensure APIs, event flows, data services, identity, access, observability, resilience, and non-functional requirements are designed and delivered end to end.
Drive environment readiness, infrastructure as code, automated deployment, telemetry, performance engineering, capacity planning, disaster recovery, and production support readiness.
Promote reuse of enterprise AI capabilities, shared services, patterns, and controls while preserving clear service boundaries and ownership.
Advanced Agile and Value-Stream Delivery
Establish and continuously improve an advanced Agile operating model organized around persistent, cross-functional teams and measurable client or business outcomes.
Lead portfolio and product-level planning, backlog readiness, dependency management, release forecasting, and flow optimization across multiple teams.
Use evidence-based metrics such as lead time, cycle time, throughput, work in progress, predictability, escaped defects, reliability, evaluation performance, and value realization.
Reduce handoffs, unnecessary governance, meeting load, and blocked work; create fast decision paths and clear single-point accountability.
Coach delivery leaders, Scrum Masters, engineering leads, and teams in modern product delivery, DevSecOps, continuous delivery, and learning-driven retrospectives.
Quality, Risk and Responsible AI
Build quality, privacy, security, regulatory compliance, model risk, accessibility, and responsible AI requirements into delivery from inception, not as release-end checkpoints.
Partner with Legal, Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Model Risk, Data Governance, and Technology Risk to establish proportionate controls and auditable evidence.
Ensure full-spectrum observability across application, infrastructure, data, model, prompt, agent, safety, and client-experience performance.
Lead incident response, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and learning reviews for technology or AI quality events.
Maintain transparent risk, issue, dependency, and decision records and ensure material risks are escalated promptly.
Stakeholder, Financial and Partner Leadership
Serve as the senior technology delivery voice for Em with InvestorLine, Wealth, Technology & Operations, Applied AI, governance partners, and executive forums.
Provide concise, fact-based reporting on outcomes, delivery confidence, risks, financials, quality, and decisions required.
Own technology delivery financial stewardship, resource planning, vendor performance, commercial dependencies, and delivery commitments.
Lead co-build and vendor engagements with clear accountability, knowledge transfer, architecture compliance, security obligations, and measurable outcomes.
Create an inclusive, high-accountability environment that develops leaders, strengthens technical depth, and keeps teams focused on client outcomes.

Key Success Measures

Predictable delivery of roadmap outcomes and releases, with transparent forecast accuracy and controlled scope change.
Measurable improvement in delivery flow, engineering productivity, automation, quality, and time to value.
AI evaluation thresholds and non-functional requirements met before release and sustained in production.
Stable, secure, resilient production performance with effective observability, incident management, and continuous improvement.
Clear ownership, faster decisions, fewer cross-team handoffs, and effective dependency resolution.
Measurable client adoption, experience, business value, and risk outcomes delivered in partnership with the Product Owner.
Effective financial, capacity, vendor, and technical-debt management.

Required Skills And Competencies

Expert-level technology delivery leadership in large, complex, regulated environments, with accountability for multiple teams and production outcomes.
Deep practical knowledge of AI/ML and generative AI delivery, including agentic architectures, LLM application patterns, evaluations, guardrails, observability, and responsible AI controls.
Strong knowledge of wealth management and digital investing platforms, including client journeys, advice or guidance experiences, market and portfolio data, trading-related integrations, and regulatory considerations.
Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Azure cloud architecture and delivery, cloud-native engineering, APIs, integration, identity and access, data services, telemetry, resilience, and DevSecOps.
Mastery of advanced Agile, product operating models, value-stream management, Lean flow, Scrum or Kanban, portfolio planning, CI/CD, test automation, and evidence-based delivery metrics.
Ability to challenge constructively, make decisions under ambiguity, translate technical complexity into business implications, and influence senior executives.
Commercial and financial acumen, including technology investment, capacity, vendor, contract, and delivery-performance management.
Exceptional leadership, communication, facilitation, negotiation, and talent-development skills.

Qualifications And Experience

15+ years of progressive experience in technology delivery, engineering, architecture, platform, or product technology leadership, including senior leadership accountability.
Demonstrated success delivering enterprise-scale digital products or platforms from strategy through production and ongoing operation.
Demonstrated delivery of AI/ML or generative AI solutions in production, ideally involving multi-agent systems or other complex AI-enabled client experiences.
Significant experience with Microsoft Azure and modern software engineering practices in a regulated enterprise.
Experience in wealth management, brokerage, digital investing, banking, or similarly regulated financial services is strongly preferred.
Proven experience leading cross-functional internal and partner teams through complex dependencies and high-stakes releases.
University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems; relevant advanced degree or certifications are considered assets.

Leadership Expectations

Act as an owner: accountable for outcomes, not activity or coordination alone.
Put clients, safety, quality, and sustainable value ahead of pace without evidence.
Create clarity: make responsibilities, decisions, risks, dependencies, and delivery confidence visible.
Lead with technical credibility while empowering engineering and product leaders closest to the work.
Build trust through candour, transparency, inclusion, disciplined follow-through, and continuous learning.

Job Description

What is the Opportunity?

This is an opportunity to lead the Data, AI, KYC and Specialized Business portfolio within RBC Caribbean Banking Technology, a team dedicated to delivering modern, resilient solutions for our Caribbean businesses and clients. We are all in on Agile delivery, DevOps, open source, cloud and modern engineering practices, and the work is highly visible: our applications are used daily by RBC staff and clients across the region.

Reporting to the Senior Director, the Director owns three connected mandates. First, the modernization of the Caribbean data foundation: evolving the data lake, data architecture and data products so that the business can trust and use its data. Second, AI engineering: building and operating production grade AI solutions for clients and colleagues, from generative and agentic AI to intelligent automation, with responsible AI and regulatory controls built in. Third, software development and delivery for KYC and Specialized Business Applications: leading the engineering team accountable for a portfolio of vendor applications and for active development of the KYC platform, and delivering the associated project portfolio on time and with quality.

The successful candidate combines hands on technical credibility in data and AI engineering with proven project delivery, vendor management and people leadership, and a clear understanding of the banking industry’s data, processes and regulatory obligations. They are comfortable navigating ambiguity and leading in a fast paced, rapidly evolving technology environment.

What Will You Do?

Data modernization and data foundation

Own end to end delivery of data engineering and data product initiatives for the Caribbean, working closely with business and technology stakeholders to define scope, priorities and expectations.
Lead the data modernization roadmap and architecture, retire legacy data flows, and establish the platform as the standard foundation for analytics, reporting, consolidation of siloed data, removal of duplicated data profiles, and AI solutions.
Establish and enforce data governance practices (data dictionary, lineage, quality and access controls) that meet regulatory and audit expectations across Caribbean jurisdictions.
Mature CI/CD and orchestration for data pipelines, with automated testing, monitoring and service level objectives for production data.
Partner with business lines to define data products and self service capabilities that create measurable value.

AI engineering and AI solutions

Define, communicate and execute the AI solutions roadmap for Caribbean applications, aligned to the business vision and to emerging AI capabilities (generative AI, agentic AI, large language models, intelligent process automation).
Build and grow an AI engineering practice: design, develop, deploy and operate production ready AI solutions for clients and colleagues, well integrated with existing Caribbean systems and data infrastructure.
Establish the engineering foundations for AI at scale: reusable patterns for LLM integration, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), agent orchestration, evaluation and testing frameworks, prompt and context management, and an AI asset registry with versioning.
Lead operational support for AI solutions in production: monitoring and observability, incident management, logging, performance tuning, drift and quality detection, and AIOps.
Champion ethical and responsible AI: ensure all initiatives comply with RBC policies and regulatory requirements applicable to banking in Canada and the Caribbean (e.g., OSFI guidance, model risk management, privacy legislation), and partner with Risk, Compliance and Legal on approvals.
Stay abreast of AI advancements, evaluate their applicability to the Caribbean banking context, and act as an internal thought leader on applied AI.

Software development and delivery: KYC and Specialized Business Applications

Lead the software development team accountable for a portfolio of vendor applications supporting Specialized Business functions, including release management, configuration, integration, upgrades, incident response and production support.
Lead active development of the KYC platform: own the backlog, architecture direction, engineering quality, security and delivery cadence, in close partnership with AML/Compliance and Operations stakeholders.
Manage vendor relationships and service ownership: contracts and SLAs, roadmap alignment, escalations and performance reviews.
Deliver the project portfolio through disciplined Agile delivery (planning, dependency and risk management, status reporting and executive communication) with accountability for scope, schedule, budget and quality.
Embed modern engineering practices (DevOps, automation, CI/CD, automated testing) to improve resilience, reduce operational risk and cost, and strengthen security and availability.
Ensure disaster recovery, uptime and resilience for all production systems in the portfolio.

Leadership and stakeholder engagement

Lead, mentor and grow a high performing, cross regional team of data engineers, AI engineers and software developers across Toronto and the Caribbean, fostering technical excellence, collaboration and continuous improvement.
Own talent acquisition, performance management, career development and retention for the team.
Collaborate with Caribbean business leaders, product managers and technology partners to understand requirements, define scope and manage expectations; communicate clearly at senior levels.
Contribute to the Senior Director’s broader technology strategy and represent the portfolio in governance forums.

What do you need to succeed?

Must hav
e

10+ years of progressive experience across data engineering, software development and/or AI engineering, with 8+ years in a leadership role managing engineers and delivery teams, with a strong emphasis on production delivery and operations.
Proven experience working within the banking or financial services industry, with a clear understanding of its data, processes, regulatory context and business challenges.
Demonstrated track record of delivering large scale, multi project programs in complex enterprise environments, including Agile delivery, dependency mitigation, budget and vendor management.
Hands on AI engineering skills and proven experience building AI solutions from concept to production: LLM integration, RAG, agent frameworks, evaluation and testing, and AI observability.
Strong experience with modern data architecture and cloud data platforms (e.g., data lake and medallion architectures, Databricks or equivalent, Spark, streaming such as Kafka, and orchestration).
Experience managing a portfolio of vendor applications alongside internal development, including production support and incident management.
Exceptional leadership, mentorship and team building abilities; outstanding communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills, including with senior executives.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related quantitative field.

Nice to have

Experience with KYC, AML or onboarding platforms and related regulatory obligations.
Experience leading distributed or cross regional teams; familiarity with Caribbean or international banking.
Knowledge of data engineering tools.
Master’s degree in a related field.
Adaptability, critical thinking and a growth mindset; a team contributor who cares about team members.

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. jobs.title: Vice President Finance
jobs.description:
GlassRatner Executive Search is partnering with eTracks Tire Management Systems (eTracks) to appoint its next Vice President, Finance.

eTracks is a leading Producer Responsibility Organization (PRO) responsible for managing tire recycling programs on behalf of tire producers across Ontario. Established in 2017 under the Canada Not-for-Profit Corporations Act, the company was created by the Tire and Rubber Association of Canada (TRAC) to support compliance with Ontario's Resource Recovery and Circular Economy Act (RRCEA).

Today, eTracks plays a critical role in advancing Ontario's circular economy by overseeing the collection, transportation, and recycling of used tires through a network of service providers. As a mission-driven organization, eTracks combines the purpose of a not-for-profit with the complexity and scale of a commercial enterprise.

As the organization enters its next phase of transformation, eTracks is seeking a strategic, forward-thinking Vice President, Finance to join its Senior Leadership Team.

The Mandate

The Vice President, Finance will serve as a strategic partner to the CEO and Senior Leadership Team, ensuring the organization has the financial insight, discipline, and operational support necessary to achieve its long-term objectives. Building on a strong financial foundation, the VP, Finance will help drive organizational performance, strengthen decision-making through data and analytics, support key strategic initiatives, and enhance overall business effectiveness.

This role is ideal for a finance leader who combines financial rigour with commercial acumen, an operational mindset, and the ability to navigate a complex stakeholder community in a highly regulated industry.

The Opportunity

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Vice President, Finance will serve as the organization's senior financial leader and a trusted advisor on strategic, operational, and financial matters. This role offers the opportunity to contribute well beyond traditional finance leadership, helping shape organizational strategy, evaluate business opportunities, support long term growth initiatives, and improve overall organizational performance.

The successful candidate will work closely with the CEO, Board of Directors, and Finance, Audit and Investment Committee (FAIC), providing financial leadership, business insight, and sound judgment across the organization.

The VP, Finance will oversee all aspects of financial management, including financial planning and analysis, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, treasury, risk management, governance, and
compliance. They will play a key role in enhancing management reporting and business intelligence capabilities, supporting technology and systems initiatives, and driving continuous improvement across financial and operational processes. In addition, the VP, Finance will lead and develop the finance team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and high performance.

To be considered for the role, you will possess the following:

University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related discipline
CPA designation required
10 years of experience in senior-level finance or accounting leadership roles
Track record as the senior finance executive within a small-to-mid-sized organization, both in a hands-on and strategic capacity
Experience from supply chain and logistics industry, waste management, environmental services or process manufacturing ideal
Experience operating within regulated environments highly preferred
Demonstrated success partnering directly with a CEO and Board of Directors
Team management and leadership, coaching, developing and mentoring a high performing team
Deep expertise in financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, reporting, internal controls, and business analysis
Experience leading ERP implementations, systems optimization initiatives, technology-enabled transformations, or major change projects enterprise-wide
Exceptional levels of integrity, diplomacy, strong negotiation skills, accountability and delivery mindset

This is an opportunity to play a key leadership role in a respected organization at the intersection of sustainability, business services, and public policy at the forefront of the circular economy. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to influence strategy, identify opportunities for continuous improvements and drive transformation initiatives, and help shape the future of an organization making a meaningful environmental impact across Ontario.

Please apply directly and in confidence. We are excited to discuss this exceptional opportunity.

jobs.title: Vice President, Finance
jobs.description:
Who we are

Kilmer Group is a multi-generational platform for business development and investment, built on operational excellence, long-term stewardship, and trusted relationships. Headquartered in Toronto, we invest across three core sectors: Private Equity, Infrastructure & Real Estate, and Sports & Media, partnering with exceptional management teams to build and grow enduring businesses.

Kilmer Group has built a reputation for disciplined investment, active ownership, and creating long-term value. Our approach is grounded in partnership, integrity, and a commitment to building businesses that generate lasting impact for our partners, stakeholders, and the communities we serve.

Who we need

Reporting to the CFO, we are hiring a Vice President, Finance to play a key leadership role across Kilmer Group's finance function. As our new Vice President, Finance, you will combine financial stewardship with strategic partnership, helping guide decisions that support the continued growth and evolution of a diversified investment platform. Working closely with the CFO, senior leaders, and investment teams, you will oversee financial reporting, treasury, budgeting, investment portfolio reporting, and governance while providing the financial insight that supports investment decisions, business performance, and long-term value creation. You will lead a finance team and contribute across a broad range of initiatives, from evaluating acquisitions and investments to strengthening reporting, improving processes, and building the financial capabilities and infrastructure needed to support the organization's continued growth.

This is an existing, full-time opportunity based in the Toronto office, working onsite five days per week.

What’s in it for you?

Strategic influence. Reporting directly to the CFO, you will act as a trusted partner to the executive leadership team, contributing financial insight that informs investment decisions, capital allocation, and the long-term direction of Kilmer Group.

Breadth and exposure. This is an opportunity to apply your expertise across a diverse investment portfolio rather than within a single operating business. You will work on initiatives spanning financial reporting, tax, budgeting, long-term forecasting, governance, and business performance.

Build what's next. Technology and AI are transforming the finance function, and Kilmer Group is evolving with it - strengthening reporting, deepening financial analysis, and modernizing our processes to harness these new tools. You will help build new capabilities, grow a high-performing team, and shape a financial foundation built for long-term success.

As our new VP Finance, you will

Lead the finance function.
You will oversee accounting, treasury, financial reporting, and cash management across a complex, multi-entity organization, ensuring strong controls, effective budgeting, and timely, accurate reporting. As a trusted partner to the CFO, you will provide the financial leadership and operational oversight that enables the team to deliver with confidence while supporting the organization's growth objectives.
Provide strategic financial insight.
You will translate financial information into meaningful analysis that supports executive decision-making. Working closely with the CFO and senior leaders, you will develop reporting and insights that strengthen planning, support investment decisions, and provide a clearer understanding of business performance across the organization.
Support investments and corporate growth.
You will partner with the investment team on acquisitions, portfolio reporting, valuations, due diligence, and other strategic initiatives. You will work closely with leaders across Kilmer Group and its portfolio companies, providing financial guidance and building trusted relationships that support long-term value creation.
Lead and develop the team.
You will mentor, coach, and support the continued growth of the finance team while fostering a collaborative, accountable, and low-ego environment. You will build capability and create opportunities for continuous learning amongst the team.

You bring

The leadership.
You have experience leading high-performing finance teams and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. You are a trusted advisor who can balance strategic priorities with operational execution while building strong relationships across the organization.
The foundation.
You are a CPA, CA with experience gained in both public accounting and industry, ideally including a Big 4 audit environment. You bring strong technical knowledge of ASPE and IFRS, investment holding company accounting, including asset valuations and investee reporting. You have experience with compliance and risk to ensure adherence with tax laws, accounting standards and internal controls. You know how to apply this technical foundation in a commercial environment, combining accounting expertise with sound strategic and business judgment.
The financial expertise.
You bring experience across financial reporting, treasury, budgeting, cash management, tax and corporate governance within complex organizations. You have worked with investment portfolios, valuations, transactions, or corporate development activities and are comfortable partnering with senior leaders to support investment decisions and long-term value creation.
The analytical mindset.
You are naturally curious and continuously look for ways to improve how work gets done. You leverage data and technology to strengthen reporting and decision-making, and you are excited by the opportunity to modernize finance through automation and the thoughtful application of AI.
The communication skills.
You can translate complex financial information into clear recommendations that support decision-making. Whether working with executives, portfolio company leaders, auditors, or external advisors, you build credibility through sound judgment, strong communication, and a collaborative approach.

Why join Kilmer Group?

Today, Kilmer Group continues to build on decades of successful investment and business leadership offering a dynamic and supportive environment with opportunities for growth and development. Beyond our investments, we are committed to strengthening the communities where we live and work through initiatives that support sport, health, research, and community development. Joining Kilmer Group means becoming part of an organization that thinks for the long term, values partnership, and is committed to building a lasting legacy.

Join us

We recognize that no candidate brings every qualification to a role. If your experience is closely aligned with what we are looking for and you are excited by the opportunity to contribute to Kilmer Group, we encourage you to apply. We look forward to learning more about your experience and the perspective you would bring to our team.

What you can expect from our interview process

A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining Kilmer Group and your experience. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
An in-person conversation with the Chief Financial Officer to discuss your leadership experience, your approach to building high-performing finance functions, and how you partner with executives to support investment decisions and long-term growth.
An in-person presentation and discussion with the Vice President, Talent and Special Projects and a senior member of the finance team. You will be asked to prepare and present a case study, followed by a conversation about your thinking, priorities, and leadership approach.
A final in-person conversation with the Chief Financial Officer to explore mutual fit, discuss your vision for the role, and answer any remaining questions. Finalists may also have the opportunity to meet additional members of the leadership team.

Kilmer Group is committed to creating a workplace where people are treated with respect, supported in their development, and empowered to contribute their best work. We recognize that diverse perspectives strengthen our business and help us make better decisions for our organization, our partners, and the communities in which we operate.

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and are committed to providing an accessible recruitment process. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

jobs.title: Director of Data Management and Business Intelligence
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Data Management and Business Intelligence based in Canada.

This is a senior leadership opportunity to shape enterprise-wide data strategy, governance, architecture, and business intelligence in a complex, safety-critical environment.

You will establish trusted data foundations that help leaders and operational teams make better, faster decisions.

The role spans aviation operations, MRO, engineering, supply chain, finance, safety, quality, HR, commercial programs, and executive management.

You will lead the evolution of enterprise data platforms, with a strong focus on data quality, integration, security, and scalable BI.

You will also guide advanced analytics and AI initiatives, ensuring they are governed, measurable, and aligned with operational needs.

Working closely with senior stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams, you will build capabilities, develop talent, and drive enterprise adoption.

The role offers broad ownership and the opportunity to directly influence operational readiness, performance, compliance, and long-term growth.

Accountabilities

Define enterprise data strategy: Partner with the CIO and senior leaders to establish a multi-year data management and BI strategy aligned with business priorities, technology roadmaps, investment plans, and operational requirements.
Build the data operating model: Establish clear ownership, stewardship, decision rights, architecture standards, delivery practices, and support responsibilities across corporate and regional teams.
Lead data governance: Develop policies and standards covering data ownership, classification, quality, lineage, retention, residency, access, archival, and acceptable use.
Improve data quality: Establish authoritative data sources, common business definitions, quality controls, issue-management processes, and scorecards across critical operational and corporate data domains.
Protect sensitive information: Work with cybersecurity, legal, privacy, export compliance, quality, and security teams to ensure data is appropriately classified, protected, accessed, and shared.
Shape enterprise data architecture: Define architecture for ingestion, integration, master and reference data, lakehouse or warehouse platforms, semantic models, metadata, reporting, monitoring, and reusable data products.
Modernize data integration: Establish secure integration patterns for ERP, MRO, finance, supply chain, engineering, and other enterprise systems using APIs, event-based interfaces, ETL/ELT pipelines, and controlled data exchange.
Strengthen aviation and MRO data: Lead data remediation and governance for maintenance and ERP environments, improving the integrity of aircraft configuration, component history, maintenance plans, technical records, work orders, defects, and inventory information.
Develop performance intelligence: Lead executive, operational, and functional dashboards and establish consistent performance measures covering fleet readiness, maintenance, supply chain, safety, customers, workforce, programs, and financial performance.
Enable self-service analytics: Build governed data products and semantic models that allow business users to access reliable insights without creating uncontrolled copies of sensitive information.
Advance analytics and AI: Identify and govern use cases including predictive maintenance, component reliability, inventory optimization, demand forecasting, anomaly detection, and program risk monitoring, with appropriate ownership, data quality, human oversight, and security controls.
Lead and develop teams: Build a multidisciplinary organization across data governance, architecture, engineering, BI, and analytics while developing talent, succession plans, and critical capabilities.
Manage vendors and investments: Oversee external partners, technology platforms, budgets, licensing, service levels, risks, and total cost of ownership.
Communicate with leadership: Present data risks, investment priorities, architectural decisions, progress, tradeoffs, and measurable business value clearly to executives and non-technical stakeholders.

Requirements

Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data engineering, analytics, business, engineering, or a related discipline; a graduate degree or relevant professional certification is an asset.
Leadership experience: At least 10 years of progressive experience across data management, analytics, BI, enterprise applications, or data architecture, including at least five years leading teams or major cross-functional programs.
Industry experience: Experience in aerospace, defense, aviation, MRO, or another highly regulated and asset-intensive industry is strongly preferred.
ERP/MRO expertise: Demonstrated experience improving data quality and reporting within complex ERP or MRO environments; experience with Ramco is a significant asset, while comparable aviation or enterprise platforms are also relevant.
International experience: Experience operating across multiple countries, legal entities, or security domains, particularly Canada and the United States, is preferred.
Data expertise: Strong knowledge of enterprise data architecture, dimensional and semantic modeling, master data management, metadata, data quality, lineage, SQL, APIs, and ETL/ELT integration.
Cloud and BI technologies: Hands-on understanding of modern cloud data platforms and BI solutions; experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Power BI, and related Microsoft data services is preferred.
Aviation data knowledge: Familiarity with maintenance and supply-chain data, including serialized components, aircraft configuration, maintenance planning, technical records, reliability, and inventory transactions.
Regulatory knowledge: Familiarity with aviation regulatory and quality environments such as Transport Canada, FAA, EASA, safety management systems, and AS9100 is an asset.
Security and compliance: Working knowledge of information classification, access control, auditability, privacy, data residency, the Canadian Controlled Goods Program, ITAR/EAR, CUI safeguards, CMMC, and NIST SP 800-171 as applicable.
Security eligibility: Ability to obtain and maintain the security clearances, controlled-goods eligibility, and customer or program authorizations required for the position.
Business leadership: Strong judgment connecting data investments to safety, operational readiness, contract delivery, customer commitments, and financial performance.
Communication: Ability to explain data limitations, security requirements, architectural decisions, and complex technical concepts to executives, operational leaders, technical specialists, and front-line users.
Program management: Proven ability to manage priorities, budgets, vendors, dependencies, risks, and organizational change in complex environments.
Collaboration: Strong influencing and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams without relying solely on formal authority.
Languages: Professional fluency in English is required; French and additional languages are considered assets.

Benefits

Full-time, remote position based in Canada.
Flexible work schedule.
Attractive benefits package.
Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
Multidisciplinary and multicultural collaboration across local and international teams.
Opportunity to work on enterprise-level data, BI, analytics, and AI initiatives with significant operational impact.
A collaborative environment emphasizing service, integrity, excellence, and teamwork.
Role requiring Level II Canadian government security clearance and eligibility for the Canadian Controlled Goods Program.

Strategy, Growth & Market Leadership
